text.title: 拉克维的食物
text.objectives: 找到拉克维刚刚猎杀的动物的尸体，从尸体上偷取一块蛇颈龙肉块。
text.description: 很久以前，我的一个兄弟从拉克维的猎物身上拿了一些肉。他那时并不知道拉克维就潜伏在丛林中看着他。拉克维跟踪了我的兄弟好几天，毁灭了他碰过的一切。我的兄弟吓坏了，最终他决定从安戈洛逃走，彻底甩开拉克维。$B$B拉克维就在这附近杀死了他。$B$B如果你想激怒拉克维，就去寻找它刚刚杀死的猎物，并从尸体上取一些肉。$B$B从西边开始搜寻它的踪迹吧。
text.progress: 不要对我说的话心不在焉，$N。如果你真想面对这头野兽，那你就必须非常小心……而且非常聪明。要想引出拉克维并打败它，你必须拥有超群的力量和观察力。
text.completion: 很好，$N。看起来拉克维这些天来吃得不错。不过令我感到奇怪的是，它是在哪里找到蛇颈龙的?这真奇怪。$B$B不管怎样，我们还是先把注意力集中在拉克维身上吧。不要担心我的安全─我相信你已经触怒了拉克维，它在品尝你的血肉之前是不会杀死我的。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Torwa Pathfinder at Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: The Fare of Lar'korwi
english.objectives: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass.
english.description: Once, a long time ago, a brother of mine took some meat from one of Lar'korwi's kills. He didn't know it at the time, but Lar'korwi saw him from the forest. Lar'korwi followed my brother for days, destroying everything he touched. My brother, scared, finally decided to run from the Crater and leave Lar'korwi behind.$B$BLar'korwi killed him not far from this spot.$B$BIf you want to provoke Lar'korwi, find a fresh kill of his and take some of the meat from it.$B$BStart your search to the west.
english.progress: Do not take my words lightly, $n. If you truly wish to face this creature, then you must be careful... and smart. It will take a great deal of strength and insight to draw out Lar'korwi and defeat him.
english.completion: This will do nicely, $n. It seems Lar'korwi eats well these days. Although, I wonder where he found a threshadon in this area. Odd. Regardless, I will hold onto this until you are ready for your confrontation with the beast. Do not worry for my safety--I am sure you've angered Lar'korwi enough that he will not kill me until after he's tasted your flesh.
english.completed: Return to Torwa Pathfinder at Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 拉克维的气味
text.objectives: 收集2份暴掠龙信息素。
text.description: 它居然没有来攻击你，这让我感到很惊讶。但是不要紧，我有个计划可以让那头野兽出来。$B$B作为这块区域的领袖，拉克维有权与任何雌性暴掠龙交配——而且它确实这么做了。你可以在这里的西边找到许多暴掠龙蛋，靠近它们，这时就会有雌性暴掠龙跑出来攻击你。这些雌性暴掠龙头上有一种腺体，它所散发出的味道可以告诉雄性暴掠龙：它准备进行交配了。给我带两个这样的腺体回来。
text.progress: 小心，$N。靠近任何恐龙蛋的行动都必定会引来它们的母亲……即使你做好了准备也要万分小心。那些雌性暴掠龙和拉克维一样致命，它们会拼死保护自己的蛋。但是，如果你成功了，我们就一定有办法把拉克维从它的藏身之处引出来。
text.completion: 啊，很不错，$N。你找到的这两个腺体中的资讯素可以轻松地把拉克维引出来。你很快就要与它正面较量了，拉克维拥有像刀刃一样锋利的爪子，当你看到它的眼睛时，你就会知道什麽是死亡。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Torwa Pathfinder at Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: The Scent of Lar'korwi
english.objectives: Obtain 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands.
english.description: I'm actually surprised he has not come for you yet, $N. But all is well, for I have a final plan that will bring the monster to us.$B$BBeing the dominant male gives Lar'korwi rights to breed with any female he chooses--and he chooses many of them. You'll find many ravasaur eggs to the west of here. Get close to them and you should provoke an attack by his mates. The females produce an awful smell from a gland in their heads that allow males to know they are ready to breed. Bring me two of those glands.
english.progress: Be careful, $n. Getting close to any nest of eggs surely will provoke the mothers... even if you've already secured a gland from one. The mothers can be just as deadly as Lar'korwi himself when they fight to protect their young. But, if you are successful, then we shall have a definitive way of bringing Lar'korwi out from hiding.
english.completion: Ah, fine specimens, $n. The two pieces you've found should be perfect for baiting Lar'korwi into the open. I cannot wait to see the outcome of your fight with the monster. He is a massive thing with claws as sharp as the finest blades. You will look into his eyes and you will know death.
english.completed: Return to Torwa Pathfinder at Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 拉克维的诱饵
text.objectives: 使用托尔瓦的麻袋中的东西召唤拉克维并打败它。将拉克维的头颅交给安戈洛环形山入口处的托尔瓦·寻路者。
text.description: 这将是整个计划中最困难的部分，因为它有点复杂。沿着河流一直向北走，寻找河水转向的地方。那是我最后一次看到拉克维的地方。那里应该散落着大型野兽的残骸，所以你很容易判断自己的位置是否正确。$B$B带上这块肉，把它放在那儿。然后在肉上涂抹我配制的这种液体。$B$B如果这两样东西加起来还不能使拉克维现身的话，我想也没什么东西能把它引诱出来了。
text.progress: Do not let fear overpower you, $n. Fear is the great betrayer... you must remain strong!
text.completion: 大地之母会很高兴的!你成功了!你在公平的较量中战胜了它，$N。你证明了自己是个合格的猎手，你拥有坚强的意志，无与伦比的勇气，以及强大的力量。我敬佩你精湛的技艺。$B$B并不是每个冒险者都能完成这样令人难以置信的壮举，恭喜你。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Torwa Pathfinder at Un'Goro Crater.
text.giverWindow: If there's one thing Lar'korwi likes more than meat, it's the ladies.

english.title: The Bait for Lar'korwi
english.objectives: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan.  Continue following the river to the north, and look for a bend in the river.  It was here I saw Lar'korwi last.  You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby.$b$bTake the meat you recovered and place it there.  Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat.$b$bIf both lures mingled together do not bring Lar'korwi to you, then I know nothing else that will.
english.progress: Do not let fear overpower you, $n. Fear is the great betrayer... you must remain strong!
english.completion: The Earth Mother be praised! You've done it! Fair play to you, $n. You have proven to be a great hunter in your own right. Your spirit is strong. Your bravery unmatched. And your strength has been fortified. I bow down to your skills. Only the greatest of my ancestors could have accomplished something so incredible. Congratulations.
english.completed: Return to Torwa Pathfinder at Un'Goro Crater.
english.giverWindow: If there's one thing Lar'korwi likes more than meat, it's the ladies.

text.title: 走丢了！
text.objectives: 在火羽山寻找林格的下落。
text.description: 你一定要帮帮我，$N！我的朋友林格去了北面的火山探险，我已经很久没有他的消息了。我真的很担心他。$B$B你能去寻找他的下落吗？带上我的水壶吧——如果你找到林格的话，我相信他会用得着的！
text.progress: Ringo's sack rests on the rock in front of you.
text.completion: You find what appears to be Ringo's belongings.  If he left these here, he can't have gone far away.  Maybe you should look for him.
text.completed: Find signs of Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

english.title: Lost!
english.objectives: Find signs of Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.
english.description: You've got to help me, $N! My friend, Ringo left earlier to explore the volcano to the north of here, and he has been gone way too long. I am really worried about him.$B$BDo you think you could find him? Why don't you take my canteen with you -- if you do find Ringo, I'm sure he'll need it!
english.progress: Ringo's sack rests on the rock in front of you.
english.completion: You find what appears to be Ringo's belongings.  If he left these here, he can't have gone far away.  Maybe you should look for him.
english.completed: Find signs of Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

text.title: 朋友的帮助
text.objectives: 把林格带回马绍尔哨站的斯普拉格·弗劳克身边。$B$B如果林格变得虚弱，就抽他耳光，如果林格晕倒了，就用斯普拉格的水壶让他恢复。
text.description: 啊……太热了……$B$B我正在探索这片地域，突然之间，我就热得昏了过去，我一定是中暑了。$B$B求求你，带我回到马绍尔哨站的朋友斯普拉格那里去，我想我还可以坚持到走回去……$B$B我感觉有些不对劲，如果我有些神志模糊，你就把我抽醒，如果我又晕倒了，就用斯普拉格的水壶里给我洒点水。我希望这能有点用……
text.completion: 林格的情况并不好，$N，但我很高兴他能活着回来!$B$B谢谢你找到他。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Stand.

english.title: A Little Help From My Friends
english.objectives: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Stand.$B$BIf Ringo feels weak, slap him.  If he faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.
english.description: Ugh... It's so hot...$B$BI was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.$B$BPlease, help me get back to my friend Spraggle at Marshal's Stand. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.$B$BI am feeling a little out of it, so you can slap me if I'm feeling woozy.  If I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from Spraggle's canteen. That should work, I hope...
english.completion: Ringo's not in the best shape, $n, but I am glad to have him back in one piece! Thank you for finding him.
english.completed: Return to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 希兹尔的飞行器
text.objectives: 收集35块精细的翼手龙鳞片。
text.description: 我正在做一架飞行器！$B$B我被困在了这里，而且不敢轻易出去。如果我走出这里的话，肯定会迷路的，但是如果使用飞行器，我就可以轻松地回到加基森去。$B$B那么，你愿意帮助我吗？我现在只剩下机翼没有完成了，我想西边尖啸河滩那里的翼手龙的鳞片会是非常合适的材料。我自己是不可能去搞到这些鳞片的，但是你看上去好像有两把刷子。为什么你不帮我找找呢？
text.progress: 每个伟大的交通工具都需要有个名字……我想我会叫它……双翼飞行器!
text.completion: 太好了，这些鳞片非常合适。我想我一定可以用这些鳞片让我的机器飞起来!谢谢你!
text.completed: Return to Shizzle at Mossy Pile.

english.title: Shizzle's Flyer
english.objectives: Collect 35 Webbed Pterrordax Scales.
english.description: I'm making a flying machine!$B$BI got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.$B$BSo, will you help me? All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax in the Screaming Reaches to the west would be perfect. There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. Why don't you give it a try?
english.progress: Every great vehicle needs a name... I was thinking I'd call it... Pwned!
english.completion: Yes, these scales are perfect. I should be able to get this flyer off the ground with these scales for sure! Thanks!
english.completed: Return to Shizzle at Mossy Pile.

text.title: 极度粘稠的沥青
text.objectives: 收集8份极度粘稠的沥青。
text.description: 我总是在寻找快速赚钱的方法，$N。如果你能帮我实现新计划，我可以让你也赚点钱，怎么样？$B$B就这么定了！$B$B我们要制作一些粘合剂。到北边的油沼去，帮我收集一些沥青。并不是所有的沥青都合适，你必须从油沼周围的野兽身上得到它。另外呢，如果你使用我的刮油刀从它们的尸体上刮沥青，就不用担心弄脏手啦。
text.progress: Tara's done it again -- this super sticky glue will be all the rage!
text.completion: Yeah, this tar is pretty sticky, I guess.  I mean, it's sticky, but it's not "make fistfuls of money" sticky.  I guess I'll have to keep thinking.
text.completed: Return to Tara in Mossy Pile.

english.title: Super Sticky
english.objectives: Collect 8 samples of Super Sticky Tar.
english.description: I'm always looking for a quick way to earn a gold, $N. If you help me with my newest idea, I'll let you in on a little of the profit. How does that sound to you?$B$BI thought so!$B$BWe're going to be making some glue. Head to the tar pits just north of here, and collect me some tar. Not just any tar, now, you'll need to get it from the beasts that live around the tar pits. As a bonus, if you use my tar scraper on their corpses, you'll keep your hands nice and clean.
english.progress: Tara's done it again -- this super sticky glue will be all the rage!
english.completion: Yeah, this tar is pretty sticky, I guess.  I mean, it's sticky, but it's not "make fistfuls of money" sticky.  I guess I'll have to keep thinking.
english.completed: Return to Tara in Mossy Pile.

text.title: 威利德的日记
text.objectives: 将日记还给安戈洛环形山中的威利德·马绍尔。
text.description: 你找到了一本被撕破的日记，其中的某些部分仍然清晰可辨，目录中有威利德·马绍尔的署名。如果日记上面的记载没错的话，那么你可以在环形山的中部地区找到威利德。根据日记中所说的，他和他的同伴们的营地被袭击了，所以他们打算找个更容易占据主动的落脚点。
text.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Williden's Journal
english.objectives: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: You have uncovered a mangled journal.  Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein.  If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the central part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought to take a more offensive stance once their refuge was attacked.
english.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 抢救物资
text.objectives: 将食物箱和研究设备交给安戈洛环形山的威利德·马绍尔。
text.description: I'm Williden Marshal, and I lead a non-aligned expedition troupe.  Now that our camp is more centrally located, it will be much more convenient for us to do many things... such as retrieving some long-forgotten supplies.$B$BWe've left some old supplies at deserted base camps both northeast and southwest of here.  You look like you're capable enough - can you help us by getting them back?
text.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Expedition Salvation
english.objectives: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: I'm Williden Marshal, and I lead a non-aligned expedition troupe.  Now that our camp is more centrally located, it will be much more convenient for us to do many things... such as retrieving some long-forgotten supplies.$B$BWe've left some old supplies at deserted base camps both northeast and southwest of here.  You look like you're capable enough - can you help us by getting them back?
english.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 火山的活动
text.objectives: 从安戈洛环形山火山口附近的火焰元素身上收集9份安戈洛灰烬样本。
text.description: 你好。我是威利德·马绍尔，我和我的姐妹一起带领着这支由探险家和科学家组成的远征队。你有空吗？$B$B我很不喜欢在那座火山附近活动的元素生物，$C。我们有这么多的设备和笔记……倘若有只发疯的元素生物溜进了我们的营地，那它肯定会造成非常非常非常严重的破坏。$B$B让它们明白，新邻居可不是好惹的。顺便带回它们的灰烬……说不定可以拿来做个小试验。
text.progress: Do you think the volcano is active?  I wonder why it didn't explode when the cataclysm hit.
text.completion: I hope that did the trick.  I'll take the ash... this may come in handy sometime down the line.
text.completed: Return to Williden Marshal in Marshal's Stand.

english.title: Volcanic Activity
english.objectives: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Welcome.  I'm Williden Marshal, and my sister and I run this expedition of explorers and scientists.  You have a moment?$b$bI don't like the look of those elementals on that volcano, $c.  We have too much equipment, too many notes... one crazed elemental could streak its way through our camp and do terrible, terrible damage.$b$bShow them that their new neighbors aren't to be trifled with.  And bring back the ash that they leave behind... we might as well do a little science while we're at it.
english.progress: Do you think the volcano is active?  I wonder why it didn't explode when the cataclysm hit.
english.completion: I hope that did the trick.  I'll take the ash... this may come in handy sometime down the line.
english.completed: Return to Williden Marshal in Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 以小换大
text.objectives: 收集5枚骨刺迅猛龙蛋。
text.description: 霍巴特认为这些小小的肉鸡蛋就够我们吃的了？呸！我们要吃正宗的蛋！$B$B我在东边的迅猛龙高地上设置了一些陷阱。将这些野生肉鸡蛋放置在陷阱里，迅猛龙就会赶过去觅食。然后，你就能换到巨大的迅猛龙蛋了。$B$B我真是个天才！
text.progress: How many did you get? I can just taste the massive omelet we're going to cook up now!
text.completion: Nice! Look at the size of those things! There's no way that Grapplehammer's going to be able to top those!
text.completed: Return to Bamm Megabomb at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Trading Up
english.objectives: Gather 5 Spiny Raptor Eggs.
english.description: Hobart thinks he's going to feed us on those tiny clucker eggs? Bah! We're going to get some real eggs!$B$BI've already set up some traps on the Raptor Rise up the path to the east. Take this bunch of wild clucker eggs and lay them in the traps. The spiny raptors will go right after the clucker eggs, and then you'll get to trade up to their larger eggs.$B$BGenius!
english.progress: How many did you get? I can just taste the massive omelet we're going to cook up now!
english.completion: Nice! Look at the size of those things! There's no way that Grapplehammer's going to be able to top those!
english.completed: Return to Bamm Megabomb at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 究根问底
text.objectives: 安戈洛尔环形山的克拉兰克要你去找到火羽山中温度最高的地方。$B$B当你找到一个看上去很热的地方时，就使用温度计来测量当地的温度。不断尝试，直到你找到温度最高的地方。
text.description: 我制作了一个测温计来读取火山的温度，希望能找到温度最高的地方。它是按照我独创的计量单位进行测量的！$B$B拿着这个温度计，当你经过某个炎热的地方，就顺便读取一下那里的温度！$B$B热点一般都是突出地面的、炽热的岩石柱。你可以在火羽山下找到这种岩石柱……沿着山麓跑一遍应该就够了。
text.progress: 我想过要自己去找，但是……我害怕那里的火元素!
text.completion: These results are astounding!  My boss will be pleased.  Thank you, kind $r!
text.completed: Return to Krakle at Marshal's Stand.
text.objective1: 找到火羽山上最热的地方

english.title: Finding the Source
english.objectives: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.$B$BWhenever you find a hot spot, use the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.
english.description: I created a thermometer to take readings of the temperatures at the volcano, and I'd like to find the hottest lava flows.  It gives the measurements in degrees Kraklenheit!$B$BHere, take it, and take readings of the temperatures at the ridge whenever you see a hot spot!$b$bHot spots usually take the form of a glowing, rocky pillar jutting out of the ground.  You'll find them around the base of Fire Plume Ridge... one trip around the perimeter will likely suffice.
english.progress: I'd go there myself, but... I'm a little scared of the fire elementals there!
english.completion: These results are astounding!  My boss will be pleased.  Thank you, kind $r!
english.completed: Return to Krakle at Marshal's Stand.
english.objective1: Find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 史上第一巨蛋
text.objectives: 取回史上第一巨蛋。
text.description: 巴姆·重磅炸弹？他以为自己是谁啊？什么骨刺迅猛龙蛋，根本比不上我们接下来要弄来的巨蛋！$B$B你也知道，每座胶囊镇都会配备一只微型机动战鸡以备不时之需。聪明如我，早就推断出这只预编程的大家伙跑到哪儿去了。$B$B去北边的焦痕深谷找它吧。当心，那玩意儿的电路板坏了，不打一架是不会把蛋给你的。
text.progress: Just think about the accolades that will rain down upon me... us, when the Biggest Egg Ever is returned!
text.completion: Eureka! My genius saves the day yet again! Take that Bamm Megabomb! And now, to reap the benefits!

english.title: The Biggest Egg Ever
english.objectives: Recover the Biggest Egg Ever.
english.description: Bamm Megabomb? Who does he think he is? His spiny raptor eggs are no match for what we are about to recover!$B$BAs you well know, each Town-In-A-Box is equipped with a micro mechachicken for just such a dietary emergency. Luckily for us, my keen intellect was able to deduce the location that our prodigious, pre-programmed poultry ran off to.$B$BHead north to the Scorched Gully. But beware, its circuit boards are fried and I imagine it's not so micro any longer!
english.progress: Just think about the accolades that will rain down upon me... us, when the Biggest Egg Ever is returned!
english.completion: Eureka! My genius saves the day yet again! Take that Bamm Megabomb! And now, to reap the benefits!
english.completed: Return to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
english.giverWindow: Obtain the Biggest Egg Ever!

text.title: 微妙的气氛（肯定不是爱）
text.objectives: 将褪色的情人节卡片交给暴风城的探员斯尼普·滑栓。
text.description: 这张卡片里面记录了一个疯狂而详细的计划。其目的是感染艾泽拉斯的全部生物。你应该立刻把它交给热砂集团的一名调查员！
text.progress: Did you take care of those no-good scheming villains?
text.completion: What've you got there? Oh hey, this is big. Real big. Most of the crazy details in one little package. Thanks - you really helped us reel this all in. Good working with ya.
text.completed: Return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Shadowfang Keep.

english.title: Something is in the Air (and it Ain't Love)
english.objectives: Bring the Faded Lovely Greeting Card to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
english.description: The inside of the card is scribbled with mad, detailed plans to infect most of Azeroth.  You should show this to one of Steamwheedle's investigators immediately!
english.progress: Did you take care of those no-good scheming villains?
english.completion: What've you got there? Oh hey, this is big. Real big. Most of the crazy details in one little package. Thanks - you really helped us reel this all in. Good working with ya.
english.completed: Return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Shadowfang Keep.

text.completed: Return to .

english.title: REUSE
english.completed: Return to .

text.title: 搞破坏！
text.objectives: 破坏一枚矮人炮弹，在它爆炸前逃离巴尔丹。
text.description: 这些矮人炮弹都设有内置的空爆计时器。这太简单了！破坏装货间的一枚炮弹，将其抛进弹药库。轰隆隆！轰隆隆！$B$B这一层的停机库后面就是装货间，你可以装货间的角落里找到炮弹。$B$B破坏炮弹之后……赶紧跑！像风一样逃走，$N！然后返回营地向加恩复命，我会紧跟着你的。
text.completion: Bael'dun? Destroyed?$B$B<Wincing in pain, Gann twists his head to peer behind him, where plumes of smoke darken the skyline.>$B$B$N, my friend. You have avenged Taurajo and avenged the Tauren people. The invaders will not soon recover from that blow. Thank you.$B$B<Gann closes his eyes, his head tipping forward as his breath gives way to a series of ragged coughs.>
text.completed: Report to Gann Stonespire at Spearhead in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Sabotage!
english.objectives: Sabotage a Dwarven Artillery Shell and then flee from Bael'Dun before it explodes.
english.description: These dwarven artillery shells have a built-in airburst timer. This is easy! Just sabotage one of the artillery shells in the loading bay and then hoist it up into the magazine. Boom, baby. BOOM!$B$BYou'll find the shells in one of two loading bays behind the main garage on this level. It's right around the corner.$B$BOnce you've rigged the artillery shell... Run! Run like the wind, $N! Then report to Gann back at camp. I'll be right behind you.
english.completion: Bael'dun? Destroyed?$B$B<Wincing in pain, Gann twists his head to peer behind him, where plumes of smoke darken the skyline.>$B$B$N, my friend. You have avenged Taurajo and avenged the Tauren people. The invaders will not soon recover from that blow. Thank you.$B$B<Gann closes his eyes, his head tipping forward as his breath gives way to a series of ragged coughs.>
english.completed: Report to Gann Stonespire at Spearhead in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 巫妖王最后的阵地
text.objectives: 冰冠堡垒中的大领主达里安·莫格莱尼希望你去消灭巫妖王。
text.description: 影之哀伤，这件武器刚刚问世不久，却已经改写了这个世界的历史。它初生便背负着无与伦比的命运。$B$B手握这件武器的你同样背负着巨大的责任，而且现在就是你履行这一责任的时候。$B$B举起这件传奇武器，向敌人发起冲锋吧。为我们牺牲的无数英雄复仇，让他们饱受折磨的灵魂得到安息。$B$B坚定你的意志，$C，引领影之哀伤去实现它的命运吧。
text.completion: So, at last it is done. May the people of Azeroth remember our deeds here forevermore. May the sacrifices of so many burn in their hearts eternally. May they never fail to risk mortal peril in the face of great evil.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

english.title: The Lich King's Last Stand
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine in Icecrown Citadel wants you to kill the Lich King.
english.description: Shadowmourne; a newly forged weapon already steeped in this world's history, reborn into an unrivaled destiny.$b$bWith this weapon you bear a solemn responsibility, and the time to carry out that charge is at hand.$b$bTake this weapon of myth and legend and march on the enemy. Avenge the countless heroes lost in his merciless campaign. Bring rest to their tortured souls.$b$bSteel yourself, $c, and guide Shadowmourne to fulfill the purpose of its creation.
english.completion: So, at last it is done. May the people of Azeroth remember our deeds here forevermore. May the sacrifices of so many burn in their hearts eternally. May they never fail to risk mortal peril in the face of great evil.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

text.title: 注入邪恶
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼要你用邪恶能量灌注影锋，并杀死普崔塞德教授。$B$B该任务只能在冰冠堡垒25人模式下完成。
text.description: 你的武器必须注入足够的力量，才能发挥出它真正的潜力。第一种要注入的力量就是邪恶。$B$B你必须找到并击败那个名叫普崔塞德教授的人。但消灭他并非你唯一的目标。你还要利用他的力量来对抗他。$B$B想办法吸收他的变异粘液。使用那种邪恶的物质为你的武器注入邪恶力量。然后我会指示你下一步的任务。
text.completion: Well done, $c. The completion of our work draws near.
text.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Unholy power then slay Putricide.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

english.title: Unholy Infusion
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to infuse Shadow's Edge with Unholy power and slay Professor Putricide.$B$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Before your weapon can reach its full potential it must be endowed with its signature powers. First among them is unholiness.$b$bYou must seek out and defeat the one called Professor Putricide, but his death is not your only goal. You must use his resources against him.$b$bFind a way to absorb his mutated slime. Use the foul substance to infuse your weapon with the power of the unholy. Only when this has been done shall I reveal your next task.
english.completion: Well done, $c. The completion of our work draws near.
english.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Unholy power then slay Putricide.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的索拉萨谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$N。去跟东边的索拉萨谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have an intense look about ya though. Fiery eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Soratha in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Soratha to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have an intense look about ya though. Fiery eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何运用魔法的力量。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya spells - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
text.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start simple. I need ta know dat you know the basics of the arcane arts.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch how you form your casts and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya spells - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
english.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 法师的技艺
text.objectives: Speak to Soratha to train Arcane Missiles. Practice using Arcane Missiles 2 times against a Tiki Target.
text.description: I tink I have something I can show ya. It's pretty simple really, but it should help.$B$BWhen ya arcane energies line up perfectly, ya can release a volley of arcane missiles dat wil be devastatin' ya enemeis. It may take some time and some luck for ya to get a chance at practicin' these magics, so be patient.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.
text.progress: With time, ya'll learn enchantments that are a bit more crude, but have a bigger impact on yer fightin'. Shields dat'll absorb attacks. Armor dat'll freeze ya opponents. Ya'll even learn ta make copies of yerself that can cast spells as well.
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
text.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: The Arts of a Mage
english.objectives: Speak to Soratha to train Arcane Missiles. Practice using Arcane Missiles 2 times against a Tiki Target.
english.description: I tink I have something I can show ya. It's pretty simple really, but it should help.$B$BWhen ya arcane energies line up perfectly, ya can release a volley of arcane missiles dat wil be devastatin' ya enemeis. It may take some time and some luck for ya to get a chance at practicin' these magics, so be patient.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.
english.progress: With time, ya'll learn enchantments that are a bit more crude, but have a bigger impact on yer fightin'. Shields dat'll absorb attacks. Armor dat'll freeze ya opponents. Ya'll even learn ta make copies of yerself that can cast spells as well.
english.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
english.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
text.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
english.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
english.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 同暗矛狱卒交谈，然后进入试炼场，杀死一名恶鳞斥候俘虏。
text.description: 你干得很不错，$C。我还可以再教你一些手段，但我不会再让你对着假人浪费时间了。$B$B现在我给你安排最后一项考验吧，伙计。到这个区域中间的试炼场去，跟一个真正的敌人交手——对方对你可是毫不留情的哟。等你准备好了，告诉那边的狱卒一声就行了。
text.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
text.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Proving Pit
english.objectives: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
english.description: Ya done quite well for ya'self, $c. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.$B$Bl put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.
english.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
english.completed: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 喜出望外
text.objectives: 向暗矛要塞中的沃金报到。
text.description: 你真是令我们喜出望外，伙计。我敢说，你的天赋对我们肯定是大有帮助。你不用再跟这些新兵蛋子混在一起啦。$B$B到东南边的村子里去吧，闯出你自己的天地来。到处帮帮忙，我相信你很快就会出人头地的。
text.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

english.title: More Than Expected
english.objectives: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.$B$BHead down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.
english.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

text.title: 鲜血灌注
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼要你使用鲜血灌注影锋，并击败鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔。$B$B该任务只能在25人难度的冰冠堡垒中完成。
text.description: 你的武器现在已经准备好要接受鲜血的力量了。$B$B你必须在战斗中面对鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔，然后使你自己受到她的血之镜像的影响。这股力量将使影锋吸取最近的活体生物的鲜血，也就是你，$R。$B$B一旦刀刃完成了苏醒，让女王的疯狂嗜血控制你，满足影锋的渴望，然后再给女王致命的一击。$B$B但愿女王死时的绝望尖啸能刺穿巫妖王的双耳。
text.completion: Well done, $c. Shadowmourne is nearly within reach.
text.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Blood then defeat Lana'thel.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

english.title: Blood Infusion
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to infuse Shadow's Edge with blood and defeat Queen Lana'thel.$B$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Your weapon is ready to be endowed with the power of blood.$b$bYou must face Queen Lana'thel in battle and subject yourself to her Blood Mirror. This will cause Shadow's Edge to drink the blood of the nearest living being. That being would be you, $r.$b$bOnce the blade has been thus awakened, allow the Queen's Frenzied Bloodthirst to take hold of you, feed the blade thrice to sate it, and then give the queen an ignominious death.$b$bMay her screams pierce the ears of the Lich King as he awaits his fate.
english.completion: Well done, $c. Shadowmourne is nearly within reach.
english.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Blood then defeat Lana'thel.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 冰霜灌注
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼对你做出了指示，他要你在使用影锋与辛达苟萨战斗时，经受住辛达苟萨的四次气息攻击，然后再杀死她。$B$B该任务只能在25人难度的冰冠堡垒中完成。
text.description: 影锋已经准好要接收其最终的力量灌注了。$B$B辛达苟萨，敌人的坐骑，必须死。但是在杀死她之前，你必须要在不死的情况下经受住她的四次冰霜气息。$B$B没有了他的龙之后，在你和巫妖王之间就不再有真正意义上的对手了。
text.completion: The axe has drunk its fill, $r, and the forge is nearly ready for the creation of Shadowmourne...
text.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Frost then slay Sindragosa.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

english.title: Frost Infusion
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine has instructed you to slay Sindragosa after subjecting yourself to 4 of her breath attacks while wielding Shadow's Edge.$B$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Shadow's Edge is prepared to receive its final infusion of power.$b$bSindragosa, the enemy's own mount, must fall. But before she is brought down, you must sustain four of her frozen breath attacks without tasting death.$b$bWithout his dragon, nothing shall stand between you and the Lich King.
english.completion: The axe has drunk its fill, $r, and the forge is nearly ready for the creation of Shadowmourne...
english.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Frost then slay Sindragosa.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

text.objectives: Speak to Nekali to train Primal Strike. Use Primal Strike 3 times against a Tiki Target.
text.description: I tink I have something I can show ya. Dis should be easy enough for ya to make a lot of use of it.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
text.completed: Return to Nekali at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.objectives: Speak to Nekali to train Primal Strike. Use Primal Strike 3 times against a Tiki Target.

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
text.completed: Return to Nekali at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
english.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
english.completed: Return to Nekali at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 同暗矛狱卒交谈，然后进入试炼场，杀死一名恶鳞斥候俘虏。
text.description: 你干得很不错，$C。我还可以再教你一些手段，但我不会再让你对着假人浪费时间了。$B$B现在我给你安排最后一项考验吧，伙计。到这个区域中间的试炼场去，跟一个真正的敌人交手——对方对你可是毫不留情的哟。等你准备好了，告诉那边的狱卒一声就行了。
text.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
text.completed: Return to Nekali at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Proving Pit
english.objectives: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
english.description: Ya done quite well for ya'self, $c. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.$B$Bl put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.
english.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
english.completed: Return to Nekali at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 喜出望外
text.objectives: 向暗矛要塞中的沃金报到。
text.description: 你真是令我们喜出望外，伙计。我敢说，你的天赋对我们肯定是大有帮助。你不用再跟这些新兵蛋子混在一起啦。$B$B到东南边的村子里去吧，闯出你自己的天地来。到处帮帮忙，我相信你很快就会出人头地的。
text.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

english.title: More Than Expected
english.objectives: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.$B$BHead down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.
english.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的岑塔布拉谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$N。去跟东边的岑塔布拉谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have a wild look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Zen'Tabra in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Zen'Tabra to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have a wild look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你对德鲁伊的技艺略知一二。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya casts - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
text.completed: Return to Zen'Tabra at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start simple. I need ta know dat you know the basics of the druidic arts.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch how you form your casts and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya casts - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
english.completed: Return to Zen'Tabra at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.objectives: Speak to Zen'Tabra to train Rejuvenation. Practice using Rejuvenation on a Wounded Darkspear Watcher in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
text.description: I tink I have something I can show ya. It's pretty simple really, but it should help.$B$BBy calling on nature, we can mend bones and cuts. We can bring back even da most gravely wounded ally ta fight on.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
text.completed: Return to Zen'Tabra at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

It's pretty simple really, but it should help.$B$BWe've all manner of trick shots we can be usin' wit bows or guns, but witout a steady hand between dose shots, ya gonna find yaself exhausted and not really managin' to kill much. Take ya time, steady ya bow, and keep the shots pourin' into ya target. Keep'm off-balance.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
text.completed: Return to Ortezza at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
text.completed: Return to Ortezza at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
english.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
english.completed: Return to Ortezza at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 同暗矛狱卒交谈，然后进入试炼场，杀死一名恶鳞斥候俘虏。
text.description: 你干得很不错，$C。我还可以再教你一些手段，但我不会再让你对着假人浪费时间了。$B$B现在我给你安排最后一项考验吧，伙计。到这个区域中间的试炼场去，跟一个真正的敌人交手——对方对你可是毫不留情的哟。等你准备好了，告诉那边的狱卒一声就行了。
text.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
text.completed: Return to Ortezza at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Proving Pit
english.objectives: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
english.description: Ya done quite well for ya'self, $c. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.$B$Bl put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.
english.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
english.completed: Return to Ortezza at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 喜出望外
text.objectives: 向暗矛要塞中的沃金报到。
text.description: 你真是令我们喜出望外，伙计。我敢说，你的天赋对我们肯定是大有帮助。你不用再跟这些新兵蛋子混在一起啦。$B$B到东南边的村子里去吧，闯出你自己的天地来。到处帮帮忙，我相信你很快就会出人头地的。
text.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

english.title: More Than Expected
english.objectives: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.$B$BHead down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.
english.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的图娜尼谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$N。去跟东边的图娜尼谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have a balanced look about ya though. Calm eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Tunari in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Tunari to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have a balanced look about ya though. Calm eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何运用神圣的力量。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya spells - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
text.completed: Return to Tunari at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start simple. I need ta know dat you know the basics of the holy arts.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch how you form your casts and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya spells - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
english.completed: Return to Tunari at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 学习暗言术
text.objectives: Speak to Tunari to train Flash Heal. Use Flash Heal 5 times to heal Wounded Darkspear Watchers around the Darkspear Training Grounds.
text.description: I tink I have something I can show ya. It's pretty simple really, but it should help.$B$BWith a quick gatherin' of holy energies, ya can bind ya wounds or the wounds of ya friends. Dis magic be quick, but it also be drainin' on you. As time goes on, ya will learn more varieties of it that won't drain ya quite so heavily.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
text.completed: Return to Tunari at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 打入内部
text.objectives: 向影牙城堡的调查员费岑·布莱斯塔克报告。
text.description: 看样子你有足够的智慧和力量完成我的任务。这本帐簿的内容表明他正待在影牙城堡。所以我现在要派你去那里。$B$B我们已经向那里派了一个人，但他还没有取得任何进展。赶快行动。我们的侦查员会在那里和你碰头。记得带上你的朋友一起过去。

english.title: Man on the Inside
english.objectives: Report to Investigator Fezzen Brasstacks in Shadowfang Keep.
english.description: You look like you're fit enough to take on the mastermind behind this operation. The ledger says he's holed up in Shadowfang Keep, so that's where I'm sending you.$b$bWe have a man there already but he's not fit to take down an operation by himself. Head on in; the investigator will meet you there. And bring friends.

text.title: 跟斯普拉格交谈
text.objectives: 跟马绍尔哨站的斯普拉格·弗劳克谈一谈。
text.description: 我的好朋友斯普拉格为了某件事烦恼了好一阵子了。我本来想帮她的，但是如你所见，我现在不挺舒坦的嘛。$B$B你能不能跟她谈谈，看看她有什么需要帮忙的？
text.completion: What?  Krakle sent you?
text.completed: 跟马绍尔哨站的斯普拉格·弗劳克谈一谈。

english.title: Speak With Spraggle
english.objectives: Speak to Spraggle Frock in Marshal's Stand.
english.description: My good friend Spraggle has been fretting about something for some time now.  I'd help her, but as you can see, I'm pretty comfortable right now.$b$bCould you check in with her and see what she needs?
english.completion: What?  Krakle sent you?
english.completed: Speak to Spraggle Frock in Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 银色盟约的胜利
text.objectives: 将奎尔德拉交给银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
text.description: 在鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔自吹自擂的时候，而你，$N，却已经取得了奎尔德拉。$B$B银色盟约和全体奎尔多雷都对你心怀感激。$B$B奎尔德拉似乎知道你是一名$C，无法使用它。那么它的下一个主人该是谁？也许银色十字军能为它找到新主人。到北边的银色比武场去，代表银色盟约将这把剑交给裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
text.progress: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?
text.completion: That a weapon of such power has been redeemed from the clutches of evil is a great omen in these times, $n. With Quel'Delar and staunch Silver Covenant allies at our side, the Lich King will have good reason to fear. The crusade maintains an arsenal of exceptional weapons for our strongest allies. Allow me to offer you your choice from among them in return for entrusting us with the care of Quel'Delar.
text.completed: Return to Justicar Mariel Trueheart in the Argent Pavilion at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

english.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
english.objectives: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: In spite of Queen Lana'thel's boasting, you have restored Quel'Delar, $N. Long have we dreamt of reclaiming Quel'Delar.$B$BThe Silver Covenant, and indeed all quel'dorei owe you a debt of gratitude.$B$BAs a $c, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? Perhaps the Argent Crusade can find one. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Silver Covenant.

text.title: 银色盟约的胜利
text.objectives: 将奎尔德拉交给达拉然紫罗兰城堡中的温蕾萨·风行者。
text.description: 在鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔自吹自擂的时候，而你，$N，却已经取得了奎尔德拉。$B$B银色盟约和全体奎尔多雷都对你心怀感激。$B$B银色盟约的领袖温蕾萨·风行者希望你从太阳之井返回以后能去见她一面。请带着奎尔德拉前往达拉然的紫罗兰城堡，她正在那里等你，$N。
text.progress: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?
text.completion: This is nothing short of an amazing accomplishment, $n. The day that Thalorien and Anasterian fell, the same day that Quel'Delar was lost, was one of the darkest of my life. To see Quel'Delar restored... it is beyond words. Without a doubt, you are meant to be the true bearer of the blade. Quel'Delar's magic is already adapting the blade to your skills and your strengths.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.

Take Quel'Delar with you and go to Dalaran's Violet Citadel where she waits, $N.

text.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
text.objectives: 将奎尔德拉交给银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
text.description: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei!$B$BAll of Silvermoon will celebrate you as a hero, $N.$B$BAs a $c, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? No worthy sin'dorei has come forward. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.

Where, then, will its next master come from? I will not conceal my disappointment; I had hoped it would be a worthy sin'dorei. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.
english.progress: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?
english.completion: That a weapon of such power has been redeemed from the clutches of evil is a great omen in these times, $N. With Quel'Delar and staunch Sunreaver allies at our side, the Lich King will have good reason to fear.$B$BThe crusade maintains an arsenal of exceptional weapons for our strongest allies. Allow me to offer you your choice from among them in return for entrusting us with the care of Quel'Delar.
english.completed: Return to Justicar Mariel Trueheart in the Argent Pavilion at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

text.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
text.objectives: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
text.description: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei! All of Silvermoon will proclaim you a hero, as will all of the Horde.$B$BArchmage Aethas Sunreaver, the leader of the Sunreavers, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. Travel to the Violet Citadel in Dalaran as soon as you can, $N and bring Quel'Delar with you. The archmage wishes to congratulate you personally!
text.progress: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?
text.completion: Quel'Delar rises again, as we sin'dorei have risen from the ashes of defeat and betrayal. The heart and the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker are both with you, $n. I see the blade has already started adapting itself to your strengths, $n. Hold your head high and always keep Quel'Delar at your side.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.

text.title: 巫妖王之怒
text.objectives: Find Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and escape the Halls of Reflection
text.description: Uther knew a great deal about how Arthas might be defeated. It's hard to believe that there is much hope of defeating Arthas upon the steps of his own throne. And who will take up the crown of Lich King if it comes to that?$B$BMany questions remain, but the answers that you've uncovered may be critical to ensuring Arthas' defeat. You need to find Sylvanas and escape the Lich King while there's still time.
text.completion: Yet again, vengeance slips through my grasp. It's hard to believe how much stronger he's gotten. It was foolish of you to come for me, but it's good to know that there are still some champions of the Horde that aren't useless cowards. The information Uther gave us may well be key to finally killing Arthas, though it is becoming more and more clear that the Horde will not be able to accomplish this on their own. Go, $c. I expect your prowess may be needed again very soon.
text.completed: Speak to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the rear of the Halls of Reflection.

text.objectives: 向暴风城的探员斯尼普·滑栓报告。
text.description: 皇冠药剂公司有些不对劲的地方。热砂集团已经开始注意他们了。我们要对此采取行动。$B$B如果你有兴趣帮助我们，就请到暴风城去。探员斯尼普·滑栓正在那里进行调查，他很需要你的帮助。
text.completion: Hey. You got some time on your hands? I could use someone like you.

english.description: Something's not right about this Crown Chemical Company. Steamwheedle's got eyes on 'em, and we could use a few more.$b$bHead to Stormwind if you're interested in helping us out. Inspector Snip Snagglebolt is heading up the investigation there, and he can use all the help he can get.

text.title: 温诺亚·松林
text.objectives: 跟南贫瘠之地世仇哨站的温诺亚·松林谈一谈。
text.description: 尽管我们在这里收获颇丰，但如果让这腐蚀趁我们的不注意的时候散布出去，那可就真是一场悲剧了。哀嚎洞穴的走廊蜿蜒在整个贫瘠之地里，如果狂野的能量找到了另一个可以冒头的地方……$B$B不过，你为我做的已经够多了。我只能要求你把这里的事情去告诉我的一个德鲁伊同伴。你可以在西南边的世仇哨站找到温诺亚·松林。
text.completion: I could feel what occured from here, $c. It bristled every hair I have.$B$BI'm overjoyed to hear you succeeded in pushing those horrors back, and I'll be sure to scour the area for any stray deviate creatures.

english.title: Winnoa Pineforest
english.objectives: Speak to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.
english.description: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point, southwest of here.
english.completion: I could feel what occured from here, $c. It bristled every hair I have.$B$BI'm overjoyed to hear you succeeded in pushing those horrors back, and I'll be sure to scour the area for any stray deviate creatures.

text.title: 不再怜悯
text.objectives: 杀死12个恶鳞纳迦。
text.description: 纳迦对我们的同胞犯下了滔天的罪行。对于他们，无需有任何怜悯之心。$B$B到山洞里去，对纳迦格杀勿论。今天你多干掉一个纳迦，明天就可以少一份担忧。我相信你会认真执行这个任务的。
text.completion: Well fought, young $r.
text.completed: Return to Morakki at Spitescale Cove in the Echo Isles.

english.title: No More Mercy
english.objectives: Kill 12 Spitescale Naga.
english.description: Da naga have committed great atrocities on our people. Da time ta show dem mercy has long passed.$B$BEnter da cave and kill any naga you find dere. Every naga dead dis day is one less naga ta take us unawares later on. I trust ya will be thorough.
english.completion: Well fought, young $r.
english.completed: Return to Morakki at Spitescale Cove in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 领土神像
text.objectives: 在恶鳞纳迦的旗帜上放置8个领土神像。
text.description: 这可不是一次普通的反击。我们的目标是把这里的纳迦赶尽杀绝，尽一切努力使他们不敢再回来。$B$B我要你去把这些神像放在纳迦山洞里的恶鳞旗帜上，这是我们向他们传达的明确信号。而且，这些神像中蕴含的魔法可以极大地削弱附近的恶鳞纳迦，这样他们就不敢留下来了。
text.completion: Dat should keep dem at bay.
text.completed: Return to Morakki at Spitescale Cove in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Territorial Fetish
english.objectives: Place 8 Territorial Fetishes on Spitescale flags.
english.description: Dis is no casual counter-attack. We be fully intendin' ta slaughter every last naga here and do anything we can ta ensure that dey will have no desire ta return.$B$BI want ya ta place dese fetishes on any Spitescale banner ya be findin' inside their cave. It should prove a clear statement of what we think of their presence here. More dan dat, da magic in dese fetishes will be weakenin' any Spitescale dat approach, which should make dem second guess stayin' on our isle.
english.completion: Dat should keep dem at bay.
english.completed: Return to Morakki at Spitescale Cove in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 古老的宿敌
text.objectives: 与恶鳞海湾内的沃金交谈，协助他杀死海巫扎尔吉拉。
text.description: 海巫就在这里，这座岛屿的顶部。我们等待这个复仇的机会已经很久了，而你将有幸亲眼见证这个时刻。$B$B到东北方的斜坡上去，与沃金会合。等你准备好加入战斗之后，就告诉他。
text.completion: Tha power d'at burst forth when tha Sea Witch died was immense. I can use d'is power ta enact a vision of places far away. Observe, youngblood. I want ya ta be here when I make contact wit' Thrall, perhaps it will be grantin' ya insight as well.
text.completed: Speak to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles.
text.giverWindow: Long ago, the Sea Witch killed Vol'jin's father and chased the trolls out of their island homes. Now she returns, and Vol'jin is finally given a chance for vengeance.
text.objective1: Speak with Vol'jin at Spitescale Cove

english.title: An Ancient Enemy
english.objectives: Speak with Vol'jin in Spitescale Cove and aid him in killing Zar'jira, the Sea Witch.
english.description: Da Sea Witch is here, on top of dis very isle. We've been waitin' a long time for dis chance at revenge and ya will be havin' da privilege of seein' it through.$B$BMeet with Vol'jin, up da ramp to da northeast. Let him know when you are ready ta join da battle.
english.completion: Tha power d'at burst forth when tha Sea Witch died was immense. I can use d'is power ta enact a vision of places far away. Observe, youngblood. I want ya ta be here when I make contact wit' Thrall, perhaps it will be grantin' ya insight as well.

text.title: 到底谁站在食物链顶层？
text.objectives: 收集5块鲨鱼肉。
text.description: 好吧，巨蛋这回事算是我输掉了。有谁想吃鲨鱼肉吗？$B$B不过有个小问题。嗯，大问题。好吧，是很大的问题：巨锤！$B$B当然，我已经想到一个绝妙的办法了。去西边的险峻海峡收集一些鲨鱼肉。将它们交给我的助手格瑞里就行，我可不想为这种小事弄脏自己的手。
text.progress: $n, take it easy on Grapplehammer. He's a genius, but he's got a fragile ego.
text.completion: These will do very nicely! We're going to combine the shark parts and the robotic remains of the Mechachicken into a submersible that should allow you to rid us of that nuisance, The Hammer!
text.completed: Deliver the Shark Parts to Assistant Greely at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Who's Top of the Food Chain Now?
english.objectives: Collect 5 Shark Parts.
english.description: Fine, fine, perhaps the whole egg thing didn't quite pan out. Who's up for some shark meat?$B$BOnly one little problem. Well, a big problem, actually. A really BIG problem: The Hammer!$B$BOf course, I have a brilliant idea. Swim out into the Dire Strait to the west and get us some shark parts. Give them to my assistant, Greely. I'm too important to get my hands dirty with the small details.
english.progress: $n, take it easy on Grapplehammer. He's a genius, but he's got a fragile ego.
english.completion: These will do very nicely! We're going to combine the shark parts and the robotic remains of the Mechachicken into a submersible that should allow you to rid us of that nuisance, The Hammer!
english.completed: Deliver the Shark Parts to Assistant Greely at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 披着鲨鱼皮的地精
text.objectives: 激活X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼控制器，再使用X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼杀死巨锤。
text.description: 我们将机动战鸡的废弃部件和鲨鱼肉块组合起来，制成了一件了不起的潜水战斗装置：X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼！$B$B霍巴特和我希望你来驾驶它，$N。潜入西边的海峡，激活X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼控制器。$B$B你必须杀死巨锤，否则我们就没法发掘险峻海峡里丰富的自然资源了！为了财团的利益 ！
text.completion: Excellent work, my boy! The Town-In-A-Box is saved and the Bilgewater Cartel will be profitable once again thanks to my overwhelmingly unbelievable intellect and tinkering know-how.
text.completed: Report your success to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Use the Mechashark X-Steam to slay this monstrosity!

english.title: A Goblin in Shark's Clothing
english.objectives: Activate a Mechashark X-Steam Controller and use the Mechashark X-Steam to slay The Hammer.
english.description: Combining the remains of the Mechachicken with these shark parts, we've assembled the greatest fighting submersible of all time: the Mechashark X-Steam!$B$BHobart and I want you to pilot it, $N. Go west to the water and activate the Mechashark X-Steam Controller.$B$BYou must kill The Hammer if we're to have any hope of exploiting the natural resources of the Dire Strait to their fullest extent. It's for the good of the cartel!
english.completion: Excellent work, my boy! The Town-In-A-Box is saved and the Bilgewater Cartel will be profitable once again thanks to my overwhelmingly unbelievable intellect and tinkering know-how.
english.completed: Report your success to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

text.description: We are here to monitor the scars of the land, and watch for further signs of instability.  While we haven't seen any yet, a cataclysmic aftershock could devastate the Barrens even further.$B$BTo the northeast, near the chasm, earth elementals rampage out of control. text.title: Fireworks At The Gilded Rose
text.objectives: Speak to Marion Sutton at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
text.description: Kid, this is about more than just perfume. There were some rockets in that crate, and they had some kind of chemical payload inside. I can't analyze it here, but I'll spare ya the trip to the lab.$B$BNah, you gotta find the guy who made these. I know the maker's mark. Snivel Rustrocket.$B$BI got a tip from a reliable source that Snivel's here in Stormwind, livin' it up at the Gilded Rose. What's more, he had some dame on his arm. Marion Sutton was the name. Go to the Gilded Rose and see what she knows.
text.completion: You... You're not Snivel. Did he send you? He's so late, I had started to give up hope... That's not like my Snivel, but what other choice is there?

text.title: 热力追踪
text.objectives: Look for Snivel Rustrocket in the Stormwind Counting House, the Auction House, and the Barbershop in Stormwind City.
text.description: 我最好从头开始说。起初是爱情，$N。那是我一眼就看中的一个地精。$B$B我们共度了一个星期的美好时光，斯内维尔说他弄到了一大笔钱，打算和我一起去南海度个长假！你能相信吗？$B$B不管怎么说，他让我收拾好行李，自己去银行、拍卖行和理发店跑趟差，但他再没回来过！我开始意识到他就是个大骗子！
text.progress: 你是谁？
text.completion: All he talked about was leaving town with all his money? Then he really has abandoned me, hasn't he? Oh, $n, I was such a fool to fall for him, but how could I help myself? He was so irresistible!
text.completed: Return to Marion Sutton in Stormwind.

english.title: Hot On The Trail
english.objectives: Look for Snivel Rustrocket in the Stormwind Counting House, the Auction House, and the Barbershop in Stormwind City.
english.description: I'd better start from the beginning. It was love at first sight, $N. There was just something about that goblin from the moment I set eyes on him.$B$BAfter a wonderful week together, Snivel said he had come into a lot of money and that he was going to take me on a long vacation to the South Seas! Can you believe it?$B$BAnyway, he told me to pack while he ran some errands to the bank, the auction house, and the barber shop, but he never came back! I'm beginning to think he's nothing but a big liar!
english.completion: All he talked about was leaving town with all his money? Then he really has abandoned me, hasn't he? Oh, $n, I was such a fool to fall for him, but how could I help myself? He was so irresistible!
english.completed: Return to Marion Sutton in Stormwind.

text.title: Snivel's Sweetheart
text.objectives: Speak to Roka at the Gotri's Travelling Gear in Orgrimmar's Drag district.
text.description: Kid, this is about more than just perfume. There were some rockets in that crate, and they had some kind of chemical payload inside. I can't analyze it here, but I'll spare ya the trip to the lab.$B$BNah, you gotta find the guy who made these. I know the maker's mark. Snivel Rustrocket.$B$BI hear Snivel's livin' it up here in Orgrimmar. What's more, he's got himself a girlfriend -- some orc dame named Roka. She's supposed to meet him at Gotri's Travelling Gear in the Drag before they make their escape.
text.completion: You're not Snivel. He was supposed to be here an hour ago! What have you done with him? This isn't like my sweet Snivel. Do you think something's happened to him?

text.title: 被囚禁的部族
text.objectives: 打开4座野猪人牢笼。
text.description: 个头姑且不论，刺背野猪人的数量也远超我们，就算是最大的牛头人，也无法抵挡结群野猪人的伏击。$B$B许多见习生都举起了武器，保卫家园，有些献出了自己的生命，而其他人则被活捉了起来。$B$B请找到关押他们的笼子，将他们解救出来。正在忙于作战的野猪人不会给你制造多少麻烦的。
text.completion: Thanks to you, our people are free to fight for our home.
text.completed: Return to Grull Hawkwind.

english.title: Our Tribe, Imprisoned
english.objectives: Open 4 Quilboar Cages.
english.description: Despite their size, the Bristleback greatly outnumber us. A pack ambush can easily overwhelm even the largest tauren.$B$BMany new initiates have taken up arms to defend our home. Some have given their lives, but others have been captured alive.$B$BPlease, find their cages and free them. The battle should keep the quilboar distracted.
english.completion: Thanks to you, our people are free to fight for our home.
english.completed: Return to Grull Hawkwind.

text.title: 寻找暴风爪
text.objectives: 向安戈洛环形山入口处的加尔·暴风爪报到。
text.description: 赞阿利利一直在学习德鲁伊的知识，$R。希望有一天赞阿利利能加入利爪德鲁伊的行列，像风暴乌鸦那样翱翔在环形山的上空。$B$B但是导师让我待在这里耐心等待。所以赞阿利利就安心地待在这里。$B$B我认识的另一名德鲁伊说不定需要你的帮助。他叫加尔·暴风爪，他就在此地以东研究药剂。要不你去找他谈谈？
text.completion: Zen'Aliri was wise to send you here.  I've hit a dead end in my studies.
text.completed: Report to Garl Stormclaw at the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Finding Stormclaw
english.objectives: Report to Garl Stormclaw at the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Zen'Aliri been studyin' the ways of the druid, $r.  Hopefully one day, Zen'Aliri join the Druids of the Talon, and soar over this crater as a storm crow.$b$bBut for now, my mentor says I stay here and wait.  So Zen'Aliri waits.$b$bI know another druid who might be able to use your help.  His name is Garl Stormclaw, and he's somewhere to the east of here, studying reagents.  Maybe you go talk to him?
english.completion: Zen'Aliri was wise to send you here.  I've hit a dead end in my studies.
english.completed: Report to Garl Stormclaw at the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 变异的花朵
text.objectives: 杀死11只血瓣花。任何种类的成年血瓣花都可以。
text.description: 北面的异生花园中的植被对血瓣花产生了奇怪的反应。树木上攀生出了更多的花朵和藤蔓，大朵的鲜花也从地面探出头来，这些情况都非比寻常。$B$B大地在与我们交谈，$R。血瓣花正在破坏生态平衡。$B$B这是我交代给你的最后一项任务，请你前往异生花园削减成年血瓣花的数量。
text.completion: The scent of bloodpetal pollen hangs about your head, $c.  This is good. You've earned your reward.
text.completed: Return to Ithis Moonwarden in the Roiling Gardens.

english.title: Aberrant Flora
english.objectives: Kill 11 Bloodpetals.  Any type of adult Bloodpetal will do.
english.description: Look how strangely the plant life reacts to the bloodpetals in the Roiling Gardens to the north.  The trees are enveloped with more flowers and vines than usual.  Large, sporous blossoms project themselves from the ground where they once did not.$b$bThe land is speaking to us, $r.  The bloodpetals are destroying the balance.$b$bAs my final task, I ask you to visit the swarming adult Bloodpetals and prune their numbers.
english.completion: The scent of bloodpetal pollen hangs about your head, $c.  This is good. You've earned your reward.
english.completed: Return to Ithis Moonwarden in the Roiling Gardens.

text.title: 迫在眉睫的威胁
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛瓦丝耶兰废墟西部入口的梅格斯·碎纸机谈一谈。
text.description: 你在这里的工作算是告一段落了，但是邪恶的势力总是想来捣乱。$B$B你还记得之前的市场营销专员梅格斯·碎纸机吗？她和其他几个人穿越迅猛龙高地，往东南方去了。沿着东面的道路离开胶囊镇，在岔路口往南走，你就会遇到她了。$B$B据说海边废墟里的蛇形人蠢蠢欲动，好像在酝酿什么阴谋。去那里调查一下情况好吗？
text.completion: Boss, we gotta problem.

english.title: Invasion Imminent!
english.objectives: Speak with Megs Dreadshredder at the western entrance to the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Your work here is done for now, but there's no rest for the wicked, eh?$B$BYou remember Megs Dreadshredder, our old marketing rep? She's taken some others over the hills to the southeast, just past the Raptor Rise. If you follow the path east out of town and follow it south at the fork, you can't miss her.$B$BApparently there's some trouble or other brewing with the snake-men at the ruins on the shore. Go see if you can't sort it all out, would you?
english.completion: Boss, we gotta problem.

text.title: 纳拉其营地的危机
text.objectives: 将刺背野猪人的进攻计划交给纳拉其营地的鹰风酋长。
text.description: 在仔细查看了地图之后，你意识到刺背野猪人的酋长正计划着对纳拉其营地展开进一步攻击。$B$B鹰风酋长必须马上得知这个消息。
text.progress: 你看起来脸色不太好，$N。你带来了什麽消息?
text.completion: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many $r, $N.
text.completed: Return to Chief Hawkwind at Camp Narache in Mulgore.

english.title: Attack on Camp Narache
english.objectives: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
english.description: After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.$b$bSurely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
english.progress: You have a look of concern about you,$N. What news do you bring?
english.completion: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many $r, $N.
english.completed: Return to Chief Hawkwind at Camp Narache in Mulgore.

text.title: Bilgewater Cartel Represent
text.objectives: Destroy 10 Naga Banners, replacing them with Bilgewater Cartel Banners.
text.description: Looks like the naga down there in the ruins are preparing to invade our Town-In-A-Box. I have lots of dead scouts here as proof.$B$BI don't know about you, but I'm not about to let them try. Let's get the jump on them!$B$BCould you lay the foundation for our new coastal holdings by replacing their banners with our own? That's some prime real estate down there!
text.completion: I wish I could have seen the looks on their scaly faces when you blew up their banners and replaced them with our own. On second thought, I don't want to be close enough to see their snarls.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Naga Hide
text.objectives: Collect 5 Intact Naga Hides.
text.description: It's oft whispered in dark corners of a material so fine, so exquisite to the touch, that goblins of sophisticated taste will spend any amount of moolah to get their hands on some.$B$BOf course, I'm speaking of naga hide!$B$B<Brett looks around to make sure no one else is listening in.>$B$BI know that you're going to head down there and that it's inevitable that you're going to have to fight those snakes. Hey, they're not going to have a use for their hides anyway. They'll be dead!
text.progress: Well? How many do you have for me? I think that a 95 to 5 split is more than generous.
text.completion: We're going to be filthy rich, I tell you! Well, if we can get off of this island, that is.
text.completed: Return to Brett "Coins" McQuid at the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Profitable Preservation
text.objectives: Collect 12 Kaldorei Artifacts.
text.description: You know, the naga are the mutated and prettier versions of the kaldorei, better known as the night elves. Don't ask me... it's a long story.$B$BSuffice to say that I'm sure you could 'procure' an artifact or two while you're down there in the ruins. If you know what I mean?$B$BWe have to preserve them in the homes of wealthy collectors everywhere! Right?
text.completed: Return to Ace at the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 最后的仪式，最初的仪式
text.objectives: 在鹰风主母的坟墓前使用葬礼祭品。
text.description: 营地已经安全，野猪人也被赶走了，这都得感谢你，年轻人。我要感谢你为我的母亲、我的儿子和我们大家所做的一切。$B$B是时候让我的母亲安息了。把最后的这件祭品放在她的脚下，$N，我们要向她道别。
text.completion: There is balance in all things. As Greatmother Hawkwind's spirit takes its final journey, you will begin your first.
text.completed: Speak with Chief Hawkwind.

english.title: Last Rites, First Rites
english.objectives: Use the Ceremonial Offering at Greatmother Hawkwind's grave.
english.description: The camp is safe, and the quilboar driven off, all thanks to you, young one. You have my personal thanks for what you have done for my mother, my son, and for all of us.$B$BIt is now time to put Greatmother Hawkwind to rest. Lay the final offering at her feet, $n, and we will say our goodbyes.
english.completion: There is balance in all things. As Greatmother Hawkwind's spirit takes its final journey, you will begin your first.
english.completed: Speak with Chief Hawkwind.

text.title: 夹道进攻
text.objectives: 杀死8名猎手岭斥候。
text.description: $C，看看四周吧。部落埋伏在俯瞰这座山谷的小道中，我们没有任何办法迫使他们走出藏身之所。他们偷袭我们的供给车队，然后消失得无影无踪！$B$B我要你杀入荣耀岗哨，让部落知道这里并不安全。跟大门口的军需官玛丁雷谈一谈。$B$B在沿途杀死这些野蛮的家伙！
text.completion: They're ambushing the roads to Stonetalon, too? We just can't get a break here. Where are they coming from, anyways?
text.completed: Report to Janice Mattingly at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Running the Gauntlet
english.objectives: Kill 8 Hunter Hill Scouts.
english.description: Look around you, $c. We've had no luck dislodging the Horde from the hidden trails that overlook this valley. They appear out of nowhere to ambush our supply caravans and then disappear into the hills!$B$BI need you to run the gauntlet to Honor's Stand and let them know the roads still aren't safe. Talk to Mattingly, the supplies officer by the gate.$B$BAnd kill a few of these brutes along the way!
english.completion: They're ambushing the roads to Stonetalon, too? We just can't get a break here. Where are they coming from, anyways?
english.completed: Report to Janice Mattingly at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 突破
text.objectives: 在荣耀岗哨以西的废墟中收集10份石爪补给品。
text.description: 部落的斥候躲藏在前面的废墟中，伺机偷袭了我的补给车队。只有两名护卫得以生还。你问我？我原本是有头发的！$B$B车队运送的补给品散落在废墟中。将它们收集起来并交给荣耀岗哨的詹妮丝·玛丁雷。即便这批物资无法抵达石爪山脉，也不能让其落入部落之手……
text.progress: What's the story out there?
text.completion: What ... our supplies? These were meant for Stonetalon. No matter, at the rate we're going, we need them more here. Honor's Stand has been cut off from the coast, $n. Commander Singleton is at his wit's end.
text.completed: Take the crates to Janice Mattingly at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Breaking the Siege
english.objectives: Gather 10 Stonetalon Supply crates from the ruins west of Honor's Stand.
english.description: Horde scouts hiding in the ruins up ahead ambushed my supply train. Only two of my bodyguards made it out of there alive. And me? I used to have hair!$B$BThe supplies I was delivering are scattered through the ruins up ahead. Gather them up and take them to Janice Mattingly at Honor's Stand. If they can't make it to Stonetalon, at least we can keep them out of Horde hands...
english.progress: What's the story out there?
english.completion: What ... our supplies? These were meant for Stonetalon. No matter, at the rate we're going, we need them more here. Honor's Stand has been cut off from the coast, $n. Commander Singleton is at his wit's end.
english.completed: Take the crates to Janice Mattingly at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 可愛到不行的小馬泳圈
text.objectives: Use the Irresistible Pool Pony to lure 12 Naga Hatchlings.
text.description: I've got a plan and you're the only one that I know crazy enough to pull it off!$B$BI need you to take this irresistible pool pony to the Vashj'elan Spawning Pool and inflate it. Then, swim down to their hatchlings with it on. I'll bet anything that the hatchlings can be lured away to follow you.$B$BBring them back here and we'll proceed with the next phase of the plan.
text.completion: Oh, they're so cute! I wish that we could turn them into little plush toys and sell them for a gazillion macaroons!
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 这箱食物还能吃吗？
text.objectives: 将食物箱交给马绍尔哨站的威利德·马绍尔。
text.description: 你发现了一箱食物，看来是这座营地被遗弃时落下的。食物箱上的印章写着“马绍尔探险队的财产”。$B$B或许你可以将它交给适当的人？
text.progress: What have you got there?
text.completion: Oh... wow... it's some really old food.  Hey Hol'anyee, take a look at this!  This $r brought us those old rations that we abandoned! No, not from Marshal's Refuge... from the old base camp! I'm not sure I want to peek inside.  I'll just give it to Nolen, I guess... he'll know what to do with it.
text.completed: Return the Crate of Foodstuffs to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand.

english.title: Is This Stuff Still Good?
english.objectives: Return the Crate of Foodstuffs to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand.
english.description: You find what appears to be a crate of food, left behind when this camp was abandoned.  On the outside of the crate, you can make out a stamp that says "PROPERTY OF MARSHAL EXPEDITIONS".$b$bPerhaps you might find someone who could use this?
