english.completion: Oh... wow... it's some really old food.  Hey Hol'anyee, take a look at this!  This $r brought us those old rations that we abandoned! No, not from Marshal's Refuge... from the old base camp! I'm not sure I want to peek inside.  I'll just give it to Nolen, I guess... he'll know what to do with it.
english.completed: Return the Crate of Foodstuffs to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 被遗弃的研究营地
text.objectives: 将研究设备交给马绍尔哨站的霍莱伊·马绍尔。
text.description: 你发现了一件研究设备，看来是这座营地被遗弃时落下的。食物箱上的印章写着“马绍尔探险队的财产”。$B$B或许你可以将它交给适当的人？
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: Well I'll be... that's Shizzle's old portable dinomometer!  Where did you find this? I'm surprised it's still functional, even after all these years.  I'll have it delivered to Shizzle promptly.
text.completed: Return the Research Equipment to Hol'anyee Marshal at Marshal's Stand.

english.title: An Abandoned Research Camp
english.objectives: Return the Research Equipment to Hol'anyee Marshal at Marshal's Stand.
english.description: You find what appears to be a piece of research equipment, left behind when this camp was abandoned.  Chiseled onto the side of the device are the words "PROPERTY OF MARSHAL EXPADISHUNS".$b$bPerhaps you might find someone who could use this?
english.progress: Yes, $n?
english.completion: Well I'll be... that's Shizzle's old portable dinomometer!  Where did you find this? I'm surprised it's still functional, even after all these years.  I'll have it delivered to Shizzle promptly.
english.completed: Return the Research Equipment to Hol'anyee Marshal at Marshal's Stand.

text.description: Placeholder, $N! This is a placeholder lumberjack quest. You? Grab that lumberjack. And do something ... placeholder-y with him.$B$BYou heard me.
text.completed: Return to Janice Mattingly.

text.title: Surrender or Else!
text.objectives: Deal with the leader of the Naga at the Ruins of Vashj'elan.
text.description: $N, you and Ace need to march those naga hatchlings down there and use them as leverage to convince the leader of the naga to surrender to us.$B$BAce knows where to go on the south side of the ruins... just follow him.
text.completion: A faceless of the deep? What's that? That does NOT sound like a naga! Well, you killed it, whatever it was. It doesn't matter now. We have other fish to fry....
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Deprogramming
text.objectives: Defeat Lady Deathwhisper while ensuring that Darnavan survives.
text.description: We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper.$B$BOur man, Darnavan, is one of them now.$B$BIf you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.
text.completion: Thank you, $N!$B$BI owe you a debt of gratitude for rescuing a friend whom I had thought forever lost to the clutches of the Cult. And the Argent Crusade owes you a debt for the invaluable intelligence Darnavan brings with him from his time walking the halls of this Citadel as one of the Cult.$B$BPlease, take this as a token of this appreciation, and may the Light bolster you as you carve a path through this terrible place.
text.completed: Return to Infiltrator Minchar.

text.title: Securing the Ramparts
text.objectives: Slay the Rotting Frost Giant.
text.description: As if this place weren't enough of a madhouse to begin with, we're fighting a war on two fronts up here, with the Scourge on one side and those blasted Alliance dogs on our other flank!$B$BWe are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay.$B$BI'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.
text.completed: Return to the Kor'kron Lieutenant.

text.title: Respite for a Tormented Soul
text.objectives: Use the Life Crystals to preserve Sindragosa's Essence.
text.description: Take this Life Crystal, and have your companions take one as well. It contains potent energies from the verdant Dragonshrine in Dragonblight, and it was my own secret to resisting the dark magics of this place for so long.$B$BWhen you face Sindragosa, battle her until she is weakened, and then have your companions use these Crystals to coax out the essence that is dormant within her. If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
text.completed: Deliver Sindragosa's Essence to Kalecgos at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: Residue Rendezvous
text.objectives: Return to Alchemist Adrianna while infected with Orange and Green Blight.
text.description: Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives.$B$BBut there's a catch -- a proper sample will need to mix two active strains within a living host. Should you have the... misfortune... of becoming such a host, please return here immediately so that we can harvest you for study.
text.end: Return with two strains of Blight.
text.completed: Return to Adrianna inside Icecrown Citadel.

text.title: Blood Quickening
text.objectives: Rescue Infiltrator Minchar before he is executed.
text.description: These Scourge bloodsuckers -- San'layn they call themselves - give me the creeps. We've had one of our best men keeping an eye on them. But this morning he got sloppy and got himself taken prisoner. He's being interrogated by the Queen herself right now, and his cries echo through the Crimson Halls. Please, save him before it's too late!
text.completed: Talk to Minchar.

Get Back to Town
text.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
text.description: We were wrong. It wasn't the naga that were preparing to attack... it was the nearby Oomlot tribe.$B$B$N, you need to get back to the Town-In-A-Box. The pygmies are already attacking!$B$BHere, take this. We bought it off of a pygmy who said it used to belong to some great leader of theirs. Someone whose name translates as Dark Tan Helmet.$B$BIt should fool them so that they don't attack you.
text.completion: $n? We're saved! Who am I kidding? We're all going to die!!!

english.title: Get Back to Town
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
english.description: We were wrong. It wasn't the naga that were preparing to attack... it was the nearby Oomlot tribe.$B$B$N, you need to get back to the Town-In-A-Box. The pygmies are already attacking!$B$BHere, take this. We bought it off of a pygmy who said it used to belong to some great leader of theirs. Someone whose name translates as Dark Tan Helmet.$B$BIt should fool them so that they don't attack you.
english.completion: $n? We're saved! Who am I kidding? We're all going to die!!!

text.title: 蝙蝠的粪便
text.objectives: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Zan'do at Firestone Point.
text.description: There be more in the Razorfen than just pigs, $gbruddah:sistah;. There be bats as well...and if you're goin in there and rilin' up the quilboar anyway, I want ya to bring me back some guano.$B$BYah, guano. The droppin's. Don't give me that look. It be foul, but powerful, primal stuff for rituals...rituals to keep the earth 'round here strong enough to keep from rippin' apart under all the damn fools warrin' round here.$B$BJust bring Zan'do one pile of guano, yah?

english.title: Going, Going, Guano!
english.objectives: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Zan'do at Firestone Point.
english.description: There be more in the Razorfen than just pigs, $gbruddah:sistah;. There be bats as well...and if you're goin in there and rilin' up the quilboar anyway, I want ya to bring me back some guano.$B$BYah, guano. The droppin's. Don't give me that look. It be foul, but powerful, primal stuff for rituals...rituals to keep the earth 'round here strong enough to keep from rippin' apart under all the damn fools warrin' round here.$B$BJust bring Zan'do one pile of guano, yah?

text.title: 蝙蝠的粪便
text.objectives: 帮幽暗城的大药剂师法拉尼尔带回一堆沼泽蝙蝠的粪便。
text.description: 就如你所见到的一样，$N，我们正要在皇家药剂师学会进行一个非常…嗯…有趣的实验。$B$B作为这里的领导者，我的职责就是监管所有最具潜质的化学实验。所以说我总是梦想太多，时间太少！$B$B你看上去是个擅长跑腿的$C，也许你可以帮我的忙。$B$B我需要一种稀有的原料，这种原料只有在产于剃刀沼泽的一种罕见的蝙蝠身上才能找到。去剃刀沼泽帮我带回一些沼泽蝙蝠的粪便来，然后我们就可以开工了……
text.completed: Return to Master Apothecary Faranell at Alterac Mountains.

english.title: Going, Going, Guano!
english.objectives: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
english.description: As you can see, $n, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.$b$bAs the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!$b$bYou look well traveled for a $c. Perhaps you can aid me.$b$bI'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
english.completed: Return to Master Apothecary Faranell at Alterac Mountains.

text.title: 蓝叶薯
text.objectives: In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.$B$BBring 6 Blueleaf Tubers to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
text.description: 蓝叶薯是美味绝顶的佳肴！但是这种东西很罕见，非常非常罕见。它们只生长在贫瘠之地，在剃刀沼泽的地下深处。$B$B不过知道这一点也没什么用，因为如果你不知道它们的确切位置，那么就算近在咫尺你也不一定找得到它们。这就是我训练这些地鼠去寻找蓝叶薯的原因——它们有很灵敏的嗅觉，在五十步以外就能嗅到蓝叶薯块茎的气味。$B$B这差事并不轻松，但是如果你帮我弄来一些蓝叶薯的话，我会付给你一笔可观的报酬。
text.completed: Return to Mebok Mizzyrix at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Blueleaf Tubers
english.objectives: In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.$B$BBring 6 Blueleaf Tubers to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
english.description: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.$B$BAnd even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.$B$BIt won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
english.completed: Return to Mebok Mizzyrix at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: Town-In-A-Box: Under Attack
text.objectives: Use a B.C. Eliminator to defeat 30 Oomlot Warriors.
text.description: $N, you have to defend us!$B$BI had the eggheads deploy the town's cannon defenses, but it seems like there's an unlimited supply of these Oomlot warriors!$B$BGet your behind into one of those B.C. Eliminators and eliminate the pygmy threat to the town!
text.completion: Okay, I think that's good enough for now, but they took a bunch of the townsfolk captive. We're going to have to take the fight to them!
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

english.objectives: Use a B.C. Eliminator to defeat 30 Oomlot Warriors.
english.description: $N, you have to defend us!$B$BI had the eggheads deploy the town's cannon defenses, but it seems like there's an unlimited supply of these Oomlot warriors!$B$BGet your behind into one of those B.C. Eliminators and eliminate the pygmy threat to the town!
english.completion: Okay, I think that's good enough for now, but they took a bunch of the townsfolk captive. We're going to have to take the fight to them!
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 追踪希尔瓦娜斯
text.objectives: 跟随托比亚斯·密斯特曼托追踪希尔瓦娜斯。
text.description: 这是真的？吉尔尼斯失去了她的宠儿。$B$B战事结束后，我们会为此默哀的，但是不是现在。$B$B敌人还踩在吉尔尼斯的土地上，我们不能沉浸在悲伤之中。$B$B父亲的军队已经做好了反击的准备，与此同时，我们还发现了女妖之王的踪迹。你准备好了就说一声。我们要为利亚姆复仇。
text.progress: Did you find her, $N?
text.completion: The Plague?  Something so heinous that not even the orcs condone its use?  I'd say this warrants notifying King Greymane.
text.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at Greymane Square in Gilneas City.

english.title: The Hunt For Sylvanas
english.objectives: Follow Tobias Mistmantle in the Hunt for Sylvanas.
english.description: It's true then?  Gilneas has lost her favorite son.$B$BWe will mourn when this is all over but not a day sooner.$B$BWe will not allow ourselves the luxury of grief while the enemy still breathes Gilnean air.$B$BMy father's men are ready to strike while we still have the Banshee Queen's trail.  Just say the word if you're ready.  Liam deserves swift vengeance.
english.progress: Did you find her, $N?
english.completion: The Plague?  Something so heinous that not even the orcs condone its use?  I'd say this warrants notifying King Greymane.
english.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at Greymane Square in Gilneas City.

text.title: 复仇或是生存
text.objectives: 跟吉尔尼斯城格雷迈恩皇家庭院的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 请转告格雷迈恩，我们掌握了希尔瓦娜斯的行踪并发现了瘟疫的阴谋。$B$B请他做出决定吧。是集结所有兵力对付被遗忘者的首领，还是安排幸存者撤离。
text.completion: You present me with the most difficult choice of my life, $n.

english.title: Vengeance or Survival
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane at Greymane Court in Gilneas City.
english.description: Tell Greymane that we have trackers on Sylvanas and tell him about the Plague.$B$BThe decision will be his.  Launch an all out attack against the leader of the Forsaken or try to evacuate our survivors.
english.completion: You present me with the most difficult choice of my life, $n.

text.title: 吉尔尼斯城保卫战
text.objectives: 取得吉尔尼斯城保卫战的胜利。
text.description: $N，是时候了。我们已经集结并武装了吉尔尼斯城所有可用的兵力。$B$B迎敌奋战吧。一举歼灭希尔瓦娜斯和她麾下的被遗忘者渣滓。$B$B利亚姆负责抵御城门处的敌军。格雷迈恩国王和我的父亲在其他城区作战。$B$B你在这场战事中也肩负重任。带上这柄剑，用它激励作战的将士们。跟克雷南·阿朗纳斯谈一谈，参与吉尔尼斯城的保卫之战吧。
text.completion: We've driven the Forsaken back.  We hold three out of the four districts. But at what cost...
text.completed: Speak to Lorna Crowley inside the Inn at Greymane Square in Gilneas City.

english.title: The Battle for Gilneas City
english.objectives: Achieve victory in the Battle for Gilneas City.
english.description: The time has come, $N.  We've rallied and armed every available Gilnean.$B$BIt is time to meet the enemy head on.  Time to settle the score with Sylvanas and her Forsaken dogs once and for all.$B$BLiam is heading the assault from this gate.  King Greymane and my father are leading the assault on the other districts.$B$BYou have a crucial role to play in this as well.  Take this rapier.  Use it to inspire our men and women in combat.  Speak to Krennan Aranas to take part in the battle for Gilneas City.
english.progress: No...
english.completion: We've driven the Forsaken back.  We hold three out of the four districts. But at what cost...
english.completed: Speak to Lorna Crowley inside the Inn at Greymane Square in Gilneas City.

text.title: Returning a Favor
text.objectives: Find Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Camp.
text.description: You know, while you were out doin' your thing, Megs stopped by here. I hadn't seen her in months, but she barely gave me the time of day, just wanted me to tell you she had more business lined up.$B$BShe said she was headed over to the Dunemaul Compound to set up shop, something about ogres. Since you're done here, might as well head over...I woundn't keep a goblin like her waiting.
text.completion: I've got a great one for you this time, $n. We're gonna initiate these ogres into the Horde...working directly under us.

english.title: Returning a Favor
english.objectives: Find Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Camp.
english.description: You know, while you were out doin' your thing, Megs stopped by here. I hadn't seen her in months, but she barely gave me the time of day, just wanted me to tell you she had more business lined up.$B$BShe said she was headed over to the Dunemaul Compound to set up shop, something about ogres. Since you're done here, might as well head over...I woundn't keep a goblin like her waiting.
english.completion: I've got a great one for you this time, $n. We're gonna initiate these ogres into the Horde...working directly under us.

text.title: 海边打捞
text.objectives: 收集7份热砂补给品。
text.description: 我们得把货物立刻投放到市场里去，不然就没竞争力了。我有一招。$B$B加基森正处于海盗的封锁之下，不过许多被打下船的货物并没有遭到损毁……它们只是被冲走了。大多数都漂到了镇子南边的浅滩上。$B$B去那儿打捞打捞，那些漂浮的箱子里可全是不要本钱的纯利润啊。
text.progress: 让我们看看你有什么本事吧。
text.completion: Hmm, mostly usable. This is good stuff. I've already got buyers lined up, of course. Here's your advance for the rest of the work you're gonna do for me and the Bilgewater Cartel...partner.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder in Gadgetzan.

english.title: Seaside Salvage
english.objectives: Collect 7 Steamwheedle Supplies.
english.description: We've got to get goods moving in this market ASAP if we want to be competitive. I've got an angle for us.$B$BGadgetzan's under blockade by pirates, but plenty of the goods that get blown off the ships survive intact... they just wash away. Most of them wash up in the shallows just south of town.$B$BHead down there and start salvaging; there's crates full of pure profit just floating around down there.
english.progress: Let's see what you've got.
english.completion: Hmm, mostly usable. This is good stuff. I've already got buyers lined up, of course. Here's your advance for the rest of the work you're gonna do for me and the Bilgewater Cartel...partner.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder in Gadgetzan.

text.title: 踩水坑
text.objectives: 杀死8名潮行巨人。
text.description: 情况是这样的。如果我们要在加基森为锈水财阀开拓市场，就得开始为社区提供服务。$B$B新海岸上商机无限，但大海也把海洋巨人给带来了。他们又大又脏，还影响到房地产价格。$B$B到镇子南边的浅滩去，尽可能地把他们除掉，等我这儿生意做成了，少不了你的一份。
text.completion: Property values have already gone up since you left. People like seafront views that don't include briny, gnarled giants stomping around. Here's your cut, $n.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Puddle Stomping
english.objectives: Kill 8 Tidal Striders.
english.description: Here's the situation. If we want to establish the Bilgewater Cartel's market presence in Gadgetzan, we'll need to start providing services to the community.$B$BThe new coast has been great for business here, but the sea also brought sea giants with it. They're large, foul, and drive real estate values down.$B$BHead to the shallows just south of town and kill as many as you can, and I'll cut you in on some of the deals I'm brokering here.
english.completion: Property values have already gone up since you left. People like seafront views that don't include briny, gnarled giants stomping around. Here's your cut, $n.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.objectives: Contact Foreman Franklin.
text.description: Nice work! For our next placeholder, talk to that dude. Uh, Foreman Franklin. Special stuff will happen.

text.description: This here placeholder will be like a shootin' gallery. On Steroids.

text.title: 火箭营救
text.objectives: 把救生火箭交给5名热砂港幸存者，用炸弹杀死40名南海封锁者。
text.description: 好吧，$N。小打小闹够了，该做大事了。$B$B热砂港废墟里还有很多倒霉的热砂地精等着人救他们。他们每一个都是未来潜在的客户。离港的每艘船都被打沉了……所以我说咱们走空路！$B$B镇子外面的港口那儿有个热气球，我们可以用它。去吧，我一会儿就到。
text.completion: Isn't it nice when you can do a good deed, and see enormous future financial gains from it? It warms my little goblin heart. And my big goblin wallet. You did great, kid. Gadgetzan's gonna be ours soon. Here's a little token of my appreciation.
text.completed: Talk to Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Rocket Rescue
english.objectives: Deliver Life-Rockets to 5 Steamwheedle Survivors and use bombs to kill 40 Southshore Blockaders.
english.description: Alright, $n. We've done enough small jobs around here; it's time to seal the deal.$B$BThe ruins of Steamwheedle Port are still full of hapless Steamwheedle goblins, waiting to be rescued. Every single one of them is a potential future customer. They're firing on every boat that leaves port...so I say we take to the skies!$B$BThere's a hot air balloon just outside of town near the docks, we can use that. Go ahead and hop in, I'll catch up with you.
english.completion: Isn't it nice when you can do a good deed, and see enormous future financial gains from it? It warms my little goblin heart. And my big goblin wallet. You did great, kid. Gadgetzan's gonna be ours soon. Here's a little token of my appreciation.
english.completed: Talk to Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 热带天堂在呼唤
text.objectives: 去找安戈洛环形山马绍尔哨站的威利德·马绍尔。
text.description: 嗨，你看来像是个眼界独到的冒险者。在找什么不一样的东西么？异国情调？某种……发财的机会？$B$B那么就把你靴里的沙子清出来，因为我有个提议。威利德·马绍尔正在寻找像你一样可靠的雇佣兵。他在马绍尔哨站有个营地，从安戈洛环形山中央的火山朝东南走便是。$B$B再次重申，天堂不是为所有人准备的，$R。是为了你。热带绿洲正等着你哪。
text.completion: Hey Hol'anyee, look at the getup on this one! Ahem.  Our recruiter sent you?  Good.  Let's start out with a bit of honesty: Un'Goro isn't the perfect nirvana that you may have been promised.  You've probably figured that out on the way over here, though. Shall we get to work?

english.title: Tropical Paradise Beckons
english.objectives: Report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Hey, you look like a discriminating adventurer.  Are you looking for something different?  Something exotic?  Something... profitable?$b$bWell shake the sand out of your boots, because I've got a proposition for you.  Williden Marshal is looking for competent sellswords such as yourself.  He's set up camp at Marshal's Stand, just southeast of the volcano in the center of lush Un'Goro Crater.$b$bThen again, paradise isn't for everyone, $r.  It's up to you.  Your tropical oasis awaits.
english.completion: Hey Hol'anyee, look at the getup on this one! Ahem.  Our recruiter sent you?  Good.  Let's start out with a bit of honesty: Un'Goro isn't the perfect nirvana that you may have been promised.  You've probably figured that out on the way over here, though. Shall we get to work?

text.title: 斧成
text.completion: Stand Clear, $c, and steady yourself.

english.title: Empowerment
english.completion: Stand Clear, $c, and steady yourself.

text.title: 记住圣光
text.objectives: 帮助学者阿弗恩同玛格图尔告别。
text.description: 玛格图尔逐渐虚弱，$N。我的治疗药准备好了……它一定要管用。一定要！$B$B你为我们俩已经做了太多。假如你能留下来见证玛格图尔的最后一刻，我将十分荣幸。
text.completion: I am moved, $n. Prophet Velen has been in closely guarded seclusion. He has dared not waste his energy on anything save preparing for the final confrontation he has foretold. And yet, he came here, in person, to comfort a single dying soul. I must thank you as well, for helping me make my last effort to comfort my friend. My research will continue... and I hope that Magtoor will continue to watch over me.
text.completed: Speak with Anchorite Avuun.

english.title: Remember the Light
english.objectives: Help Anchorite Avuun say farewell to Magtoor.
english.description: Magtoor grows weaker by the second, $n. My remedy is prepared... it must work. It must!$B$BYou have done so much for the both of us. I would be honored if you stayed for what may be Magtoor's final moments.
english.completion: I am moved, $n. Prophet Velen has been in closely guarded seclusion. He has dared not waste his energy on anything save preparing for the final confrontation he has foretold. And yet, he came here, in person, to comfort a single dying soul. I must thank you as well, for helping me make my last effort to comfort my friend. My research will continue... and I hope that Magtoor will continue to watch over me.
english.completed: Speak with Anchorite Avuun.

text.title: 个人财产
text.objectives: Bring the Sealed Chest to Highlord Darion Mograine in Icecrown Citadel.
text.description: 你在这只箱子上找不到任何开关铰链或缝隙。如果不是你在摇晃这只箱子的时候能听到里面发出物体碰撞的声音，你一定会以为它是一整块金属。$B$B很可能只有大领主莫格莱尼才知道打开这只箱子的办法。
text.completion: 给你，$N。

english.title: Personal Property
english.objectives: Bring the Sealed Chest to Highlord Darion Mograine in Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: You can detect no hinges or openings on this box. Were it not for the shifting of items inside, it could easily be mistaken for solid metal.$b$bIf anyone could know the method of its opening, it would be Highlord Mograine.
english.completion: Here you are, $r.

text.title: 拖延不可避免的局势
text.objectives: 乘坐被俘的骑乘蝙蝠摧毁6台被遗忘者投石车，并杀死40名入侵的被遗忘者。
text.description: 虽然我很想大开杀戒，为利亚姆复仇……但是我希望按照他的想法行事。生前，他总是将臣民的安危放在首位。$B$B北门河底就是送葬者小径。在城民撤离到埃德里奇的安息地前，你必须阻止瘟疫的蔓延。$B$B我们捕获到一只被遗忘者的蝙蝠。我要你驾驭这只野兽，消灭那些传播瘟疫的怪物。动作要快！
text.progress: Is it done, $N?
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  Almost everybody managed to make it through.
text.completed: Return to King Genn Greymane at Greymane Court in Gilneas City.

english.title: Slowing the Inevitable
english.objectives: Use the Captured Riding Bat to destroy 6 Forsaken Catapults and 40 Invading Forsaken.
english.description: As much as I want to exact swift and brutal revenge... I must honor my son's memory first.  He cared for his people first and foremost.$B$BThe Undertaker's Pass goes underground below Northgate River.  You must prevent the plague from being deployed while we evacuate our men, women and children to Aderic's Repose.$B$BWe captured one of the Forsaken's dreaded bombing bats.  I want you to fly the infernal beast as best you can and unleash hell upon those who seek to bring the Plague to our people.  Hurry!
english.progress: Is it done, $N?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  Almost everybody managed to make it through.
english.completed: Return to King Genn Greymane at Greymane Court in Gilneas City.

text.title: 向奥布里报到
text.objectives: 向北方城堡的海军司令奥布里报到。
text.description: 嗨，叫你呢！刚刚下船的新兵？欢迎你来到卡利姆多。要么葬身于此，要么全力奋战。$B$B城堡遇到了麻烦，你在来的路上应该也注意到了吧。海军司令奥布里急需人手来度过这次难关。$C，你已被征召！$B$B沿着山路往上走，你可以在塔楼顶层找到奥布里。
text.completion: Hm? What unit are you with, $c? No matter, we need all hands. My fleet is in tatters and they've broken into the hold. You armed? That's good enough for me.
text.completed: Report to Admiral Aubrey.

english.title: Report to Aubrey
english.objectives: Report to Admiral Aubrey in Northwatch Hold.
english.description: You there! Fresh off the boat? Welcome to Kalimdor, a land hellbent to kill you or die tryin'.$B$BThere's trouble at the hold - as I'm sure you noticed on your way in. Admiral Aubrey needs all hands on deck if we're to make it through this. Consider yourself drafted, $c!$B$BFollow the road up the hill and you'll find Aubrey in the tower, topside.
english.completion: Hm? What unit are you with, $c? No matter, we need all hands. My fleet is in tatters and they've broken into the hold. You armed? That's good enough for me.
english.completed: Report to Admiral Aubrey.

text.title: 经典旧世随机 英雄 （第一次）
乌姆洛特村
text.objectives: Speak with Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.
text.description: The pygmies took most of our people back to their village. Who knows what evil they're up to?$B$B$N, you have to go up there and free all of the captives before the pygmies work their voodoo on them!$B$BIzzy's already up near Oomlot Village to the southeast. She'll give you the heads-up on what's going down.$B$BYour pygmy helmet looks like it's in bad shape, but it should last long enough for you to get there.$B$BI hope.
text.completion: $n? What are you doing wearing that pygmy helm? Looks like it's about to fall apart. I'm glad that they sent you up here. I thought for sure they were going to send that jerk, Grapplehammer and his ego-enabling assistant.

english.objectives: Speak with Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.
english.description: The pygmies took most of our people back to their village. Who knows what evil they're up to?$B$B$N, you have to go up there and free all of the captives before the pygmies work their voodoo on them!$B$BIzzy's already up near Oomlot Village to the southeast. She'll give you the heads-up on what's going down.$B$BYour pygmy helmet looks like it's in bad shape, but it should last long enough for you to get there.$B$BI hope.
english.completion: $n? What are you doing wearing that pygmy helm? Looks like it's about to fall apart. I'm glad that they sent you up here. I thought for sure they were going to send that jerk, Grapplehammer and his ego-enabling assistant.

text.title: Free the Captives
text.objectives: Free 5 Goblin Captives.
text.description: They've got a bunch of our people in there. I know that they're doing strange rituals to them. It looks like they're sucking the life force right out of them!$B$BYou have to go into the village and free the captives before it's too late!
text.completion: Great job, but that's not even half of the hostages that they took from town. Darn it all! They must have taken the rest of the captives to their other villages up in the volcano!
text.completed: Return to Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 为A-Me 01服务
text.objectives: 将A-Me的随身存储器交给安戈洛环形山覆苔营地卡尔纳·雷塔维。
text.description: 你好。我是A-Me 01。你是……$R？$B$BA-Me成功地完成了研究本地猩猩的任务。卡尔纳所需的数据已经收集完毕。$B$B但是A-Me 01不会回去。A-Me有了新的家庭。A-Me要留在这里陪伴猩猩。$B$B<A-Me将一件小型装置从它身上拆离下来，递给了你。>$B$B你把数据交给卡尔纳。你告诉她发生的事情。
text.progress: Wh... what's this?
text.completion: She decided to stay?  Fascinating... I'll have to look over this data and find out why. Thank you again, $n. I really appreciate it.
text.completed: Return to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile in Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Serving A-Me 01
english.objectives: Bring A-Me's Thumb Drive back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Greetings.  I unit A-Me 01.  You... $r?$B$BA-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success.  A-Me has gathered data that Karna needs.$b$bA-Me 01 not returning, though.  A-Me has new family now.  Here, with the gorillas, A-Me stay.$b$b<A-Me 01 detaches a small device from her hand and gives it to you.>$b$bYou bring data back to Karna.  You tell her what happen.
english.progress: Wh... what's this?
english.completion: She decided to stay?  Fascinating... I'll have to look over this data and find out why. Thank you again, $n. I really appreciate it.
english.completed: Return to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 加基森海盗：亡灵宝藏
text.objectives: 杀死任意15名南海海盗。
text.description: 瞧，宝贝儿，你应该很容易就明白这是怎么回事。这里有海盗，有地精，地精在打海盗。还有一些可悲的小侏儒也在打海盗。$B$B我来给你说明白点：我们要去杀掉大量的海盗。去动手吧，好吗？毕竟，我们可不能被侏儒的战绩给比下去。
text.completion: I'm pleased to report that our brand recognition in this area has skyrocketed now that you've killed most of the people who didn't want us here.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder in Lost Rigger Cove.

english.title: Dead Man's Chest
english.objectives: Kill 15 Southsea Freebooters of any kind.
english.description: Look, babe, you should be able to see what's happening here pretty easily. There's pirates, there's goblins, the goblins are fighting the pirates. There's some sad little gnomes trying to fight the pirates too.$B$BI'll make it nice and simple for you: we need to kill a lot of pirates. Go do that, 'kay? We don't want the gnomes killing more than us, after all.
english.completion: I'm pleased to report that our brand recognition in this area has skyrocketed now that you've killed most of the people who didn't want us here.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder in Lost Rigger Cove.

text.title: 夷为平地！
text.objectives: 给西北小屋、东北小屋，以及西南小屋点火。
text.description: 我正在对这里的房地产进行全面评估，但不幸的是，其市值远低于可接受程度。我们必须重新翻修。$B$B我碰巧知道一种靠谱的改造方式：火攻！你要把这些完全安全的朗姆酒燃烧瓶扔到那些脏兮兮的破茅屋上去。$B$B尽量别站在下风口。
text.completion: Wonderful job. Have you ever thought about becoming a full-time arsonist? I know a few people, it's a nice gig. Well, we'll chit-chat about that one later. More to do here!
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

english.title: To The Ground!
english.objectives: Set fire to the Northwest Shack, the Southeast Shack, and the Northeast Shack.
english.description: I've conducted a thorough appraisal of the real estate here and, unfortunately, its market value is just far too low to be of any use. We're going to have to renovate.$B$BLuckily for you, I've learned a few things about arson. Hopefully you have too! You're going to be throwing these perfectly safe bottles of flaming rum at those filthy ramshackle huts over there.$B$BTry not to stand downwind.
english.completion: Wonderful job. Have you ever thought about becoming a full-time arsonist? I know a few people, it's a nice gig. Well, we'll chit-chat about that one later. More to do here!
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

text.title: Send a Message
text.objectives: Slay Yngwie.
text.description: The Oomlot leader, Yngwie, is too powerful to be left alive. He's barking nonsense from the raised west side of the village, across the rope bridge.$B$BGo up there and get him before he sends the rest of the village against us.$B$BPiece of cake!
text.completion: Nice work, bud! Hope he wasn't too tough.
text.completed: Return to Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Send them a message they'll never forget.

text.title: 顺路除害
text.objectives: 杀死5名血牙狼人。
text.description: 格雷迈恩国王要你冒生命危险营救一个恶名昭著的叛徒？这我倒没有意见。$B$B在你出去的路上，不如帮我个忙，杀死这些被诅咒的怪物。
text.completion: If I hadn't seen you kill a few of the mangy things with my own eyes, I'd think you did not complete the task I asked of you. It looks like we're hardly putting a dent in their numbers.
text.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey at the Military District in Gilneas City.

english.title: While You're At It
english.objectives: Kill 5 Bloodfang Worgen.
english.description: Fine by me if King Greymane wants you to risk your life to rescue a known traitor.$B$BDo me a favor and do something useful while you're out there and kill these cursed fleabags.
english.completion: If I hadn't seen you kill a few of the mangy things with my own eyes, I'd think you did not complete the task I asked of you. It looks like we're hardly putting a dent in their numbers.
english.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey at the Military District in Gilneas City.

text.title: 凝视者的标记
text.objectives: 从晶鳞凝视者身上获得5颗水晶之眼。
text.description: 你要出去打土狼，是吗？如果你不介意的话，我有个提议。我需要潜伏在北边的晶鳞蜥蜴的眼睛。它们的眼珠里含有神奇的水晶，有高度的……收藏价值。$B$B当然，你也许听说过有些傻子会用它们来强化自己心灵能力的事，不过我向你保证，我的意图是纯学术性的！$B$B给我多带一些来，我会大加犒赏你的。至少比这些一个铜子儿掰两半的地精要大方！
text.progress: Do, ah, do you have them?
text.completion: Ahh, perfect! Just what I need...full of potent focusing energies... ...ahem! I mean, perfect for my collection! Narain Soothfancy is in no need of artificial enhancement of any kind! Now take your pay and be off!
text.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

english.title: Gazer Tag
english.objectives: Collect 5 Ocular Crystals from Glasshide Gazers.
english.description: You're going out to hunt hyenas, eh? If you don't mind, I've got an offer myself. I'm in need of eyes from the Glasshide Gazers that lurk to the north. Their eyes contain wonderful crystals, valuable to...collectors.$B$BNow, you may have heard that some sad individuals use these to enhance paramental abilities, but I assure you, my interests are purely academic!$B$BBring me a good portion of them and I'll pay you well for them. Better than these copper-pinching goblins will, at least!
english.progress: Do, ah, do you have them?
english.completion: Ahh, perfect! Just what I need...full of potent focusing energies... ...ahem! I mean, perfect for my collection! Narain Soothfancy is in no need of artificial enhancement of any kind! Now take your pay and be off!
english.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

text.title: 斩仓
text.objectives: 在大裂口消灭任意15只哈扎里异种。
text.description: 上个星期我一直盯着这丑陋的虫巢，打算琢磨明白到底怎么才能靠一群危险、暴力的节肢动物赚钱。现在我想不出来了，还饿着肚子。$B$B这些动物就是一群废物，我说就该把它们清光。下去开始杀虫子吧。
text.completion: This isn't goin' fast enough. There's gotta be a faster way...
text.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

english.title: Cutting Losses
english.objectives: Kill 15 Hazzali Silithid of any kind in the Gaping Chasm.
english.description: I've spent the last week starin' at this ugly pit trying to think of how to exploit a bunch of dangerous, violent arthropods for profit. Now I'm out of ideas, and starving.$B$BThese things are a wash, and I say it's time to start clearing them out. Head down into that pit and start killin' bugs.
english.completion: This isn't goin' fast enough. There's gotta be a faster way...
english.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

text.title: 沙漠之鸡
text.objectives: 收集6块土狼肉块。
text.description: 我有个主意，但得先需要饵。$B$B有一天，我看到一头疯狂的疱爪土狼离裂口太近了，一只异种虫突然窜了出来，差不多一口就把它囫囵吞了！真可怕。$B$B所以显然我们需要的就是土狼肉。去找点来，确保新鲜，然后带回来。营地北边应该有不少土狼。
text.progress: This is fresh, right? They won't go after anything that's been withering in the sun.
text.completion: Man, this stuff looks delicious. I'm half tempted to just fry some up myself. No! We've gotta focus on gettin' out of here. Maybe just one piece...
text.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost.

english.title: Chicken of the Desert
english.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of Hyena Meat.
english.description: I've got an idea, but we're going to need bait.$B$BThe other day I saw a rabid blisterpaw hyena wander too close to the edge of the chasm, and one of the silithid comes diving out of nowhere. Nearly swallowed it whole! Horrible sight.$B$BSo we're gonna need hyena meat, obviously. Go gather some, make sure it's fresh, and bring it back here. There should be plenty just north of the camp.
english.progress: This is fresh, right? They won't go after anything that's been withering in the sun.
english.completion: Man, this stuff looks delicious. I'm half tempted to just fry some up myself. No! We've gotta focus on gettin' out of here. Maybe just one piece...
english.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost.

text.title: 击退不速之客！
text.objectives: 跟海军司令奥布里谈一谈，飞往黑弹珠号杀死6名怒吼水兵。
text.description: $N，海洋是我们的命脉。眼下大多数战舰要么返回塞拉摩维修船体，要么躺在海底等着生锈。只有黑弹珠号仍在坚守，保卫着这座海港。$B$B但是就在刚才，我们收到了她发出的讯号，黑弹珠号被敌人攻占了！$B$B准备好了就跟我谈谈，我会派一只狮鹫送你登上甲板。杀死那些胆敢攻击我心爱的战舰的怒吼水兵，然后向菲舍尔船长汇报。
text.completion: You make a hell of a marine, $n. We'll mop up the others. But it looks like the Horde fleet is disengaging - maybe to land more troops ashore? Admiral Aubrey will know what to do. Talk to me when you're ready to fly back!
text.completed: Speak with Captain Fisher.

english.title: Repel Boarders!
english.objectives: Speak to Admiral Aubrey to fly to the Blackpool and kill 6 Rageroar Sea Dogs.
english.description: $N, the sea is our only lifeline, and right now most of my fleet is either steaming back to Theramore for repairs or rusting at the bottom of this bay. Only the Blackpool remains afloat to defend our harbor.$B$BBut she's just signaled that she's being boarded!$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready, I'll have one of our naval gryphons deposit you right on the deck. Slaughter the rageroar sea dogs who dare assault my precious ship and report to Captain Fisher for further orders.
english.completion: You make a hell of a marine, $n. We'll mop up the others. But it looks like the Horde fleet is disengaging - maybe to land more troops ashore? Admiral Aubrey will know what to do. Talk to me when you're ready to fly back!
english.completed: Speak with Captain Fisher.

text.title: Body And Soul
text.objectives: Destroy Yngwie's Soul.$B$BIf you somehow misplace Yngwie's Body, ask Izzy if she found it.
text.description: There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough.$B$BIf you were to drag his body down to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.
text.completed: Return to Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Oomlot Dealt With
text.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
text.description: $N, you have to get back to the Town-In-A-Box and warn them about the goblin zombies up in the volcano's caldera!
text.completion: They turned some of our people into zombies? Tell me something I don't know....

english.title: Oomlot Dealt With
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
english.description: $N, you have to get back to the Town-In-A-Box and warn them about the goblin zombies up in the volcano's caldera!
english.completion: They turned some of our people into zombies? Tell me something I don't know....

text.title: 北方城堡的火炮
text.objectives: 跟炮兵斯密瑟谈一谈。
text.description: 我们收到了菲舍尔船长发出的讯号。部落战舰派出了岸勤部队？不能让他们发动侧面夹攻。$B$B我已经安排两名优秀的炮手前去阻击敌人。跟海岸边的炮兵斯密瑟谈一谈。$B$B你恐怕要一路杀出去了。就当是顺便守护城堡了嘛！
text.completion: Aubrey sent you? Good! I take it you know your way around a cannon?
text.completed: 跟炮兵斯密瑟谈一谈。

english.title: The Guns of Northwatch
english.objectives: Speak with Cannoneer Smythe.
english.description: Captain Fisher signaled us from below. The Horde fleet is landing shore parties? We can't let them flank us from the beach.$B$BI've already sent two of my best gunners down there to defend the beach head. Talk to Cannoneer Smythe down on the shore.$B$BYou'll have to fight your way through the courtyard to get there. See if you can help the others secure the hold on your way down!
english.completion: Aubrey sent you? Good! I take it you know your way around a cannon?
english.completed: Speak with Cannoneer Smythe.

text.title: 用尽炮弹
text.objectives: 使用北卫军海岸排炮摧毁10艘怒吼划艇。
text.description: 我们拥有足够的资源，却陷入人手不足的窘境，$N。操纵海岸边的大炮，击毁部落的战舰！
text.completion: Ho ho! The beach is ours! We just might keep a foothold on this miserable dustball of a continent after all.
text.completed: Report to Cannoneer Smythe.

english.title: Run Out the Guns
english.objectives: Use a Northwatch Shore Battery to destroy 10 Rageroar Rowboats.
english.description: We've got the hardware but not the manpower, $N. Man one of the carronades on the shore here and take out those incoming boats!
english.completion: Ho ho! The beach is ours! We just might keep a foothold on this miserable dustball of a continent after all.
english.completed: Report to Cannoneer Smythe.

text.title: Up the Volcano
text.objectives: Speak with Coach Crosscheck at the Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.
text.description: A whole bunch of our people headed up to the top of the volcano to mount a counter-offensive. There's something horrible brewing up there on the Lost Peak.$B$BThey're waiting for you before they make any moves against the pygmies. Those evil little things turned a lot of us into zombies!$B$B$N, save us!
text.completion: My star player has arrived!

english.title: Up the Volcano
english.objectives: Speak with Coach Crosscheck at the Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.

There's something horrible brewing up there on the Lost Peak.$B$BThey're waiting for you before they make any moves against the pygmies. Those evil little things turned a lot of us into zombies!$B$B$N, save us!
english.completion: My star player has arrived!

text.title: 开花弹
text.objectives: 收集15枚开花弹。
text.description: $C！感谢圣光——他们将我们赶回了码头。庭院已经失陷！$B$B我们的弹药储备所剩无几，而兽人正准备从山上发动袭击。必须立即补充弹药。$B$B快，冲进那座残破的塔楼，尽你所能地收集任何锋利的金属器械。刀，叉甚至钉子也行！集齐一把之后就将它们塞进炮台里！
text.progress: Paxton has already loaded a charge into the cannon. All it needs is the ammunition you improvised.
text.completion: The Horde is massing at the base of the hill. Breathlessly, you stuff the debris you collected into the muzzle of the cannon, step back, cover one ear, and tug on the igniter cord...
text.completed: Fire the cannon!

english.title: Langridge Shot
english.objectives: Gather 15 pieces of Langridge Shot.
english.description: $C! Thank the light - they've practically driven us back to the docks. The courtyard is overrun!$B$BWe're out of canister shot and the orcs are getting ready for an assault up the hill. We need to improvise some scatter-shot, and fast.$B$BHurry, run into the broken tower here and grab whatever sharp, pointy bits of scrap metal you can lay your hands on. Knives, forks, nails - anything! Load the cannon when you've got an armful!
english.progress: Paxton has already loaded a charge into the cannon. All it needs is the ammunition you improvised.
english.completion: The Horde is massing at the base of the hill. Breathlessly, you stuff the debris you collected into the muzzle of the cannon, step back, cover one ear, and tug on the igniter cord...
english.completed: Fire the cannon!

text.title: Zombies vs. Super Booster Rocket Boots
text.objectives: Use the Super Booster Rocket Boots to slay 50 Goblin Zombies.
text.description: Those zombies that got past us are nothing compared to the numbers waiting just through the pass. If we don't deal with them soon, the pygmy witch doctors are going to send all of them against the town, and even the cannons down there won't be able to handle that many!$B$BI brought a couple of shredder boots along. Greely modded them and now they're Super Booster Rocket Boots!$B$BUse the boots to incinerate the zombies in the Oostan villages to the east.
text.completion: You did it! No more zombies to worry about. Let's pause a moment in silence for the stinky departed. Okay, done.
text.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.

english.completion: You did it! No more zombies to worry about. Let's pause a moment in silence for the stinky departed. Okay, done.
english.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 夺回庭院
text.objectives: 消灭10名怒吼步兵。
text.description: 这也是剿灭敌人的妙招。兽人的尸体上插满了刀叉！$B$B怒吼氏族已经攻破了城墙，但是我们还有机会扭转战局。去山下帮助士兵们夺回庭院吧……
text.completion: Great work! We've knocked them on their heels, maybe long enough to shore up our defenses. Provided we find a way to take out their artillery...
text.completed: Return to Thomas Paxton.

english.title: Re-Take the Courtyard
english.objectives: Kill 10 Rageroar Grunts.
english.description: That's one way to clear a hill. Those corpses are impaled with knives and forks!$B$BThe Rageroar clan has breached the walls, but we can still turn this fight around. Go down the hill and help our men hold on to the courtyard below...
english.completion: Great work! We've knocked them on their heels, maybe long enough to shore up our defenses. Provided we find a way to take out their artillery...
english.completed: Return to Thomas Paxton.

text.title: 重返战场
text.objectives: 对6名受伤的防御者使用药草绷带。
text.description: 这场战争还没有结束，$C。远没有结束。$B$B庭院中的士兵有的仍一息尚存。我们可以挽救他们的性命！我将绷带放入特制的药水中浸泡，这是我们在吉尔尼斯常用的法子。这种草药非常难闻，却有起死回生的疗效。$B$B对庭院中受伤的防御者使用绷带，或许可以帮助他们恢复健康并重返战场。
text.progress: I hope you have enough bandages. My supply of those herbs was cut off when these brutes sacked my beloved Gilneas.
text.completion: A steady stream of the walking wounded have come up the hill to see me, $n. I trust that was your work? Well done!
text.completed: Return to Tolliver Houndstooth.

english.title: Back in the Fight
english.objectives: Use the Herb-Soaked Bandages on 6 Wounded Defenders.
english.description: This fight isn't over, $c. Not by a long shot.$B$BSome of the soldiers in the courtyard still have breath in their lungs. We can save them! I've soaked these rags in an herbal remedy we used to rely on back in Gilneas. The smell is awful but this poultice can practically raise the dead.$B$BUse these bandages on wounded defenders down in the courtyard and we'll see if we can't get them back in the fight.
english.progress: I hope you have enough bandages. My supply of those herbs was cut off when these brutes sacked my beloved Gilneas.
english.completion: A steady stream of the walking wounded have come up the hill to see me, $n. I trust that was your work? Well done!
english.completed: Return to Tolliver Houndstooth.

text.title: Three Little Pygmies
text.objectives: Slay Gaahl, Malmo, and Teloch.
text.description: Look, I think it's great that we're destroying all of these zombies, even though they're our friends and family. But don't you think we should be taking care of the pygmies that are creating them as well?$B$BAt the three Oostan villages, Nord, Sor, and Ost, there are witch doctors: Gaahl, Malmo, and Teloch.$B$BMaybe you could take care of them? I don't want to be turned into a zombie!
text.completion: I gotta tell you, that's a load off of my mind. That is, I won't have to worry about no new zombies coming after my brains!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.

I don't want to be turned into a zombie!
english.completion: I gotta tell you, that's a load off of my mind. That is, I won't have to worry about no new zombies coming after my brains!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 搖滾粉末
text.objectives: Collect 5 scoops of Rockin' Powder.
text.description: I'll give these pygmies one thing... they sure know how to party! But they're not so clever. I think I've discovered the source of their rockin' powers: Rockin' Powder!$B$BIt turns out that this stuff, which turns them into world-class rockers, is also highly explosive. We must have it!$B$BSo, while you're in there at Oostan to the east, make sure that you pickup a whole bunch of the stuff. Trust me, you're going to need it for what's coming up!
text.progress: Hmm, let me see how much you've got.
text.completion: This will do. In fact, it's more than we need. I devised an ingenious idea for a weapon that the boots will be turned into once you get them to Hobart. Hand the powder over and I'll load it into the the Super Booster Rocket Boots.
text.completed: Return to Assistant Greely at Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.

english.objectives: Collect 5 scoops of Rockin' Powder.
english.description: I'll give these pygmies one thing... they sure know how to party! But they're not so clever. I think I've discovered the source of their rockin' powers: Rockin' Powder!$B$BIt turns out that this stuff, which turns them into world-class rockers, is also highly explosive. english.completed: Return to Assistant Greely at Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 推进力
text.objectives: Meet Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove.
text.description: We can't just rest on our laurels here, babe. We've got to keep this momentum going! People are talking about us.$B$BUnfortunately, they're also talking about this air-headed gnome, Kelsey, who's apparently been running jobs right alongside us. If we're going to drive her out of what's rightfully a goblin town, we need to seal the deal here.$B$BWe're going to take care of Gadgetzan's pirate problem for them, for good. Head south to Lost Rigger Cove, I'll meet you there.
text.completion: Good thing you're here! I'm gonna need a lot of help if we want to beat these gnomes to the punch.

english.title: Momentum
english.objectives: Meet Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove.
english.description: We can't just rest on our laurels here, babe. We've got to keep this momentum going! People are talking about us.$B$BUnfortunately, they're also talking about this air-headed gnome, Kelsey, who's apparently been running jobs right alongside us. If we're going to drive her out of what's rightfully a goblin town, we need to seal the deal here.$B$BWe're going to take care of Gadgetzan's pirate problem for them, for good. Head south to Lost Rigger Cove, I'll meet you there.
english.completion: Good thing you're here! I'm gonna need a lot of help if we want to beat these gnomes to the punch.

text.title: 解除困境
text.objectives: 使用帕克斯顿的火炬烧毁3台怒吼投石车和1台投刃车。
text.description: 一旦怒吼兽人获得军火供给，我们就很难确保城堡的高墙不被攻破了。我要你穿越峡谷，摧毁他们的武器。$B$B兽人喜欢在重型军械上涂抹煤焦油，这让它们成为危险的易燃品。带上我的火炬，焚毁北方城堡以北的投石车。$B$B然后点燃怒吼营地里的投刃车！这些军械杀死了不少我们的士兵。
text.progress: Burn it all, $c. Burn it to cinders!
text.completion: Good! Without heavy equipment, the Horde will have to pull back to regroup. We've bought ourselves some time to re-secure the fortress. Well done!
text.completed: Return to Thomas Paxton.

english.title: Lifting the Siege
english.objectives: Use Paxton's Torch to burn 3 Rageroar Catapults and 1 Rageroar Blade Thrower.
english.description: We'll never be able to re-secure the fortress walls so long as Rageroar and his goons have access to artillery. I need you to fight your way across that chasm and take out his big guns.$B$BOrcs season their heavy machinery with coal tar, which makes them flammable. Take my torch and burn any catapults you see north of Northwatch.$B$BThen, torch those big blade-throwers in Rageroar's base camp! Those things have killed enough of our men.
english.progress: Burn it all, $c. Burn it to cinders!
english.completion: Good! Without heavy equipment, the Horde will have to pull back to regroup. We've bought ourselves some time to re-secure the fortress. Well done!
english.completed: Return to Thomas Paxton.

text.title: 收赃物
text.objectives: 获得10份海盗赃物。
text.description: 咱们干点有用的，宝贝儿。这些海盗把成吨的好东西就这么放着，等人去拿。你能相信他们就坐在这这种东西上面吗？$B$B我是说，既然东西就在那儿，他们干嘛不去拿呢？赃物可以卖掉，然后买些崭新的漂亮玩意啊。$B$B总之，行行好，出门干架的时候尽量把他们值钱的玩意儿都拿来。拜拜！
text.progress: Let's see what you've got. You're not hiding any for yourself, are you? You'll never find a buyer without me, you know.
text.completion: Beautiful! And to think these idiots were just sitting on it. Here's a bit up front, we'll talk about profit-sharing bonuses later.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

english.title: Booty Duty
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Pirate Booty.
english.description: Let's not be wasteful here, babe. These pirates have tons of valuable nonsense just sitting around, waiting to be fenced. Can you believe they just sit on this stuff?$B$BI mean, why do they even bother taking it if it's just going to sit around? Stolen goods should be sold off and used to buy shiny new things.$B$BAnyway, be a dear and go grab as much of their loot as you can carry while you're out busting heads. Ciao!
english.progress: Let's see what you've got. You're not hiding any for yourself, are you? You'll never find a buyer without me, you know.
english.completion: Beautiful! And to think these idiots were just sitting on it. Here's a bit up front, we'll talk about profit-sharing bonuses later.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

text.title: 恐须船长
text.objectives: 杀死恐须船长。
text.description: 好吧，宝贝儿，这次我有一桩更大的生意。$B$B我们在南边一条小船上发现了南海海盗的船长。是南边，不是我们横冲直撞了好几个小时想找条大鱼的地方。他就坐在那儿，袖手旁观，看着我们在这儿打成一团。$B$B我就不跟你开什么“恶意收购”的玩笑了。到他的船上去给他一顿胖揍，然后我们就能收工了！
text.completion: Sea giants? You think he was training them towards Gadgetzan on purpose? Whatever, he's splitsville now. And Gadgetzan owes us big time! I can't wait to see the look on Marin's face. Here's your cut, babe. You're moving up in the world.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.
text.giverWindow: Fear the beard.

english.title: Captain Dreadbeard
english.objectives: Kill Captain Dreadbeard.
english.description: Alright, babe, I've got something bigger for you to take on here.$B$BWe spotted the captain of the Southsea over on one of his boats to the south; that's to the south, and NOT the one we've been suicidally bum-rushing for the better part of several hours. He's sitting up there, smug and stoic, watching us war down here.$B$BI'll spare you the "hostile takeover" jokes. Get on his ship and beat the tar out of him, and we're done here!
english.completion: Sea giants? You think he was training them towards Gadgetzan on purpose? Whatever, he's splitsville now. And Gadgetzan owes us big time! I can't wait to see the look on Marin's face. Here's your cut, babe. You're moving up in the world.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.
english.giverWindow: Fear the beard.

text.title: 好主意
text.objectives: 用走私贩的虫饵抓到一只哈扎里群居蝎。
text.description: 既然我们有一堆新鲜上好的肉块，那我们只要把它们绑在这根绳子上……现在，你就去抓虫子吧。$B$B怎么？别那么看着我，完全安全。好吧，基本上安全。行了，你可能会痛苦地死去。不过很简单！只要把这块肉扔进去，等着虫子上钩，然后用绳子把它拉回来就好了！$B$B去抓一只群居蝎来。我还没见过有其它种类的生物会把土狼吃掉。你可以在虫巢边上找到大量的群居蝎。
text.completion: Look at the size of it! It's glorious. This ugly sucker's gonna help us bring down the whole hive.
text.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

english.title: A Great Idea
english.objectives: Use the Bootlegger Bug Bait to capture a Hazzali Swarmer.
english.description: Now that we've got a good pile of fresh chunks, we just tie it to this rope...and now you're ready to go catch me a silithid.$B$BWhat? Don't give me that look, it's perfectly safe. Well, mostly safe. Okay, you might die painfully. But it'll be easy! Just throw this meat out there, wait for a bug to pounce on it, and then drag 'em back here by the rope!$B$BGo after one of the swarmers. I haven't seen the other ones go for hyenas before, and you should find plenty of swarmers around the edge of the pit.
english.completion: Look at the size of it! It's glorious. This ugly sucker's gonna help us bring down the whole hive.
english.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

text.title: Rocket Boot Boost
text.objectives: Use the Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots and deliver them to Hobart Grapplehammer.
text.description: You need to get those boots down into the caldera to Hobart Grapplehammer.$B$BNow that they're infused with the leftover rockin' powder, they should have enough thrust to get you all the way there on one shot.$B$BWhen you're ready, activate the boots. Don't worry, they're automatically set to land you safely.$B$BI think.
text.progress: Well there you are!
text.completion: There's no time to waste, boy! What's wrong with the actuator on the left boot?!
text.completed: Give the Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Lost Caldera on the Lost Isles.
text.objective1: Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots used

english.objectives: Use the Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots and deliver them to Hobart Grapplehammer.

Don't worry, they're automatically set to land you safely.$B$BI think.
english.progress: Well there you are!
english.completion: There's no time to waste, boy! What's wrong with the actuator on the left boot?!
english.completed: Give the Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Lost Caldera on the Lost Isles.
english.objective1: Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots used

text.title: 只想杀点虫
text.objectives: 跟纳瑞安交谈，指挥被控制意识的爬虫进入大裂口虫巢。
text.description: 现在该全面实施我的计划了。我们在俘获的虫子上尽可能多地绑了炸药，借助纳瑞安最为奇妙的心灵之力，我们就可以把那垃圾直接送到地下虫巢的中心去。$B$B然后呢……砰！就没虫子啦！$B$B指挥这只恶心东西的荣誉就交给你了。去和纳瑞安谈一谈，跟你的虫子朋友做好准备。
text.completion: Oh man, that was awesome! You should've seen the flames coming out of the hive! Here's your reward, for entertaining me as much as for clearing the hive!
text.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

english.title: Just Trying to Kill Some Bugs
english.objectives: Talk to Narain Soothfancy to pilot the Mind-Controlled Swarmer into the Gaping Chasm hive.
english.description: Now it's time for my plan to go into full effect. We've got the captured bug strapped up with as many explosives as it can carry, and with Soothfancy's mostly amazing mental powers, we're gonna drive that sucker straight down into the center of the underground hive.$B$BAnd then...BOOM! No more bugs!$B$BYou get the personal honor of directin' the ugly thing. Go talk to Narain and get set up with your bug-pal.
english.completion: Oh man, that was awesome! You should've seen the flames coming out of the hive! Here's your reward, for entertaining me as much as for clearing the hive!
english.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

text.title: Children of a Turtle God
text.objectives: Collect 5 Fire Glands.
text.description: Volcanoth is the turtle god in the cave that these primitives worship.$B$BIt's not really a god.$B$B<Hobart rolls his eyes.>$B$BBut it is tough enough that I'm going to have to devise a new weapon for you from the one functioning boot we have left.$B$BI think that the age-old motto of "fight fire with fire" applies here. Plus, I like fire!$B$BLet's get some fire glands from Volcanoth's children. That should give me time to modify the rocket boot into something more fitting.
text.progress: No time like the present to be done with the simple task I put before you, $n. Wouldn't you agree?
text.completion: Careful with those glands, $n, careful! And now to load them into the refashioned shredder boot. I'm certain that you'll be surprised and amazed by my genius invention.
text.completed: Return to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Lost Caldera on the Lost Isles.

english.completed: Return to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Lost Caldera on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 未经许可
text.objectives: 让10个砂槌食人魔在表格上签名。
text.description: 我之前也提到了，我想让那些砂槌食人魔加入部落……以及作为廉价劳力为锈水财阀卖命。$B$B为了成事，我们就得少说多做，实际行动起来，不然我就要背黑锅。所以我把许可证画好了，入行表贴在咱们自己的限时劳动契约合同上。$B$B我给你找了一身伪装，穿上去把签名都收集过来。
text.completion: Wow, nice work! I'm amazed you even got them to hold a pen without eating it. You can uh, just throw the suit over there. Away from me. In the fire.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Recruitment Camp in Tanaris.

english.title: Un-Chartered
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Charter Signatures from Dunemaul Ogres.
english.description: As I may have mentioned, I'm trying to get these Dunemaul ogres to join the Horde..and  work for the Bilgewater Cartel as cheap local labor.$B$BTo pull this off, we've gotta pay lip service to the actual initiation process and all that, or I'm going to catch flak later on. So I've gotten this charter drawn up, and slapped the initiation rites onto our own limited time offer labor stipulation contract.$B$BI've got a disguise for you here, so suit up and get all these signatures filled out.
english.completion: Wow, nice work! I'm amazed you even got them to hold a pen without eating it. You can uh, just throw the suit over there. Away from me. In the fire.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Recruitment Camp in Tanaris.

text.title: 除掉卡迦·怒吼
text.objectives: 击败4名怒吼上尉和卡迦·怒吼，并从卡迦身上取回怒吼之盔。
text.description: 我曾经与怒吼氏族交过手，$N。氏族的首领并非兽人，而是一只阴险而残忍的嗜战恶魔。我们必须除掉他和他麾下的上尉，拯救北方城堡乃至整个艾泽拉斯。$B$B$C，杀死卡迦·怒吼并将他的头盔带回来给我。这件头盔……尤其重要。$B$B卡迦的营地就在东边，穿过峡谷就到。
text.progress: Is he dead? Do you have his ... helm?
text.completion: Rageroar's battleships intercepted our vessel as we fled from Gilneas. We were to be carried here as trophies to the Warchief. As we neared the shore, some of us fought back. Rageroar - he began killing indiscriminately - howling with laughter. Our ship capsized and he ordered his men to fire at us as we drowned. Few of us made it to land. Afterwards, I learned that he wore my brother's scalp as... as a trophy.
text.completed: Bring the helm to Tolliver Houndstooth.
text.giverWindow: Destroy Karga Rageroar. Be careful of what his minions are capable of.

english.title: Silencing Rageroar
english.objectives: Slay 4 Rageroar Lieutenants and acquire Rageroar's Helm by killing Karga Rageroar.
english.description: I have encountered the Rageroar clan before, $n. They are led not by an orc, but by a monster - a war-gorged fiend without a shred of decency or compassion. He and his lieutenants must be killed, not just to save Northwatch, but for the good of all of Azeroth.$B$BKarga Rageroar wears a helm. Execute him, $c, and bring the helm to me. It is of ... particular importance.$B$BRageroar has made his camp across the chasm, east of here.
english.progress: Is he dead? Do you have his ... helm?
english.completion: Rageroar's battleships intercepted our vessel as we fled from Gilneas. We were to be carried here as trophies to the Warchief. As we neared the shore, some of us fought back. Rageroar - he began killing indiscriminately - howling with laughter. Our ship capsized and he ordered his men to fire at us as we drowned. Few of us made it to land. Afterwards, I learned that he wore my brother's scalp as... as a trophy.
english.completed: Bring the helm to Tolliver Houndstooth.
english.giverWindow: Destroy Karga Rageroar. Be careful of what his minions are capable of.

text.title: Get The Centipaarty Started
text.objectives: Collect 20 Centipaarts from Centipaar Silithid.
text.description: Okay, babe. Like I said, the ogres are too dumb to know what signing that charter meant. Now we have to actually get them to come along with us, so we'll be procuring what is apparently beloved local flavor.$B$BBeloved local flavor for drooling idiots, I mean.$B$BJust pop on over to the Noxious Lair to the west, it's that big horrible pit full of dangerous silithid. Kill a bunch of the Centipaar silithid and bring back the pieces so we can hand 'em out, okay? Ciao.
text.progress: Have you got enough? These ogres don't look like the type to like small portions.
text.completion: Ugh! This entire camp is like a sampler course of awful smells. Let's not handle these things any longer than we have to.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Recruitment Camp in Tanaris.

text.title: Volcanoth!
text.objectives: Use the Bootzooka to slay Volcanoth.
text.description: It took a lot of blood, sweat, and tears, but the Bootzooka, patent-pending, is ready for use!$B$BThese no-good pygmies have been feeding our people to their "god", Volcanoth, and they're about to unleash it on our town!$B$BYou have to get into the cave and kill that thing before it's too late!
text.completion: I managed to get everyone else safely back to town. Jump in, we gotta get out of here before the volcano blows for good!!!
text.completed: Speak to Sassy Hardwrench in the flying machine inside Volcanoth's Lair on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Use the Bootzooka to bring down this monstrosity!!!

text.title: 从墓穴中醒来
text.objectives: 向提瑞斯法林地的丧钟镇墓地中的送葬者摩尔多报到。
text.description: $N！$B$B苏醒吧，$N！$B$B欢迎回到生者的世界。我以黑暗女王的力量为你降下赐福，将你从死亡的桎梏中解放出来。$B$B你不是奴隶，$N。你可以自由选择你的道路。如果你选择效忠黑暗女王，就去和送葬者摩尔多谈谈。你可以在我身后的墓地里找到他。
text.completion: Hello there.  You must be... $n?

english.title: Fresh out of the Grave
english.objectives: Report to Undertaker Mordo at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: $N!$b$bRise, $N!$b$bWelcome back to the realm of the living.  With the blessing and power of the Dark Lady, I have freed you from death's grip.$b$bYou are no slave, $N.  You are free to follow whatever path you choose from here.  If you choose to serve the Dark Lady Sylvanas, I recommend you speak with Undertaker Mordo.  You will find him behind me, in the graveyard.
english.completion: Hello there.  You must be... $n?

text.title: 苏醒
text.objectives: 同治安官雷德帕斯，莉莉安·沃斯和瓦德雷·莫莱交谈。
text.description: 国王，农夫，或者$C……你以前是干什么的，这根本不重要。我只需要一个舌头能活动的家伙。$B$B从死亡中苏醒的人会承受巨大的压力。所以并非每具躯体都能像你这样行动自如。现在就有三个刚刚苏醒的亡灵，还无法适应自身的变化。$B$B我希望你找到他们，和他们谈谈。他们也许只是需要一个能够交流的人。$B$B你可以在这座墓地里找到他们。
text.progress: No dilly-dallying now. You're among the Forsaken now, and we hold ours to a higher standard.
text.completion: You've done well, $c.  As you can see, not all of us have resigned to our fates.  I'm glad to see that you're at least willing to work. Valdred will be a valuable asset to the Forsaken.  As for the other two... there is not much we can do.  We cannot force them to join us.
text.completed: Return to Caretaker Caice at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: The Wakening
english.objectives: Speak with Marshal Redpath, Lilian Voss, and Valdred Moray.
english.description: King, peasant, or $c... I don't care WHAT you were before.  I just need somebody with a working tongue.$b$bBeing raised from the dead is strenuous.  Not everyone copes with it as well as you did.  In particular, there are three newly-raised undead who are having trouble coping right now.$b$bI want you to find them and talk to them.  It might be that they just need someone that they can relate with.$b$bYou'll find them here in the graveyard.
english.progress: No dilly-dallying now. You're among the Forsaken now, and we hold ours to a higher standard.
english.completion: You've done well, $c.  As you can see, not all of us have resigned to our fates.  I'm glad to see that you're at least willing to work. Valdred will be a valuable asset to the Forsaken.  As for the other two... there is not much we can do.  We cannot force them to join us.
english.completed: Return to Caretaker Caice at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 墓中的真相
text.objectives: 在丧钟镇的大旅店中找到莉莉安·沃斯。同她交谈，让她看看艾尔雷斯的小手镜。
text.description: 早先，我看到一个年轻的被遗忘者女性跑进了旧旅店里。她在为自己逝去的生命而尖叫，央求别人带她回家。$B$B并不是所有被遗忘者都跟其他人一样坚强，$N。即便如此，我们也必须接受自己已经成为亡灵的命运，不然就会死在那些处心积虑想要干掉我们的人的手上。$B$B拿着我的小手镜，让她看看自己到底是什么样，加入我们的行列。而且……我们也需要尽可能多的尸体。
text.completion: You say she ran away?  What a shame. Very well.  As long as she's maintained her free will, there's still hope.
text.completed: Return to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: The Truth of the Grave
english.objectives: Find Lilian Voss inside the large inn in Deathknell.  Then speak with her to show her Elreth's Hand Mirror.
english.description: Earlier on, I saw a young Forsaken woman running towards the old inn.  She was screaming for her life, pleading to be taken back home.$b$bNot all of us are as resolute as others, $n.  Even so, we must accept our fate as undead if we are to rise up against those that would put us down.$b$bTake my hand mirror and show it to the young woman.  She needs to see what she really is, and join us in our cause.  Besides... we can use all the bodies that we can get.
english.completion: You say she ran away?  What a shame. Very well.  As long as she's maintained her free will, there's still hope.
english.completed: Return to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 字跡模糊的卷軸
text.objectives: Read the Trail-Worn Scroll and speak to Xavier the Huntsman in Deathknell.
text.description: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the hunter trainer Xavier. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
text.progress: 啊，你来了，很好。我听说有一些人也逃脱了「死亡」，并纷纷涌入镇子里。或许我们有一天会重归安宁。$B$B你应该感谢希瓦娜斯，她给了你自由……心灵和肉体的自由。虽然你仍遭受着瘟疫的折磨，但你现在至少可以随自己的心愿来去了。
text.completion: I will be here to train you as you grow in experience... find me as often as you like. I charge a minimal fee, but you'll find everything I can teach you to be worthwhile. Go now and test your skill. Many more things will become known to you as you gain experience, some of which I am unable to discuss with you here. Just know that Sylvanas will need hunters with your type of cunning in the future. You will be the backbone of our salvation. Do not forget it.

english.title: Trail-Worn Scroll
english.objectives: Read the Trail-Worn Scroll and speak to Xavier the Huntsman in Deathknell.
english.description: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the hunter trainer Xavier. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
english.progress: Ah, so you've arrived. Good. I overheard that a few others were able to escape "death" and were heading into town. Perhaps that resilience will pay off in the future also. You may thank Sylvanas for your freedom... freedom of mind and body. Though you still remain tortured by the plague and its effects, you are now free to come and go as you see fit.

text.title: Maul 'Em With Kindness
text.objectives: Use the Bilgewater Cartel Promotional Delicacy Morsels on 8 Dunemaul Ogres after weakening them.
text.description: Okay, babe, listen up. There's two ways to get people to do what you want. You can provide goods, services, and things people want...or you can beat the living daylights out of them.$B$BI've often found it's useful to do both at the same time, and you're pretty familiar with both methods by now. Take these little silithid treats, go and beat some ogres dizzy, and then give them the treat before you knock them completely dead, 'kay?
text.completion: Good job, you've taught half the ogres here to fear and respect anything vaguely $r-shaped. It's amazing what a little reward will do to keep people under your thumb, isn't it? Here's your payment, by the way. ...what's with that look?
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Recruitment Camp in Tanaris.

text.title: The Thrill of the Hunt
text.objectives: Learn Steady Shot from Xavier the Huntsman in Deathknell, then practice using Steady Shot 5 times on a Training Dummy.
text.description: I've been told that I'm supposed to train you how to be a hunter.  That's all well and good, but in my opinion, you'll get more training out in the field than you will talking about theories with me.$b$bI suppose I can show you a couple of my tricks.  Here, come take a look at this...
text.completion: You seem to be somewhat of a natural, $n.  This is good.  I can't teach you everything myself. Go, practice what we've discussed today.  Return when you're stronger, and we'll cover some more tricks and abilities.
text.completed: Return to Xavier the Huntsman at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 魔法训练
text.objectives: Learn Arcane Missiles from Isabella in Deathknell, then practice using Arcane Missiles 2 times against a Training Dummy.
text.description: Let's get some work done, shall we?  I've got a new spell for you.  You interested?$B$BThis spell won't work like anything you've previously learned. Each time you cast another spell, there's a chance you'll have an opening to cast Arcane Missiles.
text.completion: I've got to admit, the spell I just taught you probably won't increase your intellect severalfold.  That was a lie to get you to buy my services.  But it will still be a helpful spell for you and your allies. No hard feelings!
text.completed: Return to Isabella at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: Of Light and Shadows
text.objectives: Train Flash Heal from Dark Cleric Duesten in Deathknell. Then, practice casting Flash Heal 5 times on Wounded Deathguards.
text.description: A Forsaken priest is a curious beast,$b$g his: her; path an unusual course.$b$G His: Her; shadowy rites cannot come from the Light, so $g he: she; seeks a more sinister source.$b$bNot only has the world forsaken us, $n... it seems the Light has left us as well.  As the poem hints, however... we are not without power.$b$bFirst, I shall teach you a fast heal to repair damage.  Speak with me again, and I will share with you the word's proper incantation.
text.completion: You're a good student, $n.  You'll go far.  If you ever need any further training, return to me and I'll happily oblige.
text.completed: Return to Dark Cleric Duesten at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: Stab!
text.objectives: Learn Eviscerate from David Trias in Deathknell, then practice using Eviscerate 3 times on a Training Dummy.
text.description: Quiet down!  I don't want these novices around us to hear what we're about to discuss.$b$bListen up... $n, is it?  I've got a technique that'll change the way you operate as a rogue.  You'll be able to follow up on your attacks with a deadly finishing move. Maybe even slide a dagger between their vertebrae.  Interested?
text.completion: Trust me, this'll be worth the money.  And hey - if you need any more training, stop by any time.
text.completed: Return to David Trias at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 黑暗的魔法
text.objectives: Learn Immolate from Maximillion in Deathknell, then practice casting Immolate 5 times on a Training Dummy.
text.description: As you continue your career as a warlock, you'll find it helpful to keep your spellbook filled with the latest incantations.  Lucky for you, I know these spells, and I'm willing to train you... for a price.
text.completion: Congratulations... you're one step closer to being a master of the dark arts.  Go practice a bit, and return when you're stronger.  I'll have more to teach you then.
text.completed: Return to Maximillion at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.objectives: Learn Immolate from Maximillion in Deathknell, then practice casting Immolate 5 times on a Training Dummy.

english.completed: Return to Maximillion at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: Charging into Battle
text.objectives: Learn Charge from Dannal Stern in Deathknell, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy.
text.description: If you want to become a stronger warrior, you'll need to work on your weapons.  You'll find stronger swords and larger shields out on your adventures, that I have no doubt about.  However, as a warrior you also shouldn't forget your legs. $b$bTrain with me, $n, and I'll show you how to move quickly around the battlefield.  You care to learn?
text.completion: You have the makings of a great $c, $n.  Go, practice what we've discussed, and return when you are stronger.  Then I may have more to teach you.
text.completed: Return to Dannal Stern at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
