text.title: 所有权
text.objectives: 击败10名矮人考古学家。
text.description: 不只是我们发现了南月废墟的价值。探险者协会的矮人也蜂拥至此，为联盟攫取着神器和碑文。$B$B我想我不用再做解释了。我们不允许这里的发现落入联盟之手。尽你所能击败矮人，把他们赶出废墟！
text.completion: Excellent. The less interference from the Alliance, the better.
text.completed: Return to Andoren Dawnrise.

english.title: Laying Claim
english.objectives: Kill 10 Dwarven Archeologists.
english.description: We are not the only ones who have discovered the value of the Southmoon Ruins. The dwarves of the Explorers' League have swarmed there, taking artifacts and inscriptions for the Alliance.$B$BI don't think I have to explain much further. We will not allow the discoveries here to fall into the hands of the Alliance. Slay as many dwarves as you can, and drive them from the ruins!
english.completion: Excellent. The less interference from the Alliance, the better.
english.completed: Return to Andoren Dawnrise.

text.title: 语言的碎片
text.objectives: 收集5份远古符文碑刻。
text.description: 在东边的南月废墟里，我们有了新的发现。我的同事找到了一些石头碎片，上面刻有古代的文字，它们最近才因为流沙的移动而显露出来。$B$B这些文字是我们没有见过的语言，但是它们与我们在其它泰坦废墟中看到的文字有相似之处。如果能破译这些文字，就可以解开许多秘密。$B$B不幸的是，我的同事忙于保护石板不被联盟夺走，所以我要派你去南月废墟，亲自收集那些石板。
text.progress: Do you have the tablets?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. With that dealt with, we can focus our attentions fully on exploring the gateway.
text.completed: Return to Andoren Dawnrise.

english.title: Fragments of Language
english.objectives: Collect 5 Ancient Hieroglyphs.
english.description: At the Southmoon ruins, just east of here, we've made some finds. My colleagues have found stone shards, engraved with ancient writings, newly exposed by the shifting sands.$B$BThe writings are in no known tongue, though they bear resemblance to markings we've seen on other ruins of the titans. Deciphering them could reveal many more secrets.$B$BUnfortunately, my colleagues are also busy defending the tablets from the Alliance. I need you to go to the Southmoon ruins and retrieve the tablets yourself.
english.progress: Do you have the tablets?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. With that dealt with, we can focus our attentions fully on exploring the gateway.
english.completed: Return to Andoren Dawnrise.

text.title: 魔精饥渴症
text.objectives: 从沙怒巨魔身上收集6团粘稠的魔精。
text.description: 为了能在恶劣的沙漠生存，沙怒巨魔必须知晓所有关于魔精的秘密。你喝了魔精，就会有力量……最黑暗的巫毒，不是吗？不过没有退缩的余地。$B$B假如我们想找到宝剑，就需要魔精。你真走运，玛佐加是个叛徒，是吧？这里山丘上都是成群的沙怒巨魔。$B$B去给玛佐加弄点魔精来……很多魔精……然后我们就可以举行仪式找到迦萨斯。
text.progress: Ya ain't been drinkin' it yaself, eh? I need all of it...
text.completion: Dey drink de blood, dey get de power. I drink dere blood...
text.completed: Return to Mazoga at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris.

english.title: Blood to Thrive
english.objectives: Collect 6 Fistfuls of Blood from Sandfury Trolls.
english.description: To survive in de harsh desert, de Sandfury had to learn all de secrets of blood magic. You drink de blood, you get de power...darkest voodoo, yah? But dere be no room for holdin' back out here.$B$BIf we gonna find de sword, we need blood. Lucky for ya, Mazoga be a traitor, yah? And dere be plenty of Sandfury trolls wanderin' over de hills dere.$B$BGo an' get Mazoga blood...plenty of blood...and we make de ritual to find Jang'thraze.
english.progress: Ya ain't been drinkin' it yaself, eh? I need all of it...
english.completion: Dey drink de blood, dey get de power. I drink dere blood...
english.completed: Return to Mazoga at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris.

text.title: 失败的和谈
text.objectives: 从蔓生绿洲的野猪人手中救回盖恩斯大使。
text.description: 我早就警告过盖恩斯大使这法子行不通了，但是他坚持认为自己能促成与野猪人的同盟，共同对抗部落。即便谈判成功，我也不想跟这些……猪人并肩战斗。$B$B果不其然，盖恩斯一直没有回来。他是我们最好的谈判专家之一，如果盖恩斯被那些野蛮的野猪人干掉的话，恐怕霍索恩将军要拿我问责了。$B$B进入丛林，找到并营救盖恩斯大使，如果他还活着的话。
text.completion: Good work. Gaines passed through here not long ago on his way to Northwatch and a warm bath. The mission wasn't a total loss, though. We've learned a good deal about these quilboar and their leadership structure. Now we can handle things ... MY way.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.

english.title: A Failure to Communicate
english.objectives: Rescue Ambassador Gaines from the quilboar in the Overgrowth.
english.description: I told him he was a fool, but Ambassador Gaines insisted he could negotiate an alliance with the quilboar against the Horde. Even if he succeeded, I for one wouldn't want to fight with those ... pig-men at my side.$B$BWell, Gaines hasn't returned, and General Hawthorne will hold me accountable if I lose one of our best negotiators to these squealing savages.$B$BLocate the Ambassador in this steaming mess of a jungle and rescue him if he's still alive.
english.completion: Good work. Gaines passed through here not long ago on his way to Northwatch and a warm bath. The mission wasn't a total loss, though. We've learned a good deal about these quilboar and their leadership structure. Now we can handle things ... MY way.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.

text.title: Old Friends
text.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.
text.description: Alright then, grab onto the ladder. We gotta get outa here!$B$BWe'll make a flyby of the town, and then I'm gonna get you to some old friends!
text.completion: I told you we would meet again, $n. Unfortunate that it's under such dire circumstances.

english.title: Old Friends
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Alright then, grab onto the ladder. We gotta get outa here!$B$BWe'll make a flyby of the town, and then I'm gonna get you to some old friends!
english.completion: I told you we would meet again, $n. Unfortunate that it's under such dire circumstances.

text.title: Repel the Paratroopers
text.objectives: Slay 10 Alliance Paratroopers.
text.description: The Alliance have caught back up with us at just the wrong moment, my friend. We took care of their ships, but they still have planes that are dropping their vaunted 127th Paratroopers onto the coast below.$B$BIt's all that the battlesworn and scouts can do to hold the two ramps against their overwhelming numbers. I'm certain that if you were to aid them, the tide would quickly be turned.
text.completion: I've not seen a finer display of $c prowess.
text.completed: Return to Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Repel the Paratroopers
english.objectives: Slay 10 Alliance Paratroopers.
english.description: The Alliance have caught back up with us at just the wrong moment, my friend. We took care of their ships, but they still have planes that are dropping their vaunted 127th Paratroopers onto the coast below.$B$BIt's all that the battlesworn and scouts can do to hold the two ramps against their overwhelming numbers. I'm certain that if you were to aid them, the tide would quickly be turned.
english.completion: I've not seen a finer display of $c prowess.
english.completed: Return to Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 反击者桑萨斯
text.objectives: 击败扎卡鲁，获得被封印的桑萨斯。
text.description: 灵魂说话了。我能感到它在沙中流淌……浸透在死亡中，痛苦的沙漠……$B$B<玛佐加的眼睛都翻白了。>$B$B找到了！灵魂去向了南方，进入了由骨头形成的山谷。扎卡鲁！扎卡鲁，玛卡里的后裔，渴求牺牲的黑暗者……他的父亲从祖尔法拉克被赶出来，他的升腾仪式受到了干扰……他将再度尝到灵魂的味道……$B$B<玛佐加瘫了下来。>$B$B去，$C。扎卡鲁拿着桑萨斯。相信我，你不会愿意让他拥有这武器的。
text.progress: Did the spirits speak true, mon? You got it?
text.completion: Didn't like ya much, eh? More in this world craves blood than just trolls, mon. Let's find the other blade...
text.giverWindow: Zakkaru, spawn of Makkari.

english.title: Sang'thraze the Deflector
english.objectives: Defeat Zakkaru and collect the Sealed Sang'Thraze.
english.description: The blood speaks. I can feel its flow through the sand...drenched in death, a desert of suffering...$B$B<Mazoga's eyes roll back in his head.>$B$BThere! The blood flows to the south, in a valley of bones. Zakkaru! Zakkaru, spawn of Makkari, the dark one who demands sacrifice... his father forced from Zul'Farrak, his ascension interrupted... he will taste blood once more...$B$B<Mazora reels.>$B$BGo, $c. Zakkaru has Sang'thraze. Ya not be wanting him to keep it, trust me.
english.progress: Did the spirits speak true, mon? You got it?
english.completion: Didn't like ya much, eh? More in this world craves blood than just trolls, mon. Let's find the other blade...
english.giverWindow: Zakkaru, spawn of Makkari.

text.title: 至黯魔精
text.objectives: 从沙怒僵尸身上收集6份至黯魔精。
text.description: Jang'thraze eludes me, mon...de blood is not enough. We gonna need somethin' stronger to find it.$B$BWhen you need every troll you got to help out to scrape by, one o' them dyin' on ya is a big problem, mon, an' dat's why de Sandfury learned to raise our dead wit' da voodoo. You fall over, you just get back up again and keep workin...forever!$B$BDe zombies we make be imbued wit' darkest mojo. You go on to de west an' find a whole mess o' dem, an' get me dat mojo, yah?
text.progress: You got de stuff, mon?
text.completion: Powerful stuff, mon...ah, if ya could see what I see now...mebbe you go try it yaself sometime. The spirits call...
text.completed: Return to Mazoga at Sandsorrow Watch.

english.title: Darkest Mojo
english.objectives: Collect 6 Darkest Mojo from Sandfury Zombies.
english.description: Jang'thraze eludes me, mon...de blood is not enough. We gonna need somethin' stronger to find it.$B$BWhen you need every troll you got to help out to scrape by, one o' them dyin' on ya is a big problem, mon, an' dat's why de Sandfury learned to raise our dead wit' da voodoo. You fall over, you just get back up again and keep workin...forever!$B$BDe zombies we make be imbued wit' darkest mojo. You go on to de west an' find a whole mess o' dem, an' get me dat mojo, yah?
english.progress: You got de stuff, mon?
english.completion: Powerful stuff, mon...ah, if ya could see what I see now...mebbe you go try it yaself sometime. The spirits call...
english.completed: Return to Mazoga at Sandsorrow Watch.

text.title: 你轻轻地走了，不带走一根棘刺
text.objectives: 对蔓生绿洲的三瓣牙使用荆刺之杖，并杀死她身边的2名变异野猪人巫师。
text.description: 根据盖恩斯大使的情报，野猪人的女族长叫做“三瓣牙”。她对丛林中的荆棘施加了邪恶的法术，以达到自己不可告人的目的。她还下令把盖恩斯“撕成碎片并丢进蔓生绿洲去”。真是个有气势的女王。$B$B我们要让她自食恶果。带上棘刺之杖，用它除掉三瓣牙。然后杀死受训中的变异野猪人巫师，确保没有人继承她的族长之位。
text.progress: I can see why the Horde hates these little nuisances. Have you taken on Three-Tooth yet?
text.completion: ...Torn limb from limb!? Well, I'd almost feel bad but the burning hatred gets in the way. She got what she deserved. Problem solved.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: Use the Bramblestaff to turn her magic against her.

english.title: You Flicked a Fine Vine to Leaf Me
english.objectives: Use the Bramblestaff on Three-Tooth and kill her 2 Deviate Crones in the Overgrowth.
english.description: According to Gaines, "Three-Tooth" is what the quilboar call their matriarch. She's been twisting the thorns of this crazy jungle to her own ends, and it was her orders that Gaines be "torn apart and fed to the overgrowth." Nice lady.$B$BLet's give her a taste of her own. Take the Bramblestaff you recovered, and use it on Three-Tooth to take her out of the picture. Then kill the crones she's been training, to ensure nobody else can take her place.
english.progress: I can see why the Horde hates these little nuisances. Have you taken on Three-Tooth yet?
english.completion: ...Torn limb from limb!? Well, I'd almost feel bad but the burning hatred gets in the way. She got what she deserved. Problem solved.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Use the Bramblestaff to turn her magic against her.

text.title: 地面的威胁
text.objectives: 从蔓生绿洲中的初生的花朵上收集10个不寻常的花芽。
text.description: 缇甘竟然以为这片突然冒出来的绿洲是野猪人干的，真是愚蠢的想法。看看四周吧。我每天都在观察这些植株的花朵和嫩芽，它们的变异状况一代比一代严重。这肯定不是野猪人氏族的烂魔法，而是某种原始的力量。原始而可怕的力量。$B$B前天，一位伟大的德鲁伊曾路过我们的营地。去丛林深处寻找纳拉雷克斯吧。$B$B记得在蔓生绿洲中采集一些植株样本给他以便研究。
text.progress: I am very busy, $c. This uncontrolled growth threatens to engulf the continent. Do you have any news?
text.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Take the Buds to Naralex at the Overgrowth in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Trouble From the Ground Up
english.objectives: Gather 10 Unusual Flower Buds from Budding Flowers in the overgrowth.
english.description: Teegan's a fool to think the quilboar caused this sudden overgrowth. Look around you. I've been watching these plants bloom and sprout daily - each generation is more mutated than the last. This isn't tribal magic - it's something primal. And dangerous.$B$BThe day before last a great druid passed through our camp. Seek out Naralex, somewhere in the midst of this jungle. He'll know what to do.$B$BAnd bring him some plant samples from around the overgrowth to help his studies.
english.progress: I am very busy, $c. This uncontrolled growth threatens to engulf the continent. Do you have any news?
english.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Take the Buds to Naralex at the Overgrowth in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 阿加曼德家族
text.objectives: 弄到格里高的遗物、妮萨的遗物、萨尔曼的遗物和代弗林的遗物。
text.description: 阿加曼德家族曾是提瑞斯法林地中最富有的家族。我过去曾在他们的磨坊里工作……当然，我是说在瘟疫降临之前。$B$B天灾军团入侵的时候，阿加曼德家族的人们加固了他们的庄园，并说服了在他们家做工的人留下来帮助他们抵抗天灾军团。我们实在是太蠢了，但我们至少是愚蠢而忠诚。$B$B而阿加曼德家族用荣耀之类的幌子让我们去送死，结果现在他们倒成了天灾军团的走狗！$B$B为了被遗忘者，你必须去剿灭堕落于瘟疫之中的阿加曼德家族！把他们的尸体带回来给我。
text.progress: 你把阿加曼德一家人的屍体带来了吗?这群该死的野兽被彻底消灭了吗?
text.completion: 复仇的感觉是多麽甜蜜呀，你说呢?当你将阿加曼德一家人消灭的时候，你有感觉到他们的躯体中有丝毫的自由意志吗?我希望有。我希望他们在湮灭之前能感觉到恐怖。$B$B我知道这想法是有点傻，不过我还是这麽希望……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Deaths in the Family
english.objectives: Obtain Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains, Thurman's Remains, and Devlin's Remains.
english.description: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the plague.$B$BWhen the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.$B$BThe Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!$B$BServe the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
english.progress: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
english.completion: Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion. It is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
english.completed: Return to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 闹鬼的磨坊
text.objectives: Bring Dargol's Skull to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills.
text.description: You sense a malign presence coming from within the skull of the beast.  Coleman Farthing may be interested in seeing this.
text.progress: Well well... what do we have here?
text.completion: Is this Dargol?  He was vicious even in life, with a temper that bit deep and a blade that bit deeper. Undeath has not done him any favors, though it suits his personality. Yes, this was certainly Dargol.  I can sense his malice, even from the remains you've fetched. You have my thanks, $n.
text.completed: Return to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: The Haunted Mills
english.objectives: Bring Dargol's Skull to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills.
english.description: You sense a malign presence coming from within the skull of the beast.  Coleman Farthing may be interested in seeing this.
english.progress: Well well... what do we have here?
english.completion: Is this Dargol?  He was vicious even in life, with a temper that bit deep and a blade that bit deeper. Undeath has not done him any favors, though it suits his personality. Yes, this was certainly Dargol.  I can sense his malice, even from the remains you've fetched. You have my thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 前往磨坊
text.objectives: 去找提瑞斯法林地阿加曼德磨坊的库勒曼·法席恩。
text.description: 西边的阿加曼德磨坊已经被天灾占领了。阿加曼德一家遭到了杀害，整座房子都被天灾占据。$B$B这可能是提瑞斯法最大的天灾哨站，$N。如果你觉自己是个$C，就去和那里的库勒曼·法席恩谈谈。他在尽全力收复失地，他需要帮助。沿着这条路，你就能找到他。
text.completion: Argh!  Get back!  Oh, you're not Scourge, are you? Thank the Banshee Queen that you're here.  I've greatly underestimated how bad it's gotten up here.

english.title: Head for the Mills
english.objectives: Report to Coleman Farthing at Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: The Agamand Mills, to the west, have been lost to the Scourge.  The Agamand family has been slain, and the entire residence has been claimed by the Scourge.$b$bThis is probably the largest Scourge outpost in Tirisfal, $N.  If you think you're enough of a $c, head up there and speak with Coleman Farthing.  He's been doing his best to take the land back, and he'll need help.  Just follow this road, it'll take you right to him.
english.completion: Argh!  Get back!  Oh, you're not Scourge, are you? Thank the Banshee Queen that you're here.  I've greatly underestimated how bad it's gotten up here.

text.title: 绿洲的秘密
text.objectives: 寻找保护者迦萨斯。
text.description: 是的，我看到另一半了，伙计……就在南边……$B$B我们近了，伙计。它在一个绿洲里，就埋在水里的淤泥里。别耽搁了！
text.completion: Mazoga? He's taken the sword? That filthy... At least you escaped with your life. The Lasher's bite is a vicious one.
text.completed: Return to Trenton Lighthammer at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris.

english.title: Secrets in the Oasis
english.objectives: Search for Jang'thraze the Protector.
english.description: Yes, I see the other half now, mon...to the south...$B$BWe be close now, mon. It's in an oasis, buried in de muck beneath de water. Don't delay!
english.completion: Mazoga? He's taken the sword? That filthy... At least you escaped with your life. The Lasher's bite is a vicious one.
english.completed: Return to Trenton Lighthammer at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris.

text.title: 十字军信使
text.objectives: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, and obtain any information you can find.
text.description: 布瑞尔那边的上级给我发来的文件显示，有一个从血色修道院出发的血色十字军斥候已经潜入了丧钟镇。有报告说这个人携带着非常重要的情报。至于更多的细节，我不得而知。但不管怎么样，我们必须得到这份情报！$B$B你是我眼下能调动的最合适的人选，$N。找到那个信使，带回你能弄到的任何情报。
text.completed: Return to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: The Red Messenger
english.objectives: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, and obtain any information you can find.
english.description: Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!$b$bYou're the most qualified person I have to send, $n. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
english.completed: Return to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 上前线！
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地的前线指挥站找到盖恩斯大使。
text.description: 我很想让你留在后方，但是前线传来了征召令。你还记得盖恩斯大使吗？他调去了前线指挥站，并希望你能前去协助他执行一项新任务。$B$B前线指挥站坐落在南面的平原上，当然现在我们称那里为“鲜血平原”。$B$B诸事小心，$N。部落在沿途设伏，有好几位官员遭到了袭击。
text.completion: Ah, $n! I've been talking you up to the General here. Thank you again for saving my life.
text.completed: Locate Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

english.title: To the Front!
english.objectives: Locate Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.
english.description: I'd love to keep you here behind the lines, but it looks like you've been summoned to the front. Ambassador Gaines - remember him? - has relocated to Forward Command and in his latest missive he's requested you, personally, to assist him.$B$BYou'll find our Forward Command operation south of here, in what's become known as the "Fields of Blood."$B$BBe careful, $N. The Horde has taken to ambushing some of our officers en route.
english.completion: Ah, $n! I've been talking you up to the General here. Thank you again for saving my life.
english.completed: Locate Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 突破防线
text.objectives: 与佐奴恩交谈，前往恶鳞海湾，然后找到莫拉基。
text.description: 沃金已经下令对那些占据我们北方岛屿的纳迦展开全面攻击。我们有许多战士在桥边与他们交战，但另有一小批部队正在突破他们的防线，直接进攻他们的岛屿。$B$B跟那边的佐奴恩谈谈，让他送你到岛上去。抵达之后就去找哨所队长莫拉基。他会给你委派具体任务。
text.completion: Good to have ya, brotha. Vol'jin makes us all proud in dese moments. It feels good ta be tacklin' threats head on.

english.title: Breaking the Line
english.objectives: Speak to Jornun to secure a ride to Spitescale Cove and then seek out Morakki.
english.description: Vol'jin be callin' for an all out attack on da naga that have taken over our northern isle. Many of our men were already engaged with their forces near da bridge, but several of us are breakin' through their lines ta assault their isle itself.$B$BSpeak to Jornun right 'ere to secure a ride to da isle. Once there, seek out Morakki, da Captain of da Watch. He will be tellin' ya how ya can aid in da battle.
english.completion: Good to have ya, brotha. Vol'jin makes us all proud in dese moments. It feels good ta be tacklin' threats head on.

text.title: 缇甘的麻烦
text.objectives: 向南贫瘠之地缇甘远征军营地的缇甘下士报到。
text.description: 如果海军司令得知北方城堡安然渡过难关的话，应该会很高兴吧。但是想要坚守阵地，我们必须开辟一条连接内陆的供给线。$B$B缇甘下士负责与前线指挥官的联络事宜，开战前他送来了一份奇怪的报告。他说他在“丛林”里遇到了麻烦。贫瘠之地哪来什么丛林啊！$B$B沿着往上的道路离开北方城堡，看看你能不能帮帮这位固执的下士。
text.completion: So, Paxton says there's no jungle in the Barrens? What do you call THIS!? I've got a pile of supplies to move to the interior and my camp has been overrun by a forest that - I swear - grows by the hour!
text.completed: Report to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Teegan's Troubles
english.objectives: Report to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The Admiral will be pleased that Northwatch is almost secured, but if we're to keep a grip on this continent we're going to need to maintain the supply lines to the interior.$B$BJust before the assault I received the strangest of reports from Corporal Teegan, who's in charge of maintaining our contact with Forward Command. Says he's having trouble with the "jungle?" There's no jungle in the Barrens!$B$BFollow the upper road out of Northwatch and see if you can render any assistance to our wayward Corporal.
english.completion: So, Paxton says there's no jungle in the Barrens? What do you call THIS!? I've got a pile of supplies to move to the interior and my camp has been overrun by a forest that - I swear - grows by the hour!
english.completed: Report to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 捉螃蟹
text.objectives: 杀死一些小海浪蟹，收集5份新鲜的螃蟹肉。
text.description: 我这老朽的身躯是越来越挑剔啦，但是野猪肉对我来说的确是有点难以下咽。也许新来的伙计们可以吃下那东西。$B$B我们放置了一些捕蟹器，不过如果你能容忍一个没多少耐心的老头，能不能现在就帮我弄些新鲜的螃蟹肉来尝尝？岛上到处都是螃蟹，但最佳的狩猎地点是东边的海滩。
text.progress: Da sea be offerin' few boons as delicious as fresh crawler meat.
text.completion: Oi! Tasty, mon. Thank ya for your great kindness, young one. Da spirits shall surely be regardin' ya with great favor.
text.completed: Return to Tora'jin at Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Crab Fishin'
english.objectives: Kill Pygmy Surf Crawlers and collect 5 Fresh Crawler Meat.
english.description: Perhaps me agin' body is just growin' too picky after all dese years, but boar meat just ain't goin' down easy no more. More for da new recruits I be thinkin'.$B$BWe just set out some crab traps, but if ya be willin' ta help an impatient old troll, I'd love ta have some fresh crawler meat right now. Dey're all around da island, but da best spot ta be huntin' them is off da eastern coast.
english.progress: Da sea be offerin' few boons as delicious as fresh crawler meat.
english.completion: Oi! Tasty, mon. Thank ya for your great kindness, young one. Da spirits shall surely be regardin' ya with great favor.
english.completed: Return to Tora'jin at Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 葛尔多的任务
text.objectives: 收集3根阴暗草，把它们交给布瑞尔的初级药剂师霍兰德。
text.description: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.$b$bWhen you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill.$B$B
text.progress: 那个没用的憎恶在哪里?要是你还没拿到我要的东西，就赶快给我去找。
text.completion: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense. We'll deal with the gloom weed later.  For now, we've got other matters to discuss.
text.completed: Report to Junior Apothecary Holland at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Gordo's Task
english.objectives: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in Brill.
english.description: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.$b$bWhen you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill.$B$B
english.progress: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
english.completion: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense. We'll deal with the gloom weed later.  For now, we've got other matters to discuss.
english.completed: Report to Junior Apothecary Holland at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: Have You Seen Anything Weird Out There?
text.objectives: Speak with Executor Zygand about your encounter with the worgen.
text.description: $R!  Listen up, I got somethin'... odd to discuss.$b$bI was out fishin' by Brightwater Lake when I saw the darnedest thing... some sorta wolf-man, running around Tirisfal.  Ya don't suppose that could be a... worgen, do ya?$b$bAnyway, I keep tellin' myself I should tell Executor Zygand about it, but I just get so scared when I talk to that guy.  Maybe you could talk with him?

english.title: Have You Seen Anything Weird Out There?
english.objectives: Speak with Executor Zygand about your encounter with the worgen.
english.description: $R!  Listen up, I got somethin'... odd to discuss.$b$bI was out fishin' by Brightwater Lake when I saw the darnedest thing... some sorta wolf-man, running around Tirisfal.  Ya don't suppose that could be a... worgen, do ya?$b$bAnyway, I keep tellin' myself I should tell Executor Zygand about it, but I just get so scared when I talk to that guy.  Maybe you could talk with him?

text.title: 狮子的尊严
text.objectives: 任意杀死5只原野徘徊狮或原野傲鬃狮。
text.description: 狮子，$N！凶猛的捕食者。它那优雅的线条……发达的肌肉和锋利的爪子……追逐猎物时……爆发出的原始野性……$B$B抱歉，我走神了。我是说，我非常欣赏这些狮子，但是它们谋杀了好几个巡逻兵。没错，就是谋杀。现在，士兵们天黑之后都不敢独自去洗澡了。你能帮助我们维护营地的安全吗？$B$B贫瘠之地的狮群通常栖息在大树下。
text.completion: Nice work! How was it? Did you enjoy the hunt? Did you run through tall grasses, the scent of your prey urging you forward, until you leapt at its throat, adrenaline surging as your slavering fangs... Well, something like that.
text.completed: Return to Sam Trawley at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Lion's Pride
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 5 Plains Prowlers or Plains Pridemanes.
english.description: Respect the lion, $N! A ferocious killer. You gotta admire the elegance of the beast... Muscle and claws... Running down its food... So primal...$B$BI'm sorry, my mind wandered. As I was saying, I respect these lions, but they're just murder on our patrols. I mean that literally. The men are afraid to go to the bathroom alone at night. Can you help make our camp a little safer?$B$BBarrens lions like to linger under trees.
english.completion: Nice work! How was it? Did you enjoy the hunt? Did you run through tall grasses, the scent of your prey urging you forward, until you leapt at its throat, adrenaline surging as your slavering fangs... Well, something like that.
english.completed: Return to Sam Trawley at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 填饱肚子
text.objectives: 杀死南贫瘠之地的雷角蜥蜴，收集4块新鲜的雷角蜥蜴肉排。
text.description: 所谓兵马未动，粮草先行。我们的军队已经行进了很长一段路。$B$B我在想，如果弄几只笨拙的大蜥蜴来烤烤，就可以满足数周的肉食供给了。$B$B雷角蜥蜴体型庞大，行动迟缓，应该很容易捕杀。不过……嘿你身上没带家伙吗？
text.progress: You get my steaks yet? Nice and bloody?
text.completion: Oh yeah... oh ... YES! I'll have mine raw. I suppose I can grill some up for the others... How would you like yours?
text.completed: Bring the steaks to Sam Trawley at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Marching On Our Stomachs
english.objectives: Collect 4 Fresh Stormsnout Steaks by killing Stormsnouts in Southern Barrens.
english.description: It's true what they say: An army marches on its stomach. And we've been marching a long way.$B$BI'm thinking if we barbecue up a few of those giant lumbering stormsnouts, we'll have enough meat to feed us for weeks.$B$BStormsnouts are big and slow, so they should be easy to kill. Except... Hey you're not carrying any metal on you are you?
english.progress: You get my steaks yet? Nice and bloody?
english.completion: Oh yeah... oh ... YES! I'll have mine raw. I suppose I can grill some up for the others... How would you like yours?
english.completed: Bring the steaks to Sam Trawley at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 鲜血旷野
text.objectives: 去南贫瘠之地的鲜血旷野，杀死10名凄凉蛮兵。
text.description: 部落开始把这块区域称为“鲜血旷野”。这是一个别名：因为是我的勇士们用鲜血染红了这里的草木。$B$B我派了侦查巡逻队去击垮野猪人，并打探部落军队的动向，但他们没能全身而退。他们需要你的支援。$B$B去巡查战场，然后找到那些给我们带来无尽悲痛的凄凉蛮兵。别指望他们会投降；他们的酋长教导他们要血战到死。
text.completion: Very good. We may never drive the Horde completely from these lands, but with a strong presence we can undermine their will to fight.
text.completed: Return to General Hawthorne at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Fields of Blood
english.objectives: Kill 10 Desolation Grunts at the Fields of Blood in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The Horde has taken to calling this region the "Fields of Blood." It's an apt name: these reeds run red with the blood of some of my best men.$B$BI've sent out recon patrols to crush the quilboar and report on the Horde troop movements, but not all of them return. They could use your support out there.$B$BPatrol the fields and seek out the Desolation Grunts that are causing us so much grief. Do not expect them to surrender; their Warchief has instructed them to fight to the death.
english.completion: Very good. We may never drive the Horde completely from these lands, but with a strong presence we can undermine their will to fight.
english.completed: Return to General Hawthorne at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 另类的外交
text.objectives: Take the Horn of Challenge to the Bristleback Challenge Ring in Southern Barrens. Blow the horn to challenge Sabersnout and kill him.
text.description: I have not forgotten my brush with death at the hands of the quilboar in that filthy jungle. The General here has ordered some tactical strikes, but he stops short of genocide. I have no such qualms.$B$BTake this horn that I 'borrowed' during my negotiations. Blow the horn within the Bristleback challenge ring west of our position - you can't miss it. I want you to challenge the champion of the Bristleback, Sabersnout, to single combat. His death in front of his followers will leave them in utter chaos.
text.progress: Sabersnout! Is he dead? What's the news?
text.completion: A "Boarpocalypse," you say? These animals certainly have a unique idea of "Single combat!" No matter, you've done well. With the quilboar in chaos I should have no trouble convincing the field commanders to execute any strays they find scurrying about. The General need not know we've stepped up the campaign... it's for the better.
text.completed: Return to Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: Blow the Horn of Challenge to engage Sabresnout.

english.title: Diplomacy By Another Means
english.objectives: Take the Horn of Challenge to the Bristleback Challenge Ring in Southern Barrens. Blow the horn to challenge Sabersnout and kill him.
english.description: I have not forgotten my brush with death at the hands of the quilboar in that filthy jungle. The General here has ordered some tactical strikes, but he stops short of genocide. I have no such qualms.$B$BTake this horn that I 'borrowed' during my negotiations. Blow the horn within the Bristleback challenge ring west of our position - you can't miss it. I want you to challenge the champion of the Bristleback, Sabersnout, to single combat. His death in front of his followers will leave them in utter chaos.
english.progress: Sabersnout! Is he dead? What's the news?
english.completion: A "Boarpocalypse," you say? These animals certainly have a unique idea of "Single combat!" No matter, you've done well. With the quilboar in chaos I should have no trouble convincing the field commanders to execute any strays they find scurrying about. The General need not know we've stepped up the campaign... it's for the better.
english.completed: Return to Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Blow the Horn of Challenge to engage Sabresnout.

text.title: 贫瘠之地的防线
text.objectives: 夺取鲜血旷野中的一座中立丘陵，然后在那里抵御部落的反击。
text.description: 从战略上来说，控制一个区域需要持续不断的侦查。你来看地图－－我已经划定了一些战略性的丘陵，和这个类似，联盟必须保持对这里的控制才能让敌人受制于我们。$B$B我的探子已经在战场上标记了它们的位置。我现在需要有人来带头夺取它们，你自然是干这活的最佳人选。$B$B去陶拉祖废墟的北边、东边和南边找到中立的灰色旗帜。夺取并守住它！
text.completion: Your report, $c? Incredible, $n! You're a real asset to the Alliance. I'll see to it that my men follow your example!
text.completed: Return to General Hawthorne at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

english.title: A Line in the Dirt
english.objectives: Capture a neutral hill in the Fields of Blood and defend it against a Horde counter-attack.
english.description: Strategically, control of a region requires constant observation. See here on this map - I've identified a number of strategic hills, similar to this one, that the Alliance must acquire if we are to keep the enemy under our thumb.$B$BMy scouts have already marked their location on the field. What I need is someone to spearhead their capture, and you're the $gman:woman; for the job.$B$BSeek out neutral grey flags on hills to the north, east, and south of the Taurajo Ruins. Capture one and defend it!
english.completion: Your report, $c? Incredible, $n! You're a real asset to the Alliance. I'll see to it that my men follow your example!
english.completed: Return to General Hawthorne at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: A Daughter's Embrace
text.objectives: Bring Lilian Voss to her father in the tower at Crusader's Run.
text.description: The whisper continues:$b$b<"My name is Lilian Voss.  Before I died, I was a member of the Scarlet Crusade.  My father, High Priest Voss, raised me to be a weapon against the plagued.  I studied stealth, sorcery, martial arts, anything to make myself stronger.  I gave up my childhood for him.">$b$b<"Then, as fate would have it, I died and returned as... this.  My father instantly forgot me and, when I returned, ordered me executed.">$b$b<"Come.  We will speak with him now, in his tower to the northwest.">
text.completion: From birth to grave to undeath, we all have our own path to follow.  Some are easier than others.  It sounds like this Voss girl has had a rough path so far. Hopefully she ultimately chooses to join us and follow the Dark Lady.  With power like hers, we could do incredible things. By the way, $n... excellent work out there.  If you're ever ready and willing, I may have some more work for you in the Plaguelands.
text.completed: Return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: A Daughter's Embrace
english.objectives: Bring Lilian Voss to her father in the tower at Crusader's Run.
english.description: The whisper continues:$b$b<"My name is Lilian Voss.  Before I died, I was a member of the Scarlet Crusade.  My father, High Priest Voss, raised me to be a weapon against the plagued.  I studied stealth, sorcery, martial arts, anything to make myself stronger.  I gave up my childhood for him.">$b$b<"Then, as fate would have it, I died and returned as... this.  My father instantly forgot me and, when I returned, ordered me executed.">$b$b<"Come.  We will speak with him now, in his tower to the northwest.">

Hopefully she ultimately chooses to join us and follow the Dark Lady.  With power like hers, we could do incredible things. By the way, $n... excellent work out there.  If you're ever ready and willing, I may have some more work for you in the Plaguelands.
english.completed: Return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 破损的黑豹雕像
text.objectives: 运用你的技能和材料，修复破损的雕像。
text.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.$B$B
text.completed: Completion text.

english.title: Broken Panther Figurine
english.objectives: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
english.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.$B$B
english.completed: Completion text.

text.title: 海边打捞
text.objectives: 收集7份热砂补给品。
text.description: 如果你想说服诺格弗格先生让更多的侏儒搬进来，我们就得让他看看我们有多好才行！我有个点子。$B$B加基森正处于海盗的封锁之下，不过许多被打下船的货物并没有遭到损毁……它们只是被冲走了。大多数都漂到了镇子南边的浅滩上。$B$B要是你能帮他们把补给收集起来，就能让我们交上朋友！而且还能阻止那刻薄的地精姑娘把东西拿去卖。
text.progress: Do you have a whole buncha boxes? Let's see!
text.completion: Most of this looks just fine! How lucky! The Steamwheedle goblins will be so happy to see their cargo back safe and sound. And here's a reward for your good deeds, of course! We've got lots of other stuff to do though! Busy busy!
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark in Gadgetzan.

english.title: Seaside Salvage
english.objectives: Collect 7 Steamwheedle Supplies.
english.description: If we want to convince Mister Noggenfogger to let us move more gnomes here, we've got to show him just how nice we are! I know just the thing.$B$BGadgetzan's under blockade by pirates, but plenty of the goods that get blown off the ships survive intact... they just wash away. Most of them wash up in the shallows just south of town.$B$BIf you could go collect those supplies for them, it'd help us make friends! And it'll keep that mean goblin girl over there from taking them and selling them.
english.progress: Do you have a whole buncha boxes? Let's see!
english.completion: Most of this looks just fine! How lucky! The Steamwheedle goblins will be so happy to see their cargo back safe and sound. And here's a reward for your good deeds, of course! We've got lots of other stuff to do though! Busy busy!
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark in Gadgetzan.

text.title: 踩水坑
text.objectives: 杀死8名潮行巨人。
text.description: 这里有个大麻烦！海洋淹过来其实挺好的，因为现在船能直接开到加基森。不过如今一帮恶心的海洋巨人在朝镇子进发！我敢肯定，如果咱们把他们处理掉，诺格弗格先生一定会感谢咱们的。$B$B别担心，我不会叫你去做白干活的志愿者！把他们除掉，我给你赏钱！
text.completion: Oh, it's going to be so much nicer around here now that they're gone! At least until more show up. But thank you!
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark in Gadgetzan.

english.title: Puddle Stomping
english.objectives: Kill 8 Tidal Striders.
english.description: There's a big problem here! It's great that the ocean came in so far, because now ships can get to Gadgetzan. But now there's a bunch of nasty old sea giants encroaching on the town! I'm sure Mister Noggenfogger would appreciate us taking care of them for him.$B$BDon't worry, I won't ask you to do it just out of the goodness of your heart! Take care of them and I'll give you a reward!
english.completion: Oh, it's going to be so much nicer around here now that they're gone! At least until more show up. But thank you!
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark in Gadgetzan.

text.title: 火箭营救
text.objectives: 把救生火箭交给5名热砂港幸存者，用炸弹杀死40名南海封锁者。
text.description: 大水冲进来的时候，东边的热砂港就被淹了，不少可怜的地精还困在那儿！如今这些该死的海盗要把每一艘离开港口的船只击沉。$B$B但他们不会想到我们能飞！码头上有只热气球。我们可以用它飞过去，营救地精们，并顺便处理一下海盗。诺格弗格先生会高兴的！$B$B到码头去登上气球，我紧随其后，好吗？我得弄些火箭……
text.completion: That was great! It looks like most of the goblins we helped made it back here and didn't blow up. We really showed that goblin girl! Here's a special reward for you, mister.
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Rocket Rescue
english.objectives: Deliver Liferockets to 5 Steamwheedle Survivors and use bombs to kill 40 Southsea Blockaders.
english.description: When the water came in, Steamwheedle Port to the east was flooded, and a lot of poor goblins are still stuck there! Now those mean pirates are shooting at any boat that leaves the docks here.$B$BBut they won't expect us to fly! There's a hot air balloon by the docks. We can use that, fly over to rescue the goblins, and take care of the pirates, too. Mr. Noggenfogger will be so pleased!$B$BGo to the docks and hop in the balloon and I'll be right behind you, okay? I've got to get some rockets...
english.completion: That was great! It looks like most of the goblins we helped made it back here and didn't blow up. We really showed that goblin girl! Here's a special reward for you, mister.
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 黑雾灭绝
text.objectives: 在黑雾洞穴里摧毁8枚黑雾之卵。
text.description: 占据西北边黑雾洞穴的蜘蛛，对我们来说是另一个严重威胁。食人魔倒不是对付不了它们，但在塞拉摩的部队潜伏于附近的时候把我们的注意力分散出去，将是一个致命的错误。$B$B我需要有人能到黑雾洞穴里去把它们的卵毁掉，这样就能根除这一祸害。你可以在结满蛛网的矿洞最深处找到那些卵……还有它们的守护者。
text.completion: This is a great relief, $c. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Darkmist Extermination
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Darkmist Eggs in Darkmist Cavern.
english.description: The spiders that occupy Darkmist Cavern to the northwest are another vicious threat to us here. They are nothing the ogres cannot handle, but splitting our attention to them when Theramore's forces lurk nearby is a deadly mistake.$B$BI need someone to destroy the eggs inside Darkmist Cavern, to cut off this infestation. You will find the eggs in the deepest part of the webbed mines... along with their guardians.
english.completion: This is a great relief, $c. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 加基森海盗：亡灵宝藏
text.objectives: 杀死15名南海海盗。
text.description: 天哪，你也看到了，这里即将会有一场与海盗的大战。我们要尽全力保证他们不再骚扰加基森……或者是我们侏儒的新家！$B$B杀掉他们就行。$B$B那么帮帮我们如何？我们真的得把那绿鼻子和她可怕的强盗杀掉才可以。我会万分感激你的！
text.completion: Good job! We're really cleaning up around here!
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

english.title: Dead Man's Chest
english.objectives: Kill 15 Southsea Pirates.
english.description: Well gosh, as you can plainly see there's this really big battle with these pirates here going on. We're doing our best to make sure they never bother Gadgetzan or our new gnomish homes there ever again!$B$BBy killing them.$B$BSo how about helping us? We really wanna make sure we kill more than green-nose over there and her awful thugs. I'd really appreciate it!
english.completion: Good job! We're really cleaning up around here!
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

text.title: 夷为平地！
text.objectives: 用灼烧的朗姆酒点燃西北小屋、东北小屋，以及西南小屋。
text.description: 跟你说吧，这地方如果不是又旧又脏而且还有海盗肆虐的话，倒是可以成为我们侏儒的一个不错的新家！我们正在处理海盗的问题，但是脏乱的问题也要解决。$B$B我是说，有点自尊的侏儒都不会住在像这么丑的茅舍里！因此呢，拿上这个朗姆酒燃烧瓶，把那些难看的小屋都给我们烧掉！
text.completion: Isn't that just so pretty to watch?
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

english.title: To The Ground!
english.objectives: Use the Burning Rum to set fire to the Northwest Shack, the Northeast Shack, and the Southwest Shack.
english.description: You know, this place would probably make a great home for us gnomes if it wasn't so old and dirty and full of pirates! We're taking care of the pirates problem, but the awful and dirty problem needs fixing.$B$BI mean, no self-respecting gnome would ever live in such an ugly hovel like these buildings! So here, take this bottle of flaming rum and go burn those ugly shacks down for us!
english.completion: Isn't that just so pretty to watch?
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

text.title: 抢宝贝
text.objectives: 获得10份海盗赃物。
text.description: It's just really so wasteful that all these pirates have golden treasures laying around. Some of this stuff could be used for practical things! Like melting into wire, or intrinsic shielding matrices, or selling to other stupid races that buy gold just to keep it around.$B$BAnd speaking of other stupid races, I bet those greedy goblins are going to be taking all of it. We can't let that happen! Go collect that treasure for Gnomeregan!
text.progress: I hope you don't think you're hiding any for yourself, silly! These goggles can see right through your bags. And your armor.
text.completion: Fantastic! Gosh, this will make enough wire for an entire army. Lucky us!
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

english.title: Lootin' Plunder
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Pirate Loot.
english.description: It's just really so wasteful that all these pirates have golden treasures laying around. Some of this stuff could be used for practical things! Like melting into wire, or intrinsic shielding matrices, or selling to other stupid races that buy gold just to keep it around.$B$BAnd speaking of other stupid races, I bet those greedy goblins are going to be taking all of it. english.completion: Fantastic! Gosh, this will make enough wire for an entire army. Lucky us!
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

text.title: 制伏元素
text.objectives: 加文·灰羽要你使用大地之环补给品中的元素灵契和净化图腾，制服20个激动的大地之魂。
text.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and threaten to collapse Ironforge are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated earth spirits.$B$B
text.progress: Have you subdued the elements yet?
text.completion: Well done $N.  But for every element that is subdued another one takes it's place.  The solution we have here is merely a stopgap.  Hopefully my brethren in the Earthen Ring are making more headway.
text.completed: Return to Gavan Grayfeather in Ironforge.

english.title: Subduing the Elements
english.objectives: Gavan Grayfeather wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Earth Spirits.
english.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and threaten to collapse Ironforge are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated earth spirits.$B$B
english.progress: Have you subdued the elements yet?
english.completion: Well done $N.  But for every element that is subdued another one takes it's place.  The solution we have here is merely a stopgap.  Hopefully my brethren in the Earthen Ring are making more headway.
english.completed: Return to Gavan Grayfeather in Ironforge.

text.title: 可怕的灰熊
text.objectives: 获得5张染病褐熊的毛皮。
text.description: 你看到西边染病的褐熊了吗？那些皮……那么恶心，那么病态，那么……实用！$B$B给我弄5张来。我有个主意，可以制造出万无一失的抗天灾毒药来！
text.progress: Let's see... do you have enough hides?
text.completion: Dithers, you've done it again!  These are perfect.
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Grisly Grizzlies
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Plagued Bruin Hides.
english.description: Have you seen the plagued bruins that wander to the west of here?  Those hides... so hideous, so diseased, so... perfect!$b$bFetch me 5 of them.  I've got an idea for an anti-Scourge poison that's guaranteed to succeed!
english.progress: Let's see... do you have enough hides?
english.completion: Dithers, you've done it again!  These are perfect.
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 铐上他们
text.objectives: 跟陶拉祖废墟的陶拉祖强夺者谈一谈并逮捕他们。使用北卫军镣铐逮捕5名受伤的强夺者。
text.description: $N，征召暴风城监狱中非暴力型罪犯这一政策的弊端已经暴露，给我们造成了不少麻烦。在陶拉祖之战获胜后，某些目无法纪的士兵居然擅离职守，四下掠夺城里的财物。$B$B这是藐视军规的恶行。更糟糕的是，他们的行为遭到了敌人激烈的反抗；而我们的最终目标是达成和平。$B$B带上这些镣铐，让陶拉祖强夺者受到正义的制裁。你最好先跟他们谈谈，必要的时候就使用武力。
text.progress: Is the Taurajo situation under control?
text.completion: Well done, $n. Several of the looters have already crawled back, requesting clemency. I'll let them stew for a bit in the Northwatch brig. Thank you for helping maintain discipline in the ranks. It is important for our army to be perceived as soldiers, not common bandits.
text.completed: Return to General Hawthorne at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Clap 'Em In Irons
english.objectives: Speak to the Taurajo Looters in the Taurajo Ruins and place them under arrest. Use the Northwatch Manacles to subdue 5 wounded looters.
english.description: Our policy of conscripting non-violent criminals from the Stormwind Stockades has come back to haunt us, $N. Some of my less-scrupulous soldiers broke ranks after our victory in Taurajo and are looting the remains of the city.$B$BThis is a breakdown in discipline. Worse, the desecration of their homes only spurs the enemy to fight harder when our ultimate goal should be peace.$B$BTake these manacles and bring the Taurajo looters to justice. Speak to them first, but you may need force to subdue them.
english.progress: Is the Taurajo situation under control?
english.completion: Well done, $n. Several of the looters have already crawled back, requesting clemency. I'll let them stew for a bit in the Northwatch brig. Thank you for helping maintain discipline in the ranks. It is important for our army to be perceived as soldiers, not common bandits.
english.completed: Return to General Hawthorne at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: Mine Disposal, the Goblin Way
text.objectives: Detonate 10 Land Mines.
text.description: The paratroopers have mined the beach!$B$BThe Warchief asked me if there's anything we can do about that. I told him, 'You bet we can!'. I was thinking maybe you could take this satchel of grenades and detonate the land mines from a safe distance?$B$BIt's how we do things, right?!
text.completion: Score one for the goblins! Stupid dwarves and gnomes.
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Mine Disposal, the Goblin Way
english.objectives: Detonate 10 Land Mines.
english.description: The paratroopers have mined the beach!$B$BThe Warchief asked me if there's anything we can do about that. I told him, 'You bet we can!'. I was thinking maybe you could take this satchel of grenades and detonate the land mines from a safe distance?$B$BIt's how we do things, right?!
english.completion: Score one for the goblins! Stupid dwarves and gnomes.
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 陶拉祖的情报
text.objectives: 在陶拉祖废墟搜寻3份陶拉祖情报。
text.description: 将军居然还在专心处理陶拉祖强夺者的事情。真是愚蠢！我们应该将注意力转移到继续对付部落才对。$B$B如果陶拉祖废墟被彻底焚毁的话，我们很可能会失去一批有价值的情报。在你为将军跑腿期间，留意一下废墟中的地图或是书页。我知道一点点兽人语，应该可以看懂你找到的情报。
text.progress: Have you searched the ruins yet?
text.completion: What have you dug up for me? Hmm. Interesting. This notice from Orgrimmar indicates a change in Horde leadership is underway - I guess heads are going to roll after what we did to Taurajo. What's this? A death warrant for the General here! This is good to know... Very good to know...
text.completed: Bring the intelligence to Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

english.title: The Taurajo Briefs
english.objectives: Search the Ruins of Taurajo for 3 pieces of Taurajo Intelligence.
english.description: The General is too preoccupied with the looters in Taurajo. Too soft! We ought to be focused on our next move against the Horde.$B$BThere's valuable intelligence that might be compromised if we allow the ruins of Taurajo to continue to burn. While you're running the General's errand, dig around for any maps or notes you can find. I can speak a little of the orcish tongue - I'll be able to make sense of what you find.
english.progress: Have you searched the ruins yet?
english.completion: What have you dug up for me? Hmm. Interesting. This notice from Orgrimmar indicates a change in Horde leadership is underway - I guess heads are going to roll after what we did to Taurajo. What's this? A death warrant for the General here! This is good to know... Very good to know...
english.completed: Bring the intelligence to Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 定义“疯狂”
text.objectives: Kill 10 Crazed Survivors.
text.description: We received reports that a goblin shipwreck occured on this beach some time ago, with the survivors left to fend for themselves. We expected there to be a modicum of survivors, perhaps some even suitable for interrogation.$B$BWhat we found was a crew of Bilgewater goblins who have all become insane, delusional, and maniacally violent...to further degrees than is normally observed, rather.$B$BIn short, they are useless and dangerous. Gnomeregan will be best served by cutting down as many as we can.
text.completion: Your reports of their behavior are truly disturbing...but also slightly amusing. If only that Dreadshredder wench had escaped on these vessels instead...
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

english.title: Define "Crazy"
english.objectives: Kill 10 Crazed Survivors.
english.description: We received reports that a goblin shipwreck occured on this beach some time ago, with the survivors left to fend for themselves. We expected there to be a modicum of survivors, perhaps some even suitable for interrogation.$B$BWhat we found was a crew of Bilgewater goblins who have all become insane, delusional, and maniacally violent...to further degrees than is normally observed, rather.$B$BIn short, they are useless and dangerous. Gnomeregan will be best served by cutting down as many as we can.
english.completion: Your reports of their behavior are truly disturbing...but also slightly amusing. If only that Dreadshredder wench had escaped on these vessels instead...
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

text.title: 世界的尽头
text.objectives: 跟钢烁哨站的凯尔希·钢烁谈一谈。
text.description: 嘘！嘿！靠近点，你这蠢货，你是指望让我读心还是——哦。总之过来点！$B$B你在推进诺莫瑞根在此地的计划中，做出了杰出的贡献，朋友！而且还假装你只是为了钱才这么干的，真漂亮。不过现在凯尔希·钢烁需要你的直接帮助。$B$B她还没有开始行动……她让我叫你到遥远南部的天涯海滩去找她。别让她久等了！
text.completion: I'm amazed that Soothfancy was capable of following a simple set of instructions. And ones that required him to keep his foolish mouth silenced as well. In addition, it is honestly good to see you again, $n. Now that I've dropped the charade, you'll get to see how gnomes get things done around here.

english.title: Land's End
english.objectives: Talk to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Station.
english.description: Psst! Hey! Come closer, you fool, you expect me to read your mind or--oh. Come closer anyway!$B$BYou've done a wonderful job advancing the agenda of Gnomeregan here, friend! And an amazing job of pretending you were only in it for the coin, simply splendid. But now Kelsey Steelspark could use more of your direct help.$B$BShe's moved on yet again...she asked me to tell you to meet her far south, at Land's End Beach. I wouldn't keep her waiting, either!
english.completion: I'm amazed that Soothfancy was capable of following a simple set of instructions. And ones that required him to keep his foolish mouth silenced as well. In addition, it is honestly good to see you again, $n. Now that I've dropped the charade, you'll get to see how gnomes get things done around here.

text.title: 我们来此的目的
text.objectives: 在锈水箱里寻找证据。
text.description: Gnomeregan previously learned that the Bilgewater goblins of the Horde survived a crash on an uncharted island near Kalmidor before arriving in Durotar. We initially came here to investigate what techniques and technology could possibly allow a hopeless pack of green-skinned imbeciles to survive such harsh conditions.$B$BWhile the goblins are at a loss, we still need to find out exactly what happened here. Search the beach for wreckage and belongings and bring anything that appears significant back to me.
text.progress: What have you found?
text.completion: I'm trying not to laugh. This is classic. They have no idea they're even on Kalimdor! These later pages though...something more significant may be occuring here.
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

english.title: What We Came For
english.objectives: Search Bilgewater Footlockers for evidence.
english.description: Gnomeregan previously learned that the Bilgewater goblins of the Horde survived a crash on an uncharted island near Kalmidor before arriving in Durotar. We initially came here to investigate what techniques and technology could possibly allow a hopeless pack of green-skinned imbeciles to survive such harsh conditions.$B$BWhile the goblins are at a loss, we still need to find out exactly what happened here. Search the beach for wreckage and belongings and bring anything that appears significant back to me.
english.progress: What have you found?
english.completion: I'm trying not to laugh. This is classic. They have no idea they're even on Kalimdor! These later pages though...something more significant may be occuring here.
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

text.title: 泥龟一族
text.objectives: 从海浪龟身上获得海龟消化过的钥匙。
text.description: 显然，我们需要找到日志上描述的这件物品。把它从箱子里取出来的这个方法听上去合乎情理，但却十分危险而且不稳定。试图用蛮力打开箱子可能导致灾难性的后果。$B$B幸运的是我们知道钥匙在哪儿……至少，从统计上来说是这样。海滩东边尽头有许多海龟，钥匙可能就在其中一只身上。
text.progress: Hopefully your spree of turtle destruction left it intact.
text.completion: Well, gosh, this day just keeps getting better and better! I may actually smile. When you're not looking. You've seen enough of that already.
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

english.title: Terrapination
english.objectives: Obtain a Turtle-Digested Key from a Surf Glider.
english.description: We need to obtain the object described in this journal, for certain. Extracting it from a chest would be a feasible matter, but the object itself sounds compromised, and unstable. Attempting to forcefully open the chest could be disastrous.$B$BFortunately, we know where the key is...statistically speaking, at least. There's plenty of sea turtles at the east end of this beach. One of them may hold the key.
english.progress: Hopefully your spree of turtle destruction left it intact.
english.completion: Well, gosh, this day just keeps getting better and better! I may actually smile. When you're not looking. You've seen enough of that already.
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

text.title: 莫拉亚
text.objectives: 跟莫拉亚谈谈。
text.description: 莫拉亚在找人帮忙解决迅猛龙的问题。如果有机会的话，你应该去找她谈谈。她就在暗矛要塞的另一边。
text.completion: Hey there, hon. Vol'jin sent you? So sweet of him to be thinkin' of me. I surely could use da help, but ya have a bit more walkin' ahead of ya.

english.title: Moraya
english.objectives: Speak with Moraya.
english.description: Moraya has been lookin' for some help with tha raptors. Ya should talk to her on the other side of Darkspear Hold when ya get a chance.
english.completion: Hey there, hon. Vol'jin sent you? So sweet of him to be thinkin' of me. I surely could use da help, but ya have a bit more walkin' ahead of ya.

text.title: 你也是吗，蛮兵？
text.objectives: 获得肉脸的箱子。
text.description: 该把事情解决干净了。就我们所推算，这件神秘的物体在日志上所说的一个“聪明”蛮兵手上。我们并不知道这生物到底发生了什么事情，很显然，你要多加小心。$B$B这个……“肉脸”就藏在山丘后面，那里是地精埋死人的地方。找到坟场便是，他应该就在那后面。
text.progress: Do be careful with the contents of the chest.
text.completion: Well done, $n. The contents of this chest are sure to advance Gnomeregan's knowledge base significantly. I believe you've earned a reward.
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

english.title: You Too, Brute?
english.objectives: Obtain Meatface's Chest.
english.description: It's time to conclude this matter efficiently. From what we've determined, this mysterious object is in the possession of the "smart" brute described in the journal. We don't know exactly what's happened to this creature, obviously, so you should take caution.$B$BThis... "Meatface" is hiding in the hills, near where these goblins bury their dead. Look for the graveyard and he should be just past it.
english.progress: Do be careful with the contents of the chest.
english.completion: Well done, $n. The contents of this chest are sure to advance Gnomeregan's knowledge base significantly. I believe you've earned a reward.
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Encampment.

text.title: The Pride of Kezan
text.objectives: Shoot down 10 Gnomeregan Stealth Fighters.
text.description: This is ridiculous! Those gnomes just don't know when to stop!$B$BGoblin pride is on the line here! $N, you gotta jump into the Pride of Kezan and show them what's what!$B$BLet me know when you're ready!
text.progress: What are you doing back here? Get up there and shoot them down!
text.completion: 哈！
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

english.title: The Pride of Kezan
english.objectives: Shoot down 10 Gnomeregan Stealth Fighters.
english.description: This is ridiculous! Those gnomes just don't know when to stop!$B$BGoblin pride is on the line here! $N, you gotta jump into the Pride of Kezan and show them what's what!$B$BLet me know when you're ready!
english.progress: What are you doing back here? Get up there and shoot them down!
english.completion: YES!
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：巨又霸！
text.objectives: 击败巨又霸。
text.description: 规则很简单：两个男人进去，一个人——等等，有时是女人。$B$B两个人进去，一个人——等等，不，有时不止两个……$B$B好吧，只有一条规则，就是待在机场里！没有别的规则！$B$B你头一个要面对的是废土强盗里最大、最坏的成员。这要么是一场热身赛，要么是一场血战……看你实力了！
text.completion: An impressive start. Be prepared for more.
text.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Thunderdrome: The Ginormus!
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Ginormus.
english.description: The rules are simple: Two men enter, one--wait. Sometimes there's women.$B$BTwo people enter, one--Wait, no, sometimes it's more than two...and that means more than two come out--$B$BAlright, only rule is stay in the drome! There are no other rules!$B$BYou're up against the biggest, baddest member of the Wastewander Bandits first. This'll either be a warmup or a bloodbath...it's up to you which!
english.completion: An impressive start. Be prepared for more.
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: The Crumbling Past
text.objectives: Collect 5 Earthen Jewels.
text.description: The creatures wandering these ruins are Earthen, the ancient ancestors of dwarves, made by the Titans to shape the world itself.$B$BThe original Earthen broke down and went awry thousands of years ago, and these freshly uncovered ones seem no different. We may as well make use of these confused and unstable constructs.$B$BEnter the ruins and destroy the Earthen, and collect the jewels embedded in them; their magical energies will be both valuable and worthy of study.
text.progress: Handle those carefully, $n; they are as ancient as the world itself.
text.completion: Marvelous. To think the shapers of our world crafted these...
text.completed: Return to Andoren Dawnrise.

english.objectives: Collect 5 Earthen Jewels.
