english.progress: Handle those carefully, $n; they are as ancient as the world itself.
english.completion: Marvelous. To think the shapers of our world crafted these...
english.completed: Return to Andoren Dawnrise.

text.title: The Secrets of Uldum
text.objectives: 搜索奥丹姆前厅，寻找一件完好的神器。
text.description: We are ready to enter the antechamber itself, $n. This is a momentous occasion.$B$BFrom the writings you've brought us, I believe these ruins were in fact once the grand entrance to Uldum itself. The quakes that ripped its doors open have probably collapsed the tunnels, but we may yet find amazing things hidden within.$B$BSearch the ruins for anything intact that may be studied.  The thrill of discovery awaits!
text.completion: This chest lies undisturbed, sealed for thousands of years.

english.title: The Secrets of Uldum
english.objectives: Search the Antechamber of Uldum for an intact artifact.
english.description: We are ready to enter the antechamber itself, $n. This is a momentous occasion.$B$BFrom the writings you've brought us, I believe these ruins were in fact once the grand entrance to Uldum itself. The quakes that ripped its doors open have probably collapsed the tunnels, but we may yet find amazing things hidden within.$B$BSearch the ruins for anything intact that may be studied.  The thrill of discovery awaits!
english.completion: This chest lies undisturbed, sealed for thousands of years.

text.title: 里面是什么
text.objectives: 击败前厅守卫者。
text.description: 你把手放在箱子上，听到了一阵轻微的晃动声。摩擦运动的声音在你身后回响，箱子开始关闭。$B$B有东西过来了！
text.completion: The chest now grinds open again, the rest of the antechamber fallen silent.
text.completed: Open the Antediluvian Chest.

english.title: What Lies Within
english.objectives: Defeat the Antechamber Guardian.
english.description: As you lay your hand upon the chest, a faint rumbling can be heard. The sound of grinding movement echoes behind you as the chest begins to shut itself.$B$BSomething is approaching!
english.completion: The chest now grinds open again, the rest of the antechamber fallen silent.
english.completed: Open the Antediluvian Chest.

text.title: 好地精寥寥
text.objectives: 从哈扎里虫茧中解救8名被俘的地精昆虫学者。
text.description: 我们可不是来这儿扎营与侏儒唱歌、玩弄危险机械的。我的人已经试图清除这个虫巢几个星期了！问题是，我们的人损失严重，虫子占了上风。$B$B不过还好，虫子既不喜欢吃地精，也不喜欢拿我们招待他人，所以谢天谢地，我手下几乎所有人都还困在茧里呢。我要你去把他们救出来。
text.completion: Thanks for the help, this was really killin' things here. Once you start losing men, you start losing manpower. And morale. And weapons. And the magazines you loaned to that one guy. You know how it is.
text.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

english.title: A Few Good Goblins
english.objectives: Save 8 Captured Goblin Bughunters from Hazzali Cocoons.
english.description: We haven't just been camped here singin' songs with gnomes and playing with dangerous machinery, you know. My men have been trying to clear this hive out for a week now! Problem is, we've taken so many losses by now that the bugs have the advantage.$B$BLucky for us, the bugs either don't like to eat goblins, or they like us so much they save us as treats, because nearly all my men are still cocooned up out there. I need you to go save 'em.
english.completion: Thanks for the help, this was really killin' things here. Once you start losing men, you start losing manpower. And morale. And weapons. And the magazines you loaned to that one guy. You know how it is.
english.completed: Return to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.

text.title: 森金村
text.objectives: 向森金村的加德林大师报到。
text.description: 这么年轻就有这样出色的表现，我相信你将来一定可以闯出自己的天地。$B$B去吧，到西北边去，渡过浅水滩，到森金村去找加德林大师。在你真正进入杜隆塔尔的荒野之前，他可能会给你指派一两个任务。$B$B请记住，$N，我们也许有时无法认同年轻的地狱咆哮，但他的动机毕竟是崇高的，而我们保持与部落的团结也是非常重要的事。让暗矛部族为你感到骄傲吧。
text.completion: Welcome, young $r. Ya come highly recommended, mon. It's nice ta finally be meetin' ya in person.

english.title: Sen'jin Village
english.objectives: Report to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
english.description: You've be doin' quite well for one so young. I've no doubts you'll be makin' quite da name for yarself.$B$BGo now, northwest, across da shallows ta Sen'jin Village. Dere you'll be meetin' Master Gadrin. He'll likely have a task or two for ya before ya truly make ya way out into the Durotar wilds.$B$BPlease remember, $n, we may disagree wit' the young Hellscream at times, but his intentions are noble, and it be very important that we remain united as one Horde. Make da Darkspear proud.
english.completion: Welcome, young $r. Ya come highly recommended, mon. It's nice ta finally be meetin' ya in person.

text.title: 在凯旋壁垒碰头
text.objectives: 去找贫瘠之地凯旋壁垒的指挥官罗伯兹。
text.description: 感谢你的帮助，我们终于将局势稳定下来了。现在我们需要将注意力转向南边，转向凯旋壁垒。$B$B凯旋壁垒是我们在贫瘠之地执行任务的关键－－它是连接北方城堡和塞拉摩的重要纽带。$B$B我们分头出发。你去要塞找指挥官罗伯兹，我很快会去那里找你碰头。让我们携手保卫前线吧！
text.completion: Have you heard? The General never made it! Killed in the field, like some kind of dog!
text.completed: Report to Commander Roberts at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Meet Me at Triumph
english.objectives: Report to Commander Roberts at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Thanks in part to your efforts, we've stabilized the situation here. We need to turn our attention south, to Fort Triumph.$B$BFort Triumph is the keystone of our operation in the Barrens - the vital land-link between Northwatch and Theramore.$B$BI'll pack up and head out separately. Report to Commander Roberts at the fortress and I will see you there soon. Together, we will secure the frontier!
english.completion: Have you heard? The General never made it! Killed in the field, like some kind of dog!
english.completed: Report to Commander Roberts at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 淘零件
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地的战斗之痕中收集8块攻城坦克废料。
text.description: 这些笨重的矮人攻城坦克压根就不适合在战斗之痕中进行近距离战斗。$B$B我这里有点新研究出来的好东西可以拿来小试牛刀，不过在那之前你得给我弄点备用零件来。战斗之痕里搁置着许多残骸。我需要一名有胆量的$C给我拖一架回来。$B$B说的就是你，$N。就是你没跑了。
text.progress: What have you got for me?
text.completion: Oohh look! A mostly complete exhaust manifold, a reciprocating junction box, a working counterweight slip differential ... you sure know your junk, $n.
text.completed: Bring the scrap to Mizzy Pistonhammer at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Pick-a-Part
english.objectives: Collect 8 Siege Engine Scrap pieces from the Battlescar in Southern Barrens.
english.description: These bulky dwarven siege engines aren't cut out for the close-quarters fighting of the Battlescar.$B$BI've got some new designs I'd like to try out, but first I'm going to need some spare parts. There's plenty of wreckage sitting in the Battlescar. All I need is an enterprising $c to haul it back for me.$B$BThat's you, $N. I'm talking about you.
english.progress: What have you got for me?
english.completion: Oohh look! A mostly complete exhaust manifold, a reciprocating junction box, a working counterweight slip differential ... you sure know your junk, $n.
english.completed: Bring the scrap to Mizzy Pistonhammer at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 驯服野兽
text.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vampiric Duskbat.
text.description: You have spent your young career mastering the arts of single combat.  I feel it is high time that you learned a new form of combat - that of the trained pet.$b$bTake this rod and use it on a vampiric duskbat until it joins you and your cause.  It may take you some time, but I have faith that you can bend the bat to your will.
text.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vampiric Duskbat.
english.description: You have spent your young career mastering the arts of single combat.  I feel it is high time that you learned a new form of combat - that of the trained pet.$b$bTake this rod and use it on a vampiric duskbat until it joins you and your cause.  It may take you some time, but I have faith that you can bend the bat to your will.
english.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 驯服野兽
text.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Plagued Bruin.
text.description: Lately we have seen some young, plagued bears passing over the mountains between here and the plaguelands.  While these bears' trek into Tirisfal tests and threatens the defenses that we have laid at the Bulwark, their passage is a blessing to us hunters.$b$bProve to me you learned something from our last lesson, and use the rod on a plagued bruin, far to the east.
text.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Plagued Bruin.
english.description: Lately we have seen some young, plagued bears passing over the mountains between here and the plaguelands.  While these bears' trek into Tirisfal tests and threatens the defenses that we have laid at the Bulwark, their passage is a blessing to us hunters.$b$bProve to me you learned something from our last lesson, and use the rod on a plagued bruin, far to the east.
english.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 驯服野兽
text.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vicious Night Web Spider.
text.description: Your final test involves the spiders that reside in Venomweb Vale, north of the Bulwark.  Yes, even these simple creatures can become a valuable trained ally.  I have seen many hunters that count these venomous creatures as part of their arsenal.$b$bUse the rod to tame one, and return to me when you finish.
text.end: Tame a Vicious Night Web Spider.
text.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vicious Night Web Spider.
english.description: Your final test involves the spiders that reside in Venomweb Vale, north of the Bulwark.  Yes, even these simple creatures can become a valuable trained ally.  I have seen many hunters that count these venomous creatures as part of their arsenal.$b$bUse the rod to tame one, and return to me when you finish.
english.end: Tame a Vicious Night Web Spider.
english.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 玩火药
text.objectives: 在战斗之痕附近击败一名专家级工兵，然后弄一桶烈性火药回来。
text.description: 我们从尘泥沼泽运来的硝石被劫了，这意味着我们不能在这儿自己生产火药了。$B$B但我可以改良咱们的装备，让它们能装填烈性火药。这种火药很不稳定、 非常危险、对皮肤有毒、而且吞服有害……不过我觉得我会成功的！$B$B去从那群轰炸我们的地精特种工兵那里给我抢一桶这种火药来。
text.progress: Do you have a keg of Blast-O powder yet? When you get one ... don't shake it.
text.completion: Great! Set the keg down right here. I'll measure out some charges once I've donned my full-body protective gear.
text.completed: Take the Blast-O Powder to Mizzy Pistonhammer at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Powder Play
english.objectives: Defeat a Sapper Specialist near the Battlescar and acquire a Keg of Blast-O Powder.
english.description: Our shipments of saltpeter from Dustwallow have been held up, which means we can't manufacture our own gunpowder here.$B$BBut I can retrofit our armaments to use goblin Blast-O powder. It's unstable, dangerous, toxic to the skin, and harmful if swallowed... but I think I can make it work!$B$BGet me a keg of the stuff by attacking one of those goblin sapper specialists who've been storming our walls.
english.progress: Do you have a keg of Blast-O powder yet? When you get one ... don't shake it.
english.completion: Great! Set the keg down right here. I'll measure out some charges once I've donned my full-body protective gear.
english.completed: Take the Blast-O Powder to Mizzy Pistonhammer at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 本品暂不包含电池
text.objectives: 从南贫瘠之地的雷霆蜥蜴身上弄到一个嗡嗡作响的电囊。
text.description: 好了！用了这些你给我找来的备用零件，我的全新多用途战车的框架已经初具雏形了。我现在需要的是一部小型化供电装置。$B$B我留意到这里的本地野生动物十分强力，我是说它们身上的电能很强力。你能帮我去基地周围猎杀几头雷霆蜥蜴吗？然后给我带一个完整的电囊回来。不过你可能要多杀上几头才能找到可用的电囊。
text.progress: It must be an enormous evolutionary advantage to be able to shoot lightning. From your face.
text.completion: Oh, OH! That's nasty! I love it!
text.completed: Take the gizard back to Mizzy Pistonhammer at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Batteries Not Yet Included
english.objectives: Acquire a Humming Electrogizard from a Thunderhead in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Okay! Using the spare parts you've found for me, I've got a framework roughed out for my versatile new assault vehicle. All I need now is a compact power supply.$B$BI've noticed that the indigenous wildlife here packs quite the punch, electrostatically speaking. Can you hunt down Thunderheads near the base here and get me an intact electrogizard? It might take a few kills to find a usable gland.
english.progress: It must be an enormous evolutionary advantage to be able to shoot lightning. From your face.
english.completion: Oh, OH! That's nasty! I love it!
english.completed: Take the gizard back to Mizzy Pistonhammer at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 夺得战斗之痕
text.objectives: 前往战斗之痕。找到旗帜并干掉10名凄凉袭击者。$B$B夺取旗帜会让联盟玩家在战斗之痕中获得战场上的优势。
text.description: 这里往西有一座部落的要塞，他们与我们的战事陷入了胶着状态。战争在继续，即便脚下的大地四分五裂了，战斗也没有停止。$B$B需要有人站出来打破僵持的局面！我需要你潜入战斗之痕，帮助我的人击溃那里的部落军队。$B$B在战斗之痕的中心，你会找到一面象征着地区占领的旗帜。找到那面旗帜。如果我们的人还没有夺取那面旗帜，那就靠你了。它会让你获得对战斗之痕的控制权。
text.completion: Incredible work, $n! My men report a breakthrough. Their stronghold won't survive much longer...
text.completed: Return to Commander Robers at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Claim the Battlescar
english.objectives: Go to the Battlescar. Scout out the flag marker and kill 10 Desolation Raiders.$B$BCapturing the flag will give all Alliance players in the scar a combat advantage.
english.description: The Horde has fought us to a standstill from their stronghold west of here. The fighting continues, even as the land breaks open under our feet.$B$BSomeone's got to break the stalemate! I need you to venture into the Battlescar and help my men crush the Horde opposition there.$B$BIn the center of the scar you will find a flag marker designating who controls the area. Scout out the flag. It'll be worth your while to claim the scar for the Alliance if someone hasn't already done so.
english.completion: Incredible work, $n! My men report a breakthrough. Their stronghold won't survive much longer...
english.completed: Return to Commander Robers at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 解决虫害
text.objectives: 用一桶燃烧着的沥青倒在凯旋壁垒外面的异种蝎土丘上，然后杀掉10只被烧出来的异种群居蝎。
text.description: 我实在是不明白，为啥上级指挥官们会觉得异种蝎土丘是建造要塞的理想地点。这些小虫子会在我们要塞下面打洞，然后拖慢我们的工期。我们需要把它们烧出来！$B$B拿上这个燃烧的沥青桶，然后倒在大门外面的异种蝎土丘上。它们看上去就像大堆大堆的沙子。然后把从里面爬出来的东西统统干掉，但是要小心，$N－－这些恶心的家伙很有可能在你火烧它们老家的时候倾巢而出。
text.progress: How goes the fight, $n?
text.completion: That oughta take care of our bug problem for a while - they'll be hard-pressed to tunnel their way outta that!
text.completed: Return to Logan Talonstrike at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Working the Bugs Out
english.objectives: Use the Bucket of Burning Pitch on the silithid mounds outside of Fort Triumph to flush out and kill 10 Silithid Swarmers.
english.description: Why high command decided that a silithid mound was the ideal place to build a fortress, I'll never know. Them lil' buggers are tunneling under our fortifications and setting back our timetables. We need to scorch 'em out!$B$BTake this here bucket of burning pitch and dump it on the silithid mounds right outside the main gate. They look like big piles of sand. Kill anything that comes out, but be careful, $N - them nasties are likely to swarm you when you light those mounds up.
english.progress: How goes the fight, $n?
english.completion: That oughta take care of our bug problem for a while - they'll be hard-pressed to tunnel their way outta that!
english.completed: Return to Logan Talonstrike at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

text.title: Beast Training
text.objectives: Speak with Apolos in the War Quarter of the Undercity.
text.description: One last thing, $g hunter: huntress;.  You'll want to speak with Apolos at the Undercity.  He'll teach you the last few bits of knowledge necessary to care for and train your pet.$b$bYou can find him in the War Quarter.
text.completed: Return to Ganaar at Azuremyst Isle.

english.title: Beast Training
english.objectives: Speak with Apolos in the War Quarter of the Undercity.
english.description: One last thing, $g hunter: huntress;.  You'll want to speak with Apolos at the Undercity.  He'll teach you the last few bits of knowledge necessary to care for and train your pet.$b$bYou can find him in the War Quarter.
english.completed: Return to Ganaar at Azuremyst Isle.

text.title: 增长的威胁
text.objectives: 杀掉13头钢鬃野猪人。
text.description: 稍微打扰一下，$C。$B$B就我们所知，这里的麻烦比世界末日还要严重。我们的卫戍受到了野猪人的威胁。当然，只要他们待在沼泽里，我们不会去打扰他们，但每一天他们都逐渐地朝我们的营地推进。$B$B如果我亲自出去大开杀戒的话，玛卡是绝对不会原谅我的。但如果你能帮我把那些离营地太近的野猪人赶回去，我将感激不尽。
text.completion: You've my thanks, if not that of the entire Earthen Ring. Maybe someday we'll find a way to talk it out with these pigs, but we can't heal the land if we're dead in our sleep.
text.completed: Return to Dorn Redearth at Firestone Point in South Barrens.

english.title: A Growing Threat
english.objectives: Kill 13 Razormane Quilboar.
english.description: A moment there, $c.$B$BWe've got more problems here than just the end of the world as we know it. Our vigil here's threatened by the quilboar. We've been content to leave them be when they stay in the Kraul, sure, but every day they press further and further out towards our camp.$B$BMahka, bless her green heart, wouldn't ever forgive me if I went out bashing heads in myself, but if you could help drive back those that're wandering near the camp, I'd appreciate it.
english.completion: You've my thanks, if not that of the entire Earthen Ring. Maybe someday we'll find a way to talk it out with these pigs, but we can't heal the land if we're dead in our sleep.
english.completed: Return to Dorn Redearth at Firestone Point in South Barrens.

text.title: 碎牙
text.objectives: 杀死碎牙。
text.description: 乌娜曾在陶拉祖营地里待过一段时间。她告诉我说曾有个野猪人被抓到那里去，他的名字叫做碎牙。对野猪人而言，他算是非常聪明的一个。$B$B我一直在想，究竟是什么让这些野猪人近来如此恼怒，也许原因就是那个从陶拉祖活着逃了出来的碎牙。如果是这样的话，那么一定是他在煽风点火。$B$B西北边的山丘上有个巨大的茅屋。如果你在那里找到碎牙，就把他宰掉。
text.completion: That's a relief. Maybe the rest of 'em will keep to their own devices now. The less fighting around here, the better.
text.completed: Return to Dorn Redearth in South Barrens.

english.title: Mangletooth
english.objectives: Kill Mangletooth.
english.description: Una here used to spend time in Camp Taurajo. She's told me about a quilboar that used to be captured there, named Mangletooth. Quite the clever one, for a quilboar.$B$BI've been tryin' to think what got these quilboar riled up so much recently, and it might be that Mangletooth escaped Taurajo alive. If he has, he's certainly calling the shots.$B$BThere's a large hut up in the hills to the northwest. If you find Mangletooth there, cut 'im down.
english.completion: That's a relief. Maybe the rest of 'em will keep to their own devices now. The less fighting around here, the better.
english.completed: Return to Dorn Redearth in South Barrens.

text.title: 火石岗哨
text.objectives: 去南贫瘠之地的火石岗哨寻找多恩·红土。
text.description: 有件大事要求你帮我，$N？我嫂子的叔叔是大地之环的人，他现在正在贫瘠之地的火石岗哨研究大灾变对那里的影响。他说他们的营地被野猪人包围了，我担心野猪人会血洗营地。$B$B你能帮我打听一下多恩·红土的消息吗？我不想他有事，一则为了我们的家族，也为了所有人。
text.completion: What? Little Logan thinks I might need protection? It's me doing the protectin'! The quilboar here are poised to rampage. They've choked off the entire south, and we're the only thing standing in their way.
text.completed: 去南贫瘠之地的火石岗哨寻找多恩·红土。

english.title: Firestone Point
english.objectives: Seek out Dorn Redearth at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Can you do me a huge favor, $N? My sister-in-law's uncle is in the Earthen Ring, and he's here in the Barrens studying the impact of the Cataclysm, down at Firestone Point. He says their camp is surrounded by quilboar and I worry that they might get overrun.$B$BCan you check in on Dorn Redearth for me? I'd hate for anything to happen to him, what with the close family bond and all.
english.completion: What? Little Logan thinks I might need protection? It's me doing the protectin'! The quilboar here are poised to rampage. They've choked off the entire south, and we're the only thing standing in their way.
english.completed: Seek out Dorn Redearth at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 向双辫将军汇报
text.objectives: 将前线战报送给双辫将军，他正在南贫瘠之地巡逻。
text.description: 联盟可欠巴尔莫丹矮人一个人情，我们在贫瘠之地最早期的防御工事都是他们修建的。$B$B他们的指挥官，双辫将军，那是条真正的汉子，是我们最强的勇士之一。他就在南边巡逻，时刻警惕着部落的来袭。$B$B我非常希望他能预估这里的形势，以便我们可以调整下一步的行动。你能把这份前线报告送给他吗？
text.progress: Hrm, news from the fortress? Well. Spit it out!
text.completion: Quite a name you're earning for yourself here in the Barrens, $n. But Roberts isn't going far enough. What we need is a decisive victory...
text.completed: Deliver the Frontline Report to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Report to Twinbraid
english.objectives: Deliver the Frontline Report to General Twinbraid, who is on patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The Alliance owes a debt to the dwarves of Bael Modan, who built some of our earliest fortifications in the Barrens.$B$BTheir commander, General Twinbraid, is a real stalwart. One of our best. He's on patrol south of here, keeping the Horde on their toes.$B$BI definitely want to keep him appraised of the situation here so we can coordinate our next move. Can you deliver this frontline report to him in the field?
english.progress: Hrm, news from the fortress? Well. Spit it out!
english.completion: Quite a name you're earning for yourself here in the Barrens, $n. But Roberts isn't going far enough. What we need is a decisive victory...
english.completed: Deliver the Frontline Report to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 走出墓穴
text.objectives: 与提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的亡灵卫兵萨尔坦交谈。
text.description: 达内尔跟我说，你们俩已经见过面了。很好，我要把你们都派到丧钟镇去。你们在这里的工作已经完成了。$B$B到北边去跟丧钟镇的亡灵卫兵萨尔坦谈一谈，他会告诉你更多你必须知道的事情。
text.completion: Those val'kyr have been really busy resurrecting you newbies lately.  I've already seen a couple dozen new bodies run down that hill since this morning. You, however, are the most promising $c I've seen today.

english.title: Beyond the Graves
english.objectives: Speak with Deathguard Saltain at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: Darnell tells me that the two of you have already met.  That's good, because I'm sending you both into Deathknell.  Your work is done here.$b$bSpeak with Deathguard Saltain in Deathknell, to the north.  He will tell you more of what you must know.
english.completion: Those val'kyr have been really busy resurrecting you newbies lately.  I've already seen a couple dozen new bodies run down that hill since this morning. You, however, are the most promising $c I've seen today.

text.title: 腐烂的爪子
text.objectives: 给炉灰庄园的亡灵卫兵迪林格尔带回7只腐烂的爪子。
text.description: 有一小撮天灾军团的士兵已经渗入了提瑞斯法林地。$B$B我需要有人来帮我击退所有占领这个小农场的腐烂的死者和破碎的尸体。把他们都给我拆成骨头架子，然后把他们那腐烂的爪子给我带回来，我会奖励你的。
text.progress: 你完成了我委托给你的任务了吗?拿到那些腐烂的爪子了吗?
text.completion: Well done.  I enjoyed watching you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
text.completed: Return to Deathguard Dillinger at Cold Hearth Manor in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: A Putrid Task
english.objectives: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Cold Hearth Manor.
english.description: Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested this area.$B$BI need someone to beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses that have taken this small farm.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws.  The Deathguards will reward you.
english.progress: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
english.completion: Well done.  I enjoyed watching you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
english.completed: Return to Deathguard Dillinger at Cold Hearth Manor in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 流沙岗哨
text.objectives: 跟流沙岗哨的特伦顿·轻锤谈一谈。
text.description: 假如你想找更多的事做，我给你指条路。$B$B我知道有个叫做特伦顿·轻锤的精灵，几年来一心只想着找附近的沙漠巨魔。他是打算非找到他们打造的某种神话般的宝剑不可，不久之前终于凑够了人，前往流沙岗哨进行寻找了。$B$B我听到的最新消息是，他们把巨魔从一个营地赶了出来，自己在那儿开了业。到西边的祖尔法拉克附近去找他。
text.completion: Marin sent you? I'm appreciative of his help. I'm here to seek out Sul'thraze. If you wish to help, speak with Mazoga...he's been cooperative so far.

english.title: Sandsorrow Watch
english.objectives: Speak with Trenton Lighthammer at Sandsorrow Watch.
english.description: If you're looking for more work, I've got a line for you.$B$B I know an elf by the name of Trenton Lighthammer who's been obsessed with the sand trolls near here for years. He's dead-set on finding some kind of mythical sword made by them, and just a while ago he finally got a crew together to go to Sandsorrow Watch and look for it.$B$BLast I heard, they kicked the trolls out of one of their camps and set up shop there. Look for it to the west, near Zul'Farrak.
english.completion: Marin sent you? I'm appreciative of his help. I'm here to seek out Sul'thraze. If you wish to help, speak with Mazoga...he's been cooperative so far.

text.title: 制伏元素
text.objectives: 先知巴胡拉要你使用大地之环补给品中的元素灵契和净化图腾，制服20个激动的火焰之魂。
text.description: $C，元素的动荡永不会止歇。正在危害这片土地的地震和随时可能烧毁奥格瑞玛的大火并不寻常。大地之环相信，我们必须在元素彻底撕裂艾泽拉斯之前让它们恢复平静。我们需要你的帮助，$N。$B$B我会给你一口袋大地之环的补给品。你能在其中找到两件物品——元素灵契和净化图腾。你可以用灵契看到元素世界。然后你就要使用净化图腾制服躁动的火焰之魂。
text.progress: Have you subdued the elements yet?
text.completion: Well done $N.  But for every element that is subdued another one takes it's place.  The solution we have here is merely a stopgap.  Hopefully my brethren in the Earthen Ring are making more headway.
text.completed: Return to Seer Bahura in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Subduing the Elements
english.objectives: Seer Bahura wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Fire Spirits.
english.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and the fires that threaten to burn down Orgrimmar are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated fire spirits.
english.progress: Have you subdued the elements yet?
english.completion: Well done $N.  But for every element that is subdued another one takes it's place.  The solution we have here is merely a stopgap.  Hopefully my brethren in the Earthen Ring are making more headway.
english.completed: Return to Seer Bahura in Orgrimmar.

text.title: The Heads of the SI:7
text.objectives: Collect the heads of Commander Arrington, Darkblade Cyn, and Alexi Silenthowl.
text.description: These orcs were murdered in cold-blood by the Alliance down on the coast. We did nothing to provoke them.$B$BTheir deaths should not be in vain, $N. Will you bring them justice?$B$B<Aggra appears as if she can barely contain her rage.>$B$BThere are three SI:7 leaders down there along the beach. Bring me each of their heads.
text.progress: Has justice been served?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. The spirits of the fallen can now be put to rest.
text.completed: Return to Aggra at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

english.title: The Heads of the SI:7
english.objectives: Collect the heads of Commander Arrington, Darkblade Cyn, and Alexi Silenthowl.
english.description: These orcs were murdered in cold-blood by the Alliance down on the coast. We did nothing to provoke them.$B$BTheir deaths should not be in vain, $N. Will you bring them justice?$B$B<Aggra appears as if she can barely contain her rage.>$B$BThere are three SI:7 leaders down there along the beach. Bring me each of their heads.
english.progress: Has justice been served?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. The spirits of the fallen can now be put to rest.
english.completed: Return to Aggra at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：祖蒙加！
text.objectives: 击败祖蒙加。
text.description: 漂亮！但你的对手不止是人类！$B$B下一个上场的是个凶残的家伙……当心他的右勾拳。还有他的左勾拳。总之他的拳头都要当心。
text.completion: Not bad. You've got a ways to go, however.
text.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Thunderdrome: Zumonga!
english.objectives: Defeat Zumonga.
english.description: Splendidly done! But you'll be fighting more than mere humans!$B$BYour next opponent's a mean one...watch out for his right hook. And his left. I'd be wary of his fists in general.
english.completion: Not bad. You've got a ways to go, however.
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：萨里尼克斯！
text.objectives: 击败萨里尼克斯。
text.description: 但愿你准备好继续下一场了，$N。走错一步，就可能立刻导致痛苦的死亡！但人们付钱就是来看这个的，不是吗？$B$B希望你不怕虫子……
text.completion: Rather impressive. Few can bear to see a silithid reaver face to face, let alone defeat it.
text.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Thunderdrome: Sarinexx!
english.objectives: Defeat Sarinexx.
english.description: I hope you're ready for the next one, $n. One mistake could mean instant, painful death! But that's what the people pay to see, isn't it?$B$BI hope you're not afraid of bugs...
english.completion: Rather impressive. Few can bear to see a silithid reaver face to face, let alone defeat it.
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: Thunderdrome: Prince Mosh!
text.objectives: Defeat Prince Mosh.
text.description: We're gonna have to bring out the big guns to top that last fight!$B$BDon't worry, my friend, we've got more blood for you to spill. Many goblins died to capture the next fighter...he's a whopper!
text.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Thunderdrome: Prince Mosh!
english.objectives: Defeat Prince Mosh.
english.description: We're gonna have to bring out the big guns to top that last fight!$B$BDon't worry, my friend, we've got more blood for you to spill. Many goblins died to capture the next fighter...he's a whopper!
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 小事
text.objectives: 德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔要你跟千针石林的韦恩·法兹维吉谈一谈。
text.description: 听着，伙计。$B$B我有个朋友，他认识一个家伙，正在找一名对战斗在行的$C。$B$B如果你不怕把手弄脏的话，就往南穿过山脉去找一个叫做韦恩的地精。$B$B告诉他是德拉兹派你去的。

english.title: Little Sumpthin'
english.objectives: Drazzit Dripvalve wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Lissen, pal.$b$bI got a friend, who knows a fella, who might just be lookin' for a $c that knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands dirty, head south over the mountains and look for a goblin named Vern.$b$bTell him Drazz sent ya...

text.title: The Warchief Wants You
text.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.
text.description: True to his word, Thrall is going to get us going in the right direction to rescue our people. He asked to speak with you.$B$BGood luck, $N. We're all depending on you.
text.completion: Once again you have helped us to overcome our mutual enemy, the Alliance. Now it is time for us to help you.

english.title: The Warchief Wants You
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.
english.description: True to his word, Thrall is going to get us going in the right direction to rescue our people. He asked to speak with you.$B$BGood luck, $N. We're all depending on you.
english.completion: Once again you have helped us to overcome our mutual enemy, the Alliance. Now it is time for us to help you.

text.title: Borrow Bastia
text.objectives: Speak with Kilag Gorefang at the Tranquil Coast on the Lost Isles.
text.description: Head back down to the coast and tell Kilag that I'd like for you to borrow Bastia. The panther knows the way to where your friends are being held captive.$B$BGo now. I will see you again before we make our move against the Trade Prince.
text.completion: Of course you can borrow Bastia. That is, if she'll take you.

english.title: Borrow Bastia
english.objectives: Speak with Kilag Gorefang at the Tranquil Coast on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Head back down to the coast and tell Kilag that I'd like for you to borrow Bastia. The panther knows the way to where your friends are being held captive.$B$BGo now. I will see you again before we make our move against the Trade Prince.
english.completion: Of course you can borrow Bastia. That is, if she'll take you.

text.title: Let's Ride
text.objectives: Speak with Slinky Sharpshiv at Sky Falls on the Lost Isles.
text.description: Bastia will make sure that you get to where you need to go, goblin.
text.completion: $n?! Nice kitty. Look we don't have much time here. You might have noticed that the volcano is blowing?!

english.title: Let's Ride
english.objectives: Speak with Slinky Sharpshiv at Sky Falls on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Bastia will make sure that you get to where you need to go, goblin.
english.completion: $n?! Nice kitty. Look we don't have much time here. You might have noticed that the volcano is blowing?!

text.title: 朋友的朋友
text.objectives: 微笑的吉姆要你跟千针石林的韦恩·法兹维吉谈一谈。
text.description: 嗯，你看起来像是个精神充沛的家伙……$B$B我正好认识一个人，需要一名对战斗在行的$C。$B$B如果你不怕把手弄脏的话，就往南穿过山脉去找一个叫做韦恩的地精。$B$B告诉他是微笑的吉姆派你去的。

english.title: Friend of a Friend
english.objectives: Smiling Jim wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Say, you look like a frisky sort...$b$bI know a guy who knows a fella that might be lookin' for a $c who knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands a little dirty, make your way south across the mountains and look for a goblin by the name of Vern.$b$bTell him Smiling Jim sent ya.

text.title: 驱赶巨兽
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地杀死4头震地科多兽和1头震地蛮兽。
text.description: 双辫将军的巡逻岗一直面临着诸多威胁。不是遭遇部落的突然袭击，就是被野猪人的游击战搞得苦不堪言。$B$B究其原因，要怪那些震地科多兽。这些体型庞大的多毛兽走起路来，大地都会震颤……导致我们无法察觉部落的伏兵。$B$B想法子让它们离开这片区域吧。杀掉几只，应该可以让兽群往南迁徙，远离巡逻岗。
text.completion: I thought you might be responsible for them clouds of dust I saw to the east. Nice work! Them bulls ain't sissies.
text.completed: Return to Hurlston Stonesthrow at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

english.title: No Bull
english.objectives: Kill 4 Landquaker Kodos and 1 Landquaker Bull in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Twinbraid's patrols always throw us right into the thick of danger. If it's not Horde ambushes, it's a quilboar hit-and-run.$B$BThe problem is them lousy landquaker kodos. Big walkin' walls of fur, shakin' the ground... We can't see or hear an ambush creepin' up on our backside.$B$BGo scare 'em off from our patrol, here. Killing a few should drive the herd south and out of what's left of me hair.
english.completion: I thought you might be responsible for them clouds of dust I saw to the east. Nice work! Them bulls ain't sissies.
english.completed: Return to Hurlston Stonesthrow at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 商旅哨站
text.objectives: 跟商旅哨站的泽克·磨靴谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在这儿做了一件了不起的事。我得确保这些图书顺利完工，然后再回加基森一趟。$B$B要是你打算继续让我们的热砂港朋友们刮目相看，或只是打算多挣点，就到西南方去。商旅哨站就位于大裂口边上。跟泽克·磨靴谈谈。$B$B我敢跟你赌个大的，他正需要帮忙呢。
text.completion: You're with Megs, huh? Word is she's been pretty hell-bent on making nice with Noggenfogger. Not like I care. Are you ready to kill some bugs?

english.title: Bootlegger Outpost
english.objectives: Talk to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost.
english.description: We've done a bang up job here. I'm gonna make sure these mooks finish properly and then head back to Gadgetzan for a bit.$B$BIf you want to keep making a good impression on our Steamwheedle friends, or just make more money, you should head southwest of here. Bootlegger Outpost is set up on the edge of the gaping chasm.$B$BTalk to Zeke Bootscuff. I'd bet good money he'll need help.
english.completion: You're with Megs, huh? Word is she's been pretty hell-bent on making nice with Noggenfogger. Not like I care. Are you ready to kill some bugs?

text.title: 挖掘场的情形
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地的巴尔莫丹挖掘场外找到马尔雷·双辫。
text.description: 巡逻兵还没有任何消息。这让我有些担忧，$N。$B$B自从联盟攻陷陶拉祖后，没有地方是安全的。你像是个有能力的家伙，能请你外出巡逻吗？$B$B去东南方的巴尔莫丹挖掘场外找我的儿子马尔雷。挖掘场完全暴露在敌方的火力范围内，很容易受到攻击。而我的儿子又非常自傲，即便是遇到麻烦，他也不肯发来求救信号的。
text.completion: Father sent you? He worries too much. There's nothing here I can't handle... But I'd still appreciate the help.
text.completed: Locate Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael Modan Excavation in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Digsite Status
english.objectives: Locate Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael Modan Excavation in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The patrol's been quiet today. And that's got me worried, $N.$B$BEver since the Alliance sacked Taurajo, none of our positions are secure. You look like you can handle yourself - can you scout around for me?$B$BCheck in with my son Marley outside the Bael Modan excavation, southeast of here. The site's exposed and susceptible to raids, and my son's too proud to signal for help if he needs it.
english.completion: Father sent you? He worries too much. There's nothing here I can't handle... But I'd still appreciate the help.
english.completed: Locate Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael Modan Excavation in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 龅牙！不！
text.objectives: Cut three Solid Zephyrites and give them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
text.description: Lila's pet Nibbler got into my workshop again!$b$bI was making a bracelet, to be delivered today.  The work was almost done, except for the gems.  I spent all night cutting them, but when I stepped out for a bit of breakfast, the little beast came into my workshop and swallowed every gem in sight!  The thing can digest ANYTHING, and trust me, you'd break your back trying to pick up its leavings.$b$bI need to get replacement gems fast; the courier is coming in tonight.  Help!
text.progress: Have you brought the solid zephyrites I need?
text.completion: You've really saved my skin, $n.  Thanks!
text.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

english.title: Nibbler!  No!
english.objectives: Cut three Solid Zephyrites and give them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: Lila's pet Nibbler got into my workshop again!$b$bI was making a bracelet, to be delivered today.  The work was almost done, except for the gems.  I spent all night cutting them, but when I stepped out for a bit of breakfast, the little beast came into my workshop and swallowed every gem in sight!  The thing can digest ANYTHING, and trust me, you'd break your back trying to pick up its leavings.$b$bI need to get replacement gems fast; the courier is coming in tonight.  Help!
english.progress: Have you brought the solid zephyrites I need?
english.completion: You've really saved my skin, $n.  Thanks!
english.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

text.title: 考古成果属于我！
text.objectives: 进入巴尔莫丹挖掘场，杀死8名挖掘袭击者，取回5块巴尔莫丹圣物并找到双辫的工具。
text.description: 瞧瞧下面乱得一团糟，$N！我已经告诉工头，让他们尽可能地抢救圣物。谁知道那些牛头人会掠走什么样的古器。$B$B你能帮我处理一下这里的麻烦事吗？杀死袭击者，尽可能地夺回圣物。$B$B顺便找到我丢失的工具。只需要一些小修理，这台飞行器就能再次正常运转啦。
text.progress: How's the situation down there? When the raid started I popped a bullet into their ringleader, Stonespire, but they just kept right on coming.
text.completion: My father would be proud of you, $n. Now, to get this flying machine up and about again...
text.completed: Return the tools and artifacts to Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael'modan Digsite in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Hands Off Me Dig!
english.objectives: Kill 8 Excavation Raiders, rescue 5 Bael'modan Artifacts, and acquire Twinbraid's Tools in the Bael'modan Digsite.
english.description: Look at the chaos down there, $N! I've instructed the foremen to save what artifacts they can. Who knows what treasures these tauren animals are like to make off with.$B$BCan you help get a handle on things? Kill the raiders and save what artifacts you can.$B$BWhile you're at it, look for my missing tools. A few quick repairs and I can get this flying machine up and running again.
english.progress: How's the situation down there? When the raid started I popped a bullet into their ringleader, Stonespire, but they just kept right on coming.
english.completion: My father would be proud of you, $n. Now, to get this flying machine up and about again...
english.completed: Return the tools and artifacts to Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael'modan Digsite in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 庄严的石板
text.objectives: Take the Grand Tablet to Andoren Dawnrise.
text.description: At the bottom of the chest, you find a large tablet. Made of a material resembling stone, but completely smooth and flawless, it is covered in strange writing.$B$BWhile some resembles the writing on the walls, other scripts appear completely different. Andoren would probably like to see this.
text.progress: You're back! What have you found?
text.completion: This is truly incredible. The hieroglyphs are undoubtedly titan, but the markings below it... Some of these characters resemble ancient Kaldorei writings. And you say the antechamber was covered in hieroglyphs? You've made a find more monumental than any riches, $n. Please, take whatever reward you prefer.

english.title: The Grand Tablet
english.objectives: Take the Grand Tablet to Andoren Dawnrise.
english.description: At the bottom of the chest, you find a large tablet. Made of a material resembling stone, but completely smooth and flawless, it is covered in strange writing.$B$BWhile some resembles the writing on the walls, other scripts appear completely different. Andoren would probably like to see this.
english.progress: You're back! What have you found?
english.completion: This is truly incredible. The hieroglyphs are undoubtedly titan, but the markings below it... Some of these characters resemble ancient Kaldorei writings. And you say the antechamber was covered in hieroglyphs? You've made a find more monumental than any riches, $n. Please, take whatever reward you prefer.

text.title: 被流放的费格雷
text.objectives: 杀死巴尔莫丹挖掘场中被流放的费格雷。
text.description: $N，这是我所知的最悲惨的故事。费格雷原本是最优秀的挖掘工之一，直到他得到——“月神之泪”。它改变并重塑了费格雷。我真希望这玩意儿永远埋在地下。$B$B费格雷被逐出了巴尔莫丹，但是我接到报告称他又回到挖掘场。月神之泪让他吃尽了苦头。如果你在挖掘场里撞见费格雷，结束他的痛苦吧。
text.completion: Aye, it's for the best I suppose.
text.completed: Return to Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael Modan Digsite in Southern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: He dug too deep.

english.title: Feegly the Exiled
english.objectives: Kill Feegly the Exiled in the Bael Modan Digsite.
english.description: Saddest story I ever heard told, $N. Feegly was one of our fastest diggers, until he got a hold of that - thing. "The Tear of the Moons" we called it. It changed him. Remade him. I wish it had stayed buried.$B$BFeegly was banished from Bael Modan but I've heard reports he's come sniffing around the dig site again. He's suffered enough, the wretched thing. If you find him down there, put ol' Feegly out of his misery.
english.completion: Aye, it's for the best I suppose.
english.completed: Return to Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael Modan Digsite in Southern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: He dug too deep.

text.title: The Gallywix Labor Mine
text.objectives: Speak with Assistant Greely inside the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.
text.description: We barely escaped with our hides intact!$B$BThe Trade Prince has a whole bunch of us enslaved and performing manual labor inside the cavern.$B$BGreely helped the seven of us to get out, but she was recaptured in the process.$B$B$N, you're the only one crazy enough to walk into an exploding volcano! The assistant will be able to help you free the others.$B$BHurry! This place is about to blow for good!
text.completion: Huh... what? Who?

The assistant will be able to help you free the others.$B$BHurry! This place is about to blow for good!

text.title: Kaja'Cola Gives You IDEAS! (TM)
text.objectives: Collect 1 Kaja'Cola Zero-One.
text.description: Assistant Greely is clearly bewildered and intimidated. How will she help you to find a way to rescue everyone in this condition?$B$BMaybe if she were to drink one of those Kaja'Cola Zero-One drinks you saw, she'd be able to have a bright idea?
text.progress: 哈？
text.completed: Return to Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

english.objectives: Collect 1 Kaja'Cola Zero-One.
english.description: Assistant Greely is clearly bewildered and intimidated. How will she help you to find a way to rescue everyone in this condition?$B$BMaybe if she were to drink one of those Kaja'Cola Zero-One drinks you saw, she'd be able to have a bright idea?
english.progress: Huh?
english.completed: Return to Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 清扫食腐动物
text.objectives: 使用收集机器人采集12具火鹏尸体。
text.description: 我知道你不挑活儿，所以我有另外一个工作要交给你。你看见聚集在骨头附近的那些红色羽毛的鸟了吗？那些是火鹏。不当心的话，它们会把你点着的。$B$B托它们那独特的构造的福，它们可值钱了。在这里晃悠的大多数猎人都是来杀吐火的秃鹰挣钱的……你觉得你能搞定吗？
text.completion: Alchemists pay through the nose for these things. Sure, maybe I tell some of them they're dragon parts, but that ain't my problem, right?
text.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Scavengers Scavenged
english.objectives: Use Butcherbot to harvest 12 Fire Roc corpses.
english.description: Now that I know you're not squeamish, I've got another job for you. Have you seen the red-feathered birds swarming around the bones out there? Those are fire rocs. They'll light you up good if you're not careful.$B$BThey're also pretty darn valuable thanks to their unique anatomy. Most of the hunters loafing around here aren't up to the task of killing fire-spitting buzzards for money...think you can handle it?
english.completion: Alchemists pay through the nose for these things. Sure, maybe I tell some of them they're dragon parts, but that ain't my problem, right?
english.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 收集机器人
text.objectives: 使用收集机器人采集8具晶鳞蜥蜴尸体。
text.description: 我在这里靠卖动物器官挣钱。我已经完善了一种万无一失、一本万利的方法：收集机器人！$B$B基于逐项分析机制，这些小东西被编制程序，专门从野生动物身上采集每一块有用的材料。他什么都能干，最棒的是，只有我才知道怎么把货从他背上拿出来。$B$B要是你对挣钱感兴趣的话，就带上我的一架收集机器人出去转一转。我需要一些晶鳞蜥蜴的器官，你在南边应该能找到很多。
text.completion: Nice going, kid. Didn't lose any fingers? Good, we can get some more work for you then.
text.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Butcherbot
english.objectives: Use the Butcherbot to harvest 10 Glasshide Basilisk corpses.
english.description: I make my money around here selling animal parts. I've been perfecting a foolproof method of maximizing profit: The butcherbot!$B$BThese little guys are programmed to harvest every scrap of usable material from the wildlife around here, on a case-by-case basis. He does all the work, and best of all, only I know how to get the goods back out of him.$B$BIf you're interested in making some coin, take one of these guys for a spin. I need some glasshide basilisk parts; you'll find a bunch of them to the south.
english.completion: Nice going, kid. Didn't lose any fingers? Good, we can get some more work for you then.
english.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Scorpid Poaching: Dunestalkers
text.objectives: Collect 12 Pounds of Dunestalker Legs from Scorpid Dunestalkers.
text.description: The bigger scorpids to the south, the dunestalkers, are too tough and dry for the tail meat to sell. But I'll tell you what everyone overlooks: the legs!$B$BI won't bother you with all the finer details of scorpid part appraisal, but suffice it to say they sell like hotcakes. Or crablegs. Crabcakes?$B$BAnyway, I don't care what the chefs do with them as long as the money flows. Bring me about, oh, twelve pounds of legs.
text.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Basilisk Poaching: Gazer Guts
text.objectives: Collect 12 Gazer Guts from Glasshide Gazers.
text.description: That last job didn't exactly paint you as the dainty type, so I think you're cut out for more.$B$BThe larger basilisks to the south, the gazers, get to some impressive sizes. The alchemists prefer the smaller brains, usually, but the other organs are better sized up.$B$BAt any rate, I'm no alchemist: I just know what Driz sells by the truckload. Bring us back a sack full of gazer guts.
text.completed: Return to Jane Farnum at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 疱爪肉贩
text.objectives: 使用收集机器人采集10具疱爪土狼尸体。
text.description: 废土上徘徊的土狼看起来瘦骨嶙峋，可它们拥有你能找到的最强壮的下颚！不当心的话，它们一口能把你的一条腿咬掉。那种骨密度可是稀有资源，我的朋友，就等着找个买家吧！$B$B把我的收集机器人带上。分离下颚不是件轻松的活，这个小家伙已经设置好了，知道该怎么做。他装满之后，就把他带回来。
text.completion: Beautiful! We'll have these puppies shined up and ready to sell in no time.
text.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Blisterpaw Butchery
english.objectives: Use the Butcherbot to harvest 10 Blisterpaw Hyena corpses.
english.description: The hyenas wandering the wastes here might look scrawny, but they've got some of the strongest jaws you'll find! If you're not careful, they'll take a leg off in one bite. That kind of bone strength is a valuable resource, my friend, just waiting to find a buyer!$B$BTake one of my Butcherbots with you. Jaw separation isn't an easy task, and this little guy has been set up to know exactly what to do. Just bring him back when he's full.
english.completion: Beautiful! We'll have these puppies shined up and ready to sell in no time.
english.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Hyena Poaching: Rabid Livers
text.objectives: Collect 12 Rabid Livers from Blisterpaw Hyenas.
text.description: I know Driz hates sport hunting, but the way I see it, it's okay to have fun as long as you're not being wasteful! Right?$B$BWhat I mean is, the northern hyenas are no fun. The ones further south, they've all got nasty cases of rabies. Now that's fun, when a single deep bite could do you in! And what's more, the rabies makes the liver swell up so much, it's prized for its weight.$B$BNow I've gotten all worked up again. Could you bring back some livers while I sit here, bored? Sigh.
text.completed: Return to Alastair the Savage at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.completed: Return to Alastair the Savage at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: Scout's Dishonor
text.objectives: Collect the Dark Iron Dispatch from the Dark Iron Scout.
text.description: The Dark Iron are up to their usual tricks out here. They've been keeping to themselves, but I just know trouble's brewing.$B$BWe're going to take a look at it. There's a Dark Iron Scout puttering around the center of what used to be the Loch, keeping an eye out. I want you to take him out and bring back any documents or orders he has.$B$BIf my suspicions are unfounded... I'll take the blame from Moira myself. Promise ya.
text.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

english.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

text.title: 寻找潜伏者
text.objectives: 消灭8只森林潜伏者。
text.description: 不知道你怎么想，不过我可不大喜欢蜘蛛，尤其不喜欢那些比我还要大的。洛克莫丹是个怡人的地方，但我要说得先把那些在附近溜达的恐怖玩意给除掉才行。$B$B告诉你吧，我有点闲钱，而你看起来又是个厉害角色。要是你去花时间帮我干掉那些家伙，我就付钱给你。
text.completion: I'll rest easier knowing one of those lumbering things won't be wandering into my bedroom at night... again.  Thanks much.
text.completed: Return to Dakk Blunderblast.

english.title: Looking for Lurkers
english.objectives: Kill 8 Forest Lurkers.
english.description: I don't know about you, but I'm not much a fan of spiders, much less the kind that come bigger than me. Loch Modan's a gorgeous place, but I'd say it could do without those horrid things waltzing around.$B$BTell you what, I've got some spare coin, and you look like a tough one. If you head out and off some of those things for me, I'll pay you for your time.
english.completion: I'll rest easier knowing one of those lumbering things won't be wandering into my bedroom at night... again.  Thanks much.
english.completed: Return to Dakk Blunderblast.

text.title: Impulse Hunting
text.objectives: Collect 6 Sides of Crocolisk from Loch Crocolisks.
text.description: Ashlan's no doubt going to send you off to the Loch to investigate the Dark Iron hooligans he keeps muttering about. If you're headed down there, might as well make some coin while you're at it, right?$B$BThe loch's draining wiped out most of the wildlife in it. Not many places to swim anymore. But there's still crocolisks padding around on the now-dry ground.$B$BThey'll starve in time, so we may as well get 'em while they're fresh. Bring me back some full sides of croc and we'll talk rewards.
text.completed: Return to Kelt Thomasin at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

text.title: 马尔雷最后的飞行
text.objectives: 跟马尔雷·双辫谈一谈，乘坐他的飞行器兜一圈。
text.description: 嗨，$N！将这些圣物以及第一手报告交给我的父亲吧。$B$B在你的帮助下，飞行器可以正常运转了。我们可以一起飞翔，享受美妙的时光。$B$B你准备好出发的话，就跟我谈谈！
text.completed: Hurry! Check to see if Marley Twinbraid survived the flying machine crash outside Bael'Dun Fortress in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Marley's Final Flight
english.objectives: Talk to Marley Twinbraid and take a spin in his flying machine.
english.description: Okay, $N! Let's take these artifacts to my father and give him our report firsthand.$B$BThanks to your help my flying machine is ready to roll. We can fly there together and share in the glory.$B$BTalk to me when you're all set to move out!
english.completed: Hurry! Check to see if Marley Twinbraid survived the flying machine crash outside Bael'Dun Fortress in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 推进力
text.objectives: 去找落帆海湾的凯尔希·钢烁。
text.description: 看来我们有更多的工作要做！诺格弗格先生能让我们处理剩下的海盗真是我们的荣幸。$B$B既然你这么有用，为什么不到落帆海湾去找我呢？我要找个稍微舒服点的交通工具摸进去，所以不要等我了。我会比你先到的，我保证！
text.completion: Hi there! The fun's already started!

english.title: Momentum
english.objectives: Meet Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove.
english.description: It looks like we've got more work to do! Having Mr. Noggenfogger ask us to take care of the rest of the pirates is a true honor.$B$BSince you've been SO helpful, why don't you meet me at Lost Rigger Cove? I've just got to slip into something a bit more comfortable, so don't wait on me. I'll beat you there, promise!
english.completion: Hi there! The fun's already started!

text.title: Morale Boost
text.objectives: Use Kaja'Cola Zero-One to free Ace, Izzy, Gobber, and 6 Goblin Survivors or Kezan Citizens.
text.description: You've got to get all the Kaja'Cola Zero-One that you can and make the goblins drink it to boost their morale and free them!
text.completion: I hate the Trade Prince, but you can't argue with the results of his methods. Kaja'Cola Zero-One is a huge improvement over regular old Kaja'Cola at half the calories and twice the ideas!
text.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

english.description: You've got to get all the Kaja'Cola Zero-One that you can and make the goblins drink it to boost their morale and free them!
english.completion: I hate the Trade Prince, but you can't argue with the results of his methods. Kaja'Cola Zero-One is a huge improvement over regular old Kaja'Cola at half the calories and twice the ideas!
english.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Throw It On the Ground!
text.objectives: Destroy Blastshadow the Brutemaster's soulstone.
text.description: This nightmare will never be over while Blastshadow the Brutemaster still breathes. There are a couple of problems though.$B$BOne, being a warlock, he's got a succubus named Delicia Whipsnaps. If you kill Blastshadow quickly, the demon will go back to where it was summoned from.$B$BThe second problem, since Blastshadow is a warlock, he has a soulstone that allows him to resurrect. You have to get his soulstone and destroy it so that he'll be dead forever!
text.completion: Your soulstone has expired, Blastshadow!
text.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Destroy his soulstone!

text.title: Brute Brutality
text.objectives: Slay 6 Brute Overseers.
text.description: I was thinking. You should probably take care of some of these Brute Overseers while you're doing everything else.$B$BYou know?
text.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Light at the End of the Tunnel
text.objectives: Interact with the Mine Cart outside the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.
text.description: Okay, we have got to get out of here before she blows for good!$B$BLet's head out the other end of the tunnel on the north side of the mine. We should be able to use one of the mine carts for a quick ride down the side of the volcano.
text.completion: Looks a little rickety....

english.objectives: Interact with the Mine Cart outside the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

english.completion: Looks a little rickety....

text.title: 小试身手
text.objectives: 杀掉6只杂斑野猪。
text.description: 第一项任务将在力量方面对你进行考验。我本来可以把你派去贫瘠之地猎杀科多兽，不过呢，照实说，你活着比死了对我们来说更有用。$B$B我相信，如果你去杀掉北边和东北边的农场里的一些杂斑野猪，对我们来说就更有价值了。
text.completion: 嗯，不错啊，$N。但你可别因此就洋洋自得起来……你总有一天会遇到比这些野猪更强的敌手。$B$B尽管如此，你还是证明了自己的价值，在下一个试炼之中，你会遇到一些更危险的对手，所以你应该会需要一些新的护具。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Gornek at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Cutting Teeth
english.objectives: Slaughter 6 Mottled Boars.
english.description: The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.$b$bI believe you'll be of more use to us slaughtering the boars you'll find in the farms to the north and northeast of here.
english.completion: Hmmm, not bad, $n. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career. Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
english.completed: Return to Gornek at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 工蝎的尾巴
text.objectives: 获得8根工蝎的尾巴。
text.description: 我必须把你再次派到荒野中去，$C。在这里的西北方有大量蝎子在活动，你去给我带八条蝎尾回来。$B$B事实上，它们尾巴上的毒针正是制作解毒剂的重要材料，解毒剂是从毒针中提取的。我们必须备有大量的解毒剂，以防止像你这样的新手被蝎毒所害……$B$B但我肯定你是不会需要这种玩意的，对吧？
text.progress: 对於一名有着坚定决心的战士来说，蠍子坚硬的表壳其实就像纸一样脆弱。不要犹豫，给那些蠍子以最沉重的打击吧，你会发现它们真的非常脆弱。
text.completion: 在与这些蠍子战斗的过程中，你会学到重要的一课。无论是看起来多麽不起眼的对手，都可能会让你陷入恐惧之中。在激烈的战斗中，任何东西都将可能会把你击倒，这一点你千万要小心，以後不要在阴沟里翻船。$B$B我已经没什麽可教给你的了，$N。你表现得非常不错，但我以後仍然会关注你的成长。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Gornek at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Sting of the Scorpid
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Scorpid Worker Tails.
english.description: I must send you back into the fields again, $c. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me eight of their tails.$b$bThe antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...$b$bBut I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
english.progress: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
english.completion: There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall. I have no more to teach you, $n. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
english.completed: Return to Gornek at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: Hana'zua
text.objectives: 在试炼谷中找到哈纳祖。
text.description: 嘿，伙计，稍等一下，听我说几句话。我们遇到了一个麻烦。$B$B我的一个好朋友哈纳祖到峡谷中去了，到现在还没有回来。我最后一次看到他的时候，他朝北边去了，那里是蝎子的狩猎场。你能去找找他吗？万灵告诉我说，他的情况很糟。

english.title: Hana'zua
english.objectives: Find Hana'zua in the Valley of Trials.
english.description: Hey mon, take a knee and hear me out.  We got a problem.$b$bA good friend of mine, Hana'zua, has gone out into the valley and he hasn't returned.  Last I seen, he was headin' north, where the scorpids hunt.  Maybe you go take a look for him?  The spirits be tellin' me that he's not well.

text.title: Sarkoth
text.objectives: 杀死萨科斯并将它的爪子带回去交给哈纳祖。
text.description: $C！我差点就神不知鬼不觉地死在这鬼地方了！我在谷里捕猎蝎子的时候，突然看到一只看上去特别凶恶的蝎子。当时我就决定以它为猎物，打算在它那硕大的钳子钳住我的腿以前，先重重地给它来上那么一下子。$B$B但我忘记了它还有根毒刺，毒刺猛扎了下来，一下子就刺进我的胸口。拜托，你一定得替我报仇！只有这样才能留存我的名誉！我是在南边的高地上碰上它的。
text.progress: 啊……父亲经常说，我不会太出众，看来，他是对的，现在的我就只能这样躺在树下慢慢等死……$B$B但至少，我希望在我死之前能得知我的最後一个敌人也已经被干掉了……
text.completion: 我的实力还不足以杀死它，但看着我能给它造成了这麽严重的伤害，我还是有那麽一点点自豪的。如果我死了，这点自豪就是我可以用来慰藉自己的全部了，我一生中所完成的事实在是太少了，这实在令我愤懑不已。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Hana'zua in Durotar.
text.giverWindow: Be ready to dodge his poison, friend.

english.title: Sarkoth
english.objectives: Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.
english.description: $C! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.$b$bI wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
english.progress: Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right. At least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
english.completion: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
english.completed: Return to Hana'zua in Durotar.
english.giverWindow: Be ready to dodge his poison, friend.

text.title: 返回大兽穴
text.objectives: 将哈纳祖目前的状况告诉试炼谷的高内克。
text.description: 看见你为我这么一个素不相识的可怜家伙做了这么多事情，我突然又坚强了起来。我绝不能就这么轻易地死在这种地方！我得坚持下去！$B$B可现在我还是不能自己回到营地去。$N，请你再帮个忙，回去向高内克报告一下我现在的情况。
text.completion: 从你对那只野兽的描述来看，你说的一定是萨科斯!怪不得哈纳祖被它打倒了。我们马上就会派人去帮助它，你就不用再管哈纳祖这摊子事了。$B$B无论如何，我不得不说的是，对於你能够单枪匹马杀死萨科斯这样的猛兽，我的确感到非常震惊。这绝对是一件值得自豪的事，$N。你再一次无私地选择为一个陌生人的荣誉而战，你应得的荣耀又多了一分。$B$B

english.title: Back to the Den
english.objectives: Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek in the Valley of Trials.
english.description: Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!$b$bBut it remains that I cannot make the trek back to our settlement unassisted. Please, $n, return and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.
english.completion: From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight. However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, $n. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.

text.title: 邪灵劣魔
text.objectives: 杀死8只邪灵劣魔。
text.description: 我相信你会在试炼谷学到很多东西，年轻的$C。$B$B我本是被派到这处谷地里来指引和教育你们的，但我却在这里发现了不断滋长的腐蚀气息……$B$B一个火刃教派的成员——这是个崇拜恶魔的邪恶教派——潜入了试炼谷，躲进北方的一处洞穴里，他的邪灵劣魔则不断从洞中涌出，在周边的一大片地区肆虐。$B$B作为你对抗火刃的第一个任务，我命令你消灭这些劣魔。尽可能地多杀一些，如果杀完了它们之后你还活着的话，就回来向我复命。
text.completion: 你干得很好，$N。$B$B尽管这些邪灵劣魔仅仅是火刃氏族的宠物而已，但你成功的行动向他们预示着，我们将采取更进一步的大规模行动。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Zureetha Fargaze at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Vile Familiars
english.objectives: Kill 8 Vile Familiars.
english.description: I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young $c.$B$BI was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...$B$BOne of the Burning Blade - a foul, demon-worshipping cult - has made camp here in the Valley of Trials.  He skulks in a cave to the north, and his vile familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.$B$BAs your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
english.completion: You have done well, $n. Although the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
english.completed: Return to Zureetha Fargaze at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 火刃奖章
text.objectives: Slay 7 Felstalkers and obtain the Burning Blade Medallion.
text.description: 通过占卜，我发现在火刃集会所的深处藏有一件蕴涵着强大力量的物品——一枚奖章，它被一些猛兽和黑暗的魔法守卫着。我们必须得到它。$B$B这些膜拜恶魔的家伙已经污染我们的家园很久了。杀死那些恶魔野兽和他们的头目，净化洞穴中的恶魔污染。带着那枚奖章回来作为证明。$B$B去吧，$N。你可以在北边的一座洞穴中找到他们的集会所。
text.progress: Is your task complete, $n?
text.completion: 你找到它了!干得好!$B$B你在燃刃集会所中所做出的努力无疑正是将这群家伙赶出试炼谷的关键一步。但我真正担心的是，他们也许对我们的土地有着更可怕的打算。$B$B当前我们还无法彻底看清他们下一步要干什么。
text.completed: Return to Zureetha Fargaze at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Burning Blade Medallion
english.objectives: Slay 7 Felstalkers and obtain the Burning Blade Medallion.
english.description: Through my divinations, I see that an item of power - a medallion - hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.  We must have it.$b$bFor too long these demon-worshippers have defiled our homelands.  Cleanse the coven of its demonic taint by slaying the fel beasts and their leader.  Return with this medallion as proof of your deed.$B$BGo, $N.  You will find the coven in a cave to the north.
english.progress: Is your task complete, $n?
english.completion: You retrieved it!  Well done! Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials.  But I fear they have further aims in our land. We have not seen the end of them.
english.completed: Return to Zureetha Fargaze at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 去森金村报到
text.objectives: 与森金村的加德林大师谈一谈。
text.description: 你在这山谷中的针对火刃氏族的试炼……如今就算是完成了。但我希望你能去向其他人报告一下你的发现。$B$B到森金村去找加德林大师吧。先从山谷的东侧出去，在岔路口转向右一直走到底就能抵达森金村了。$B$B我们必须把火刃氏族的势力出现在试炼谷的事告诉加德林大师。$B$B去吧，$N，动作要快。恐怕我们在火刃集会所中找到的东西只是更可怕的威胁的预兆而已……
text.completion: Hm... your report comes at a bad time.  The Burning Blade is no longer seen here in Sen'jin, but we will be vigilant in our efforts to prevent their return to the area. The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls.  Honorable friends.  We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.

english.title: Report to Sen'jin Village
english.objectives: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
english.description: Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley.  But I want you to report your findings.$B$BGo to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin.  Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.$B$BTell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials.  Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.$B$BGo, $N, and be swift.  I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
english.completion: Hm... your report comes at a bad time.  The Burning Blade is no longer seen here in Sen'jin, but we will be vigilant in our efforts to prevent their return to the area. The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls.  Honorable friends.  We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.

text.title: 懒惰的苦工
text.objectives: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on 4 Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.
text.description: Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.$B$BYou look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.$B$BLook for them underneath the trees in the valley.  Lousy slacking peons...
text.progress: 偷懒可不好……$B$B嗯?你手里拿的是我的木棒?你抓到偷懒睡觉的苦工没有?
text.completion: 很好，很好，也许他们下次偷懒之前会记起这次的教训!感谢你的帮助!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar.

english.title: Lazy Peons
english.objectives: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on 4 Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.
english.description: Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.$B$BYou look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.$B$BLook for them underneath the trees in the valley.  Lousy slacking peons...
english.progress: No good lazy... Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
english.completion: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar.

text.title: 塔兹利尔的镐
text.objectives: 将塔兹利尔的镐还给塔兹利尔。
text.description: $N，你是个值得信赖的$R。我能把另一个任务也托付给你吗？$B$B不久前，我在北边的一个洞穴中挖掘矿石的时候不小心弄丢了我最喜欢的镐。后来当我回去找它的时候，却发现洞穴中住满了邪恶的野兽！到那个被称作火刃集会所的洞穴中去帮我取回我的镐，行吗？$B$B我把它放在一个有瀑布的大厅里了。我的镐附有魔法，你在黑暗中也能看见它，所以你不必担心找不到它……只要小心那些守护它的野兽就是了！
text.progress: 你进入火刃集会所了吗，$N?你找到我的镐了吗?
text.completion: 好极了!非常感谢你，$N。这是我最喜欢的镐!要是我的苦工能砍完这些树，我们或许就能找到一个挖矿的好去处了!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar.

english.title: Thazz'ril's Pick
english.objectives: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.
english.description: $N, you are a dependable $r.  Can I count on you for another task?$B$BSome time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?$B$BI left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
english.progress: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $n?  Did you find my pick?
english.completion: Great, you got it!  Thanks a lot, $n.  This is my favorite pick!  Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar.

text.title: 戈加尔的清凉果
text.objectives: 收集6颗仙人掌果。
text.description: 试炼谷这里真是热得要死。$B$B<戈加尔擦了擦额头。>$B$B如果我有仙人掌果的话，就可以做点清凉果来吃了！没什么能比清凉果更甘甜消暑的。$B$B我跟你说啊，$N，只要你给我弄6颗仙人掌果来，我就帮你做一些清凉果。如果你感兴趣的话，就到这附近去找找仙人掌，采集它们的果子。
text.progress: 你收集到我要的仙人掌果了吗?
text.completion: 太好了，$N!这是给你的清凉果，还有一些其他的东西。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Galgar at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Cactus Apples.
english.description: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.$B$B<Galgar wipes his brow.>$B$BIf only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.$B$BI'll tell you what, $N. If you bring me 6 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
english.progress: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
english.completion: Wonderful, $n! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.
english.completed: Return to Galgar at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: Valley of Trials: PRK - H - Warlock Pet Imp
text.objectives: 给鲁赞带回6颗邪灵劣魔的头颅。
text.description: 我们之前的术士，在这里得到的只有部落的不信任，虽然我们现在得到了一些容忍，但是部落仍然对我们没有丝毫敬爱。$B$B这令我们术士们更加团结在一起，当然，也有一些人选择了隐居的生活，独自研究着他们的魔法。我不会强迫或引导你选择其中的任何一条道路，只会帮助你变得更加成熟。$B$B在我教会你召唤恶魔的方法之前，先给我带六颗邪灵劣魔的脑袋回来，在东北方的山洞里就能找到这种生物。
text.completed: Return to Ruzan at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Valley of Trials: PRK - H - Warlock Pet Imp
english.objectives: Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.
english.description: Those warlocks who came before us have earned the distrust of the Horde, and while we are tolerated, we are not loved.$b$bThis has not brought the warlocks closer together, however, as many choose to live reclusively, dabbling in their magics alone. I will not seek to lead you down one path or the other, but only help you in your maturation.$b$bBefore I teach you the art of summoning, bring me six heads of the vile familiars from the cave to the northeast.
english.completed: Return to Ruzan at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 雕文羊皮纸
text.objectives: 阅读雕文羊皮纸，然后与试炼谷的奥克莱法谈谈。
text.description: 啊，你刚才外出的时候，有人给你送来了一张羊皮纸，$N。$B$B有时间就读一下吧。如果我没搞错的话，是法师训练师奥克莱法给你的。等你准备好了，她想跟你谈谈。
text.progress: What?  Who are you?  Get away!$b$bOh, you're the other mage, the new one, the one with the $g big arms: funny hair;.  Come on, let's get to work.
text.completion: Ahh, where to start... introductions!  I'm Acrypha - the one who sent you that parchment - I've spent the last several years in an Undercity library, my head in a book.  I learned everything I could about the arcane, and now I've returned home to share it with grunts like yourself. Shall we begin?

english.title: Glyphic Parchment
english.objectives: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Acrypha in the Valley of Trials.
english.description: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Acrypha. She would have words with you when you're ready.
english.progress: What?  Who are you?  Get away!$b$bOh, you're the other mage, the new one, the one with the $g big arms: funny hair;.  Come on, let's get to work.
english.completion: Ahh, where to start... introductions!  I'm Acrypha - the one who sent you that parchment - I've spent the last several years in an Undercity library, my head in a book.  I learned everything I could about the arcane, and now I've returned home to share it with grunts like yourself. Shall we begin?

text.title: 稳固射击
text.objectives: Learn Steady Shot from Karranisha in the Valley of Trials. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
text.description: You already know how to fire an arcane shot.  Good.  But doing so depletes your focus.  To gain your focus back you will need to switch to a second type of ranged attack.  I can teach it to you.
text.completion: 你学得很快。
text.completed: Return to Karranisha at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Steady Shot
english.objectives: Learn Steady Shot from Karranisha in the Valley of Trials. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
english.description: You already know how to fire an arcane shot.  Good.  But doing so depletes your focus.  To gain your focus back you will need to switch to a second type of ranged attack.  I can teach it to you.
english.completion: You learn quickly.
english.completed: Return to Karranisha at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: Swine Hunting
text.objectives: Pluck Lo'shall's hair.  You may wish to use Track Beasts.
text.description: Just to the south of this village, you will find a young swine that goes by the name of Lo'shall.  He hides among the cactus and the trees.  While he is small of size, he conceals an intelligence that most boars lack.$b$bFind him, pluck one of his hairs, and then return to me.$b$bRemember what I taught you, $n.  You may find Track Beasts to be helpful here.
text.completed: Return to Karranisha at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.objectives: Pluck Lo'shall's hair.  You may wish to use Track Beasts.
english.description: Just to the south of this village, you will find a young swine that goes by the name of Lo'shall.  He hides among the cactus and the trees.  While he is small of size, he conceals an intelligence that most boars lack.$b$bFind him, pluck one of his hairs, and then return to me.$b$bRemember what I taught you, $n.  You may find Track Beasts to be helpful here.
english.completed: Return to Karranisha at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 刺骨
text.objectives: Learn Eviscerate from Rwag in the Valley of Trials. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
text.description: Let's start with the basics, shall we?  I'm the only rogue trainer in town, so you're going to have to learn it from me.$b$bHere's how it's going to go: you give me your money, and I'll teach you how to finish off a foe.  Do we have a deal?
text.completion: You won't be sorry.  The ability to capitalize on the opportunities created by previous attacks is one of our greatest strengths.
text.completed: Return to Rwag at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Eviscerate
english.objectives: Learn Eviscerate from Rwag in the Valley of Trials. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
english.description: Let's start with the basics, shall we?  I'm the only rogue trainer in town, so you're going to have to learn it from me.$b$bHere's how it's going to go: you give me your money, and I'll teach you how to finish off a foe.  Do we have a deal?
english.completion: You won't be sorry.  The ability to capitalize on the opportunities created by previous attacks is one of our greatest strengths.
english.completed: Return to Rwag at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: Into the Shadows
text.objectives: Use your Stealth ability next to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
text.description: I want to see you try to sneak past me.  I'll still be able to detect you, since you're still a novice, so don't try anything funny.  I just want to see what you've learned.
text.completed: Return to Rwag at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Into the Shadows
english.objectives: Use your Stealth ability next to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
english.description: I want to see you try to sneak past me.  I'll still be able to detect you, since you're still a novice, so don't try anything funny.  I just want to see what you've learned.
english.completed: Return to Rwag at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 根源打击
text.objectives: Train Primal Strike from Shikrik in the Valley of Trials. Look for a training dummy near Shikrik and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
text.description: I will teach you the art of the primal strike.  By following these steps, you can deal additional damage to your foes with your weapon.  Speak with me again and I will show you the way.$B$BAfter your lessons are complete, practice using the training dummies outside the Den.
text.completion: Very well.  Now that you know how to speak with the elements, we will test your bond with them.
text.completed: Return to Shikrik at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Primal Strike
english.objectives: Train Primal Strike from Shikrik in the Valley of Trials. Look for a training dummy near Shikrik and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
english.description: I will teach you the art of the primal strike.  By following these steps, you can deal additional damage to your foes with your weapon.  Speak with me again and I will show you the way.$B$BAfter your lessons are complete, practice using the training dummies outside the Den.
english.completion: Very well.  Now that you know how to speak with the elements, we will test your bond with them.
english.completed: Return to Shikrik at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: Rock Meets Flesh
text.objectives: Defeat a Captured Northwatch Scout while your weapon is enchanted with Rockbiter Weapon.
text.description: Our village leaders have apprehended human invaders that have attempted to enter the valley.  These invaders are kept in cages, in the cave to the west.$b$bI want you to use this ability on one of these invaders, $n.
