text.objectives: Train Charge from Frang in the Valley of Trials. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Charge.
text.description: I've been instructed to prepare you for battle.  Though, from the look of you, it looks like you've already spent a little time out in the field.  Good.$b$bIt's been said that a warriors fight not only with their arms but their legs.  You must learn to move quickly around the battlefield .$b$bSpeak to me again, and I will teach you how to charge.
text.completion: You understand now?  Good, let's try it out.
text.completed: Return to Frang at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.objectives: Learn Arcane Missiles from Acrypha in the Valley of Trials. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Arcane Missiles 2 times.
text.description: Alright, here's the easy part.  All you have to do is listen to me.  And pay me a little bit of copper.$b$bSpeak with me again and we'll teach you the rite of Arcane Missiles. This isn't just an ordinary spell, $N. Each time you attack with a spell, you'll have a chance to activate Arcane Missiles, so be attentive.$B$B Once your lesson is finished, practice your new spell against a training dummy.
text.completion: Good.  Now we practice.
text.completed: Return to Acrypha at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.description: Arcane Intellect is a spell that you can use on yourself, your friends, or even random passers-by.  While under the spell's temporary effect, you should feel a bit more... mentally acute.  Now let's try it out.$b$bI want you to cast Arcane Intellect on someone.  Actually, scratch that.  I want you to cast it on ME.

text.title: 他需要麦酒！
text.objectives: 在巴尔丹城堡内找到一杯陈年招牌烈酒，将它交给入口处的马尔雷·双辫。
text.description: <马尔雷的手上满是血污，他颤抖着抓住你耳边的头发。>$B$B麦酒……要……麦酒……$B$B城堡里有陈年招牌烈酒。<他剧烈地咳嗽起来。>我……需要它。
text.completion: Ah... that's the stuff. Ol' Barkerstout... Thank you, friend. That'll make this... a little easier.
text.completed: Bring the ale to Marley Twinbraid outside of Bael'Dun Keep in Southern Barrens.

english.title: He Needs Ale!
english.objectives: Search Bael'dun Keep for a Mug of Ol' Barkerstout and bring it to Marley Twinbraid at the entrance.
english.description: <Marley grasps the side of your head with a shaking, bloody hand.>$B$BAle... Must... have ale...$B$BOl' Barkerstout from inside. <He coughs.> That should ... do the trick.
english.completion: Ah... that's the stuff. Ol' Barkerstout... Thank you, friend. That'll make this... a little easier.
english.completed: Bring the ale to Marley Twinbraid outside of Bael'Dun Keep in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 起点
text.objectives: 跟高内克谈一谈。
text.description: Finally, you are of age, $N... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.$B$BYes...$B$B<Kaltunk looks you over.>$B$BYou will do nicely.$B$BNo doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.$B$B<Kaltunk laughs.>$B$BReport to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find him seated at the fire behind me.$B$B
text.completion: 卡尔图克派来的又一个新兵，对吗?$B$B如果这就是部落可提供的最佳人选，那我们的处境可就不妙了。没关系，当我们认为你已经整装待发并可以离开峡谷的时候，你就将成为部落引以为傲的战士。$B$B

english.title: Your Place In The World
english.objectives: Speak with Gornek.
english.description: Finally, you are of age, $N... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.$B$BYes...$B$B<Kaltunk looks you over.>$B$BYou will do nicely.$B$BNo doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.$B$B<Kaltunk laughs.>$B$BReport to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find him seated at the fire behind me.$B$B
english.completion: Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm? A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.

text.title: 营救巴尔丹幸存者
text.objectives: 进入巴尔丹城堡，从废墟中营救10名巴尔丹幸存者。$B$B使用紧急灭火阀保护自己不被火焰吞噬。
text.description: 帮帮忙！帮帮忙啊！你就不能伸出援手吗！$B$B城堡里还有很多矮人——他们被活活掩埋在废墟和火焰里！那真是噩梦般的回忆。城堡的屋顶随时都可能坍塌……$B$B$C，求求你，救救他们吧！$B$B冲进城堡，使用紧急灭火阀保护自己不被火焰吞噬。你是那些幸存者唯一的希望……
text.completion: You're a legend, $n. The other survivors and I will be telling the story of your deeds for years to come.
text.completed: Return to the Bael'dun Survivor outside of Bael'dun Keep in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Bael'dun Rescue
english.objectives: Go into Bael'dun Keep and rescue 10 Bael'dun Survivors from the rubble.$B$BUse the Emergency Fire Valves to protect yourself from the flames.
english.description: Help - Help! You've got to do something!$B$BSome dwarves are still inside - so many - they're trapped in the debris. Buried alive. The flames! It's a nightmare in there. We don't know how much longer until the roof collapses...$B$BPlease, $c, you've got to save them!$B$BRun inside. Use the emergency fire valves to protect yourself from the flames. You're the only hope they have...
english.completion: You're a legend, $n. The other survivors and I will be telling the story of your deeds for years to come.
english.completed: Return to the Bael'dun Survivor outside of Bael'dun Keep in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 给莉娜的礼物
text.objectives: 切割3颗永恒夜之石，把它们交给暴风城的伊莎贝尔·琼斯。
text.description: 我正在试图拉拢一艘商船的船长莉娜。我动手制作了一条项链，用来配她漂亮的紫色秀发，但是宝石却不翼而飞了！昨天晚上，我把项链给好友柯薇儿欣赏的时候，它们还好好的呢。当时我们在喝月光酒，我醉倒了——醒来之后宝石就不见了！肯定是很厉害的盗贼偷走的，因为柯薇儿什么都没看到。$B$B她的船今晚就要靠港，我需要三颗夜之石来完成这件给她的礼物。帮帮我吧！
text.progress: Have you brought me the nightstones?
text.completion: Thanks!  I'm sure to beat out that Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar with these!  I can't wait to see the look in her beautiful eye when I give this to her.
text.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

english.title: A Present for Lila
english.objectives: Cut three Timeless Nightstones and give them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: I'm trying to impress this trade ship captain Lila.  I've been working on a necklace to match her lovely purple hair, but the gems have gone missing!  They were there when I was showing them off to my good friend Curver last evening.  We were drinking moonshine and I blacked out - when I woke up the gems were gone!  They must have been darn good thieves, because Curver didn't see anything.$b$bHer ship is coming in tonight, and I really need three nightstones to get her present done.  Help me out here!
english.progress: Have you brought me the nightstones?
english.completion: Thanks!  I'm sure to beat out that Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar with these!  I can't wait to see the look in her beautiful eye when I give this to her.
english.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

text.title: 诡异的欧格佐尼亚斯
text.objectives: 切割3颗裂纹碧玉，把它们交给暴风城的伊莎贝尔·琼斯。
text.description: 艾泽拉斯快递公司应该送一批碧玉来给我的，但我刚刚听说他们的船撞上了一座名叫欧格佐尼亚的小岛。我挺担心那些船员的，据说岛上的女食人魔会对不幸登岛的男性举行可怕的仪式。不过，我的工作还得继续，我们需要那些宝石。我听说你是个非常出色的珠宝匠——今晚之前能交给我三颗裂纹碧玉吗？
text.progress: Have you brought me the gems I need?
text.completion: Your work is as good as it is rumored to be!
text.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

english.title: Ogrezonians in the Mood
english.objectives: Cut three Jagged Jaspers and give them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: I was supposed to receive a shipment of jasper from Azeroth Express, but I just heard their ship crashed into some tiny island called Ogrezonia.  I worry about the crew, as the giant female ogres on the island are rumored to perform horrible rituals on men who happen upon their island.  My work must go on, though, and we need those gems.  I've heard great things about your skill as a jewelcrafter - could you deliver three jagged jaspers by the end of the day?
english.progress: Have you brought me the gems I need?
english.completion: Your work is as good as it is rumored to be!
english.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

text.title: 元素粘稠物
text.objectives: 从任意灾变元素生物身上收集10份元素粘稠物，把它们交给暴风城的伊莎贝尔·琼斯。
text.description: 我厌倦了那套将宝石镶入戒指首饰的老办法，开始使用一种具有创造性的全新手艺。只需用巴恩沃斯神奇元素胶水把宝石粘上去就好啦！不过教授需要更多元素粘稠物才能制作新的胶水，而我手头的工作堆积如山。你能去帮我弄一点吗？
text.progress: Did you bring me the elemental goo?
text.completion: Thanks.  Erm.  Just set them over there.  I need to figure out how to get my hand off of this jarï¿½
text.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

english.title: Elemental Goo
english.objectives: Collect 10 Elemental Goo from any Cataclysm elemental and bring them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: Instead of using the tired old method of setting gems into rings and such, I use an innovative new method.  I simply glue on the gems with Barnsworth Elemental Glue!  The professor needs more elemental goo for another batch, though, and I have a whole bunch of setting to do.  Can you go get me some?
english.progress: Did you bring me the elemental goo?
english.completion: Thanks.  Erm.  Just set them over there.  I need to figure out how to get my hand off of this jarï¿½
english.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

text.title: 时尚潮流！
text.objectives: 对10名“人型生物目标”测试星尘2号。
text.description: 巴恩沃斯教授正在研究新的星尘——这可是本季度奥格瑞玛最热门的玩意，它能令一切都闪闪发光。如果我们将它投放市场的话，肯定要赚翻了！不过珠宝匠协会不允许我们贩卖它，除非我们完成一些“活体实验”——因为他们觉得使用魔法尘可能会导致危险什么的。好吧，看来我们得迎合他们一下。把这袋星尘拿上，找些人来测试星尘2号。
text.completion: It did what!?  We're ruined!  Hmm.  Well, actually... Maybe the professor can find some other applications for it?
text.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

english.title: The Latest Fashion!
english.objectives: Test Stardust No. 2 on 10 "humanoid subjects".
english.description: Professor Barnsworth has been working on this new stardust - what with the fashion in Stormwind this season being about all things sparkly, I'm sure if we can get it to the market it will be all the rage!  The Jewelcrafter's Association, however, won't let us market it until we've completed some humanoid testing - something about tinkering with magical dust being dangerous or some such nonsense.  Well, I suppose we need to humor them.  Take this bag and test out Stardust No. 2 on some humanoid subjects.
english.completion: It did what!?  We're ruined!  Hmm.  Well, actually... Maybe the professor can find some other applications for it?
english.completed: Return to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.

text.title: 龅牙！不！
text.objectives: Cut three Solid Zephyrites and give them to Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar.
text.description: Lila's pet Nibbler got into my workshop again!$b$bI was making a bracelet, to be delivered today.  The work was almost done, except for the gems.  I spent all night cutting them, but when I stepped out for a bit of breakfast, the little beast came into my workshop and swallowed every gem in sight!  The thing can digest ANYTHING, and trust me, you'd break your back trying to pick up its leavings.$b$bI need to get replacement gems fast; the courier is coming in tonight.  Help!
text.progress: Have you brought me those solid zephyrites I need?
text.completion: You've really saved my skin, $n.  Thanks!
text.completed: Return to Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 元素粘稠物
text.objectives: 从任意灾变元素生物身上收集10份元素粘稠物，把它们交给奥格瑞玛的玛瑞希·拉苏妮亚。
text.description: 我厌倦了那套将宝石镶入戒指首饰的老办法，开始使用一种具有创造性的全新手艺。只需用维恩斯通神奇元素胶水把宝石粘上去就好啦！不过博士需要更多元素粘稠物才能制作新的胶水，而我手头的工作堆积如山。你能去帮我弄一点吗？
text.progress: Did you bring me the elemental goo?
text.completion: Thanks.  Erm.  Just set them over there.  I need to figure out how to get my hand off of this jarï¿½
text.completed: Return to Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Elemental Goo
english.objectives: Collect 10 Elemental Goo from any Cataclysm elemental and bring them to Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Instead of using the tired old method of setting gems into rings and such, I use an innovative new method.  I simply glue on the gems with Vernstrom Elemental Glue!  The doctor needs more elemental goo for another batch, though, and I have a whole bunch of setting to do.  Can you go get me some?
english.progress: Did you bring me the elemental goo?
english.completion: Thanks.  Erm.  Just set them over there.  I need to figure out how to get my hand off of this jarï¿½
english.completed: Return to Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 谁干的？
text.objectives: 在巴尔丹城堡中找到一具部落的尸体。
text.description: 阴谋！这是个阴谋。城堡的仓库发生了爆炸。肯定有部落潜了进来……$B$B$C，你既然有勇气冲进这座燃烧的城堡……就去寻找灾难的线索吧。将军迫不及待地想要知道答案！在废墟中寻找部落的尸体，揭开这场灾难背后的秘密……
text.completed: Look for a Horde corpse within Bael'dun Keep in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Who Did This?
english.objectives: Look for a Horde corpse within Bael'dun Keep.
english.description: Sabotage! It had to be. The whole fortress magazine exploded. The Horde must've gotten someone inside...$B$B$C, if you've the stones to rush into that burning nightmare... look for some clues as to who did this to us. The General will want to know! Look for a Horde corpse in the wreckage and get to the bottom of this disaster...
english.completed: Look for a Horde corpse within Bael'dun Keep in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 背水一战
text.objectives: 保卫大地之环营地直到纳迦撤退。
text.description: 纳迦打过来了，$C。帮我们击退他们！
text.completion: I'm glad you were here, mon. Toshe be lookin' like he wants to chase dem down. You should go help'em.
text.completed: Speak to Farseer Gadra in Damplight Cavern.

english.title: Backed Into a Corner
english.objectives: Defend the Earthen Ring camp until the naga retreat.
english.description: The naga are upon us, $c. Aid us in fightin' dem off!
english.completion: I'm glad you were here, mon. Toshe be lookin' like he wants to chase dem down. You should go help'em.
english.completed: Speak to Farseer Gadra in Damplight Cavern.

text.title: 永远不要相信大蝎刺和微笑
text.objectives: 将毒素萃取图腾插在巨钳蝎附近，收集6份蝎毒样本。
text.description: 接下来，我们需要附近的蝎子身上的毒药。不要担心，波贝不会让你受伤的！$B$B波贝有一个大图腾，你在蝎子攻击时把它插在地上。图腾会吸收所有的毒素，你就可以活着回来啦。听起来不错吧？
text.completion: This is it!  The scorpid juju Bom'bay been waitin' for!  Now we gonna fix you right up, $c. You come back to Bom'bay when you be needin' a pickup.  Bom'bay got the spells to fix ya!
text.completed: Return to Bom'bay at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

english.title: Never Trust a Big Barb and a Smile
english.objectives: Obtain 6 samples of Scorpid Venom by placing the Poison Extraction Totem near a Clattering Scorpid.
english.description: Next, we gonna get some poison from the scorpions that be runnin' around here.  But don't you worry, Bom'bay's not gonna let you get hurt!$b$bBom'bay's got a big totem that you gonna stick in the ground when the scorpion strikes.  The totem gonna suck up all the poison, and you gonna walk away still breathing.  Sound good?
english.completion: This is it!  The scorpid juju Bom'bay been waitin' for!  Now we gonna fix you right up, $c. You come back to Bom'bay when you be needin' a pickup.  Bom'bay got the spells to fix ya!
english.completed: Return to Bom'bay at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

text.title: 恐须船长
text.objectives: 杀死恐须船长。
text.description: 真是有意思，不过别忘了我们是为了诺莫瑞根来的！$B$B我们在南边的一艘小艇上发现了南海海盗的船长，就在战场后面。小船上就他一个人，毫无防守！$B$B如果你能去把他干掉，剩下来的海盗我们转眼就能清光。
text.completion: He was controlling a sea giant? Fascinating. If we'd managed to investigate further... Oh, I mean, wow, that's totally crazy! But thank goodness he's gone, hooray! Mister Noggenfogger will be so pleased. Here's a nice big reward, you!
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.
text.giverWindow: Fear the beard.

english.title: Captain Dreadbeard
english.objectives: Kill Captain Dreadbeard.
english.description: This is getting pretty fun, but let's not forget we're here for Gnomeregan!$B$BWe spotted the captain of the Southsea over on one of his boats to the south, past where all the fighting is. He's all alone on his little boat, undefended!$B$BIf you go take care of him, we'll have the rest of these pirates mopped up in no time.
english.completion: He was controlling a sea giant? Fascinating. If we'd managed to investigate further... Oh, I mean, wow, that's totally crazy! But thank goodness he's gone, hooray! Mister Noggenfogger will be so pleased. Here's a nice big reward, you!
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.
english.giverWindow: Fear the beard.

text.title: 斩断链条
text.objectives: 摧毁3只北方城堡补给箱，并杀死10个北卫军劳工。
text.description: 啊，伙计，这可真不妙。不是一般的不妙。$B$B萨尔出海去了，沃金在处理回音群岛的事，老加德林大师留在了森金村。然后呢？那些人类从北方城堡出来，在我们的后院扎营了！$B$B幸运的是，他们刚来不久，还在忙着建造基地。你可以帮助老加德林，摧毁他们搬来的物资储备箱，以及搬运它们的劳工。你可以在西南边找到他们。
text.completion: Well, we've stymied their efforts for now, but they're still here.  We'll have to press on, $n.
text.completed: Return to Master Gadrin at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

english.title: Breaking the Chain
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Northwatch Supply Crates and kill 10 Northwatch Lugs.
english.description: Aw man, this ain't good.  Not one bit, mon.$b$bThrall's off to sea, Vol'jin's taking care of business in Echo Isles, and old Master Gadrin is left behind to take care of Sen'jin.  And then what happens?  Those humans come outta Northwatch Hold and set up camp in our backyard!$b$bLucky for us, they just got here, and they're still setting up their base.  You can help out old Gadrin by destroying those big supply crates they carry, and by killing the laborers carryin' them. You'll find'm to the southwest.
english.completion: Well, we've stymied their efforts for now, but they're still here.  We'll have to press on, $n.
english.completed: Return to Master Gadrin at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

text.title: 净化峡谷
text.objectives: 在北卫军根据地击败12名北卫军的士兵。
text.description: 北方城堡是一座有重兵把守的要塞，坐落在这里的西南方，过了港口就是。这是一座具有重大战略意义的要塞，部落仍在为了攻陷它而努力。我们不能让人类在杜隆塔尔再建起一座北方城堡来。$B$B去西边的峡谷中大开杀戒，干掉那些人类，$N。让他们感受森金的愤怒和力量吧。
text.completion: A battle well-fought, $c, but I still have my doubts about our effectiveness.  These humans don't seem to be going anywhere. You, however, have done more than could reasonably be asked of any loyal member of the Horde.  Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Master Gadrin at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

english.title: Purge the Valley
english.objectives: Defeat 12 Northwatch troops in Northwatch Foothold.
english.description: Northwatch is a highly-defended stronghold southwest of here, across the harbor.  It's a strategically-located stronghold that the Horde still struggles to overtake.  We don't need the humans setting up another Northwatch here in Durotar.$b$bSweep through the valley to the west and slay these humans, $n.  Let them know the power and the fury of Sen'jin.
english.completion: A battle well-fought, $c, but I still have my doubts about our effectiveness.  These humans don't seem to be going anywhere. You, however, have done more than could reasonably be asked of any loyal member of the Horde.  Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Master Gadrin at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

text.title: 北卫军的侵略战争
text.objectives: 在北卫军根据地里摧毁3份进攻计划。
text.description: 西边的那些人类，可不是只打算在杜隆塔尔扎个营就算了的，伙计。他们有更大的计划，比如占领我们的家园，把我们斩首示众之类的。$B$B我可不答应！绝对不行！拉尔不答应！我的家人都在森金村，我绝对不能允许那些蛮子把我心爱的泰塔希的脑袋挂起来！$B$B他们的计划都是写下来的，伙计。大卷轴，看起来很重要。在他们烧死我们之前，我们要烧掉那些卷轴。
text.completion: Good work, hero.  You done good for Sen'jin today.  No... you done good for all of Durotar.
text.completed: Return to Lar Prowltusk at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
text.objective1: Attack Plan: Valley of Trials burned

english.title: The War of Northwatch Aggression
english.objectives: Destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Northwatch Foothold.
english.description: These humans in the west, they don't just wanna camp out in Durotar, mon.  They got bigger plans, and those plans involve takin' our home and leavin' our skulls on pikes.$b$bWell I'm not havin' it.  Nope!  Not Lar!  I've got family here in Sen'jin, and I'll be damned if I let one of those brutes put my Tai'tasi's head on a stick!$b$bThey've got their plans written down in there, mon.  Big scrolls, real important-lookin'.  We gonna burn those scrolls before they burn us.
english.completion: Good work, hero.  You done good for Sen'jin today.  No... you done good for all of Durotar.
english.completed: Return to Lar Prowltusk at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
english.objective1: Attack Plan: Valley of Trials burned

text.title: 清理海岸
text.objectives: 收集5抷蟹胶。
text.description: 你好呀，伙计！波贝正在试制新的魔精。你要来点吗？嗯，在这之前，波贝得让你帮忙去弄点材料。$B$B首先，波贝需要你去水边，从螃蟹身上弄些黏糊糊的东西。让我看看你的手！$B$B<波贝仔细检查了一下你的手。>$B$B波贝需要5捧。快去吧！
text.progress: You bring the jujus, I show you my mojo.
text.completion: Ya mon, that's tha stuff.  Now we get the other jujus.
text.completed: Return to Bom'bay at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

english.title: Cleaning Up the Coastline
english.objectives: Obtain 5 handfuls of Crawler Mucus.
english.description: Heya mon!  Bom'bay be workin' on some new mojo.  You wanna try a piece of it?  Well, before ya do, Bom'bay's gonna need ya to pick up some jujus.$b$bFirst, Bom'bay needs ya to get some o' the goop from the crabs down by the water.  Let me see your hands!$b$b<Bom'bay examines your hands closely.>$b$bBom'bay gonna need 5 handfuls.  Go on now!
english.progress: You bring the jujus, I show you my mojo.
english.completion: Ya mon, that's tha stuff.  Now we get the other jujus.
english.completed: Return to Bom'bay at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

text.title: 骑狼旅行
text.objectives: 与狼骑兵希亚什交谈，让他送你前往剃刀岭。抵达之后，与加索克交谈。
text.description: 我们必须把情况告知剃刀岭。这些人类今天也许是败退了，但他们改日肯定要卷土重来，届时我们就需要兽人的帮助了。$B$B去跟希亚什谈谈，他就在森金村的大门外。他会送你去剃刀岭的。他的狼很熟悉这条路。
text.completion: That $r wants us to send help?  Bah, he can forget it.  I've got my own human problems to worry about, and even those are the least of my worries right now. Sen'jin Village is right next to Echo Isles and the Valley of Trials.  Old Gadrin should find plenty of youngbloods to help him with his human infestation.

english.title: Riding On
english.objectives: Speak to Raider Jhash to get a ride to Razor Hill.  Once there, speak with Gar'thok.
english.description: We gotta pass the word on to Razor Hill.  These humans may be defeated today, but tomorrow they'll come again, and when they do, we'll need help from the orcs.$b$bSpeak with Jhash, outside the gates of Sen'jin.  He'll give you a ride to Razor Hill.  His wolves know the path well.
english.completion: That $r wants us to send help?  Bah, he can forget it.  I've got my own human problems to worry about, and even those are the least of my worries right now. Sen'jin Village is right next to Echo Isles and the Valley of Trials.  Old Gadrin should find plenty of youngbloods to help him with his human infestation.

text.title: 家园里的入侵者
text.objectives: 杀死7个北卫军斥候。
text.description: 你不是个普通的步兵——好像是个挺认真的$C呢。很好，这正是我要的。$B$B你最好不要声张，因为我不想引起恐慌……有报告称附近有更多人类活动。这是明目张胆地违反我们与那个可悲的吉安娜·普罗德摩尔签订的和平协议！我们不能允许人类踏足杜隆塔尔，尤其是试炼谷。$B$B你可以在南边找到他们。快点去把他们干掉，免得他们人数越来越多。
text.completion: Executed with quickness and discretion.  A job well done.
text.completed: Return to Gornek at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Invaders in Our Home
english.objectives: Slay 7 Northwatch Scouts.
english.description: You're not just another grunt - you seem to be a serious $c.  Good, because that's exactly what I need.$b$bTry not to let the word out, since I don't want to cause a panic... but there have been reports of more humans nearby.  This is an egregious betrayal of the peace that we negotiated with that miserable Jaina Proudmoore!  We can't allow humans here in Durotar, and especially not here in the Valley.$b$bYou will find them to the south.  Slay them quickly, before their numbers increase any more.
english.completion: Executed with quickness and discretion.  A job well done.
english.completed: Return to Gornek at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 越来越糟
text.objectives: 在提拉加德城堡中杀死6个北卫军水兵、6个北卫军射手和帕里特中尉。
text.description: 提拉加德城堡坐落在这里的东南方，杜隆塔尔的东部海岸上。你从森金村过来的路上也许会经过它。这座城堡一直以来都是我的眼中钉肉中刺。$B$B库尔提拉斯来的人类在城堡里住了好些年，每次我试图攻陷它的努力都无功而返。大灾变降临时，海岸线被撕裂，那座城堡和里面的人类也都玩完了。不过，北方城堡的那帮自以为是的家伙又跑去替代了他们的位置！$B$B<加索克发出了攻击性的咆哮。>
text.completion: 你的英勇已经尽人皆知，$C。你在提拉加德城堡所获得的胜利将在奥格玛广为传诵。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: From Bad to Worse
english.objectives: Kill 6 Northwatch Marines, 6 Northwatch Sharpshooters, and Lieutenant Palliter in Tiragarde Keep.
english.description: Tiragarde Keep lies to the southeast of here, on Durotar's eastern shore.  You probably passed it on your trip from Sen'jin Village.  This castle has been a thorn in my side for too long.$b$bHumans from Kul Tiras lived in the castle for years, thwarting my every attempt to crush them.  When the cataclysm hit us, the shore was wiped out, along with the castle and all the humans.  However, these upstarts from Northwatch have moved in to take their place!$b$b<Gar'Thok roars in aggravation.>
english.completion: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
english.completed: Return to Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 告知双辫将军
text.objectives: 返回南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，向双辫将军复命。
text.description: <应该将这次卑劣的袭击行动汇报给双辫将军。你开始收集证据。>
text.completion: What... WHAT!? Bael'dun in ruins? Corpses everywhere - no. No! The Bilgewater goblins, was it? They want a fight do they? We'll show 'em what it means to be a part of the Horde, we will. I'll fill the Battlescar with their corpses. I'll redden the dirt with their blood. Goblins. Are going. To die!
text.completed: Report to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Twinbraid Needs to Know
english.objectives: Report to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: <General Twinbraid will want to know the details of this cowardly attack. You gather up the evidence.>
english.completion: What... WHAT!? Bael'dun in ruins? Corpses everywhere - no. No! The Bilgewater goblins, was it? They want a fight do they? We'll show 'em what it means to be a part of the Horde, we will. I'll fill the Battlescar with their corpses. I'll redden the dirt with their blood. Goblins. Are going. To die!
english.completed: Report to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 坏消息
text.objectives: 前往南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，告诉双辫将军这一坏消息。
text.description: <你用手阖上马尔雷的眼睛。>$B$B<必须有人告知双辫将军，部落杀死了他唯一的儿子。>$B$B<就由你来传达这个消息吧。>
text.completion: That was my boy, $n. My only boy. They've made it personal, $c. Personal.
text.completed: Bring the bad news to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

english.title: The Bad News
english.objectives: Bring the bad news to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: <You gently close Marley's eyes.>$B$B<Someone is going to have to tell General Twinbraid that the Horde has killed his only son.>$B$B<That someone is you.>
english.completion: That was my boy, $n. My only boy. They've made it personal, $c. Personal.
english.completed: Bring the bad news to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 顺手牵羊
text.objectives: 收集6份库尔提拉斯宝藏。
text.description: $g Hey there, handsome!  I've had my eye on those big, beefy biceps ever since you stepped into town.: What're you looking at, ugly?  I've seen you walking around Razor Hill, trying to steal MY men from me!;$b$bListen, I've got something for you to do.  I hear Gar'Thok's got you headed over to Tiragarde.  While you're there, think you could find some abandoned Kul Tiras knicknacks?$b$b$gThanks sweetie!: Don't ask why, just get to it!;
text.completion: You brought me my treasure!  What a sweetheart!
text.completed: Return to Gail Nozzywig at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: Exploiting the Situation
english.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Kul Tiras Treasure.
english.description: $g Hey there, handsome!  I've had my eye on those big, beefy biceps ever since you stepped into town.: What're you looking at, ugly?  I've seen you walking around Razor Hill, trying to steal MY men from me!;$b$bListen, I've got something for you to do.  I hear Gar'Thok's got you headed over to Tiragarde.  While you're there, think you could find some abandoned Kul Tiras knicknacks?$b$b$gThanks sweetie!: Don't ask why, just get to it!;
english.completion: You brought me my treasure!  What a sweetheart!
english.completed: Return to Gail Nozzywig at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 突袭海滩
text.objectives: 杀死11只泡沫海元素。
text.description: 人类已经滚远啦，现在该处理更为紧要的事务了。$B$B这场大灾变彻底吞噬了杜隆塔尔的东海岸区域。你所见到的残骸本是提拉加德城堡。东边的海滩处，破坏情况就更加严重了。$B$B第一波海浪席卷过后，那片海滩就被愤怒的海洋元素生物霸占了。我派了步兵去对付它们，却没能挡住其攻势。我觉得你会比较幸运吧。$B$B当心海浪！
text.completion: The scent of the sea hangs about you, $n.  Your efforts may have purchased another day for Razor Hill. I will pass word of your deeds up my chain of command.  You have our gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: Storming the Beaches
english.objectives: Kill 11 Foaming Sea Elementals.
english.description: Now that those humans are out of our hair for a bit, we can move on to more pressing matters.$b$bThe cataclysm utterly decimated Durotar's eastern coast.  You saw the wreckage that it made of Tiragarde.  The devastation was even worse on the coast to the east of here.$b$bAfter the first wave, the beach was overtaken by angry elementals that came from the sea.  I sent grunts to take care of it, but the onslaught was too much.  I'm guessing you'll have a little more luck than they did.$b$bBeware the tides!
english.completion: The scent of the sea hangs about you, $n.  Your efforts may have purchased another day for Razor Hill. I will pass word of your deeds up my chain of command.  You have our gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 搜寻船骸
text.objectives: 收集4套侏儒的工具。
text.description: $g Hey handsome, welcome back!  You wouldn't mind running another errand, would you?  I'd be EVER so grateful...: You!  Stop right there, you tramp!  I'm not finished with you yet.;$b$bI hear you're headed off to the shore east of here.  The beach is filled with crashed ships, and those ships have gnomish tools in them... tools that I can use.$b$b$g See you soon, beefcake!: Get cracking, missy!;
text.progress: Has my knight in shining armor returned?
text.completion: You really know how to treat a girl, you know that?  If you ever need anything...
text.completed: Return to Gail Nozzywig at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: Shipwreck Searching
english.objectives: Obtain 4 sets of Gnomish Tools.
english.description: $g Hey handsome, welcome back!  You wouldn't mind running another errand, would you?  I'd be EVER so grateful...: You!  Stop right there, you tramp!  I'm not finished with you yet.;$b$bI hear you're headed off to the shore east of here.  The beach is filled with crashed ships, and those ships have gnomish tools in them... tools that I can use.$b$b$g See you soon, beefcake!: Get cracking, missy!;
english.progress: Has my knight in shining armor returned?
english.completion: You really know how to treat a girl, you know that?  If you ever need anything...
english.completed: Return to Gail Nozzywig at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 减少损失
text.objectives: 营救4个受伤的剃刀岭步兵。
text.description: 你必须帮帮我们。那些元素生物……它们比外表看起来的更强，而且一来就是一大堆。它们突然发动攻击，我们措手不及，溃不成军。$B$B我的许多手下在海滩上垂死挣扎。如果你能救他们的命……我会很感谢你的。剃刀岭的加索克也会感谢你。
text.completion: I've already spoken with several orcs that have returned from the beach.  All of them told me that you were the one who saved them. You've done a noble task today, $n.  Lok'tar ogar!  For the Horde!
text.completed: Report to Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: Loss Reduction
english.objectives: Rescue 4 Injured Razor Hill Grunts.
english.description: You've got to help us.  The elementals... they're stronger than they look, and they come in waves.  They took us completely by surprise, and we were overcome.$b$bMany of my fellow grunts lay dying on the beach.  If you could save them... I would be grateful, as would Gar'Thok back in Razor Hill.
english.completion: I've already spoken with several orcs that have returned from the beach.  All of them told me that you were the one who saved them. You've done a noble task today, $n.  Lok'tar ogar!  For the Horde!
english.completed: Report to Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 地之石板
text.objectives: 将地之石板带给铁炉堡的顾问贝尔格拉姆。
text.description: 不久前，布莱恩从奥杜尔给麦格尼国王发来一份紧急报告。他说，他发现了一个古老的泰坦宝藏，从里面发掘出一些神秘而重要的遗物。乌瑞恩国王已经派遣了最快的一艘船前往诺森德，将携带遗物的信使护送回来。我本该在这里和使者会面，检查他带回的古老石板。但那名信使至今还没有出现。$B$B麦格尼很担心，$N。因为我到现在都没有得到任何关于那名使者的消息。你是否能去一趟暴风城港口，看看他是不是在那里？
text.progress: Did you meet up with the courier?
text.completion: Why would Twilight's Hammer take an interest in these tablets? Brann himself wrote that he hardly knows their significance, although he did mention something about becoming one with the earth. I will need to confer with my fellow Explorer's League scholars to decipher these as soon as possible.$B$BThank you, $N. Without your aid, these tablets would've fallen into enemy hands.

english.title: Tablets of the Earth
english.objectives: Bring the Tablets of Earth to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
english.description: Some time ago, Brann sent King Magni an urgent message from Ulduar. He said he'd found an ancient titan cache with mysterious and important relics. King Wrynn dispatched one of his fastest ships to Northrend to transport the courier. I was to meet him here and examine the tablets, but the courier is nowhere to be seen.$B$BMagni is worried, $N. I haven't heard anything about the courier's arrival. Would you be willing to travel to Stormwind Harbor and see if he's arrived?
english.progress: Did you meet up with the courier?
english.completion: Why would Twilight's Hammer take an interest in these tablets? Brann himself wrote that he hardly knows their significance, although he did mention something about becoming one with the earth. I will need to confer with my fellow Explorer's League scholars to decipher these as soon as possible.$B$BThank you, $N. Without your aid, these tablets would've fallen into enemy hands.

text.title: 火之石板
text.objectives: Bring the Tablets of Fire to Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar.
text.description: I'm expecting the arrival of a courier traveling from Northrend. He's carrying a collection of ancient titan treasures, ones I'm hoping will shed light on my troubling visions. The shaman should've arrived on one of the recent zeppelin flights and I'm starting to get worried.$B$BHe was to meet me by the zeppelin tower southwest of Orgrimmar's gates, but I don't want to miss my audience with the warchief. Would you be willing to look for the courier and see what's delaying him?
text.progress: Did you meet up with the courier?
text.completion: Why would Twilight's Hammer take an interest in these tablets? Their contents are a mystery to our most learned scholars and deciphering them will take some time. If Twilight's Hammer knows about these relics and desires them, what more are they plotting?$B$BWe are most fortunate that you protected them from capture, $N.

english.title: Tablets of Fire
english.objectives: Bring the Tablets of Fire to Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I'm expecting the arrival of a courier traveling from Northrend. He's carrying a collection of ancient titan treasures, ones I'm hoping will shed light on my troubling visions. The shaman should've arrived on one of the recent zeppelin flights and I'm starting to get worried.$B$BHe was to meet me by the zeppelin tower southwest of Orgrimmar's gates, but I don't want to miss my audience with the warchief. Would you be willing to look for the courier and see what's delaying him?
english.progress: Did you meet up with the courier?
english.completion: Why would Twilight's Hammer take an interest in these tablets? Their contents are a mystery to our most learned scholars and deciphering them will take some time. If Twilight's Hammer knows about these relics and desires them, what more are they plotting?$B$BWe are most fortunate that you protected them from capture, $N.

text.title: 杀光他们！
text.objectives: Kill 10 Frazzlecraz Miners at the Frazzlecraz Motherlode in Southern Barrens.
text.description: I want to see some dead goblins, $N! Just west of here you'll find a whole warren of those little insects burrowing into the mountain.$B$BLet's see to it that they're digging their grave.$B$BDestroy them. Lay waste to their whole grubby operation. They've sown their own demise in Bael'dun, $c, and it is time to meet the reaper.
text.completion: Dead? Good. Let word of this deed spread, and with it, terror. The Horde will feel the consequences of their attack on Bael'dun, and they'll rue the day they ever crossed us, $n.
text.completed: 返回南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，向双辫将军复命。

english.title: Kill 'em All!
english.objectives: Kill 10 Frazzlecraz Miners at the Frazzlecraz Motherlode in Southern Barrens.
english.description: I want to see some dead goblins, $N! Just west of here you'll find a whole warren of those little insects burrowing into the mountain.$B$BLet's see to it that they're digging their grave.$B$BDestroy them. Lay waste to their whole grubby operation. They've sown their own demise in Bael'dun, $c, and it is time to meet the reaper.
english.completion: Dead? Good. Let word of this deed spread, and with it, terror. The Horde will feel the consequences of their attack on Bael'dun, and they'll rue the day they ever crossed us, $n.
english.completed: Return to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: ……并掩埋一切
text.objectives: 在弗兹卡勒的主矿脉中装填6桶弗兹卡勒炸药。
text.description: 杀掉他们还不够——巴尔丹遇袭后，我就下定决心要以牙还牙，用地精的方式对付他们。$B$B进入弗兹卡勒矿脉中并布下炸药。你可以在矿洞入口处找到类似开关或是活塞的玩意儿。布好炸药后，就启动活塞炸飞矿洞。$C，让恐惧吞噬他们的心灵！
text.completed: Use the Big Nasty Plunger at the entrance to the Frazzlecraz Motherlode Mine in Southern Barrens.

english.title: ...And Bury the Rest
english.objectives: Arm 6 Frazzlecraz Explosives in the Frazzlecraz Motherlode mine.
english.description: It's not enough to kill 'em - after Bael'dun, I want to give those goblins a taste of their own.$B$BGo into Frazzlecraz's mine and arm a pile of the explosives inside.$B$BAt the entrance to the mine you should see some sort of switch or plunger. Once the explosives are armed, use the plunger to blow that place sky-high. Put the fear in 'em, $C!
english.completed: Use the Big Nasty Plunger at the entrance to the Frazzlecraz Motherlode Mine in Southern Barrens.

text.title: Wild Mine Cart Ride
text.objectives: Use the Mine Cart to take a ride to the end of the line and then speak with Assistant Greely.
text.description: All you have to do is jump in and speak with Assistant Greely when you get to the bottom.
text.completion: As we would say in the Tinker's Union, out of the heat-applied metallic cooking container and into the oxydizing, energetic mixture of reacting gases and solids!
text.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Wild Mine Cart Ride
english.objectives: Use the Mine Cart to take a ride to the end of the line and then speak with Assistant Greely.
english.description: All you have to do is jump in and speak with Assistant Greely when you get to the bottom.
english.completion: As we would say in the Tinker's Union, out of the heat-applied metallic cooking container and into the oxydizing, energetic mixture of reacting gases and solids!
english.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 任务完成
text.objectives: 返回南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，向双辫将军复命。
text.description: <矿洞轰然坍塌，扬起漫天尘埃，你闭上了眼睛。>$B$B<双辫将军应该会很满意吧，但是你怀疑这样是否就能平息他复仇的欲望。>
text.completion: Very nice work, $n. I suppose there's some strategic value in depriving the Horde of those minerals, but I'd have done it anyway just to crush those little green monstrosities.
text.completed: 返回南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，向双辫将军复命。

english.title: The Deed Is Done
english.objectives: Return to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: <You shield your eyes from the blast and the debris as the mine implodes onto itself.>$B$B<General Twinbraid will be pleased, but somehow you doubt it'll be enough to quench his thirst for vengeance.>
english.completion: Very nice work, $n. I suppose there's some strategic value in depriving the Horde of those minerals, but I'd have done it anyway just to crush those little green monstrosities.
english.completed: Return to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 徒劳的反抗
text.objectives: 杀死位于石爪山脉和南贫瘠之地交界处的科纳·雷行。
text.description: $N，我可不希望指挥官辛格顿在这份报告中看不到一条好消息。经过艰苦的战斗，我们取得了部落驻军点周遭道路的控制权。$B$B从目前掌握的情报来看，科纳·雷行就是部落的头目。他驻扎在此地以北的营地里。这家伙是石爪山脉的原住民，他比任何人都要了解这里的山路。如果能除掉他，西边的敌军或许就会溃散。$B$B找到并杀死科纳·雷行，然后向指挥官辛格顿汇报！
text.completion: So our supplies aren't getting through? Hmmm. Honor's Stand just gets more and more isolated. Still, the defeat of Thunderwalk should send a signal to our foes that we mean to stay. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Report to Commander Singleton at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: Seek him out at the edge of the great chasm.

english.title: Futile Resistance
english.objectives: Slay Kona Thunderwalk on the border between Stonetalon and Southern Barrens.
english.description: $N, I certainly don't want to deliver my report to Commander Singleton without at least a little bit of good news. We've got to wrestle control of these roads back from these Horde holdouts.$B$BFrom what we can gather, Kona Thunderwalk is the name of the ringleader. He's got a camp just north of here. A Stonetalon native, he knows these roads better than his own hide. If we can wipe him out, resistance from the west might vanish.$B$BFind and kill Kona Thunderwalk, then report to Commander Singleton!
english.completion: So our supplies aren't getting through? Hmmm. Honor's Stand just gets more and more isolated. Still, the defeat of Thunderwalk should send a signal to our foes that we mean to stay. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Report to Commander Singleton at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Seek him out at the edge of the great chasm.

text.title: 迷失在洪水中
text.objectives: 使用索恩克的望远镜，在怒水河流域盆地搜索幸存者。
text.description: 最近这天翻地覆的大灾变可不仅仅是把几艘船冲到我们的海岸边而已，$C。怒水河泛滥成灾，整个杜隆塔尔西部盆地都被水淹了。$B$B那边仍有幸存者。我去搜寻过一段时间，但是没有找到任何东西。你要不要拿我的望远镜自己看看？
text.completion: I see... so the trick is that you need to put the LITTLE end of the spyglass up to your eye.  I'll remember that piece of information.
text.completed: Return to Thonk at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: Lost in the Floods
english.objectives: Use Thonk's Spyglass to search for survivors in Southfury Watershed.
english.description: The recent cataclysmic events have done more than wash a few boats onto our shore, $c.  The Southfury River has overflowed, and Durotar's entire western basin is now flooded.$b$bThere are still people out there.  I've been searching for a while, but haven't been able to find anything.  Would you mind using my telescope and taking a look for yourself?
english.completion: I see... so the trick is that you need to put the LITTLE end of the spyglass up to your eye.  I'll remember that piece of information.
english.completed: Return to Thonk at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 巡逻流域盆地
text.objectives: 搜索怒水河流域盆地，帮助那些你用望远镜看到的人。
text.description: 我的岗位在这座塔里，$N，我不能擅离职守。得有人去帮助那些仍被困在洪水中的人。$B$B我能指望你吗？
text.completion: I used that trick you taught me with the spyglass, and I watched you running around down there.  Quite impressive! How'd you make the old woman fly, by the way?
text.completed: Return to Thonk at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: Watershed Patrol
english.objectives: Search the Southfury Watershed and help the people you saw in the spyglass.
english.description: My post is here on the tower, $N, and I cannot leave it.  I need someone to go out there and help the people who are still trapped in the river's overflow.$b$bCan I count on you?
english.completion: I used that trick you taught me with the spyglass, and I watched you running around down there.  Quite impressive! How'd you make the old woman fly, by the way?
english.completed: Return to Thonk at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 赞美万灵
text.objectives: 护送特克拉主母到拉格兰那里去。
text.description: 你是谁？这是怎么回事？$B$B我正在自己的棚屋里独自冥想，突然……$B$B啊，我想起来了。万灵发出悲鸣，河水灌了进来。能被你找到是我走运了。我年事已高，身体已经不是很听使唤啦。你能带我出去吗？
text.completion: My grandmother was a powerful shaman in her day.  I thought she had lost most of her powers in her old age, but I suppose some things stay with you forever.
text.completed: Speak with Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

english.title: Spirits Be Praised
english.objectives: Escort Grandmatron Tekla to Raggaran.
english.description: Who are you?  What happened?$b$bI was alone in my hut, meditating, when...$b$bAhh, I remember now.  The spirits cried out, and the river swept in.  I'm lucky that you found me here.  I am old, and no longer physically able to endure the elements like this.  Will you lead me out of here?
english.completion: My grandmother was a powerful shaman in her day.  I thought she had lost most of her powers in her old age, but I suppose some things stay with you forever.
english.completed: Speak with Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

text.title: 拉格兰的愤怒
text.objectives: 杀死4个钢鬃野猪人和4个钢鬃斥候。
text.description: 野猪人是这片土地上挥之不去的污点，就连河水都冲不走！他们叫我赶快撤离，但我告诉他们，我的工作还没有完成。$B$B啊啊啊啊啊！我恨死野猪人了！你能帮我去杀掉他们吗？
text.completion: Good, good.  One step closer to eliminating those beady-eyed, basket-wearing, hog-nosed, two-toed... ...hunchbacked, squealing, prickly... no-good... gnome-loving... GREEEAAAAGH!  Quilboar!
text.completed: Return to Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

english.title: Raggaran's Rage
english.objectives: Kill 4 Razormane Quilboar and 4 Razormane Scouts.
english.description: The quilboar are a stain on the land that not even the river can wash away.  They told me to evacuate, but I told them that my job was not yet done.$b$bHrrrraaagh!  I hate quilboar so much!  Will you help me kill them?
english.completion: Good, good.  One step closer to eliminating those beady-eyed, basket-wearing, hog-nosed, two-toed... ...hunchbacked, squealing, prickly... no-good... gnome-loving... GREEEAAAAGH!  Quilboar!
english.completed: Return to Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

text.title: 调查灾情
text.objectives: 跟荣耀岗哨的妮布·轴轮谈一谈，调查这场浩劫的情况。
text.description: 早就听说卡利姆多爆发了大规模的异常地震活动，但是我没有料到这里的地壳变迁是如此剧烈！$B$B我得留下来研究地震波读数，同时我急需一份最新的灾后报告。你能乘坐自动航测飞机，帮我收集数据吗？航线已经设置好了。$B$B完成调查后，将报告交给我在北方城堡的同事荷尔登。
text.completion: What, what!? Can't you see we're under attack here! Yes sure of course I'll give Nibb's findings careful study. Later. From the safety of the Eastern Kingdoms, if I have any say about it!
text.completed: Report your findings to Horton Gimbleheart at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Survey the Destruction
english.objectives: Speak with Nibb Spindlegear at Honor's Stand to survey the cataclysm's destruction.
english.description: I had heard of enormous seismic anomalies here in Kalimdor, but I had no inkling that the geological chaos would be so profound!$B$BI need an up-to-date survey of the destruction while I stay here to study the seismographic readings. Could you gather some data via my automated survey craft? I'll take care of all the flying.$B$BWhen the survey is complete, present the data to my colleague Horton Gimbleheart in Northwatch.
english.completion: What, what!? Can't you see we're under attack here! Yes sure of course I'll give Nibb's findings careful study. Later. From the safety of the Eastern Kingdoms, if I have any say about it!
english.completed: Report your findings to Horton Gimbleheart at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 拉格兰的怒火
text.objectives: 杀死5个钢鬃传令兵和5个钢鬃卫兵。
text.description: 除非他们都被干掉，我是无法安心休息的！杀光他们！$B$B<拉格兰缓了一口气。>$B$B他们恶臭的巢穴就在北边，或者西南边！
text.completion: You've done well, stranger. I'm sorry you had to see me like that.  Thank you for killing the quilboar, but maybe you should leave before I fly into another one of my rages.
text.completed: Return to Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

english.title: Raggaran's Fury
english.objectives: Kill 5 Razormane Dustrunners and 5 Razormane Battleguards.
english.description: I will not rest until they're defeated!  Slay them all!$b$b<Raggaran catches his breath.>$b$bTheir stinking lairs are to the north, or to the southwest!
english.completion: You've done well, stranger. I'm sorry you had to see me like that.  Thank you for killing the quilboar, but maybe you should leave before I fly into another one of my rages.
english.completed: Return to Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

text.title: 丢失的孩子
text.objectives: 收集250颗鳄鱼的牙齿。
text.description: 今天是我的儿子克鲁恩的周年祭。我始终不愿意接受这件事，直到我清楚地认识到：克鲁恩再也不会回到我身边了，他在一次鳄鱼狩猎行动中永远地离开了我。$B$B我有个心愿……希望以此纪念克鲁恩。做一条鳄鱼牙齿项链……项链上串起密密麻麻的牙齿，只有最勇敢的兽人才配得上它。我想把这串项链放在他的墓碑旁。$B$B克鲁恩很勇敢，却没有你这么强壮。你愿意帮我收集牙齿吗？
text.progress: Kron will be remembered.
text.completion: Thank you, $r.  I will get to work on the necklace right away. Before Kron died, I had made this for him to wear.  I have no use for it now, but perhaps you might.
text.completed: Return to Misha Tor'kren at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.
text.giverWindow: Beloved Kron, as he appeared in life.

english.title: Lost But Not Forgotten
english.objectives: Obtain 250 Crocolisk Teeth.
english.description: Today marks the anniversary of my son Kron's passing.  As long as I refused to admit it, I recognize now: Kron is not returning from his crocolisk hunt.$B$BI've been working on a project... something that will memorialize Kron's passion for the hunt.  It's a crocolisk-tooth necklace... rows and rows of teeth, suitable to be worn by only the bravest young orc.  I will place it on his grave.$b$bKron was brave, but he was not strong, like you.  Will you bring me the teeth for my necklace?
english.progress: Kron will be remembered.
english.completion: Thank you, $r.  I will get to work on the necklace right away. Before Kron died, I had made this for him to wear.  I have no use for it now, but perhaps you might.
english.completed: Return to Misha Tor'kren at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.
english.giverWindow: Beloved Kron, as he appeared in life.

text.title: 不请自来的访客
text.objectives: 攻击3只游荡的平原陆行鸟，直到它们往贫瘠之地逃去。
text.description: 别担心，岑塔基没事啦。只是研究一下河水泛滥时到底发生了什么状况。$B$B你看见站在河床上的大鸟了吗？岑塔基觉得它们有麻烦了。地震和洪水让陆行鸟不得不撤到河流对岸，但是它们回不去了，又不会游泳。$B$B如果这些大鸟继续待在这里，它们会死掉的。岑塔基不喜欢暴力，但是你可以去攻击它们，让它们逃到对岸去。好吗？
text.completion: I love all the little animals, mon.  I love the big ones, too.  I just hate to see you hurt them like that... but it's for the best.
text.completed: Return to Zen'Taji at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

english.title: Unbidden Visitors
english.objectives: Attack 3 Wayward Plainstriders until they flee toward the Barrens.
english.description: Don' worry, Zen'Taji's not in any trouble.  He just been studyin' what happens when the river overflows.$b$bYa see the big tall birds that stand on the riverbank?  Zen'Taji thinks they're in trouble.  The earthquake and the flood pushed the plainstriders over to this side of the water, but they can't fly back, and they're too scared to swim.$b$bThey'll die if they stay here.  Zen'Taji doesn't like violence, but maybe YOU can attack them and scare them over to the other side.  Yes?
english.completion: I love all the little animals, mon.  I love the big ones, too.  I just hate to see you hurt them like that... but it's for the best.
english.completed: Return to Zen'Taji at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

text.title: 迅猛龙的末日
text.objectives: 杀死迅猛龙尖啸利爪。
text.description: 河水冲进山谷时淹死了不少动物。但是迅猛龙却活了下来。它们是聪明的猎食者，以其他动物的不幸为代价世代生活在这片土地上。$B$B其中一只迅猛龙尤其凶猛。它不断地捕杀小动物，却又不吃，任由尸体在河水里腐烂！它叫做尖啸利爪，如果我们不采取措施的话，这里的生态平衡就会遭到破坏。$B$B去北边杀死它，让它回归自然吧。
text.completion: Something happened to Screamslash when the cataclysm hit, Zen'Taji thinks.  He wasn't always so violent and irrational. Thank you for your help, $n.  Zen'Taji gonna get back to his studying now.
text.completed: Return to Zen'Taji at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.
text.giverWindow: The Terror of the Watershed.

english.title: That's the End of That Raptor
english.objectives: Slay the raptor called Screamslash.
english.description: Many creatures died when the water came rushin' into the valley.  The raptors, however, thrived.  They're clever predators, and they've been living off the misfortune of the other creatures.$b$bOne of the raptors is particularly cruel.  He's killing the little animals and letting them rot in the water without even eating them!  He goes by the name of Screamslash, and if we're not careful, he could seriously disrupt the balance of nature.$b$bTravel north, slay him, and give his body back to nature.
english.completion: Something happened to Screamslash when the cataclysm hit, Zen'Taji thinks.  He wasn't always so violent and irrational. Thank you for your help, $n.  Zen'Taji gonna get back to his studying now.
english.completed: Return to Zen'Taji at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.
english.giverWindow: The Terror of the Watershed.

text.title: 德拉诺什尔封锁线
text.objectives: 向杜隆塔尔德拉诺什尔封锁线的执行者戈尔报到。
text.description: 往北边去吧，$N。跟杜隆塔尔德拉诺什尔封锁线的执行者戈尔谈谈。他负责保卫奥格瑞玛航道的安全，他所在的码头旁边就是骷髅石。我相信他会对我们未完成的事业感兴趣的。
text.completion: You're the one who handled the Burning Blade to the south?  I've got ears in all kinds of places, boy, and word travels fast.

english.title: The Dranosh'ar Blockade
english.objectives: Report to Gor the Enforcer at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.
english.description: You should head north from here, $N.  Speak with Gor the Enforcer at the Dranosh'ar Blockade.  He's been placed in charge of securing shipping lanes for Orgrimmar, and Skull Rock sits right next to his precious dock.  I'm certain he'll be interested in picking up where we left off.
english.completion: You're the one who handled the Burning Blade to the south?  I've got ears in all kinds of places, boy, and word travels fast.

text.title: 不愿撤离的海军司令
text.objectives: 向南贫瘠之地北方城堡的海军司令奥布里报到。
text.description: 嗯？你想待在这里参战？你真是位典型的$C，即便有机会逃生，也要留下来击退部落。$B$B如果你真的愿意拯救北方城堡，就去后面的塔楼向海军司令奥布里报到吧。我曾经恳求他带我们撤离此地，但是他选择了坚守海湾。$B$B如果没有别的事，我要去收拾行李了！
text.completion: You've ventured all the way here from Honor's Stand? Excellent, we could use your experience here. They may have breached the walls, but Northwatch isn't going down without a fight.
text.completed: Report to Admiral Aubrey at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.

english.title: The Admiral Won't Back Down
english.objectives: Report to Admiral Aubrey at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.
english.description: What? You want to stay here to fight? Typical $c, wanting to stay and fight off the Horde while there's still a chance to run for it.$B$BLook, if you really want to save Northwatch, you should report to Admiral Aubrey in the tower behind me. He's keeping his ships here to fight, instead of ferrying us all away like I begged him to.$B$BNow if you'll excuse me, I've got to finish packing!
english.completion: You've ventured all the way here from Honor's Stand? Excellent, we could use your experience here. They may have breached the walls, but Northwatch isn't going down without a fight.
english.completed: Report to Admiral Aubrey at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 温诺亚·松林
text.objectives: 跟南贫瘠之地世仇哨站的温诺亚·松林谈一谈。
text.description: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood, southwest of here.

english.title: Winnoa Pineforest
english.objectives: Speak to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.
english.description: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood, southwest of here.

text.title: 基本命令
text.objectives: 完成教官汽轴的命令，然后回去向崔德·火钻队长报告。
text.description: 嗨！看样子你能帮我们一把！$B$B如果你真的愿意帮助我们，我们就要先对你进行训练。侏儒训练相当严格，强度也相当大。所以我希望你对此有所准备。$B$B去找教官汽轴，他会向你提供你需要知道的一切。记住，一定要严格按照他的命令行动，否则你将无法完成任务。$B$B虽然我已经警告过你，但你也许还不了解你将面对怎样的困难。等你完成任务之后再来见我吧。
text.completed: Report back to Captain Tread Sparknozzle.

english.title: Basic Orders
english.objectives: Follow Drill Sergeant Steamcrank's cues and then report back to Captain Tread Sparknozzle.
english.description: Hey! You look like you could give us a hand!$B$BIf you're willing to help our cause, we have to get you through training.  Gnome training is brutal and rigorous, so I hope you're ready.$B$BHead over to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank and he'll walk you through what you need to know.  Make sure you follow his orders when he gives them, or else you'll never make it$B$BI'm warning you though, it's tough over there.  Come back to see me, if you make it.
english.completed: Report back to Captain Tread Sparknozzle.

text.title: Shredder Shutdown
text.objectives: Slay 8 Steamwheedle Sharks.
text.description: That no-good Trade Prince Gallywix somehow managed to stow the whole Steamwheedle Sharks footbomb team away on the yacht. I didn't even see any of them!$B$BNow he has them doing his dirty work here at the lumber yard. $N, you're the $g guy : gal; who won the championship for us back home on Kezan. You've got to get rid of them!
text.completion: I can't say that I was ever much of a footbomb fan, but you're giving me an appreciation for the game!
text.completed: Return to Assistant Greely at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.

english.completion: I can't say that I was ever much of a footbomb fan, but you're giving me an appreciation for the game!
english.completed: Return to Assistant Greely at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.

text.title: The Ultimate Footbomb Uniform
text.objectives: Collect 8 Shredder Spare Parts.
text.description: Look, kid, I'm here to see to it that you've got a fighting chance at the end game. Thrall's going to need your help in the fight against the Trade Prince.$B$BGreely, Hobart, and I have a plan to put together the ultimate footbomb uniform for you so that you can win the game, but I'm going to need some things first.$B$BLucky for us, this lumber yard is sick with spare shredder parts. Now get out there and give me 110%!
text.progress: Let's see what you have there, $n.
text.completion: Yeah, these will do nicely. You did good, kid. I'll see to it that you get the best footbomb uniform ever made. In the meantime, you've got other bombs to drop on the Trade Prince's lackeys.
text.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.

text.title: The Fastest Way to His Heart
text.objectives: Rip the Still-Beating Heart from out of Chip Endale's chest.
text.description: Oh, girl! You're never going to guess who's out on the oil platform to the north.$B$B<Izzy shakes her head sadly at you.>$B$BChip's out there, and he's working for the Trade Prince. That cold-hearted snake dropped you like a bad habit and now he's working for the other team. I even heard he's going out with that tramp, Candy Cane!$B$BI don't know about you, but if he was my ex, I'd rip his still-beating heart out of his chest.
text.progress: What did you decide? Death or forgiveness?
text.completion: He got just what he deserved. There, there, don't cry. You'll find someone else that'll treat you right. Here, let me take that... we wouldn't want people to think that you're crazy.
text.completed: Return to Izzy at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Carve the Still-Beating Heart from his chest!

text.title: What Kind of Name is Chip, Anyway?
text.objectives: Slay Chip Endale.
text.description: Dude! You're never going to guess who's out on the oil platform to the north.$B$B<Ace shakes head in disbelief.>$B$BChip's out there, and he's working for the Trade Prince. That traitor's now working for the other team. But worse, I heard he's going out with your ex-girlfriend, Candy Cane!$B$BI don't know about you, but if he was going out with my ex, I'd do something about it.
text.completion: There's no two ways about it... he got exactly what he deserved.
text.completed: Return to Ace at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Off this loser!

text.title: Release the Valves
text.objectives: Release Valves #1 - 4.
text.description: We have to stop Trade Prince Gallywix's oil supply and bring his machines to a grinding halt.$B$BWe're going to need you to go out to the KTC Oil Platform and release the valves to overload the coolant system. After you do that, head to the platform control panel on the platform and set it to blow.
text.completion: All of the lights and indicators on the control panel are going crazy!
text.completed: Interact with the Platform Control Panel on the KTC Oil Platform.

After you do that, head to the platform control panel on the platform and set it to blow.
english.completion: All of the lights and indicators on the control panel are going crazy!
english.completed: Interact with the Platform Control Panel on the KTC Oil Platform.

text.title: 狼和科多兽
text.objectives: 听听希恩·石柱的寓言故事。
text.description: 我在这里的“同事”对你所做的安排，我不是很赞同。他的行动过于急迫，无法控制，且不负责任。其最终结果可能是让你送了命。$B$B在你与戈尔共事之前，先听听我要讲述的故事吧。这是一个有教育意义的故事——一个寓言——不过我相信它是有价值的一课。等你准备好了，就告诉我一声。
text.completion: The moral of the story: hasty, lazy actions have ruinous results.  We mustn't take shortcuts... we must work for our rewards.  I've been trying to tell this story to the "Enforcer", but I fear his Hellscream-worshipping skull is a little bit too thick.
text.completed: Return to Shin Stonepillar at The Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

english.title: The Wolf and The Kodo
english.objectives: Hear the moral of Shin Stonepillar's story.
english.description: My "associate" here has some plans for you that I don't agree with.  His actions are hasty, uncontrolled, and irresponsible, and you may end up paying for them with your life.$b$bBefore you work with Gor, first listen to the tale that I have to tell.  It's a moralistic story - a fable - but I believe its lesson will prove valuable.  Speak to me when you are ready.
english.completion: The moral of the story: hasty, lazy actions have ruinous results.  We mustn't take shortcuts... we must work for our rewards.  I've been trying to tell this story to the "Enforcer", but I fear his Hellscream-worshipping skull is a little bit too thick.
english.completed: Return to Shin Stonepillar at The Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

text.title: 无视警告
text.objectives: 杀死12个正在交战的元素生物。杀死狂怒的大地卫士或翻腾的水流卫士都可以。
text.description: 别理那个萨满祭司，士兵。部落里的某些大人物要求我带着他，但我向你保证，那个热爱萨尔的先知的眼界连这间棚子外面都看不到。$B$B这里西边的元素生物互相攻击，我通常不会在意这种事，不过我得保证那片土地足够安全，以确保这里和贫瘠之地间的商路畅通无阻。元素生物一般都是很强大的，但由于互相攻打，它们已经被削弱了。借此机会消灭它们吧。
text.completion: See?  The shaman's tales are nothing but that... a youngling's bedtime stories.  The new Horde takes what it wants, and doesn't waste time with such frivolity. If you get a chance, I recommend you tell Shin... and those like him... not to waste any more of your time.
text.completed: Return to Gor the Enforcer at The Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

english.title: Ignoring the Warnings
english.objectives: Destroy 12 Warring Elementals.  You may slay either Furious Earthguards or Teeming Waterguards.
english.description: Ignore the shaman, soldier.  Certain powers-that-be within the Horde demand that I keep him with me, but I assure you, that Thrall-loving farseer truly sees no farther than the borders of this hut.$b$bElementals war against one another to the west of here.  I normally wouldn't mind, but I need that land clear to secure a broader shipping route to and from the Barrens.  The elementals are normally quite strong, but they are weakened by their attacks against one another.  Use this knowledge to destroy them.
english.completion: See?  The shaman's tales are nothing but that... a youngling's bedtime stories.  The new Horde takes what it wants, and doesn't waste time with such frivolity. If you get a chance, I recommend you tell Shin... and those like him... not to waste any more of your time.
english.completed: Return to Gor the Enforcer at The Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

text.title: Good-bye, Sweet Oil
text.objectives: Press the Big Red Button to destroy the KTC Oil Platform.
text.description: There is single big, red button on the platform control console. Clearly if ever there were a button to cause massive explosions, that is it!
text.completion: I felt the heat from the explosions all the way over here!
text.completed: Return to Assistant Greely at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.
