text.title: 告诉西尔维亚
text.objectives: 跟埃斯图兰之塔的西尔维亚谈一谈。
text.description: 看来我们发现的祸害比想象得要严重得多。毫无疑问，古加尔想借助戈多克食人魔，获得厄运之槌里埃雷萨拉斯的残余力量。那是令辛德拉覆灭的禁忌之力……$B$B我不寒而栗。快去吧，$N，把你所知道的一切都告诉西尔维亚。无论厄运之槌里发生了什么，我们都必须阻止它。
text.completion: You're back. What did Estulan say?

english.title: Tell Silvia
english.objectives: Talk to Silvia at the Tower of Estulan.
english.description: It seems we've found an infestation far worse than the one we expected. Cho'gall is no doubt trying to use the Gordok to gain access to the remnants of Eldre'thalas within Dire Maul, full of the forbidden powers that brought the downfall of the Shen'dralar...$B$BI am rambling. Leave me, $n. Tell Silvia of what you've learned. Whatever is occuring in Dire Maul must be stopped.
english.completion: You're back. What did Estulan say?

text.title: 戈杜尼的威胁
text.objectives: Kill 16 Gordunni Ogres in the High Wilderness.
text.description: Within the High Wilderness to the south lay countless ancient ruins. It's there that the ancestors of the night elves fooled about with arcane magic, and it's there that the Gordunni ogres wander, searching for leftover scraps.$B$BYou'll notice the forest is completely destroyed in that area; the ogres leave only useless muck in their wake, depriving the Horde of valuable resources.$B$BGo and slay the Gordunni there, $n. Secure the area for the Horde, and only for the Horde!
text.completion: 你已经证明自己的确是个可以信赖的朋友，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Orhan Ogreblade at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

english.title: The Gordunni Threat
english.objectives: Kill 16 Gordunni Ogres in the High Wilderness.
english.description: Within the High Wilderness to the south lay countless ancient ruins. It's there that the ancestors of the night elves fooled about with arcane magic, and it's there that the Gordunni ogres wander, searching for leftover scraps.$B$BYou'll notice the forest is completely destroyed in that area; the ogres leave only useless muck in their wake, depriving the Horde of valuable resources.$B$BGo and slay the Gordunni there, $n. Secure the area for the Horde, and only for the Horde!
english.completion: You have proven yourself to be a trustworthy and dependable ally, $n.
english.completed: Return to Orhan Ogreblade at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

text.title: 改变的迹象
text.objectives: 收集8只被感染的鹿角。
text.description: 一种恶疾降临在了这片森林中的生物身上。起先我以为这只是自然现象的一部分，可它经久不褪。$B$B那些平常温驯而强壮的雄鹿，如今病得最重。一些在虚弱中白白送了性命，其他的则陷入危险的癫狂。我需要一些鹿角，以便从万灵那里进一步了解这种疾病。
text.progress: This is a sad task, $n, but necessary.
text.completion: I thank you, $n. I will study the horns, but the situation has become even more dire since you left.
text.completed: Return to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

english.title: Signs of Change
english.objectives: Collect 8 Infected Stag Antlers.
english.description: A severe illness has fallen over the creatures of this forest. While at first I hoped it was part of nature's course, it has refused to pass.$B$BThe forest stags, normally strong and serene, have suffered the worst. Some waste away in weakness; others froth and rage dangerously. If I am to consult the spirits to learn more of this sickness, I will need the stags' antlers.
english.progress: This is a sad task, $n, but necessary.
english.completion: I thank you, $n. I will study the horns, but the situation has become even more dire since you left.
english.completed: Return to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

text.title: 大扫除
text.objectives: 杀掉丹奥加兹的5名龙喉兽人。
text.description: 别听拉伦的，他脑子就是一团浆糊！麦酒遭劫就是他的错！$B$B更糟的是，我得说还有比麦酒被偷更要命的事情。这么多年了丹奥加兹还有龙喉兽人出没这件事本身就是扯淡！$B$B这么着吧，$C，你到那些废墟里去，尽可能地把兽人都赶出来。丹奥加兹已经不像话了，我要是放任他们不管那才叫真该死。
text.completion: That'll show 'em!  Nice work!
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Grugelm at Dun Algaz in the Wetlands.

english.title: Cleaning Hovel
english.objectives: Kill 5 Dragonmaw Orcs in Dun Algaz.
english.description: Don't listen to Rharen. He's as addled as they come. It's his fault that the ale got captured!$B$BAnd what's more, I figure there's a bigger issue here than the ale being stolen. The fact that there's a bunch of orcs runnin' about Dun Algaz after all these years is ridiculous!$B$BTell you what, $c. You head in there and be sure to drive as many orcs out of those ruins as you can. Dun Algaz isn't good for much anymore, but I'll be damned if we let them just sit in there.
english.completion: That'll show 'em!  Nice work!
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Grugelm at Dun Algaz in the Wetlands.

text.title: 通风口测量
text.objectives: 使用飞行员杰夫·玛兹斯波克的飞行工具，将辐射计量仪投放到诺莫瑞根周围的通风口去。
text.description: 我们本以为只要耐心等待，诺莫瑞根的辐射自然会渐渐衰弱。但现在这一情况仍然没有得到改善。$B$B如果要夺回我们的城市，我们至少需要确保我们的部队能够安全进入那里。$B$B带上这些辐射计量仪，登上这里的“雷光号”，将它们投放到诺莫瑞根外面的通风口附近。它们会测量那里的辐射水平，并将相关信息传回给我。
text.progress: Did you deploy all the devices?
text.completion: Fantastic work!$B$BThe data I received shows the radiation levels are fully within safety range of our suits. That is excellent news!
text.completed: Talk to Pilot Muzzlesprock.

english.title: Vent Horizon
english.objectives: Use Pilot Muzzlesprock's flying machine to toss Radiageigatrons at the vents surrounding Gnomeregan.
english.description: We thought that we could wait for the radiation to subside around Gnomeregan, but it doesn't appear to be getting better.$B$BIf we want to take back our city, we need to make sure it's safe for our troops to enter.$B$BTake these Radiageigatrons, hop in 'Thunderflash' here,  and toss them at the ventilation shafts outside of Gnomeregan. They'll report the radiation levels directly to me.
english.progress: Did you deploy all the devices?
english.completion: Fantastic work!$B$BThe data I received shows the radiation levels are fully within safety range of our suits. That is excellent news!
english.completed: Talk to Pilot Muzzlesprock.

starters.name: 飞行员杰夫·玛兹斯波克

enders.name: 飞行员杰夫·玛兹斯波克

text.title: 奴隶营
text.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Slave Pits.
text.description: Sassy's over at the Slave Pits. She's there with the orcs getting ready to execute the final play on the Trade Prince.$B$B$N, take the footbomb uniform up the road to the southwest and find her. I know she's going to want you to lead the charge!$B$BAck, I'm starting to talk like the coach now!
text.completion: I was wondering where you were! Don't worry, Hobart will get that footbomb uniform converted into the most Ultimate Footbomb Uniform ever!

english.title: The Slave Pits
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Slave Pits.
english.description: Sassy's over at the Slave Pits. She's there with the orcs getting ready to execute the final play on the Trade Prince.$B$B$N, take the footbomb uniform up the road to the southwest and find her. I know she's going to want you to lead the charge!$B$BAck, I'm starting to talk like the coach now!
english.completion: I was wondering where you were! Don't worry, Hobart will get that footbomb uniform converted into the most Ultimate Footbomb Uniform ever!

text.title: Escape Velocity
text.objectives: Use the Single-Stage Booster Rockets to launch the cages of 8 Kezan Citizens or Goblin Survivors.
text.description: We really don't have time to rescue those that are incompetent enough to get themselves captured over and over. Still, since I have some extra rockets leftover, this problem should be a snap.$B$BTake these single-stage booster rockets down into the Slave Pits to the north and put them on the cages.$B$BThe cage will lift off into orbit and those idiots will be freed.
text.completion: Oops. Well, what goes up must eventually come down.
text.completed: Return to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Slave Pits on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Escape Velocity
english.objectives: Use the Single-Stage Booster Rockets to launch the cages of 8 Kezan Citizens or Goblin Survivors.
english.description: We really don't have time to rescue those that are incompetent enough to get themselves captured over and over. Still, since I have some extra rockets leftover, this problem should be a snap.$B$BTake these single-stage booster rockets down into the Slave Pits to the north and put them on the cages.$B$BThe cage will lift off into orbit and those idiots will be freed.
english.completion: Oops. Well, what goes up must eventually come down.
english.completed: Return to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Slave Pits on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 扰人的气味
text.objectives: 将3具金加塔尔袭击者的躯体拖到南边光渊峡谷的开阔海域。
text.description: 捕食者在一里外就能闻到这些死纳迦的气味。到时候我们就得杀进杀出。你能帮我打扫打扫吗？$B$B南边海崖过去就是光渊峡谷。你得把那些蛇怪的躯体从洞穴东部的出口拖到峡谷去丢掉。尽可能小心避开鲨鱼便是。
text.completion: It shouldn't take long to cleanse the water. Thank you for your help.
text.completed: Speak to Felora Firewreath in Silver Tide Hollow.

english.title: A Distracting Scent
english.objectives: Drag 3 Dead Zin'jatar Raiders into the open water over Glimmerdeep Gorge to the south.
english.description: Predators will smell these dead naga from nearly a mile away. Soon we'll find ourselves fighting just to get in and out of the cave. Care to help me clean up?$B$BJust over the ridge to the south is Glimmerdeep Gorge. If you drag the corpses from the eastern exit of the cave over there to the gorge and cut them loose, the wildlife will pick them clean before they hit the sea floor. Just steer clear of the sharks as much as you can.
english.completion: It shouldn't take long to cleanse the water. Thank you for your help.
english.completed: Speak to Felora Firewreath in Silver Tide Hollow.

text.title: 了不起的萨比诺
text.objectives: 在银潮海沟西侧找到“萨姆”。
text.description: 要是你去壕沟，我希望你能帮我探望一个新兵。$B$B他的名字叫萨姆，不过他总喜欢添油加醋地称自己为萨比诺。他不是很明白大地之环的成员们是怎么干的，不过他挺努力的，所以我们就勉强当他是自己人了。$B$B别被他那些疯狂的设计迷住了。就让他别伤着自己，那我也可以稍稍安心了。
text.completion: Another fan of the Great Sambino! Come all this way for an autograph perhaps? I'm far too busy to be signing anything... move along now.

english.title: The Great Sambino
english.objectives: Find "Sam" at the western end of Silver Tide Trench.
english.description: If you're heading down the trench, I'd like you to check in one of our novice members for me.$B$BHis name is Sam, but he's likely to embellish it a bit. He doesn't really understand how members of the Earthen Ring work, but he tries hard, so we try to give him the benefit of the doubt.$B$BDon't get too wrapped up in helping him with his crazy schemes. Just make sure he's still in one piece and let me know so that I can have a little peace of mind.
english.completion: Another fan of the Great Sambino! Come all this way for an autograph perhaps? I'm far too busy to be signing anything... move along now.

text.title: 图腾改良
text.objectives: 将萨比诺的改良型图腾安放在银潮海沟的沙石中。
text.description: 好吧，既然你那么绝望地看着我，我就让你参与真正的工作。$B$B这块石头尚未被开发！它能创造出的财富甚至能超过大战时期的贸易大王！我需要样本。更多的样本。哪儿的样本都要！$B$B我已经把自己的大地图腾改良了一下，让它可以钻过沙层，储存底下的岩石样本。找个好地方安一个上去。$B$B隆隆作响可能会招来一些可爱好奇的野生动物，所以你多半可以在干活的时候交些朋友。
text.completion: Another sample. Brilliant! The rocky riches of the sea shall soon be mine!
text.completed: Return to The Great Sambino at the western end of Silver Tide Trench.

english.title: Totem Modification
english.objectives: Plant one of Sambino's modified totems in the sand of Silver Tide Trench.
english.description: Okay, I'll let you in on the real work, since you're looking at me so desperately.$B$BThis rock is untapped! It's probably richer than a trade prince during a great war! I need samples. More samples. Samples from everywhere!$B$BI've modified my earth totems to drill through the sand and store samples of the rock underneath. Go find a nice spot and plant one.$B$BThe shaking and rumbling will probably attract all the cute, curious wildlife, so maybe you can make some friends while you're at it.
english.completion: Another sample. Brilliant! The rocky riches of the sea shall soon be mine!
english.completed: Return to The Great Sambino at the western end of Silver Tide Trench.

text.title: 海底膨胀
text.objectives: 给萨比诺的气球充气，找到他丢失的气阀。
text.description: 好！好。你说服我了。你可以帮忙。$B$B我这儿漏气漏得跟一艘塞满了野猪人的飞艇似的！我一定是在壕沟里哪儿弄松了气阀。$B$B我带来了多余的气球——给自己找点事儿做，充个气行不行？然后去找我的阀门！我也需要那个。$B$B我敢说是螃蟹夹走的……贪婪的小混账。
text.progress: If only air weren't so darn floaty! Or if only those water breathing spells came with stylish helmets! Either would do nicely.
text.completion: Ya know, I should have given you a weight belt so that you wouldn't just float away, air balloon and all. Lucky for me you came down here with armor and all! Hah!
text.completed: Return to The Great Sambino at the western end of Silver Tide Trench.

english.title: Undersea Inflation
english.objectives: Fill one of Sambino's Air Balloons and find his Lost Air Valve.
english.description: Fine! Fine. You argued me into it. You can help.$B$BI'm leaking air worse than a zeppelin stuffed with quilboar! My air valve must have come loose somewhere in the trench.$B$BI brought spare air balloons - make yourself useful and go fill one up, will ya? And find my valve! I'll need that too.$B$BI bet the crabs snatched it up... pinchy, greedy little things.
english.progress: If only air weren't so darn floaty! Or if only those water breathing spells came with stylish helmets! Either would do nicely.
english.completion: Ya know, I should have given you a weight belt so that you wouldn't just float away, air balloon and all. Lucky for me you came down here with armor and all! Hah!
english.completed: Return to The Great Sambino at the western end of Silver Tide Trench.

text.title: 别自蛳
text.objectives: 收集10条卷壳筛虫。
text.description: 我在研究螺蛳。$B$B是的。螺蛳。等你笑完了，说不定能帮上忙。$B$B我敢说你注意到山脊对面的巨大贝壳了……是的，我也很肯定里面有东西。有几处肯定是嘴巴或入口什么的，我也看见过那些筛虫进进出出的。$B$B我想我们或许能借螺蛳之力进去。理论上就是这样。
text.progress: I know, this isn't the most desirable work, but can you really help but be curious about that shell? It's immense. There has to be something more to it.
text.completion: Thank you. Seriously. If I would have had to endure another shipwreckee laughing at me, I swear I would have gored someone. I'll let you know if I come up with anything.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn in Silver Tide Hollow.

english.title: Don't be Shellfish
english.objectives: Collect 10 Coilshell Sifters.
english.description: I'm researching snails.$B$BYes. Snails. When you're done laughing, maybe you can help.$B$BI'm sure you noticed the gigantic shellfish across the ridge... well, I'm pretty sure there's something inside it. It has several points that can only be mouths or entrances of some kind, and I've seen those sifting snails squeezing in and out.$B$BI'm thinking that we might be able to use the snails to gain entrance ourselves. That's the theory anyway.
english.progress: I know, this isn't the most desirable work, but can you really help but be curious about that shell? It's immense. There has to be something more to it.
english.completion: Thank you. Seriously. If I would have had to endure another shipwreckee laughing at me, I swear I would have gored someone. I'll let you know if I come up with anything.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn in Silver Tide Hollow.

text.title: 滑不溜手的威胁
text.objectives: 杀掉12条刺牙鳗。
text.description: 在海崖边上被鳗鱼袭击过吗？没有的话，你会的。它们是恶毒、嗜血的小怪物。咬起来也没有个特别的偏好。$B$B要是你到那片流域去的话，消减一下它们的数量我会很感激的。这儿不是所有人都像你一样装备优良——咱们一个抓伤可能就回不来啦。
text.completion: Thank you, $c. There are still much bigger predators we'll have to keep an eye out for, but this will at least give us a bit of peace of mind around the cave.
text.completed: Return to Caretaker Movra in Silver Tide Hollow.

english.title: Slippery Threat
english.objectives: Kill 12 Spiketooth Eels.
english.description: Been attacked by any of the eels along the ridges yet? If not, you will. They are vicious, bloodthirsty little monsters. They don't seem to show much of any preference in what they're biting.$B$BIf you're going out into the valley, I'd appreciate if you thinned their population a bit. Not everyone here is as well equipped as you - we might not come back with just scratches.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. There are still much bigger predators we'll have to keep an eye out for, but this will at least give us a bit of peace of mind around the cave.
english.completed: Return to Caretaker Movra in Silver Tide Hollow.

text.title: 追捕
text.objectives: 用托什的狩猎长矛追捕20名逃跑的金加塔尔纳迦。
text.description: 他们逃了！$B$B就是这些纳迦攻击了船只，掳走了我们的朋友。我们不能让他们逃了！$B$B带上这些矛，乘上海马追捕他们……不要浪费时间停下来，追上他们，能用长矛杀死多少就算多少。$B$B我会去追深水领主，完事后在海崖尽头等我。
text.completion: Swift work. Very impressive. That Fathom-Lord got away... I don't see him anywhere. He's most certainly the key to finding our captured friends. I will hunt him down. He cannot stay hidden for long.
text.completed: Find Toshe Chaosrender at the south end of the Shimmering Grotto.

english.title: Rundown
english.objectives: Use Toshe's Hunting Spear to run down 20 fleeing Zin'jatar naga.
english.description: They're getting away!$B$BThese are the same naga that attacked the boats and carried away our friends. We cannot let them escape!$B$BTake these spears and run them down with that seahorse of yours... don't waste your time dismounting, just keep after them and kill all that you can with the spears.$B$BI will try to hunt down that Fathom-Lord. Meet me at the far end of the ledge when you're done.
english.completion: Swift work. Very impressive. That Fathom-Lord got away... I don't see him anywhere. He's most certainly the key to finding our captured friends. I will hunt him down. He cannot stay hidden for long.
english.completed: Find Toshe Chaosrender at the south end of the Shimmering Grotto.

text.title: 银潮谷
text.objectives: 去找银潮谷的费罗拉·火冠。
text.description: 大多数逃离了船上的屠杀的大地之环成员都藏身在山下不远处的一个洞穴里。就在巨型岩层的中间，那枚巨大的贝壳奈瑟匹拉的西边。我要你去确认他们都还好。说不准到底是不是也有纳迦袭击了他们。$B$B我要去追捕那个深水领主。找到他的藏身之处后，我会叫你的。
text.completion: A friendly face! Welcome! Very kind of you to come check on us. We're fine. A naga scouting force did find us, but I'm pretty sure none escaped. We should be safe for now.

english.title: Silver Tide Hollow
english.objectives: Seek out Felora Firewreath in Silver Tide Hollow.
english.description: Most of the other Earthen Ring that escaped the massacre on the boats have taken shelter in a cave a short swim down from the ridge. It's tucked midway up a huge rock formation, west of Nespirah, the gigantic shell on the horizon.  I need you to make sure they're okay. There's no telling how many naga might have attacked them as well.$B$BI'm going to hunt down that Fathom-Lord. I'll send word if I find the rock he's hiding under.
english.completion: A friendly face! Welcome! Very kind of you to come check on us. We're fine. A naga scouting force did find us, but I'm pretty sure none escaped. We should be safe for now.

text.title: 浴火尖兵
text.objectives: 击败8名火焰导师。
text.description: 我得说大潮席卷海加尔是件好事，新兵蛋子们因此就克尽职守……但老实不客气地说，你们都是累赘。$B$B要是每个被大灾变吓坏的农民加入我们，我就能拿一个铜子儿的话……这么说吧，我早就是富婆了。$B$B好在我们自有办法去芜存菁。去找下面的火焰导师证明一下自己。但愿你比其他人要强。
text.completion: I suppose your abilities are... suitable.  Color me impressed.
text.completed: Return to Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight Gauntlet in Hyjal.

english.title: Trial By Fire
english.objectives: Defeat 8 Fiery Instructors.
english.description: I'd love to say that with the tides turning against us in Hyjal, every recruit helps our cause and so on... but to be perfectly blunt, most of you are nothing but a burden.$B$BIf I had a copper for every peasant who got too scared when the cataclysm hit and now wishes to join our side... well, let's just say I'd be a rich woman.$B$BFortunately we have checks in place to separate the wheat from the chaff.  Go and prove yourself to the fiery instructors below.  Hopefully you'll do better than the others.
english.completion: I suppose your abilities are... suitable.  Color me impressed.
english.completed: Return to Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight Gauntlet in Hyjal.

text.title: 盛开
text.objectives: 获得5株烈焰花。
text.description: 派新兵去执行困难的乃至不可能的任务是这里的传统。我就被派去找过黑龙鳞，去年教官们出的题目是凤凰羽毛。$B$B你的课题要相对简单些。给我带几株烈焰花来。$B$B这附近的植株还算是盛足。噢，对了，更加刺激的是，那附近还有一只巨大的熔火恶犬。尽量避开它便是。
text.progress: Yes, $Ndamus?
text.completion: So you managed to pass this part of the test without getting yourself eaten by Smolderos or being incinerated by the fire elementals? I suppose I should congratulate you on ascending the lowest rung of our ladder. Well... congratulations, recruit!
text.completed: Return to Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight Gauntlet in Hyjal.

english.title: In Bloom
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Flame Blossoms.
english.description: It is customary for new recruits to be sent on a difficult or sometimes impossible task.  I was sent to obtain a black dragon's scale; last year's instructors demanded a feather from a phoenix.$B$BYour lot has it relatively easy.  Find me a handful of flame blossoms.$B$BThey grow around here in relative abundance.  Oh, right.  There will be a gigantic core hound roaming the fields to keep things interesting.  Do your best to avoid him.
english.progress: Yes, $Ndamus?
english.completion: So you managed to pass this part of the test without getting yourself eaten by Smolderos or being incinerated by the fire elementals? I suppose I should congratulate you on ascending the lowest rung of our ladder. Well... congratulations, recruit!
english.completed: Return to Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight Gauntlet in Hyjal.

text.title: Oil Change
text.objectives: Collect 6 Kajaro 0W Grade Oil.
text.description: The lubricant in these shredders is useless. What we need is some good ol' Kajaro 0W Grade Oil!$B$BYou know what has that kind of oil? KTC Oil Bots! You know where you can find them? At the KTC Oil Platform to the northwest!
text.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Oil Change
english.objectives: Collect 6 Kajaro 0W Grade Oil.
english.description: The lubricant in these shredders is useless. What we need is some good ol' Kajaro 0W Grade Oil!$B$BYou know what has that kind of oil? KTC Oil Bots! You know where you can find them? At the KTC Oil Platform to the northwest!
english.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 索恩克
text.objectives: 去找剃刀岭西北方哨塔上的索恩克。
text.description: $g Oh, sweetie, I just remembered!: Sorry if I've been mean to you.  Sometimes I get a little jealous when other women come into town, as I'm a little insecure about my appearance.;$b$bMy VERY good friend Thonk works in the guard tower on that cliff, just to the northwest of Razor Hill.  He said something about a river overflowing, lots of work to be done, and so on.  I wasn't really paying attention... I was staring into those deep brown eyes of his.$b$b$gWhat, we can't see other people?: Thanks.;
text.completion: Gail sent you?  Did... did she say anything about me?

english.title: Thonk
english.objectives: Report to Thonk on the guard tower northwest of Razor Hill.
english.description: $g Oh, sweetie, I just remembered!: Sorry if I've been mean to you.  Sometimes I get a little jealous when other women come into town, as I'm a little insecure about my appearance.;$b$bMy VERY good friend Thonk works in the guard tower on that cliff, just to the northwest of Razor Hill.  He said something about a river overflowing, lots of work to be done, and so on.  I wasn't really paying attention... I was staring into those deep brown eyes of his.$b$b$gWhat, we can't see other people?: Thanks.;
english.completion: Gail sent you?  Did... did she say anything about me?

text.title: 末日预言
text.objectives: Listen to a speech given by a Doomsayer in the Drag and obtain copies of the pamphlets "Elemental Fire for the Soul", "What Does 'The End of All Things' Mean for Me?", and "Finding Security and Comfort in a Doomed World".
text.description: Harbingers of doom are nothing new on the streets of Orgrimmar, but I'm worried about this latest batch. These people are organized and they've attracted a lot of attention in the Drag, where they seem to congregate.$B$BI've thought about rounding them up or otherwise disrupting their activities, but that will just drive them underground. We need to find out more about them. Would you go to the Drag, listen to what these doomsayers are spreading, and gather any literature you can find about their ideas?
text.progress: Well, did you find out anything?
text.completion: <Torek reads over the scrolls you collected.>$B$BWhoever these people are, they really mean to gain a following. It looks like they're having quite a bit of success. They can't be allowed to incite the citizens of Ogrimmar to panic and hysteria. We must discourage interest in this group and learn as much about it as we can.
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

english.title: Prophecies Of Doom
english.objectives: Listen to a speech given by a Doomsayer in the Drag and obtain copies of the pamphlets "Elemental Fire for the Soul", "What Does 'The End of All Things' Mean for Me?", and "Finding Security and Comfort in a Doomed World".

We need to find out more about them. Would you go to the Drag, listen to what these doomsayers are spreading, and gather any literature you can find about their ideas?
english.progress: Well, did you find out anything?

They can't be allowed to incite the citizens of Ogrimmar to panic and hysteria. We must discourage interest in this group and learn as much about it as we can.
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

text.title: 好侏儒寥寥
text.objectives: 使用激励仪，在侏儒区征募侏儒，并率领他们返回钢架补给站，去见崔德·火钻队长。
text.description: Our engineers have been working on getting our battle machines ready for our assault on Gnomeregan, but we're out of pilots!$B$BWe've developed a device called the Motivate-a-Tron, which prevents distraction from other sources and gives the gnome the courage to enlist.$B$BAfter motivating a few Gnome Citizens, lead them out to Captain Tread Sparknozzle out at Steelgrill's Depot, just south of Ironforge.$B$BOh, and be careful. The device is still a little experimental.$B$B
text.progress: Did you find some fresh recruits?
text.completion: This is the best group of potential pilots you could find?$B$BOkay, well, I'll see what I can do.  I've been known to turn even the biggest pile of gnarled gears into a smooth-runnin' fightin' machine and I expect no less with this lot.$B$BWell, I guess it's time to work!
text.completed: Talk to Captain Tread Sparknozzle outside of Steelgrill Depot.
text.objective2: Motivated Gnomes Brought to Captain Sparknozzle

english.title: A Few Good Gnomes
english.objectives: Recruit Gnome Citizens from Tinker Town using the Motivate-a-Tron and lead them to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill's Depot.
english.description: Our engineers have been working on getting our battle machines ready for our assault on Gnomeregan, but we're out of pilots!$B$BWe've developed a device called the Motivate-a-Tron, which prevents distraction from other sources and gives the gnome the courage to enlist.$B$BAfter motivating a few Gnome Citizens, lead them out to Captain Tread Sparknozzle out at Steelgrill's Depot, just south of Ironforge.$B$BOh, and be careful. The device is still a little experimental.$B$B
english.progress: Did you find some fresh recruits?
english.completion: This is the best group of potential pilots you could find?$B$BOkay, well, I'll see what I can do.  I've been known to turn even the biggest pile of gnarled gears into a smooth-runnin' fightin' machine and I expect no less with this lot.$B$BWell, I guess it's time to work!
english.completed: Talk to Captain Tread Sparknozzle outside of Steelgrill Depot.
english.objective2: Motivated Gnomes Brought to Captain Sparknozzle

text.title: 不只是病了
text.objectives: 杀死10头毒性雏龙。
text.description: We've found a brood of dragon whelps gathered off the road to the north, and they show the same illness as the stags.$B$BGreen dragons are not simple beasts of nature, but the very guardians of the wild. They are magical creatures, and to see them ill as well implies this is a dangerous threat.$B$BWe must stop this from spreading further through any means. Slay the infected whelps, $n, and return to me.
text.completion: These events disturb me greatly. My study of the antlers while you were gone has revealed little. We must find some way to fix this...
text.completed: Return to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

english.title: More Than Illness
english.objectives: Kill 10 Noxious Whelps.

text.title: Southseas Scum
text.objectives: Slay 6 Southsea Mercenaries.
text.description: Even now, Aggra and Kilag assault the docks to clear the way for Thrall to engage the Trade Prince. The plan is for you to assist in that attack, but first, we must ensure that Gallywix's Southsea mercenaries do not reinforce him.$B$BGo down into the Slave Pits and make certain that they don't!
text.completed: Return to Chawg at the Slave Pits on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 火刃兽人
text.objectives: 从尘风洞穴的火刃成员那里夺得6份火刃魔法卷轴。
text.description: 杜隆塔尔的火刃兽人越来越多，我奉命来这里调查此事。火刃氏族在东北方的洞穴中训练新招募的成员。我很想知道他们都教些什么。$B$B我把这件事告诉你，仅仅是因为你似乎想找活儿干。如果你对金币感兴趣的话，就杀进洞去，夺走他们的卷轴。$B$B洞穴的位置有些隐蔽，从东面的道路离开剃刀岭，然后沿着峡谷的东部边缘走就到了。
text.progress: The scrolls, $n, the scrolls!
text.completion: This is quite interesting.  These rites aren't all that different from the spells which are taught to Horde warlocks.  This merits further investigation!
text.completed: Return to Orgnil Soulscar at Razor Hill in Durotar.

english.title: The Burning Blade
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Burning Blade Spellscrolls from members of the Burning Blade in Dustwind Cave.
english.description: I've been sent to investigate the presence of more Burning Blade agents here in Durotar.  To the northeast, you'll find a cave where the organization trains their new recruits.  I'm interested in what exactly they are teaching these neophytes.$b$bI only tell you this because you seem to be looking for work.  If you're interested in a little coin, sack the cave and return with their spellscrolls.$b$bThe cave is somewhat hidden: exit Razor Hill from the east, and follow the canyon's eastern ridge.
english.progress: The scrolls, $n, the scrolls!
english.completion: This is quite interesting.  These rites aren't all that different from the spells which are taught to Horde warlocks.  This merits further investigation!
english.completed: Return to Orgnil Soulscar at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 补给线的尽头
text.objectives: 击败海加尔山狼神小径的4名暮光督工。
text.description: 古加尔的暮光督工发毒誓要把补给运过前线去，若不成功则严惩不贷。有我们在，他们当然成功不了。$B$B去阻止那些运送补给的督工。
text.completion: Well done! The chaos we sow back here will be felt up and down the chain of command.
text.completed: Return to Jadi Falaryn at Wolf's Run in Hyjal.

english.title: End of the Supply Line
english.objectives: Slay 4 Twilight Proveditors at Wolf's Run in Hyjal.
english.description: Cho'gall's Twilight Proveditors swear a blood oath that they will get their supplies through to the front, pledging a pound of their own considerable flesh for every pound of supplies they fail to deliver. They would rather die than fail.$B$BSee to it that they do both.
english.completion: Well done! The chaos we sow back here will be felt up and down the chain of command.
english.completed: Return to Jadi Falaryn at Wolf's Run in Hyjal.

text.title: 后勤保障
text.objectives: 收集36份从暮光奴隶身上掉下来的暮光补给品。
text.description: 暮光之锤的囚犯们被强迫从事各项杂役用以支援战事，他们就如牲口一般被使唤。我要那些补给，而且要是我们能从暮光之锤的邪恶控制下顺便解放几个灵魂那就再好不过了。$B$B到我们南边的路旁去把驱奴者杀掉，奴隶们就可以逃跑了。$B$B检查他们留下来的包裹，将补给品都带回来。
text.progress: Have you created some havoc down there, $n?
text.completion: Augh! Cursed - this metal is cursed - it bites! What demented workmanship is this? $n, I've never fought any foe like this before.
text.completed: Take the Twilight Supplies to Jadi Falaryn at Wolf's Run in Hyjal.

english.title: In the Rear With the Gear
english.objectives: Collect 36 Twilight Supplies left behind from freed Twilight Slaves.
english.description: Prisoners of the Twilight's Hammer are forced to lug around sundries for the war effort, like common pack animals. I want those supplies, and if we can free a few poor souls from the Hammer's shadowy grip, all the better.$B$BKill the slave drivers along the road to our south and nearby slaves should make a break for it.$B$BSearch the packs they leave behind for anything valuable, and destroy anything you can't carry.
english.progress: Have you created some havoc down there, $n?
english.completion: Augh! Cursed - this metal is cursed - it bites! What demented workmanship is this? $n, I've never fought any foe like this before.
english.completed: Take the Twilight Supplies to Jadi Falaryn at Wolf's Run in Hyjal.

text.title: 粗野的沃古尔
text.objectives: 杀死15名任意种类的裂拳食人魔。
text.description: 嘿，$C。介意给夜色镇的人们帮把手吗？$B$B山丘那头有个巨大的食人魔山。裂拳食人魔通常安分守己，不过他们有个坏习惯，就是喜欢袭击旅行者。那一天我看到其中一个拖走了一个可怜人的马，准备拿它当饭吃……那人没被吃掉真是算走运！$B$B守夜人只想用最少的人手来抵御更为紧迫的威胁，这些人手里就有我。但如果你能把那些食人魔杀掉几个，我倒是可以付你报酬。
text.completion: I saw you drop a few of them from here. Nice work. Here's your reward, on behalf of the Night Watch.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Dodds in Duskwood.

english.title: Vulgar Vul'Gol
english.objectives: Kill 15 Splinter Fist Ogres of any kind.
english.description: Hail, $c. Care to lend a hand for the people of Darkshire?$B$BThere's a huge ogre mound just down the hill there. The Splinter Fist ogres usually keep to themselves, but they've got a bad habit of attacking travelers. Just the other day I saw one drag off a poor man's horse for food... he was lucky it left him behind!$B$BThe Night Watch wants to only risk its few members in the defense of more immediate threats, me included. But if you kill some of those ogres for me, I'll pay you for your deed.
english.completion: I saw you drop a few of them from here. Nice work. Here's your reward, on behalf of the Night Watch.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Dodds in Duskwood.

text.title: 溺死的雷霆蜥蜴
text.objectives: 将一根魔纹拴绳绑在雷霆山的8条溺死的雷霆蜥蜴身上。
text.description: Our army needs water, and luckily the elements gave us plenty of that when the Cataclysm hit.  The water that filled up the canyon to the southwest should do the trick.$b$bUnfortunately, the corpses of thunder lizards still sit at the bottom of the canyon, and their electrical discharges are a bit too dangerous.  I've got grunts that can lift them out of the water, but we need someone agile enough to attach the other end of the rope.  Are you my $g man: woman;, $N?
text.completion: The electricity was only one of the dangers.  If those carcasses rot too long under the water, that entire source becomes undrinkable. Well done, $c.
text.completed: Return to Gor the Enforcer at The Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

english.objectives: Attach a Mageweave Tether to 8 Drowned Thunder Lizards in Thunder Ridge.

text.title: 石之泪
text.objectives: 收集7颗石之泪。
text.description: As you witnessed, the dragon Ysondre has told us that the tears of the land can seal the portal from which this corruption stems.$B$BWeeks ago, in the glade to the west, I saw the mountain giants distraught. They raged in frustration and wept, and their tears fell upon the stones as shining crystals.$B$BThough the giants weep no more, these stonetears must be what Ysondre referred to; a source of nature's purity. We must gather them.
text.progress: The tears are among the very rocks that the giants themselves rise from. There should be loose ones near the base of these large monoliths.
text.completion: Thank you once again, $n. I will prepare these for our final task.
text.completed: Return to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

text.title: 大地，堕落了
text.objectives: Kill 7 Corrupted Cliff Giants.
text.description: The cliff giants of Feralas are extensions of the earth itself, $n. When nature thrives, they are benevolent protectors and peaceful guardians.$B$BBut as the forest is tainted, so too are they.$B$BIf the corruption has spread to them, they will lash out at the wildlife and their own kind, causing great destruction. You must destroy any corrupted giants you come across.
text.completion: The spirits of these guardians will return in time, $n. You've freed them to move on in nature's cycle. Now it falls to us to make sure that cycle is free of corruption and needless suffering.
text.completed: Return to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

text.completion: You are a true champion of our cause, $n.  None can claim to be more dedicated to the struggle than you. It is rumored that the minions of the Scourge fear you more than they do the Lich King himself.  You are might incarnate. Accept this humble gift as a reward for your many triumphs.
text.completed: Return to Ormus the Penitent.

text.title: She Loves Me, She Loves Me NOT!
text.objectives: Rip the Fickle Heart from out of Candy Cane's chest.
text.description: Oh, sweetie! You're never going to guess who's down in the slave pits to the north.$B$B<Sassy shakes her head sadly at you.>$B$BCandy's down there, and she's working for the Trade Prince. She dropped you like a bad habit and now she's working for the other team. but it gets worse. Since you "dealt" with Chip, she's dating the Trade Prince!$B$BI don't know about you, but if she were my ex, I'd rip her fickle heart right out of her chest.
text.progress: What did you decide to do, hon?
text.completion: I'm sure she deserved it, $n. She should never have betrayed you like that. It gives me the shivers to think that she might have kissed that monster, the Trade Prince!
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Slave Pits on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Carve the Fickle Heart out of her chest!

text.title: What Kind of Name is Candy, Anyway?
text.objectives: Slay Candy Cane.
text.description: Can you believe that Candy Cane! You know up until you "dealt" with Chip, she was dating him. Now she's going out with the Trade Prince!$B$BI just can't get over the fact that she betrayed you like that with your ex. Maybe you should head down into the Slave Pits and take care of her once and for all?
text.completion: Serves her right for stealing your man in the first place.
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Slave Pits on the Lost Isles.
text.giverWindow: Time to take out the trash!

text.title: 封锁梦境
text.objectives: 用伊森德雷之泪封闭梦境之树的传送门。
text.description: It is ready. Take this, $n; a beacon of natural essence, blessed by the will of Ysondre.$B$BTo the east, on the other side of the flowing brook, is Dream Bough. There stands the Great Tree, the tallest in Feralas, a sapling of the World Tree itself. A portal to the heart of the Emerald Dream sits in its trunk, and it is this portal you must seal.$B$BThe portal will be guarded, but you must be brave. May the Earth Mother watch over you.
text.completion: The corruption has been stemmed! The forest can begin to heal now. May you have the blessing of the Earth Mother wherever you go, friend.
text.completed: Return to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

text.objectives: Get into the Ultimate Footbomb Uniform and then deal with Trade Prince Gallywix.
text.description: $N, this is it! Thrall's down at the Gallywix Docks fighting the Trade Prince right now!$B$BYou gotta jump into your Ultimate Footbomb Uniform and get over there!
text.completion: You did it! You did it! We're saved, $n!
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at the Slave Pits on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Rulers of Dire Maul
text.objectives: 杀死6个戈多克执行者和6个戈多克食人魔法师。
text.description: Now that we've put the hurt on them at the ruins, it's time to attack the ogres in their own territory.$B$BThe Gordok are the "upper class" of the Gordunni clan, chosen to defend Dire Maul. They'll know we mean business once we start taking out their strongest members.$B$BNothing fancy here, $n. Just get out there and crack some Gordok skulls.
text.completion: Excellent! Even these fools will soon know that to stand against the Horde means death.
text.completed: Return to Orhan Ogreblade in Stonemaul Hold.

text.title: 末日预言
text.objectives: 在旧城区听取一名末日预言者的演讲，并取得名为《灵魂之元素火焰》、《万物的终结对我有何意义？》和《在毁灭的世界中寻找安全与舒适》的小册子。
text.description: 暴风城的街道上出现了一帮家伙，他们满嘴都是灾难即将降临的蠢话。这在暴风城本不算什么新鲜事。但这帮家伙却让我相当担忧。他们在旧城区建立起据点，形成了高效率的组织。$B$B我考虑过将他们剿除，或者制止他们的活动。但贸然行动只会让他们转入地下。我们需要对他们有更多了解。你能不能到旧城区去，听听那些末日预言者都在传播些什么？你最好能找到一些与他们的理念相关的文字情报。
text.progress: What did you encounter in Old Town?
text.completion: <Anton reads over the scrolls you collected.>$B$BWhoever put these leaflets together knows how to get attention and from the state of things in Old Town, there's no lack of interest. We must act before they can build a significant following in the city. I fear they'll use their influence to spread panic throughout the city, paralyzing us.$B$BWe've got to get inside the organization and learn as much as possible.
text.completed: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

english.title: Prophecies Of Doom
english.objectives: Listen to a speech given by a Doomsayer in Old Town and obtain copies of the pamphlets "Elemental Fire for the Soul", "What Does 'The End of All Things' Mean for Me?", and "Finding Security and Comfort in a Doomed World".
english.description: Harbingers of doom are nothing new on the streets of Stormwind, but I'm worried about the most recent ones. They've set up shop all over Old Town and they seem well coordinated.$B$BI've thought about rounding them up or otherwise disrupting their activities, but that will just drive them underground. We need to find out as much as we can about them. Would you go to Old Town, hear what idea these doomsayers are spreading, and see if you can collect any of their leaflets?
english.progress: What did you encounter in Old Town?
english.completion: <Anton reads over the scrolls you collected.>$B$BWhoever put these leaflets together knows how to get attention and from the state of things in Old Town, there's no lack of interest. We must act before they can build a significant following in the city. I fear they'll use their influence to spread panic throughout the city, paralyzing us.$B$BWe've got to get inside the organization and learn as much as possible.
english.completed: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: Signs Of The Times
text.objectives: Setup 5 Warning Posters around the Valley of Strength, the Drag, or the Valley of Honor.
text.description: We've got to do something to reduce interest in this doomsday cult, but I'm hesitant to take much action until we know more about who is behind this group.$B$BI've had my men place markers around heavily traveled areas in Orgrimmar. Take these posters and set them up where you see the markers. They won't discourage the most determined of seekers, but it's a first step in exposing this cult. The Horde has enough to deal with as it is, without people wilfully spreading lies too.
text.completion: Well done, $N. Now we must focus our efforts on discovering more about this cult and freeing the people they've conned into joining.
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

english.title: Signs Of The Times
english.objectives: Setup 5 Warning Posters around the Valley of Strength, the Drag, or the Valley of Honor.
english.description: We've got to do something to reduce interest in this doomsday cult, but I'm hesitant to take much action until we know more about who is behind this group.$B$BI've had my men place markers around heavily traveled areas in Orgrimmar. Take these posters and set them up where you see the markers. They won't discourage the most determined of seekers, but it's a first step in exposing this cult. The Horde has enough to deal with as it is, without people wilfully spreading lies too.
english.completion: Well done, $N. Now we must focus our efforts on discovering more about this cult and freeing the people they've conned into joining.
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

text.title: 驱逐猎人
text.objectives: 消灭海加尔山狼神小径的6名暮光猎人。
text.description: 暮光之锤身份渐渐显露，它不仅仅是一个邪教。他们是一部战争机器——仿佛一群蝗虫入侵了圣山，一路肆虐，吞噬掉沿途的一切。$B$B暮光猎人在那些没有被化为焦土的森林里捕杀动物来供养凡胎肉身的邪教徒。$B$B我们必须阻止那些猎人在狼神小径的滥捕，不仅仅是为了保护动物，也是要断绝邪教的口粮。到这里的南边还有通往东边的路上去对付那些猎人。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. I worry that our actions here may be too little, too late, but nature always has a way of rebuilding itself that never ceases to amaze.
text.completed: Return to Oomla Whitehorn at Wolf's Run in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Harrying the Hunters
english.objectives: Kill 6 Twilight Hunters at Wolf's Run in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Twilight's Hammer has revealed itself as more than a mere cult. They're a war machine - a swarm of locusts moving up the mountain, devouring anything in their way.$B$BThe parts of the forest they're not setting ablaze are being scoured of life in order to feed the mortal cultists.$B$BWe've got to put a stop to the hunters canvassing Wolf's Run, not only to preserve what wildlife remains but to force the cult to march on empty stomachs. Look south of here, as well as up the road to the east.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. I worry that our actions here may be too little, too late, but nature always has a way of rebuilding itself that never ceases to amaze.
english.completed: Return to Oomla Whitehorn at Wolf's Run in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 外出求援
text.objectives: 去找杜隆塔尔死眼海岸的刺牙。
text.description: 你，$R，等一下。$B$B我的老板刺牙派我来寻找帮助和补给。你看起来不像是个商人，但你依然有可能帮到他。他就在这里的东南边，在坏掉的货车旁。哦，记得告诉他是我派你去的……得让他知道我没有在这里磨洋工。
text.completion: Vek'nag sent you?  Without telling you that I need wagon wheels, nails, and rations?  That idiot.

english.title: Sent for Help
english.objectives: Report to Spiketooth at Deadeye Shore in Durotar.
english.description: You, $r, stop a minute.$b$bMy boss Spiketooth sent me to look for help and supplies.  You don't appear to be a merchant, but you can probably still help him out.  He's just to the southeast of here, next to the crashed cart.  Oh, and tell him I sent you... I want to make sure that he knows I'm not just slacking off over here.
english.completion: Vek'nag sent you?  Without telling you that I need wagon wheels, nails, and rations?  That idiot.

text.title: 西瑟兰尼亚
text.objectives: 在战斗中击败西瑟兰尼亚。
text.description: 我养了一些角斗士，并带着他们环游卡利姆多，到处参赛。你可以看到，大部分都栓在这里……幸运的是在货车坏掉之后，我们还能控制住他们。$B$B西瑟兰尼亚，就是那边的纳迦……她的上三次战斗都输了。看来她需要调整一下，或者是教训一顿。去挑战她，我敢说，就算你也要比她强一些。
text.completion: I watched you fight out there.  How long you been a $c? You're alright, kid.
text.completed: Return to Spiketooth at Deadeye Shore in Durotar.

english.title: Ghislania
english.objectives: Defeat Ghislania in combat.
english.description: I own a couple gladiators that I put into competitions around Kalimdor.  You can see most of them chained up around here... we were lucky to rein these ones in after the cart broke down.$b$bGhislania, that naga over there... she's lost her last three fights.  She could use a tune-up, or maybe just a little bit of thrashing.  Go challenge her, I'll bet even YOU are stronger than she is.
english.completion: I watched you fight out there.  How long you been a $c? You're alright, kid.
english.completed: Return to Spiketooth at Deadeye Shore in Durotar.

text.title: 格里斯沃德·汉尼登
text.objectives: 在战斗中击败格里斯沃德·汉尼登。
text.description: 格里斯沃德，拴在悬崖上的那个，是我最新入手的角斗士。我们在这里的南边发现他的时候，他正在窥探北方城堡的士兵。我让我的人把他逮住，现在他为我效力了。$B$B他看起来很壮实，不过还没有经过实战检验。去跟他打一场，让我看看他是不是值得留下。
text.completion: I'm at a crossroads now, $n... you defeated him easily in combat, but then again, I did get him for free, and he's pretty cheap to feed.  Maybe we'll keep him around for a bit.
text.completed: Return to Spiketooth at Deadeye Shore in Durotar.

english.title: Griswold Hanniston
english.objectives: Defeat Griswold Hanniston in combat.
english.description: Griswold, chained up over there on the cliffs, is my newest gladiator.  We found him just south of here, sniffing around with Northwatch soldiers.  I had my men nab him up, and now he works for me.$b$bHe looks tough enough, but he hasn't really been battle-tested yet.  Go pick a fight with him so I can see if he's worth keeping around.
english.completion: I'm at a crossroads now, $n... you defeated him easily in combat, but then again, I did get him for free, and he's pretty cheap to feed.  Maybe we'll keep him around for a bit.
english.completed: Return to Spiketooth at Deadeye Shore in Durotar.

text.title: 高乌·冰角
text.objectives: 在战斗中击败高乌·冰角。
text.description: 通常来说，我不会把牦牛人当做奴隶，因为他们跟部落的关系太近了……不过这家伙是个叛徒，而且是个坏透了的罪犯。他被自己的部族放逐，就独自划船到了艾萨拉，在瓦罗莫克偷东西的时候被抓了现行。如果不是我出手相助的话，他早就被咔嚓了。$B$B高乌是我最得意的角斗士，$C。我跟你打10个银币的赌，你绝对赢不了他。
text.completion: Fine, here's the money... but you'd better make yourself scarce before I reconsider my policy on keeping Horde slaves.
text.completed: Return to Spiketooth at Deadeye Shore in Durotar.

english.title: Gaur Icehorn
english.objectives: Defeat Gaur Icehorn in combat.
english.description: I wouldn't normally keep a taunka as a captive, due to their close relationship with the Horde... but this one is a traitor, and a criminal to boot.  Exiled by his own tribe, he canoed down to Azshara and was found stealing supplies from Valormok.  He would have been put to the axe had I not been standing by, wallet in hand.$b$bGaur is my winningest gladiator, $c.  I'll bet you 10 silver that you can't beat him.
english.completion: Fine, here's the money... but you'd better make yourself scarce before I reconsider my policy on keeping Horde slaves.
english.completed: Return to Spiketooth at Deadeye Shore in Durotar.

text.title: 费滋尔之球
text.objectives: 从雷霆山的费滋尔·黑爪那里获得费滋尔之球。
text.description: 西南方的大洪水荡平了一处仍然残留在杜隆塔尔的火刃营地。这处营地的头目是个名叫费滋尔·黑爪的地精，相信我，我们最好不去理会他。$B$B不过，黑爪拥有一枚宝珠，部落希望能得到它。至于原因就不得而知了……估计是术士们的事吧。我只知道，我要那枚宝珠。
text.progress: Run into any trouble on the way?
text.completion: I ask for an orb, and you bring half of the goblin's arm with you?  I like the way you work. Tell you what... you've already given me a hand.  Allow me to return the favor.
text.completed: Return to Gor the Enforcer at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.
text.giverWindow: I imagine he'll look a little more waterlogged by the time you get to him.

english.title: Fizzled
english.objectives: Obtain Fizzle's Orb from Fizzle Darkclaw in Thunder Ridge.
english.description: The flood to the southwest wiped out one of the few Burning Blade camps that still pockmark Durotar.  This one was led by a goblin named Fizzle Darkclaw, and believe me, we're better off without him.$b$bDarkclaw, however, did possess an orb that the Horde is interested in procuring.  Who knows why... I leave that to the warlocks.  All I know is that I need that orb.
english.progress: Run into any trouble on the way?
english.completion: I ask for an orb, and you bring half of the goblin's arm with you?  I like the way you work. Tell you what... you've already given me a hand.  Allow me to return the favor.
english.completed: Return to Gor the Enforcer at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.
english.giverWindow: I imagine he'll look a little more waterlogged by the time you get to him.

text.title: Margoz
text.objectives: 和玛高兹谈一谈。
text.description: 我们有一位名叫玛高兹的强大的萨满祭司，对于火刃氏族的堕落颇有了解。他说在山里——就在奥格瑞玛外面！——有一座被称为骷髅石的山洞，一大批火刃祭司藏匿在那里。$B$B在你前往骷髅石之前，去和玛高兹谈谈吧。他十分睿智，会给你一些有价值的建议。$B$B玛高兹就住在东北方的海岸和枯水谷中间。$B$B你要听从玛高兹的建议，但是不管他怎么说，$N，我都要求你干掉那些火刃祭司！
text.completion: 欢迎，$N。我听说你要来这里，对你在杜洛塔的丰功伟绩更是耳熟能详。$B$B你是一个越来越强大而知名的$C。$B$B继续在正义之路上前进，你将前途无量。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Margoz at Durotar.

english.title: Margoz
english.objectives: Speak with Margoz.
english.description: One of our more useful shaman, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption.  He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains, just outside Orgrimmar, that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.$B$BBefore you go to Skull Rock, speak with Margoz.  He is wise and his council is valued.$B$BHe is camped to the southeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.$B$BFollow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, $N, I still want you to crush those cultists!
english.completion: Welcome, $n.  Word reached me of your coming, and of your exploits in Durotar. You are a $c of growing skill and renown. Stay on the pure path, and your future will be great indeed.
english.completed: Return to Margoz at Durotar.

text.title: 骷髅石
text.objectives: 在骷髅石中的火刃祭司身上收集6只灼热项圈。
text.description: $N。火刃氏族就躲在奥格瑞玛东部的骷髅石山洞里。他们在洞中进行邪恶的仪式，用灼热项圈去燃烧自己的身体。$B$B我相信他们戴上这些项圈之后便会获得恶魔的力量，不过如果要确定这一点，我还得收集一些项圈来做研究。$B$B到骷髅石去，从那些火刃祭司身上找些灼热项圈给我，让我来揭开他们的秘密。
text.progress: 你进入骷髅石洞了吗，$N?你拿到灼热项圈了吗?
text.completion: 很好。这些项圈中隐藏着火刃氏族背後的秘密，而我即将揭开这个秘密……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Margoz in Durotar.

english.title: Skull Rock
english.objectives: Gather 6 Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.
english.description: $N.  The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of Orgrimmar known as Skull Rock.  Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.$B$BBy wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power.  But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.$B$BGo to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there.  Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.
english.progress: Have you yet entered Skull Rock, $n?  Do you have the Searing Collars?
english.completion: Good.  Hiding within these collars is the secret behind the Burning Blade.  And I will uncover that secret...
english.completed: Return to Margoz in Durotar.

text.title: 尼尔鲁·火刃
text.objectives: 给奥格瑞玛的尼尔鲁·火刃带去一个项圈样本。
text.description: 你带回来的灼热项圈是充满恶魔力量的强大器物工具。它们的来源恐怕已经不是我这样的萨满祭司所能探究的了。我们必须找个专精于此的术士来研究它们。$B$B把这个项圈带给尼尔鲁·火刃。他是个技艺高超的术士，但他却擅长使用自己所掌握的恶魔力量来对抗恶魔，还声称他对恶魔的研究都是有益于部落的。不管这些话是真是假，如果我们要对付那些信仰恶魔的家伙，就需要他的帮助。$B$B你可以在奥格瑞玛的暗影裂口找到尼尔鲁。
text.progress: 向您致以我最谦卑的致意，$C。我能帮您什麽忙吗，我的$R$G兄弟:姐妹;?
text.completion: Ah, and where did you get this?  Good Margoz sent you to me, did he? Well, let me take a closer look...

english.title: Neeru Fireblade
english.objectives: Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
english.description: The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful demonic implements.  Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman.  We will need a warlock to study them.$B$BTake a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade.  Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign.  Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in Durotar.$B$BYou may find Neeru in Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow.
english.progress: My most humble greetings, $c.  How might I help my $r brother today?
english.completion: Ah, and where did you get this?  Good Margoz sent you to me, did he? Well, let me take a closer look...

text.title: Ak'Zeloth
text.objectives: 与北贫瘠之地前沿哨所的雅克塞罗斯交谈。
text.description: 自从我们在上一次大战中击败燃烧军团之后，我一直在寻找潜藏在兽人中的恶魔势力的源头。你带来的项圈证实了我的担忧。$B$B这项圈属于火刃氏族。$B$B你在这件事中的职责就要完成了，$N。到贫瘠之地西部边境的前沿哨所去找我的助手雅克塞罗斯吧，把这件事告诉他。
text.completion: This is not news to me.  While I appreciate your efforts, the Burning Blade will have to wait.  We have other matters to which we must attend.
text.completed: 与北贫瘠之地前沿哨所的雅克塞罗斯交谈。

english.title: Ak'Zeloth
english.objectives: Speak with Ak'Zeloth at Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens.
english.description: Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society.  The collar you brought me confirms my fears.$B$BIt belongs to the Burning Blade.$B$BYour role in this tale is nearly complete, $n.  Go to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth.  Pass on to him this information.
english.completion: This is not news to me.  While I appreciate your efforts, the Burning Blade will have to wait.  We have other matters to which we must attend.
english.completed: Speak with Ak'Zeloth at Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 胜利！
text.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Gallywix Docks on the Lost Isles.
text.description: We just can't thank you enough for all that you've done. Now we can all get off of this island before it kills us!$B$BThrall is going to want to speak with you first, $N. I'll rocket you over there.$B$BSee you on the ship!
text.completion: Lok'tar! Victory, $n!

english.title: Victory!
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Gallywix Docks on the Lost Isles.
english.description: We just can't thank you enough for all that you've done. Now we can all get off of this island before it kills us!$B$BThrall is going to want to speak with you first, $N. I'll rocket you over there.$B$BSee you on the ship!
english.completion: Lok'tar! Victory, $n!

text.title: 酋长的大使
text.objectives: Deliver the Sealed Package to the Kor'kron Loyalist on the docks at Bladefist Bay in Durotar.
text.description: The goblins and orcs have accomplished too much together to part ways now, $c. I intend for the Bilgewater Cartel to become part of the Horde.$B$BI have something that I want you to deliver to the new warchief. Give this package to my Kor'kron friend on the dock at Bladefist Bay in Durotar. He will help you to get into Orgrimmar safely.$B$BSpeak with Sassy Hardwrench on the ship when you are ready to set sail.$B$BUntil we meet again. Aka'Magosh, a blessing on you and yours, $N!
text.progress: What possible business could you have in Orgrimmar, $r?
text.completion: I know who sent you. Did he give you something to deliver to me?

english.title: Warchief's Emissary
english.objectives: Deliver the Sealed Package to the Kor'kron Loyalist on the docks at Bladefist Bay in Durotar.
english.description: The goblins and orcs have accomplished too much together to part ways now, $c. I intend for the Bilgewater Cartel to become part of the Horde.$B$BI have something that I want you to deliver to the new warchief. Give this package to my Kor'kron friend on the dock at Bladefist Bay in Durotar. He will help you to get into Orgrimmar safely.$B$BSpeak with Sassy Hardwrench on the ship when you are ready to set sail.$B$BUntil we meet again. Aka'Magosh, a blessing on you and yours, $N!
english.progress: What possible business could you have in Orgrimmar, $r?
english.completion: I know who sent you. Did he give you something to deliver to me?

text.title: 给沃金的消息
text.objectives: Deliver the SI:7 Emblem to Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
text.description: <The Kor'kron loyalist opens the package, palming one object while reading a letter from within. As he finishes the note from Thrall, the barest hint of a fanged smile appears on his face.>$B$BYou are to take this directly to Warchief Hellscream inside Orgrimmar. Make certain that Garrosh knows that it is from Thrall.$B$BTake my battleworg. Hurry, little goblin, there is no time to waste for this message!
text.progress: What is this, $r? Your kind are not allowed inside Grommash Hold. Leave before I have to teach you your place.
text.completion: Thrall had you deliver this? I understand the meaning of this all too well, $r. This smelly thing was caught unattended in the city and seems to recognize you. I have already put others of your kind to work in Azshara. Take it with you when you leave. From this day forward, you and your Bilgewater Cartel will serve the Horde!

english.title: Message for Garrosh
english.objectives: Deliver the SI:7 Emblem to Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
english.description: <The Kor'kron loyalist opens the package, palming one object while reading a letter from within. As he finishes the note from Thrall, the barest hint of a fanged smile appears on his face.>$B$BYou are to take this directly to Warchief Hellscream inside Orgrimmar. Make certain that Garrosh knows that it is from Thrall.$B$BTake my battleworg. Hurry, little goblin, there is no time to waste for this message!
english.progress: What is this, $r? Your kind are not allowed inside Grommash Hold. Leave before I have to teach you your place.
english.completion: Thrall had you deliver this? I understand the meaning of this all too well, $r. This smelly thing was caught unattended in the city and seems to recognize you. I have already put others of your kind to work in Azshara. Take it with you when you leave. From this day forward, you and your Bilgewater Cartel will serve the Horde!

text.title: 戈德林之声
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山戈德林圣殿的伊安·杜兰。
text.description: 戈德林圣殿矗立于西南，为的是纪念在上古战争中做出杰出贡献的远古狼灵。$B$B我们新的狼人盟友被狼神的记忆所吸引——天知道这是怎么回事，但重点是他们正在清理圣殿。$B$B我已经很久没有和我的联络人伊安·杜兰接上头了。你能飞过去把他找来吗？我有种不祥的预感，戈德林圣殿有麻烦了……
text.completion: You're here to rescue me, $c? Thank you! No, no, don't worry about the cage for now. My life isn't important. We've got to save the shrine, first.
text.completed: Locate Ian Duran near the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

english.title: The Voice of Goldrinn
english.objectives: Locate Ian Duran near the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
english.description: Southwest of here lies the shrine of Goldrinn, a memorial erected in honor of the ancient wolf spirit and his contribution during the War of the Ancients.$B$BOur new worgen allies have been drawn to the memory of the wolf god - go figure! - and were in the process of cleaning up the shrine.$B$BI haven't heard anything from my contact, Ian Duran, in days. Can you fly down there and find him? I've got a bad feeling that Goldrinn's shrine is in trouble...
english.completion: You're here to rescue me, $c? Thank you! No, no, don't worry about the cage for now. My life isn't important. We've got to save the shrine, first.
english.completed: Locate Ian Duran near the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: The Voice of Lo'Gosh
text.objectives: Locate Takrik Ragehowl near the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
text.description: Have you heard of Lo'Gosh, the wolf ancient? In the Alliance tongue, he is known as "Goldrinn."$B$BI don't need to tell you how important the wolf god has been to the Horde - his tenacity under adversity has been an inspiration to all of our disparate races.$B$BSouthwest of here, down in the valley, lies a shrine to Goldrinn. My friend Takrik Ragehowl was refurbishing the shrine when I stopped hearing from him. I fear the worst.$B$BPlease find Takrik and make sure the shrine is okay!
text.completion: Lok'tar, $c! Don't worry about this cage - these animals will come to fear me before long. My first priority is to clear this filth away from my beloved shrine.
text.completed: Locate Takrik Ragehowl near the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

english.objectives: Locate Takrik Ragehowl near the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
english.description: Have you heard of Lo'Gosh, the wolf ancient? In the Alliance tongue, he is known as "Goldrinn."$B$BI don't need to tell you how important the wolf god has been to the Horde - his tenacity under adversity has been an inspiration to all of our disparate races.$B$BSouthwest of here, down in the valley, lies a shrine to Goldrinn. My friend Takrik Ragehowl was refurbishing the shrine when I stopped hearing from him. I fear the worst.$B$BPlease find Takrik and make sure the shrine is okay!
english.completion: Lok'tar, $c! Don't worry about this cage - these animals will come to fear me before long. My first priority is to clear this filth away from my beloved shrine.
english.completed: Locate Takrik Ragehowl near the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: Howling Mad
text.objectives: 获取6污染的香火。
text.description: The shrine has been taken, $N. We need the tenacity of Lo'Gosh now more than ever.$B$BThese defilers - the lice-ridden wolf-men running rampant over the shrine - dishonor the memory of the wolf god. They arrived with the Twilight's Hammer, howling with their own twisted religion. They seek to corrupt noble Lo'Gosh to fit their own warped pantheon.$B$BKill them! Kill them and bring me the tools of their worship, a kind of polluted incense. I must understand what they want with the shrine...
text.progress: These animals were once men, but they've turned into mindless beasts under the influence of the Twilight's hammer. Do not hesitate to slay them all.
text.completion: Disgusting. This is like the incense we burn when we wish to commune with the spirits... but it's... befouled.
text.completed: Return to Takrik Ragehowl at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

english.objectives: Acquire 6 Polluted Incense.

text.title: 戈德林的凶暴
text.objectives: 获取6污染的香火。
text.description: 你在这里看到的畜牲们，他们不再是我们吉尔尼斯的弟兄。他们被某种疯狂所污染，并且侵占了圣殿。$B$B当暮光之锤来到海加尔的时候，他们也随之出现，亵渎地呼号着我们敬爱的戈德林之名。不要管我——你的当务之急是解决掉这些渣滓，阻止他们继续亵渎圣殿。$B$B在你消灭他们的时候，记得在他们身上找一种熏香，带些样本回来给我。
text.progress: Worgen like myself were drawn to the story of Goldrinn, his strength and wisdom. But these vandals - they worship a different aspect of the wolf god entirely.
text.completion: As I suspected. These reagents bear the marks of the Twilight's Hammer. And here, the name "Lycanthoth." I believe these are used in a summoning ritual...
text.completed: 返回海加尔山的戈德林圣殿，向伊安·杜兰复命。

english.title: Goldrinn's Ferocity
english.objectives: Acquire 6 Polluted Incense.
english.description: The beasts you see here, they're no longer my brothers from Gilneas. They've been corrupted by some kind of madness, and they've taken over the shrine.$B$BThey came when the Twilight's Hammer arrived in Hyjal, and they howl the name of some blasphemous mockery of our beloved Goldrinn. Forget about me - destroy these vandals before they continue to defile the shrine.$B$BAs you destroy them, look for the incense they carry and bring me some samples.
english.progress: Worgen like myself were drawn to the story of Goldrinn, his strength and wisdom. But these vandals - they worship a different aspect of the wolf god entirely.
english.completion: As I suspected. These reagents bear the marks of the Twilight's Hammer. And here, the name "Lycanthoth." I believe these are used in a summoning ritual...
english.completed: Return to Ian Duran at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 腐蚀者莱坎索斯
text.objectives: 在海加尔山莱坎索斯之喉使用莱坎索斯熏香，召唤并杀掉莱坎索斯。
text.description: The actions of these feral dogs are beginning to make sense. The Twilight's Hammer fears the power of the ancients. They do not want Lo'Gosh to return.$B$BSo they've summoned their own wolf god - a perversion of what once was. "Lycanthoth," the corruptor.$B$B$N, Lycanthoth is but a shadow of Lo'Gosh's power, but the beast must be destroyed so that the true ancient can return. Take this incense, and burn it in the maw of Lycanthoth east of here. Slay the monstrosity and free the spirit of Lo'Gosh!
text.progress: Your bravery is an inspiration to others, $c. Tell me your name.
text.completion: You were brave to face down Lycanthoth, $n. Like myself, he was a primal force of nature... but his origins were from a darker place. Those who birthed that beast reached deep into the blackness, channeling powers never intended for this world. Come, $c. Climb onto my back, and let us show these beasts the true face of ferocity!
text.completed: Speak with the Spirit of Lo'Gosh over the corpse of Lycanthoth at the Maw of Lycanthoth in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: Use the incense within the Maw of Lycanthoth to summon the beast.

english.title: Lycanthoth the Corruptor
english.objectives: Use Lycanthoth's Incense within the Maw of Lycanthoth in Hyjal to summon and kill Lycanthoth.

text.title: 腐蚀者莱坎索斯
text.objectives: 在海加尔山莱坎索斯之喉使用莱坎索斯熏香，召唤并杀掉莱坎索斯。
text.description: 我想我知道这是怎么回事了。暮光之锤担心远古半神有一天会出来对抗他们。他们会不惜一切来阻挠戈德林的回归。$B$B这个“莱坎索斯”是我们敬爱的狼神的扭曲体，暮光之锤把它召唤出来，是打算取而代之。$B$B呸！那不过是戈德林之力的阴暗面。$N，杀掉这头畜牲，好让真正的远古半神回归。带上这熏香，在东边莱坎索斯之喉那里焚烧。杀掉那个怪物，解放戈德林！
text.progress: Your bravery is an inspiration to others, $c. Tell me your name.
text.completion: You were brave to face down Lycanthoth, $n. Like myself, he was a primal force of nature... but his origins were from a darker place. Those who birthed that beast reached deep into the blackness, channeling powers never intended for this world. Come, $c. Climb onto my back, and let us show these beasts the true face of ferocity!
text.completed: Speak with the Spirit of Goldrinn over the corpse of Lycanthoth at the Maw of Lycanthoth in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: Use the incense within the Maw of Lycanthoth to summon the beast.

english.title: Lycanthoth the Corruptor
english.objectives: Use Lycanthoth's Incense within the Maw of Lycanthoth in Hyjal to summon and kill Lycanthoth.
english.description: I think I understand what's happening here. The Twilight's Hammer fears that the ancients may someday rise up to oppose them. They'll do anything to stop the return of Goldrinn.$B$BThis "Lycanthoth" is a twisted version of our beloved wolf god, summoned by the Twilight's Hammer to replace him.$B$BBah! It is but a shadow of Goldrinn's power. $N, kill this beast so that the true ancient can return. Take this incense and burn it in the Maw of Lycanthoth east of here. Slay that beast and free Goldrinn!
english.progress: Your bravery is an inspiration to others, $c. Tell me your name.
english.completion: You were brave to face down Lycanthoth, $n. Like myself, he was a primal force of nature... but his origins were from a darker place. Those who birthed that beast reached deep into the blackness, channeling powers never intended for this world. Come, $c. Climb onto my back, and let us show these beasts the true face of ferocity!
english.completed: Speak with the Spirit of Goldrinn over the corpse of Lycanthoth at the Maw of Lycanthoth in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Use the incense within the Maw of Lycanthoth to summon the beast.

text.title: 暮光签名
text.objectives: 诱使一名暮光新兵掉队，并拿到他的暮光招募文件。
text.description: 你终于来了，$N。时间刚刚好。$B$B拉格纳罗斯出现的消息让各路人马都想加入暮光之锤。$B$B假如你要混进邪教，现在就是机会了。我们需要招募文件——由暮光成员的推荐人亲笔签就。诱使一名新兵掉队，用这根闷棍给他脑后来一下。$B$B运气好的话，你可以把他的招募文件弄来。把它们带来给我，我们尽量伪造得不出纰漏。
text.progress: Did you get the papers?
text.completion: Excellent.  I'll do my best to alter these documents.
text.completed: Return to Elementalist Ortell at Darkwhisper Pass in Hyjal.

english.title: Signed in Blood
english.objectives: Lure a Twilight Recruit away from the group and take his Twilight Recruitment Papers.
english.description: You're here at last, $N.  Just in time as well.$B$BNews of Ragnaros' emergence has spurred a large wave of recruits to seek membership in the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BIf you're to infiltrate the cult, the time is now.  We will need recruitment papers -- signed in blood by a referring Twilight member.  Lure one of the new recruits away from the group and hit them with this blackjack.$B$BIf you're lucky, you'll be able to steal his recruitment papers.  Bring them back to me and we'll do our best to alter them.
english.progress: Did you get the papers?
english.completion: Excellent.  I'll do my best to alter these documents.
english.completed: Return to Elementalist Ortell at Darkwhisper Pass in Hyjal.

text.title: 向劳工队长报道
text.objectives: 向艾萨拉奥格瑞玛后门的劳工队长格拉比特报道。
text.description: Your people are busy with the terraforming of Azshara. We will remake the land in the image of the Horde so that all will know that Kalimdor is ours!$B$BGo north through the city. On the far side of the Valley of Honor you will find the Orgrimmar Rear Gate. Report to Labor Captain Grabbit outside the gates, goblin.$B$BFor the Horde!!!
text.completion: $n? The $n?! The rumors are already flying about you. I don't know if I should be thankful or frightened that you're here. At least we don't have any volcanoes in Azshara! Honestly, I can't believe you're showing your face here... Trade Prince Gallywix has setup shop atop the mountain!

english.title: Report to the Labor Captain
english.objectives: Report to Labor Captain Grabbit at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.
english.description: Your people are busy with the terraforming of Azshara. We will remake the land in the image of the Horde so that all will know that Kalimdor is ours!$B$BGo north through the city. On the far side of the Valley of Honor you will find the Orgrimmar Rear Gate. Report to Labor Captain Grabbit outside the gates, goblin.$B$BFor the Horde!!!
english.completion: $n? The $n?! The rumors are already flying about you. I don't know if I should be thankful or frightened that you're here. At least we don't have any volcanoes in Azshara! Honestly, I can't believe you're showing your face here... Trade Prince Gallywix has setup shop atop the mountain!

text.title: 你的新身份
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山训练场的无情的肯登纳谈一谈。
text.description: 给。这不是我最好的作品,但也差不到哪里去。你在邪教徒里的名字叫做“$N·丹玛斯”。$B$B这些文件可以让你混进编制内，直接同暮光导师对话。$B$B到实验场去把它们交给无情的肯登纳看，她自会对你有所区别对待。$B$B让她瞧瞧你的本事。
text.progress: You will address me with the respect I am due, recruit.
text.completion: Earthenfurydamus?  Let us hope your parents brought you into this world with more than just a ridiculous name.

english.title: Your New Identity
english.objectives: Speak to Condenna the Pitiless at the Training Grounds in Hyjal.
english.description: There.  Not my best work, but certainly not my worst.  You will be known as "$Ndamus" among the cultists.$B$BThese papers will bump you ahead of the other recruits and allow you to speak directly to the Twilight instructors.$B$BGo to the proving grounds and show these to Condenna the Pitiless.  She's separating the wheat from the chaff.$B$BShow her what you're made of.
english.progress: You will address me with the respect I am due, recruit.
english.completion: Earthenfurydamus?  Let us hope your parents brought you into this world with more than just a ridiculous name.

text.title: 打扫房间
text.objectives: 杀掉海加尔山伽格尔的营地的任意8名蛮兵或暗法师。
text.description: We are well on our way to returning the shrine to its former glory, $N. But there is some housecleaning to take care of. On the other side of this meadow, some ogre squatters are setting up camp, led by a thick-headed chunk of ugly by the name of Gar'gol.$B$BKill Gar'gol's minions and see if we can't send him packing.
text.completion: Hah! So you really sent some heads rolling, did you? It was said during the War of the Ancients that Lo'Gosh fought demons for ten days solid. Hopefully you weren't fighting that long...
text.completed: Return to Takrik Ragehowl at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

english.title: Cleaning House
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 8 Hovel Brutes or Hovel Shadowcasters within Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
english.description: We are well on our way to returning the shrine to its former glory, $N. But there is some housecleaning to take care of. On the other side of this meadow, some ogre squatters are setting up camp, led by a thick-headed chunk of ugly by the name of Gar'gol.$B$BKill Gar'gol's minions and see if we can't send him packing.

english.completed: Return to Takrik Ragehowl at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 打扫房间
text.objectives: 杀掉海加尔山伽格尔的营地的任意8名蛮兵或暗法师。
text.description: 得益于你的帮忙，我们很快就能让这座圣堂恢复往日的荣光，但首先我们要确保山谷的安全。南边有一组食人魔，由伽格尔率领，建立了一个臭气熏天的营地。$B$B在我看来，伽格尔还算不上是我们的“威胁”，他充其量只是挡在我们通往真正威胁路上的一个满身是肉的小毛刺儿而已。不管怎么说，他和他的手下是一定要处理的。$B$B以戈德林的名义，杀掉伽格尔的爪牙。
text.completion: You really cleared that place out, didn't you? Well done! The night elves once told me a story about how Goldrinn fought and killed a dreadlord, even as three others clung to his flanks, burning his flesh. I wonder if you or I will ever have the strength to do the same?
text.completed: 返回海加尔山的戈德林圣殿，向伊安·杜兰复命。

english.title: Cleaning House
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 8 Hovel Brutes or Hovel Shadowcasters within Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
english.description: Thanks to your efforts, we may soon be able to return this shrine to its former glory. But first we've got to secure this valley. South of here, a group of ogres led by Gar'gol has set up camp in a stinking hovel.$B$BI wouldn't characterize Gar'gol as a 'threat' so much as an enormous fleshy obstacle thrown into our path to distract us from the real danger. Nonetheless, he and his goons will have to be dealt with.$B$BKill Gar'gol's minions in Goldrinn's name!
english.completion: You really cleared that place out, didn't you? Well done! The night elves once told me a story about how Goldrinn fought and killed a dreadlord, even as three others clung to his flanks, burning his flesh. I wonder if you or I will ever have the strength to do the same?
english.completed: Return to Ian Duran at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 夺回神殿
text.objectives: 回到在海加尔的Goldrinn回收神殿的Takrik Ragehowl。
text.description: Yes, $N. I am Goldrinn, the one called "Lo'Gosh" in your tongue. Your persistence in the face of fear has unbound me from twilight's grasp.$B$BMy shrine has been purified, and my worshippers have returned to their rightful place at my right paw.$B$BReturn to Takrik and continue your work here in Hyjal. I will have need of you again soon.
text.completion: $n, it was incredible! For a fleeting moment I saw Lo'Gosh through the trees - a creature of both fury and light. My cage collapsed and the vandals melted like wax under the kiss of his claws, their screams and howls echoing through the valley... Was that your work?
text.completed: 回到在海加尔的Goldrinn回收神殿的Takrik Ragehowl。

english.title: The Shrine Reclaimed
english.objectives: Return to Takrik Ragehowl at the reclaimed Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
english.description: Yes, $N. I am Goldrinn, the one called "Lo'Gosh" in your tongue. Your persistence in the face of fear has unbound me from twilight's grasp.$B$BMy shrine has been purified, and my worshippers have returned to their rightful place at my right paw.$B$BReturn to Takrik and continue your work here in Hyjal. I will have need of you again soon.
