english.completed: Return to Takrik Ragehowl at the reclaimed Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 夺回神殿
text.objectives: 夺回海加尔山的戈德林圣殿，然后向伊安·杜兰复命。
text.description: 是的，$N，我就是戈德林。你的坚韧和勇敢让我摆脱了暮光之锤的控制。$B$B我的神殿已被净化，我的追随者也回到了他们应属的位置，接受着我的庇护。$B$B回去找伊安，继续你的海加尔山之旅吧。我很快就要再次借助你的帮助了。
text.completion: $n, it was astounding! Goldrinn himself appeared to free us, his white fur bright like the summer moon. Our cages collapsed and the vandals melted like wax under the kiss of his claws. He was beautiful, $n. Beautiful!
text.completed: 夺回海加尔山的戈德林圣殿，然后向伊安·杜兰复命。

english.title: The Shrine Reclaimed
english.objectives: Return to Ian Duran at the reclaimed Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
english.description: Yes $N, I am Goldrinn. Your persistence in the face of fear has unbound me from twilight's grasp.$B$BMy shrine has been purified, and my worshippers have returned to their rightful place at my right paw.$B$BReturn to Ian and continue your work here in Hyjal. I will have need of you again soon.
english.completion: $n, it was astounding! Goldrinn himself appeared to free us, his white fur bright like the summer moon. Our cages collapsed and the vandals melted like wax under the kiss of his claws. He was beautiful, $n. Beautiful!
english.completed: Return to Ian Duran at the reclaimed Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 回馈恩情
text.objectives: 使用附魔海螺壳营救6名溺水的士兵。
text.description: 现在你可以在水域里自由行动，也不用担心被淹死了。$B$B那么开始做正事吧。$B$B首先，很多士兵都面临溺亡的危险。我救了你，你也应该向他们伸出援手。$B$B我在这个海螺壳上施加了法术。用它来搭救你的朋友吧。$B$B快点！
text.completion: While you were away, I was able to revive some of the fallen soldiers.$b$bWe'll need every hand if we are to survive here.
text.completed: Speak with Erunak in The Briny Cutter.

english.title: Pay It Forward
english.objectives: Use the Enchanted Conch Shell to rescue 6 Drowning Soldiers.
english.description: You are now able to move about this realm more freely and without fear of drowning.$b$bThis is where our work begins.$b$bFirst, you have many allies nearby who are drowning as we speak. As I saved you, you must save them.$b$bI have enchanted the shell you brought me. Use it to rescue your friends.$b$bHurry now!
english.completion: While you were away, I was able to revive some of the fallen soldiers.$b$bWe'll need every hand if we are to survive here.
english.completed: Speak with Erunak in The Briny Cutter.

text.title: Signs Of The Times
text.objectives: Set up 5 Warning Posters in the Trade District, Cathedral Square, Old Town, or Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
text.description: We've got to do something to reduce interest in this doomsday cult, but I'm hesitant to take much action until we know more about who is behind this group.$B$BI've had my men place markers around heavily traveled areas of the city. Take these posters and set them up where you see the markers. They won't discourage the most determined of seekers, but it's a first step in exposing this cult. The king already has enough enemies without his own people turning against him.
text.completion: Well done, $N. Now we must focus our efforts on discovering more about this cult and freeing the people they've conned into joining.
text.completed: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 演讲练习
text.objectives: 分别在卡拉诺斯北边的奥齐·电环面前，钢架补给站的米利·羽哨面前和卡拉诺斯旅店外面的托格·锈链面前使用侏儒播放器。当所有演讲都播放完毕之后，回去见托比·速轮。
text.description: 梅卡托克国王要我写一份战前演讲稿，但我还无法确定哪些话的演讲效果好，哪些的演讲效果会很糟糕。$B$B你能不能在本地侏儒居民面前试一下这些演讲？这个装置能产生一个梅卡托克的影像，并说出几句我写的演讲稿。$B$B让我知道演讲稿的哪部分比较好，行不？
text.progress: Hey, did you have a chance to test out my speeches?
text.completion: Oh my.  Their reactions were that different?$B$BNot completely what I was expecting, but I think I have a speech that will do.$B$BJust let me find where I put it...
text.completed: Return to Toby Ziegear at Steelgrill Depot.

english.title: Prepping the Speech
english.objectives: Use the Gnomish Playback Device in front of Ozzie Togglevolt north of Kharanos, Milli Featherwhistle at Steelgrill Depot and Tog Rustsprocket outside the Kharanos Inn.  Return to Toby Ziegear when all the speeches have been given.
english.description: High Tinker Mekkatorque asked me to write a speech that he could give before the battle starts, but I can't tell which draft is good and which ones just stink.$B$BCould you try some of them out on some of the local gnome residents?  This device creates an image of Mekkatorque saying a few lines from each of my speech drafts.$B$BLet me know which one works, okay?
english.progress: Hey, did you have a chance to test out my speeches?
english.completion: Oh my.  Their reactions were that different?$B$BNot completely what I was expecting, but I think I have a speech that will do.$B$BJust let me find where I put it...
english.completed: Return to Toby Ziegear at Steelgrill Depot.

text.title: 传播恐惧
text.objectives: 杀死5名哨塔卫士。使用霍格姆身旁的绳索可以快速进出荣耀岗哨。
text.description: $C，我们的资源十分有限，但是我们仍然有能力解决周遭的麻烦。使用绳索滑下山岭，杀死哨塔卫士。$B$B虽然这点人员损失不会对战局产生影响，但是当人类发现那一堆尸体时，他们必然会陷入无尽的恐慌和混乱……$B$B<霍格姆发出爽朗的笑声，双目炯炯有神。>
text.progress: Tell me about the guards. Chaos? Fear? Panic? Hm?
text.completion: Good, good. It'll take them many sleepless nights to figure out where we came from and where we disappeared to after the kills...
text.completed: Return to Holgom at the High Road in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Feeding the Fear
english.objectives: Kill 5 Tower Wardens. Use the ropes beside Holgom to quickly move in and out of Honor's Stand.
english.description: Our resources are limited, $c, but that doesn't mean we can't make some trouble down below. Use the ropes here to sneak down the hillside, then slay the human prison wardens.$B$BKilling a couple scrawny guards won't turn the tide of battle, but  imagine the fear and chaos we'll reap as the humans discover the mutilated bodies...$B$B<Holgom grins a yellowed grin, his eyes glinting.>
english.progress: Tell me about the guards. Chaos? Fear? Panic? Hm?
english.completion: Good, good. It'll take them many sleepless nights to figure out where we came from and where we disappeared to after the kills...
english.completed: Return to Holgom at the High Road in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 有进有出
text.objectives: 测试弹射型步行坦克的弹射系统。
text.description: 我们的新型步行坦克已经做好了出击准备。想不想帮我们测试一下这些小混蛋？！你当然想！$B$B首先，我们需要确认你钻进坦克之后，还能钻出来。在战场上，如果你觉得自己的坦克要爆炸了，那就得赶快出来！我见到过许多侏儒被困在爆炸的坦克里……$B$B所以，我在坦克里安装了一个弹射椅。去试试它好用不？
text.completed: Let Captain Tread Sparknozzle know you ejected safely.

english.title: In and Out
english.objectives: Test out the ejection system in the Ejector Mechano-Tank.
english.description: We've gotta get these new mechano-tanks ready for the assault.  You ready to help test these bad boys out?!  Of course you are!$b$bFirst, we need to make sure that once you're in, you can get out.  In battle, if you think your tank is going to explode, get out!  I've seen many a gnome stay in 'til the bitter end... the tank blows up, and them along with it.$B$BWell, I've upgraded this tank with an ejection seat.  Try it out for me, will ya?
english.completed: Let Captain Tread Sparknozzle know you ejected safely.

text.title: 递送演讲稿
text.objectives: 将演讲稿交给钢架补给站的崔德·火钻队长。
text.description: 好哇，$N，演讲稿完成了！它能够为所有伟大的战争作序言……它鼓舞人心，雄辩无碍，能够为侏儒们清晰地指明方向。再也没有比这个更优秀的演讲稿了！$B$B把这份演讲稿交给崔德·火钻队长，然后再从他那里乘坐交通工具，把它交给大工匠梅卡托克！
text.completion: Toby is all done with the speech?  Let me see...$B$B<Reads the speech> Pumping pistons! What a fantastic speech! I knew Toby was a good writer, but this is perhaps the best he's ever written.$B$BI think it's time to get you out to the battle.
text.completed: Talk to Captain Tread Sparknozzleat Steelgrill Depot.

english.title: Words for Delivery
english.objectives: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.
english.description: Here we go.  This is the speech, $N!$B$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes.  Never has a finer speech been written!$B$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and get some transportation to High Tinker Mekkatorque!
english.completion: Toby is all done with the speech?  Let me see...$B$B<Reads the speech> Pumping pistons! What a fantastic speech! I knew Toby was a good writer, but this is perhaps the best he's ever written.$B$BI think it's time to get you out to the battle.
english.completed: Talk to Captain Tread Sparknozzleat Steelgrill Depot.

text.title: 递送演讲稿
text.objectives: 登上钢架补给站的“雷光号”，前往大工匠梅卡托克那里，将托比的发言稿交给他。
text.description: 好了，士兵。现在你证明自身能力的时间到了！$B$B拿上这份演讲稿，登上“雷光号”。这是大工匠梅卡托克最快的一艘飞船。而这份演讲稿正是梅卡托克在诺莫瑞根行动之前最迫切需要的东西。$B$B赶快出发吧！
text.progress: Were you here to deliver Toby Zeigear's speech?
text.completion: This is the final draft, then?  Let me have a look...
text.completed: Give Mekkatorque's Speech to High Tinker Mekkatorque.

english.title: Words for Delivery
english.objectives: Ride 'Thunderflash' from Steelgrill Depot to High Tinker Mekkatorque and deliver Toby's speech.
english.description: All right, soldier. Time to prove your worth!$B$BTake the speech and board the flying machine "Thunderflash".  It's the fastest ship to High Tinker Mekkatorque and this speech is the only thing he's waiting on before starting Operation: Gnomeregan.$B$BGo! Now!
english.progress: Were you here to deliver Toby Zeigear's speech?
english.completion: This is the final draft, then?  Let me have a look...
english.completed: Give Mekkatorque's Speech to High Tinker Mekkatorque.

text.title: Infiltrating The Cult
text.objectives: Go to Orgrimmar's Drag and speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the cult, then put on your Recruit's Robe.
text.description: The streets of Orgrimmar are wild with rumors about the cult's origins and practices. There's only one way to know the truth about this group, $N. You're going to join them.$B$BApproach one of the Doomsayers in the Drag and tell them you wish to join their group. With any luck, they will give you instructions to introduce yourself to one of the group's leaders and tell you where the group is hiding. Don any clothing given to you by the doomsayer; you'll need it to gain entry to the group's hideout.
text.completion: Welcome, friend. We are honored that you have decided to embrace the truth and join us. Come, there will be more time to talk later and you have much to learn.
text.completed: Report to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm outside Orgrimmar.

english.title: Infiltrating The Cult
english.objectives: Go to Orgrimmar's Drag and speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the cult, then put on your Recruit's Robe.
english.description: The streets of Orgrimmar are wild with rumors about the cult's origins and practices. There's only one way to know the truth about this group, $N. You're going to join them.$B$BApproach one of the Doomsayers in the Drag and tell them you wish to join their group. With any luck, they will give you instructions to introduce yourself to one of the group's leaders and tell you where the group is hiding. Don any clothing given to you by the doomsayer; you'll need it to gain entry to the group's hideout.
english.completion: Welcome, friend. We are honored that you have decided to embrace the truth and join us. Come, there will be more time to talk later and you have much to learn.
english.completed: Report to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm outside Orgrimmar.

text.title: 向前一步……
text.objectives: Test the the Scuttling Mechano-Tank's maneuverability.
text.description: 既然弹射系统性能可靠了，那么我们就可以进行下一步的测试了。这辆坦克有一个特殊功能：自动规避能力！$B$B我想要你检查一下它左腿和右腿的伺服系统，还有它的自动规避系统。$B$B这很容易，要不了多久。
text.completed: Inform Captain Tread Sparknozzle of your results.

english.title: One Step Forward...
english.objectives: Test the the Scuttling Mechano-Tank's maneuverability.
english.description: With the ejection system working, I think we're ready to test out movement.  This tank has an extra special feature: Automatic Evasive Maneuvers!$b$bI want you to check out the servos on the left leg, the right leg and the Automatic Evasive Maneuver system.$b$bThis is easy stuff, so it shouldn't take too long.
english.completed: Inform Captain Tread Sparknozzle of your results.

text.title: Infiltrating the Cult
text.objectives: Go to Stormwind's Old Town and either speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the doomsday cult, then equip the Doomsday Recruit's Robe you receive.
text.description: It's getting difficult to keep the cultists out of the public eye and rumors are spreading across the city. I want you to join the cult and learn as much as you can.$B$BApproach one of the doomsayers in Old Town and tell them you wish to join their group. The doomsayer will likely give you clothing and instructions to meet with other cultists in one of the group's hideouts. Follow those instructions, $N. It's the only way to gain their confidence.
text.completion: Welcome, friend. We are honored that you have decided to embrace the truth and join us. Come, there will be more time to talk later and you have much to learn.
text.completed: Report to Overseer Sylandra at the Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Infiltrating the Cult
english.objectives: Go to Stormwind's Old Town and either speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the doomsday cult, then equip the Doomsday Recruit's Robe you receive.
english.description: It's getting difficult to keep the cultists out of the public eye and rumors are spreading across the city. I want you to join the cult and learn as much as you can.$B$BApproach one of the doomsayers in Old Town and tell them you wish to join their group. The doomsayer will likely give you clothing and instructions to meet with other cultists in one of the group's hideouts. Follow those instructions, $N. It's the only way to gain their confidence.
english.completion: Welcome, friend. We are honored that you have decided to embrace the truth and join us. Come, there will be more time to talk later and you have much to learn.
english.completed: Report to Overseer Sylandra at the Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 暮光训练
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山的导师密尔瓦谈一谈。
text.description: 你在我们最基本的训练中的最容易上手的任务中表现得还不错。$B$B东边有我们的营地，去跟导师密尔瓦谈一谈。
text.completion: You think you're ready for the next step then, Earthenfurydamus? Let's see what you're capable of.

english.title: Twilight Training
english.objectives: Speak to Instructor Mylva in Hyjal.
english.description: You've proven you're worthy of at least participating in our most basic training.$B$BYou'll find one of our settlements east of here.  Speak to instructor Mylva there.
english.completion: You think you're ready for the next step then, Earthenfurydamus? Let's see what you're capable of.

text.title: 近亲
text.objectives: 将矮人弹丸交给尘泥沼泽蕨墙村的奥托·石塔。
text.description: <纳托把你拉到一边，低声耳语道。>$B$B$N，我已经把子弹从加恩的胸部拿出来了，但他血里的气泡告诉了我一切。他的肺被击穿了，伤口正在化脓。他是活不了多久了。$B$B把这个拿去。这就是要他命的那颗子弹。他的家人会希望知道，他们最年轻的战士变成了什么样。$B$B找到奥托·石塔。他就驻扎在尘泥沼泽。朝东北方走，沿着道路前往蕨墙村便是。
text.progress: Hello, $c. You look to be caked in dust instead of mud. I take it you've ventured here from the Barrens?
text.completion: Gann? Dead? I ... I should've known. His temper... his recklessness. I knew someday it would get the better of him. But it sounds as though you've already gifted him with vengeance. Thank you, $n! Turn your attention now to Dustwallow. If the Alliance finishes their cursed road through here, all your victories in the Barrens may have been for nothing.
text.completed: 将矮人弹丸交给尘泥沼泽蕨墙村的奥托·石塔。

english.title: Next of Kin
english.objectives: Take the Dwarven Slug to Alto Stonespire at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: <Nato pulls you aside and speaks in a whisper.>$B$B$N, I have removed the bullet from Gann's chest, but the bubbles in his blood tell me all I need to know. His lungs are punctured, and the wound grows septic. He is not long for this world.$B$BTake this. It's the bullet that killed him. His family will want to know what became of their youngest warrior.$B$BSeek out Alto Stonespire. He is posted in Dustwallow Marsh. Go northeast, and follow the roads to Brackenwall Village.
english.progress: Hello, $c. You look to be caked in dust instead of mud. I take it you've ventured here from the Barrens?
english.completion: Gann? Dead? I ... I should've known. His temper... his recklessness. I knew someday it would get the better of him. But it sounds as though you've already gifted him with vengeance. Thank you, $n! Turn your attention now to Dustwallow. If the Alliance finishes their cursed road through here, all your victories in the Barrens may have been for nothing.
english.completed: Take the Dwarven Slug to Alto Stonespire at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: The Missing
text.objectives: While wearing your Cult Disguise, speak to Cultist Kagarn, Cultist Agtar, Cultist Tokka, and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.
text.description: Aside from the disturbances and the paranoia spread by the cult, we've been inundated with reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling that they can be found in one of the cult's compounds outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at the Jaggedswine Farm south of Orgrimmar? To blend in, you'll need to get a robe from one of the doomsayers in the Drag.
text.completion: So you found them? Why did the missing men and women not return with you? We cannot compel them to change their minds and return to their families. I will let the families know that the relatives have been found and that they are safe. After this cult is broken up, they will likely return to their normal lives.
text.completed: Report back to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Missing
english.objectives: While wearing your Cult Disguise, speak to Cultist Kagarn, Cultist Agtar, Cultist Tokka, and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.
english.description: Aside from the disturbances and the paranoia spread by the cult, we've been inundated with reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling that they can be found in one of the cult's compounds outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at the Jaggedswine Farm south of Orgrimmar? To blend in, you'll need to get a robe from one of the doomsayers in the Drag.
english.completion: So you found them? Why did the missing men and women not return with you? We cannot compel them to change their minds and return to their families. I will let the families know that the relatives have been found and that they are safe. After this cult is broken up, they will likely return to their normal lives.
english.completed: Report back to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 遛狗
text.objectives: 收集5块烧烤蜥蜴肉给斯莫多斯的幼犬吃。
text.description: 嗯……这年头他们可真不挑人了。$B$B很好。你毫无疑问在实验场和斯莫多斯打得火热。$B$B好吧，我就让你照看他的小犬。让这小家伙安静点——要是他能长得和他父亲一样，就能为我们平添战力。$B$B从石化蜥蜴的身上弄点肉来给他吃。
text.completion: Excellent.  This little pup will grow to be strong and merciless like his father.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Devoran at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

english.title: Walking the Dog
english.objectives: Collect and feed 5 pieces of Charred Basilisk Meat to the Spawn of Smolderos.
english.description: Hmmmphh.... it seems they'll let anyone in these days.$B$BVery well.  You doubtlessly became acquainted with Smolderos in the proving grounds.$B$BWell, I've been entrusted with the care of one of his pups.  Quite the little terror -- if he grows up to be anything like his father he shall serve our cause well.$B$BCollect meat from the basilisks around the area and feed them to him.
english.completion: Excellent.  This little pup will grow to be strong and merciless like his father.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Devoran at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

text.title: 猛烈的炮火
text.objectives: 利用附近的目标来测试射击型步行坦克的武器系统。
text.description: 安全系统连通！马达启动！现在我们只需要确认它的火炮能正常射击。$B$B这应该不太难，$N。我们背后山丘上的步行坦克已经填装好教练弹。你只需要向附近的目标发射几轮炮火，然后就可以向我报告了。
text.completed: Inform Captain Tread Sparknozzle of your results.

english.title: Press Fire
english.objectives: Test out the Shooting Mechano-Tank weapon systems on the nearby targets.
english.description: Safety systems, online!  Motor functions, functioning!  Now all we need is to make sure that the guns will fire.$b$bThis shouldn't be too hard, $n.  The mechano-tank on the hill behind us has been loaded with harmless pellets. Just fire off a couple rounds at the nearby targets and report back to me.
english.completed: Inform Captain Tread Sparknozzle of your results.

text.title: 收集情报
text.objectives: 获得暮光公报和海加尔作战计划。
text.description: 是我，$N，奥泰尔！$B$B别朝厕所瞧过来，你会暴露我的位置的。$B$B一切都按计划进行吗？很好！$B$B我要你在这儿收集一些情报。我们是不大可能拿到地图啊密信什么的，但假如能预测敌人的下一步行动，也能救个百来条我们的人命。
text.progress: Did you get the documents, $N?
text.completion: Excellent job, $n.  Or should I say: "$n"damus? Give me a minute to read these.

english.title: Gather the Intelligence
english.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Communique and the Hyjal Battleplans.
english.description: It's me, $N, Ortell!$B$BDon't look directly at the outhouse... you'll give away my position.$B$BEverything's going according to plan then?  Excellent!$B$BI'm going to need you to obtain some intelligence while you're here.  It might not seem like much to get our hands on a map or a letter, but it may mean saving a hundred lives on our side if we can anticipate our enemy's next move.
english.progress: Did you get the documents, $N?
english.completion: Excellent job, $n.  Or should I say: "$n"damus? Give me a minute to read these.

text.title: 疯从口出
text.objectives: 收集石花、苦寒之花和一撮暗焰余烬。
text.description: 我知道一个方子，能让这些语无伦次的前奴隶为之一振。从伽格尔的营地边的石头上收集一些石花，附近的湖边收集一些苦寒之花，然后营地门口的火盆里揪一撮暗焰余烬。方剂效力不长，所以你得在营地入口的暮光之锅里投下原料。$B$B抿上这么一口，那些洗了脑的奴隶就会精神振奋起来的！
text.completed: Mix the ingredients together at a Twilight Cauldron at the entrance to Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

english.title: From the Mouth of Madness
english.objectives: Gather up Stonebloom, Bitterblossom, and a Darkflame Ember.
english.description: I know of a draught that should jolt these gibbering former slaves back to reality. Gather some stonebloom from the rocks around Gar'gol's hovel, some bitterblossom from the shores of the nearby lake, and a darkflame ember from one of the braziers at the hovel entrance. The draught won't last long, so combine the ingredients at a twilight cauldron by the entrance to the hovel.$B$BOne sip of that draught should knock some sense into the brainwashed slaves!
english.completed: Mix the ingredients together at a Twilight Cauldron at the entrance to Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

text.title: 心自在，体自来
text.objectives: 同8名暮光奴仆交谈，送药后把他们救出来。
text.description: <瑞欧说药剂的效力不会太长。>$B$B<你最好赶紧到营地去，将药剂送给尽可能多的暮光奴仆。>
text.progress: Did the draught work?
text.completion: Excellent! Let's hope the damage wasn't permanent. Judging by the poor victims still in camp here, the Twilight's Hammer really messed with their heads.
text.completed: Return to Rio Duran at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

english.title: Free Your Mind, the Rest Follows
english.objectives: Speak with 8 Twilight Servitors to administer the draught and rescue them.
english.description: <Rio said that the draught would not remain effective for long.>$B$B<You'd better hurry into the hovel and administer it to as many Twilight Servitors as you can find.>
english.progress: Did the draught work?
english.completion: Excellent! Let's hope the damage wasn't permanent. Judging by the poor victims still in camp here, the Twilight's Hammer really messed with their heads.
english.completed: Return to Rio Duran at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 心灵训练：向权力说真话
text.objectives: 使用升腾宝珠如实回答10个问题。
text.description: 你可能以为自己准备好接受我们要传授的知识了，其实你没有。$B$B把你的心灵想象成盒中盒。$B$B我们的每一步训练都会打开其中一个，直到你达到同元素直接沟通的境界。$B$B拿上升腾之核，回答所有它提出的问题，要老实说。瞎编排的后果……是要命的。
text.completion: You've succeeded, Earthenfurydamus.  You're ready for the next step.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

english.title: Mental Training: Speaking the Truth to Power
english.objectives: Use the Orb of Ascension and answer 10 answers correctly.
english.description: You might think you're ready to receive the knowledge we're to impart on you.  But you are not.$B$BThink of your mind as a box inside a series of other boxes.$B$BEach step of our training will open one of those boxes, until you are ready to achieve direct communion with the elements.$B$BTake the Core of Ascension and answer all questions it asks of you, truthfully.  Failing to do so could be... fatal.
english.completion: You've succeeded, Earthenfurydamus.  You're ready for the next step.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

text.title: 暮光之眼
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山伽格尔的营地的暮光之眼。
text.description: 湖对岸的食人魔氏族的首领叫做伽格尔。我用词不当，伽格尔的智商也就和生牛肉差不多。$B$B就我所知，伽格尔听命于一件魔法装置：“暮光之眼”，而且对它惟命是从。$B$B要是我们能够破坏掉魔法之眼，那就能造成想象不到的伤害了。$B$B到伽格尔营地的入口去找到暮光之眼。研究它。想办法破坏它。啊，混乱是多么地美妙……
text.completed: 去找海加尔山伽格尔的营地的暮光之眼。

english.title: The Eye of Twilight
english.objectives: Seek out the Eye of Twilight near the entrance to Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
english.description: The ogre clan across the lake is led by Gar'gol. I use the term loosely; Gar'gol has the intelligence of raw beef.$B$BSo far as I can tell, Gar'gol is taking orders from a magical instrument: "The Eye of Twilight." He follows its commands unquestioningly.$B$BIf we can sabotage the eye, we can cause unimaginable havoc.$B$BGo to Gar'gol's hovel and seek out the Eye of Twilight near the entrance. Study it. Find a way to subvert it. Ah, marvelous chaos...
english.completed: Seek out the Eye of Twilight near the entrance to Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

text.title: 主宰玩偶
text.objectives: 在海加尔山伽格尔营地里找到暮光伪经。
text.description: <在你同眼睛的短暂交流中，你感到它的力量来自于营地深处。你感觉到一本强大的典籍，绑缚着四大元素。>$B$B<想要主宰魔眼，就要先得到营地里的典籍。>
text.completed: Locate the Twilight Apocrypha inside of Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

english.title: Mastering Puppets
english.objectives: Locate the Twilight Apocrypha inside of Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
english.description: <During your brief communion with the Eye, you felt that its power source lay deep within the hovel. You felt the weight of a powerful tome, binding together four elements.>$B$B<Mastering the Eye will require you to search the hovel for this tome.>
english.completed: Locate the Twilight Apocrypha inside of Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

text.title: Remnants of Battle
text.objectives: Bring the Broken Shard to XXX at XXX.
text.description: A great battle took place here. Mixed with the naga skeletons are that of some sort of large humanoids. This might be interesting news to XXX.

english.title: Remnants of Battle
english.objectives: Bring the Broken Shard to XXX at XXX.
english.description: A great battle took place here. Mixed with the naga skeletons are that of some sort of large humanoids. This might be interesting news to XXX.

text.title: 元素太初！
text.objectives: 按正确的顺序启动附近的四座锻炉，控制暮光之眼。
text.description: <你无法读懂文字，但图画表明你应该以某种顺序激活一系列装置。>$B$B<暮光伪经的其中一节被翻译成了现代文：>$B$B起初，渊远黑暗。$B仇恨爆发，就有了火。$B伤结了痂，便是土。$B痛苦的哭号诞生了风。$B天上所渗下的，乃是泪的海洋。$B我们生于阴暗，$B所知的天地皑皑，$B是为愤怒、伤害、痛苦和悲哀。
text.progress: <You pour over the Apocrypha, trying to make sense of it all.>
text.completed: Consult the Twilight Apocrypha within Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

english.title: Elementary!
english.objectives: Activate the four nearby elemental crucibles in the correct order to take control of the Eye of Twilight.
english.description: <You can't read the text, but diagrams seem to indicate that the devices around you should be activated in a set order.>$B$B<One passage of the Apocrypha has been translated to modern text:>$B$B   In the beginning was shadow eternal.$B   Hate blazed forth, and FIRE was born.$B   Wounds scabbed, and so begat EARTH.$B   Cries of anguish birthed howling WIND.$B   Wherein the skies wept seas of TEARS.$B      We live in the shadow,$B      The world we know$B   Built of rage, hurt, anguish and sorrow.
english.progress: <You pour over the Apocrypha, trying to make sense of it all.>
english.completed: Consult the Twilight Apocrypha within Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

text.title: 萨尔多之战
text.objectives: 跟萨尔多岛的塔姆布莉谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在萨尔多岛的殖民地被憎世纳迦夺走了。在寡不敌众的情况下，我们只好撤回大陆。就在他们垂涎自己刚刚获得的沙洲时，我们已经在海岸上建立了新羽月要塞，召集了一支规模更大的军队。$B$B现在，憎世纳迦将被赶回海里去。在岸边找到我们的战争古树。他会带你到前线去，塔姆布莉是这次进攻的指挥。
text.completion: These foul things will be driven back into the sea. I hope you're ready.

english.title: The Battle of Sardor
english.objectives: Speak with Tambre on Sardor Isle.
english.description: Our settlement on Sardor Isle was lost to the Hatecrest naga. Overwhelmed by their numbers, we fell back to the mainland. While they coveted their newly-gained sandbar, we raised New Feathermoon on the shore and amassed an even greater army.$B$BNow, the Hatecrest will be driven back into the sea. Find our Ancient of War along the shore. He will take you to the front lines, where Tambre leads the offensive.
english.completion: These foul things will be driven back into the sea. I hope you're ready.

text.title: 别回头
text.objectives: 杀死10条憎世纳迦以及他们的首领。
text.description: 我们在萨尔多岛的殖民地被憎世纳迦夺走了。在寡不敌众的情况下，我们只好撤回大陆。就在他们垂涎自己刚刚获得的沙洲时，我们已经在海岸上建立了新羽月要塞，召集了一支规模更大的军队。$B$B现在，憎世纳迦将被赶回海里去。跟哨兵兰娜黛谈谈，加入我们在萨尔多的大军。杀掉纳迦，不管是哪条肮脏的蛇在给他们发号施令，也一并给宰掉。
text.completed: Return to Shandris Feathermoon at New Feathermoon.

english.title: Never Look Back
english.objectives: Kill 10 Hatecrest Naga and slay their leader.
english.description: Our settlement on Sardor Isle was lost to the Hatecrest naga. Overwhelmed by their numbers, we fell back to the mainland. While they coveted their newly-gained sandbar, we raised New Feathermoon on the shore and amassed an even greater army.$B$BNow, the Hatecrest will be driven back into the sea. Speak with Sentinel Ranadae to join our forces at Sardor. Slay the naga, and make sure whichever foul snake they take orders from is killed as well.
english.completed: Return to Shandris Feathermoon at New Feathermoon.

text.title: 你参军了！
text.objectives: [ph] Log Description
text.description: [ph] War!

english.title: You're In The Army Gnow!
english.objectives: [ph] Log Description
english.description: [ph] War!

text.title: 纷争的种子
text.objectives: 引开卡尔贡，消灭海加尔山天选者之座的高阶异教徒阿泽尼乌斯。
text.description: 根据你获得的情报，教派里食人魔和非食人魔之间摩擦不断。$B$B高阶异教徒阿泽尼乌斯和食人魔法师卡尔贡正在天选者之座会面，尝试解决纠纷。$B$B天选者之座那里也有个和这个一样的厕所。进去把食人魔的伪装换上，想办法在阿泽尼乌斯履行和平使命的时候击败他。$B$B我们必须好好利用这个矛盾！
text.completion: Excellent job, $n!  You've outdone yourself this time.
text.completed: Return to the Outhouse Hideout at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: Azennios is the one we want! Kill him!

english.title: Seeds of Discord
english.objectives: Distract Karr'gonn and slay Dark Cultist Azennios at the Seat of the Chosen in Hyjal.
english.description: According to the intelligence you acquired, there is major friction between the ogres and non-ogres in the cult.$B$BHigh Cultist Azennios and the ogre mage Karr'gonn are meeting at the Seat of the Chosen in an attempt to ease the conflict.$B$BThere is an outhouse like this one at the Seat of the Chosen.  Go there and put on this ogre disguise.  Find a way to kill Azennios while he's in this mission of peace.$B$BWe must exploit this division as much as we can!
english.completion: Excellent job, $n!  You've outdone yourself this time.
english.completed: Return to the Outhouse Hideout at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Azennios is the one we want! Kill him!

text.title: 灵魂训练：弱者才手软
text.objectives: 教训末日祷告祭坛的5名失败的哀求者。
text.description: 你挺到了现在，而其他人都没有。$B$B到末日祷告祭坛去，就在北边。我们把……失败的都集合在那里。我要你去照看照看他们，这对你的灵魂成长有好处。$B$B要是这种冷血的作风让你感到不适，就把它当作他们的第二次机会好了。要是有人能教训你你……嗯，他们就能取你而代之。
text.completion: You're on the fast-track to success.  Let us hope you don't ruin your track record with such silly notions as compassion and humaneness. Come, then.  Let us discuss your future.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

english.title: Spiritual Training: Mercy is for the Weak
english.objectives: Slay 5 Failed Supplicants at Doom's Vigil.
english.description: You've made it this far.  Others haven't.$B$BGo to Doom's  Vigil, just north of here.  We've rounded up all the... failures.  I want you to help take care of them.  It'll be good for your spiritual growth.$B$BIf this cold-blooded act gives you trouble, think of it as their second chance.  Should any of them manage to kill you... well, they'll take your spot.
english.completion: You're on the fast-track to success.  Let us hope you don't ruin your track record with such silly notions as compassion and humaneness. Come, then.  Let us discuss your future.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

text.title: 两邪相权取其重
text.objectives: 在海加尔山索萨恩之门使用烈焰统御护符并消灭军团之拳加诺斯。
text.description: 我们用武力从燃烧军团的恶魔手中夺回了暗语峡谷。我们目前领土都还防守得不错，只有一处例外。$B$B最近索萨恩之门被一名深渊领主领军攻陷。我们不能允许这样的状况持续下去。$B$B你接近他的时候就使用这个护符，你将会暂时获得一名火焰升腾者的力量。善加利用吧。
text.completion: Excellent work, Earthenfurydamus.  We must show all would-be competitors that we are not ones to give up easily.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: The Burning Legion has no place here. This is Twilight land now.

english.title: The Greater of Two Evils
english.objectives: Use the Talisman of Flame Ascendancy and slay Garnoth, Fist of the Legion, at the Gates of Sothann in Hyjal.
english.description: We took Darkwhisper Gorge from the demons of the Burning Legion by force.  We've held on to our territory pretty well so far, with one exception.$B$BWe recently lost the Gates of Sothann to a pit lord and his army.  We cannot allow this to stand.$B$BUse this talisman when you're near him.  You'll gain the powers of a flame ascendant temporarily.  Make it count.
english.completion: Excellent work, Earthenfurydamus.  We must show all would-be competitors that we are not ones to give up easily.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: The Burning Legion has no place here. This is Twilight land now.

text.title: 暮光领地
text.objectives: 消灭海加尔山索萨恩之门的10名恐惧守卫。
text.description: 燃烧军团的恶魔以为他们可以为所欲为，随随便便就能攫取领土。是的——这地盘原本的确是他们的，但那又是另话了。$B$B我们得让他们晓得别和暮光之锤较劲。$B$B到索萨恩之门去把那里成群结队的恐惧守卫统统干掉。
text.completion: Sharp as always.  You do not disappoint me.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

english.title: Twilight Territory
english.objectives: Slay 10 Horrorguards at the Gates of Sothann in Hyjal.
english.description: The demons of the Burning Legion think they can just walk up here and take whatever territory they want.  Sure -- the territory was previously theirs, but that's beside the point.$B$BWe'll teach them not to cross the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BHead to the Gates of Sothann and wipe out the contingent of Horrorguards that roam the area.
english.completion: Sharp as always.  You do not disappoint me.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.

text.title: 去找暮语
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山戈德林圣殿的罗伊斯·暮语。
text.description: <你将思维集中在魔眼上，操纵它对食人魔下达不同的命令。这时候，你感觉魔眼中又有另一个存在，窥探着你，寻找着弱点。某个充满着愤怒的遥远存在。你给自己树立了新的敌人！>$B$B<这里的工作已经结束。去找戈德林圣殿的罗伊斯·暮语，告诉他你完成任务了。>
text.completion: Hello, yes? What? You? Oh, you're one of the ones I sent after the Eye of Twilight, aren't you? Good work, very good. I suppose that's a valuable lesson: Never to take orders from a big purple ball.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山戈德林圣殿的罗伊斯·暮语。

english.title: Return to Duskwhisper
english.objectives: Return to Royce Duskwhisper at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
english.description: <You force your own image into the Eye, manipulating it to give the ogres different orders. As you do so, you feel another presence within the Eye, probing you, seeking out a weakness. A distant being fumes with rage. You've made some enemies today!>$B$B<Your work here is done, and the ogres will be friendly to you. Return to Royce Duskwhisper at the Shrine of Goldrinn and let him know what you've accomplished.>
english.completion: Hello, yes? What? You? Oh, you're one of the ones I sent after the Eye of Twilight, aren't you? Good work, very good. I suppose that's a valuable lesson: Never to take orders from a big purple ball.
english.completed: Return to Royce Duskwhisper at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: The Defector
text.objectives: Bring the Incriminating Envelope to Elementalist Ortell at the Outhouse at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
text.description: Stay your hand!  Please, I beg you!$B$BI'm only here because of a girl.  Her words were so sweet... but now I realize the madness behind them.$B$BTake this envelope.  It has information that'll score you some points with your superiors.$B$BThe guards are distracted... I can make a run for it.  Please.  I don't want to die!

english.title: The Defector
english.objectives: Bring the Incriminating Envelope to Elementalist Ortell at the Outhouse at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
english.description: Stay your hand!  Please, I beg you!$B$BI'm only here because of a girl.  Her words were so sweet... but now I realize the madness behind them.$B$BTake this envelope.  It has information that'll score you some points with your superiors.$B$BThe guards are distracted... I can make a run for it.  Please.  I don't want to die!

text.title: 傻瓜演讲小抄
text.objectives: 消灭海加尔山天选者之座外的欧克罗格。
text.description: 听好了，$N。我知道他们打算对加洛德·影歌干什么了。暮光之锤的食人魔打算把他当作今年的入教式上的祭品。$B$B我听说在血祭之前发表讲话的是一个叫做欧克罗格的食人魔，但注意了：你是替补。$B$B要想救出加洛德，就得要你来发表讲话。别担心——我会给你写几张小抄——而你必须确保欧克罗格在离开天选者之座时会遇上“意外”。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Our plan's almost come together.
text.completed: Return to the Outhouse Hideout at the Supplicant's Forge in Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: ...and by "accident", I mean I want you to kill him.

english.title: Speech Writing for Dummies
english.objectives: Kill Okrog outside the Seat of the Chosen in Hyjal.
english.description: Listen, $N.  I found out what they're doing with Jarod Shadowsong.  He's scheduled to be sacrificed by the ogres of the Twilight's Hammer as part of this year's initiation.$B$BI heard that the initiate charged with delivering the speech ahead of the sacrifice is an ogre named Okrog, but get this: you were a close second.$B$BWe need you to deliver that speech if we're to free Jarod.  Don't worry -- I'll write you some cue cards -- just make sure Okrog has an "accident" as he leaves the Seat of the Chosen.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Our plan's almost come together.
english.completed: Return to the Outhouse Hideout at the Supplicant's Forge in Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: ...and by "accident", I mean I want you to kill him.

text.title: 毕业演说
text.objectives: 在末日祷告祭坛的演讲台上成功发表毕业演说。
text.description: 你终于准备好了，$N·丹玛斯。$B$B我为你和你的成就而感到骄傲。$B$B今天你要在同袍前发表讲话，激励他们奋勇杀敌，直到海加尔山化为灰烬。$B$B记住，$N·丹玛斯。抓住观众的情绪，并且用言词把这些情绪尽可能地调用起来是极为重要的。
text.completion: You.  You're clearly not with them. An ally then?
text.completed: Speak to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at Doom's Vigil in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Graduation Speech
english.objectives: Use the Initiation Podium at Doom's Vigil to successfully deliver the Graduation Speech.
english.description: You're finally ready, $Ndamus.$B$BI am so proud of you and all you've accomplished.$B$BToday you will deliver a speech in front of your peers and inspire them to crush our enemies until Hyjal is nothing but a pile of ash.$B$BRemember, $Ndamus.  It'll be important to read your audience's emotions and use words that best address those emotions.
english.completion: You.  You're clearly not with them. An ally then?
english.completed: Speak to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at Doom's Vigil in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 海加尔在燃烧
text.objectives: 借助阿隆努斯飞往海加尔，到达后跟伊瑟拉谈一谈。
text.description: $N！我久仰你的丰功伟绩。$B$B艾泽拉斯需要的时候，你来了。$B$B死亡之翼的爪牙正在攻打海加尔山，想要将毁天灭地的拉格纳罗斯带回现世。$B$B阿隆努斯会带你加入玛法里奥部署在海加尔的部队。尽可能帮助他们。

english.title: As Hyjal Burns
english.objectives: Fly to Hyjal using Aronus and speak to Ysera once you're there.
english.description: $N!  We've heard much about you and your previous accomplishments.$B$BIt is good that you've come here just as Azeroth finds itself in a time of great need.$B$BDeathwing's minions are attacking Hyjal and seek to bring the destructive Ragnaros back into our world.$B$BAronus will take you to join Malfurion's forces in Hyjal. Lend them what help you can.

text.title: Protect the World Tree
text.objectives: 与海加尔山宁静林地的玛法里奥·怒风交谈。
text.description: <Ysera's eyes look distant, as if not fully acknowledging you.>$B$BI feel it as well, $c. Ragnaros has arrived.$B$BWe must defeat his minions before he can join them and lend them his strength.$B$BSeek Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove, west of here, and aid his forces in any way you can.$B$BI must seek answers from within the Emerald Dream.  You must protect the world tree until I return.
text.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.

english.title: Protect the World Tree
english.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <Ysera's eyes look distant, as if not fully acknowledging you.>$B$BI feel it as well, $c. Ragnaros has arrived.$B$BWe must defeat his minions before he can join them and lend them his strength.$B$BSeek Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove, west of here, and aid his forces in any way you can.$B$BI must seek answers from within the Emerald Dream.  You must protect the world tree until I return.
english.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.

text.title: 向暮光之锤开战
text.objectives: 消灭4名暮光烈焰召唤者和10名暮光湮灭者。
text.description: Make no mistake about this, $N.  The outcome of this war will determine the very survival of our world as we know it.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has become more powerful than ever with Deathwing's return.  Should they succeed in taking over the world tree, they might strike a blow from which we will never recover.$B$BIt is time we beat back the enemy.  It is time we crushed the Twilight's Hammer.
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  But I fear the battle is far from over.
text.completed: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: War on the Twilight's Hammer
english.objectives: Kill 4 Twilight Flamecallers and 10 Twilight Vanquishers.
english.description: Make no mistake about this, $N.  The outcome of this war will determine the very survival of our world as we know it.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has become more powerful than ever with Deathwing's return.  Should they succeed in taking over the world tree, they might strike a blow from which we will never recover.$B$BIt is time we beat back the enemy.  It is time we crushed the Twilight's Hammer.
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  But I fear the battle is far from over.
english.completed: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 被俘的斥候
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山暮光封锁线的斥候拉兰迪雅。
text.description: 我听说过你，$N，还有你从南边带来的消息。战斗已经进入了僵局。$B$B我担心火焰领主的再度苏醒会打破这个僵局。$B$B除非我们能够想办法扭转局面。$B$B暮光之锤俘获了我们的一个斥候。我相信她携带着重要的情报，到西边的暮光营地去找她吧。
text.completion: Help has arrived at last!

english.title: The Captured Scout
english.objectives: Find Scout Larandia at the Twilight Command Post in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: I've heard about you, $N, and the news you brought from the south.  The battle has reached a stalemate.$B$BOne that I fear is about to be broken by the Firelord's reawakening.$B$BThat is unless we tip the scales in our favor in some way.$B$BThere is a scout that was captured by the Twilight's Hammer.  I believe she was in possession of valuable intelligence. Find her in the Twilight camp to the west.
english.completion: Help has arrived at last!

text.title: 监禁
text.objectives: 在海加尔山的暮光封锁线获得暮光监督者的钥匙。
text.description: 他们抓住我的时候，我已经在敌后侦察了快有一天了。$B$B对咱们前线的进攻并不是表面上那么简单，$N。$B$B我会告诉你详情，但首先你得把我弄出去。$B$B只有监督者手中才有笼子的钥匙。$B$B我记得他们位于山口中央，就在最深处。$B$B看你能不能从他们身上搞到钥匙。
text.progress: The key, $n.  Did you get it?
text.completion: I am thankful, $n.  I will deliver my findings to our people.
text.completed: Return to Scout Larandia at the Twilight Command Post in Hyjal.

english.title: Twilight Captivity
english.objectives: Obtain a Twilight Overseer's Key at the Twilight Command Post in Hyjal.
english.description: I'd been scouting behind enemy lines for nearly a day when they caught me.$B$BThis attack on our frontlines is not what it appears, $N.$B$BI'll give you all the details, but first let's find a way to get me out of here.$B$BOnly the overseers carry keys to these cages.$B$BFrom what I recall, they're in the middle of the crater, in the thick of it.$B$BSee if you can get a key off of one of them.
english.progress: The key, $n.  Did you get it?
english.completion: I am thankful, $n.  I will deliver my findings to our people.
english.completed: Return to Scout Larandia at the Twilight Command Post in Hyjal.

text.title: 火焰誊文
text.objectives: Speak to Hamuul Runetotem in Hyjal.
text.description: 这枚徽章同你以往所见的均有不同。上面的符文似乎同附近的火元素一脉相应。$B$B也许你该把这件事告诉哈缪尔·符文图腾。

english.title: Fiery Inscriptions
english.objectives: Speak to Hamuul Runetotem in Hyjal.
english.description: The medallion is unlike any you've seen before.  Its runes appear to glow in conjunction with the near fire elementals.$B$BPerhaps you should tell Hamuul Runetotem about this.

text.title: 破火诀
text.objectives: 消灭30个不受束缚的焰灵。
text.description: 围攻我们的巨型元素并非单一的个体。$B$B它是由暮光之锤的邪教徒用魔法将低级灵体组合在一起的。$B$B重塑过的烈焰先知之杖可以帮助我们削弱其中的连接。$B$B你把大的元素分解掉以后，就可以对付那些分解出来的小元素了。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  This will help us turn the tide against the enemy.
text.completed: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Flamebreaker
english.objectives: Kill 30 Unbound Flame Spirits.
english.description: The large elementals that besiege us are not a singular entity.$B$BThey are an amalgamation of lesser spirits bound together by the Twilight's Hammer cultists' magic.$B$BThe rebuilt flameseer's staff will give us enough power to shatter its bonds.$B$BDestroy the smaller elementals once you've broken up the more dangerous large ones.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  This will help us turn the tide against the enemy.
english.completed: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 事关利害
text.objectives: 与海加尔山兽穴中的萨伊娜·风驰队长交谈。
text.description: 暮光之锤想要释放范达尔·鹿盔？$B$B玛法里奥原本只是猜测他的堕落已经无可救药……这下倒是板上钉钉了。$B$B不管怎么样，我们都不能让敌人同如此强大的大德鲁伊接触。$B$B我有个计划，$N。我们要在翡翠梦境里转移囚犯。这很冒险，但是有这么多的邪教徒在，也许这是唯一能够确保成功的方法了。$B$B去找东北边兽穴中的萨伊娜·风驰吧。
text.completion: The dragon might be right.  The Twilight's Hammer has breached our security and this is our most dangerous prisoner.

english.title: A Prisoner of Interest
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at the Barrow Dens in Hyjal.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer wants to free Fandral Staghelm?$B$BMalfurion suspected his corruption ran deep... this just cements it.$B$BAt any rate we cannot allow our enemies to get their hands on such a powerful arch druid.$B$BI've a plan, $N.  We will move the prisoner through the Emerald Dream.  It will be risky, but with all the cultists present here it might be the only way to guarantee our success.$B$BSpeak to Saynna Stormrunner inside the Barrow Dens to the northeast.
english.completion: The dragon might be right.  The Twilight's Hammer has breached our security and this is our most dangerous prisoner.

text.title: 穿越梦境
text.objectives: 把大德鲁伊范达尔·鹿盔押送到海加尔山兽穴入口的奥利瑟拉处。
text.description: 奥利瑟拉的计划或许很有必要，$N。我不知道我们还能抵挡住邪教徒多久。$B$B范达尔·鹿盔被禁锢在强力法术中，即便在翡翠梦境里，他也是没法逃掉的。$B$B不过，还是要当心，因为我们得知噩梦已经侵入了这里的梦境世界。$B$B把范达尔带上去交给奥利瑟拉。但愿月光林地的安保比这里要好。
text.completion: You did well, $n.  I will take Fandral to Moonglade myself. His prison will be far enough from the battlefront there.

english.title: Through the Dream
english.objectives: Deliver Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm to Alysra at the entrance of the Barrow Dens in Hyjal.
english.description: Alysra's plan might be necessary, $N.  I don't know how much longer we can hold off the cultists.$B$BFandral Staghelm is bound by powerful spells.  He won't be able to escape you, even inside the Emerald Dream.$B$BBeware, though, for all we know the nightmare has spread to this part of the world inside the dream.$B$BTake Fandral to the surface and hand him to Alysra.  Let us hope he's more secure in Moonglade than he is here.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  I will take Fandral to Moonglade myself. His prison will be far enough from the battlefront there.

text.title: 伽格尔要出发
text.objectives: 从伽格尔的私人宝箱里拿到生锈的雕塑钥匙。
text.description: <克里斯托弗探过头来，想要盯着你的眼睛。>$B$B听着，你得把我弄出去。他们要么就会吃了我，要么把我交给暮光之锤。也许两者都有。$B$B他们把我锁在这儿，钥匙被伽格尔藏在了他的私人宝箱里。如有必要，杀掉伽格尔也行——但一定要拿到钥匙！$B$B<克里斯托弗无助地瘫软了下去。>
text.progress: Key? Now? Please?
text.completion: It's about time! ...Can I get a little help here?
text.completed: Bring the key to Kristoff Manheim, hanging in Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: Look for a lockbox somewhere near Gar'gol's enormous, crud-crusted feet.

english.title: Gar'gol's Gotta Go
english.objectives: Get the Rusted Skull Key from Gar'gol's Personal Treasure Chest.
english.description: <Kristoff cranes his neck, trying to look you in the eye.>$B$BListen, you gotta get me outta here. They're either going to eat me or turn me over to the Twilight's Hammer. Maybe both.$B$BThey've padlocked me in, and Gar'gol keeps the key in his personal treasure chest. Kill Gar'gol if you have to - but get that key!$B$B<Kristoff flails his limbs, helplessly.>
english.progress: Key? Now? Please?
english.completion: It's about time! ...Can I get a little help here?
english.completed: Bring the key to Kristoff Manheim, hanging in Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Look for a lockbox somewhere near Gar'gol's enormous, crud-crusted feet.

text.title: Might of the Stonemaul
text.objectives: 干扰古加尔的暮光布道。
text.description: So the Twilight's Hammer thinks it can just raise its own army of ogres here? In the middle of Horde territory? $B$BWe'll see about that.$B$BOgres only respect one thing: strength. I want you to lead the assault on Cho'gall's sermon, $n. Throw wide the doors of Dire Maul, leap into the arena, and cut down his attendants.
text.completion: We've done it! Cho'gall himself has been utterly humiliated by you. His minions are dead, the Gordok are scattered, and now all will know the might of the Horde! Lok'tar, $n. You've more than earned your reward.
text.completed: Return to Orhan Ogreblade at Stonemaul Hold.

english.title: Might of the Stonemaul
english.objectives: Disrupt Cho'Gall's Twilight Sermon.
english.description: So the Twilight's Hammer thinks it can just raise its own army of ogres here? In the middle of Horde territory? $B$BWe'll see about that.$B$BOgres only respect one thing: strength. I want you to lead the assault on Cho'gall's sermon, $n. Throw wide the doors of Dire Maul, leap into the arena, and cut down his attendants.
english.completion: We've done it! Cho'gall himself has been utterly humiliated by you. His minions are dead, the Gordok are scattered, and now all will know the might of the Horde! Lok'tar, $n. You've more than earned your reward.
english.completed: Return to Orhan Ogreblade at Stonemaul Hold.

text.title: 肉身废物
text.objectives: 用寒霜之晶扑灭4个挑战失败的试炼者身上的火。
text.description: 瞧瞧这些蠢货。一半人都撑不过试炼，只能被元素的力量所束缚。$B$B他们不配被提拔到我们的核心中来。但也许……也许可以把他们当仆役来使。$B$B拿上这颗宝石，用它的力量救几个不够格，毫无成功机会的试炼者。
text.completion: Excellent work, Earthenfurydamus.  I'm having the servants you chose for me briefed on their new duties.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Cargall at the Twilight Gauntlet in Hyjal.

english.title: Waste of Flesh
english.objectives: Use the Frostgale Crystal to extinguish the flames on 4 Immolated Supplicants.
english.description: Look at these fools.  Half of them won't even make it past this trial.$B$BThey are not worthy of ascending into our inner circles.  But perhaps... perhaps they are worthy of menial service.$B$BTake this gem and utilize its power to save some of the less competent supplicants.  Those who have no chance of succeeding.  Those already on fire, preferably.
english.completion: Excellent work, Earthenfurydamus.  I'm having the servants you chose for me briefed on their new duties.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Cargall at the Twilight Gauntlet in Hyjal.

text.title: 外婆的猫咪
text.objectives: Grandma Wahl at the Wahl cottage wants you to retrieve Chance the Cat.
text.description: 嗯哼！撤退。$B$B我要我的猫咪，不然我就不走。他是一只黄色的虎斑猫，非常可爱。$B$B这里的东北边有一棵大树，树下有一辆破损的货车，小运最喜欢在那里玩耍了。$B$B你去把他找回来，然后我们就可以动身了。

english.title: Grandma's Cat
english.objectives: Grandma Wahl at the Wahl cottage wants you to retrieve Chance the Cat.
english.description: Right!  About the evacuation, dear.$B$BI just cannot leave without my cat.  He's an adorable orange tabby.$B$BChance's favorite spot to play is a broken down cart near an arbor northeast of here.$B$BBring him here and we'll be on our way.

text.title: 把我弄出去！
text.objectives: 把克里斯托弗护送出伽格尔的营地。
text.description: <你伸手去解克里斯托弗的枷锁。>$B$B好的！去找出口，我跟着你。$B$B要是咱们走散了，就回来瞧瞧，看我是不是又被抓住了。
text.completion: Kristoff, Kristoff... Oh yes, I remember now. I recall sending him on what amounted to a suicide mission. He survived? I suppose that means he failed. Still, you deserve at least some coin for the trouble.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山戈德林圣殿的罗伊斯·暮语。

english.title: Get Me Outta Here!
english.objectives: Escort Kristoff out of Gar'gol's Hovel.
english.description: <You reach up to unfasten Kristoff's bonds.>$B$BGood! Make a break for the exit, and I'll follow.$B$BIf we get separated, check back here to make sure I haven't been recaptured.
english.completion: Kristoff, Kristoff... Oh yes, I remember now. I recall sending him on what amounted to a suicide mission. He survived? I suppose that means he failed. Still, you deserve at least some coin for the trouble.
english.completed: Return to Royce Duskwhisper at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 哨兵的力量
text.objectives: 干扰古加尔的暮光布道。
text.description: 暮光之锤？在这里？$B$B这比我想象的还要严重得多。我们得着手制止他们。我不知道我是否准备好领导这样一次进攻，但我是不会让恐惧阻挡我的！$B$B我会把部队从羽月要塞集结过来。到厄运之槌的竞技场去干扰古加尔的活动，我们将趁他们阵脚大乱时发动攻击。
text.completion: Welcome back from the battle! The Twilight's Hammer have been disgraced in the eyes of the Gordunni, and driven from Feralas.$B$BWe've shown the glory of the Alliance in full force today! Be proud!
text.completed: Return to Silvia at the Tower of Estulan in Feralas.

english.title: Might of the Sentinels
english.objectives: Disrupt Cho'Gall's Twilight Sermon.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer? Here?$B$BThis is far more serious than I expected. We've got to put a stop to this. I don't know if I'm ready to lead such an offensive, but I'm not about to let my fears get in the way of what needs to be done!$B$BI will rally our forces from Feathermoon Stronghold. Head to Dire Maul, make your way to the arena, and disrupt Cho'gall's activities; we will launch our attack during the confusion.
english.completion: Welcome back from the battle! The Twilight's Hammer have been disgraced in the eyes of the Gordunni, and driven from Feralas.$B$BWe've shown the glory of the Alliance in full force today! Be proud!
english.completed: Return to Silvia at the Tower of Estulan in Feralas.

text.title: 浮现的威胁
text.objectives: 同先知加德拉交谈，进入精神恍惚状态。
text.description: 你能感觉到元素们有多愤怒吗？自从我们来了以后它们就想攻击我们，消灭我们。我们得让它们镇静下来，但得先知道是什么惹恼了它们才行。$B$B过来同我坐在火边。把你自己投入到火焰里去……让你的灵魂窥探到真正的威胁。
text.completion: We'd all suspected da naga, but I knew nothin' of the Twilight Cult bein' beneath the waves. Somehow dey are corruptin' and pervertin' the elements, makin' demselves into dese horrors. We goin' ta have to be fightin' both of dese threats to stand a chance of bringin' peace ta Vashj'ir. We don't have da men ta do that yet. Come, $c, we got much ta do.
text.completed: Speak to Farseer Gadra.
text.objective1: Share in Farseer Gadra's Spirit Vision

english.title: The Looming Threat
english.objectives: Speak to Farseer Gadra to enter your Spirit Trance.
english.description: Can ya feel how angry the elements be? They be wantin' to attack us and consume us even as we just arrive. We need ta calm dem, but that kinda wisdom only comes from knowin' what's riling them up in da first place.$B$BCome sit with me by da fire. Let yaself get lost in da flames... let ya spirit peer into the true threat.
english.completion: We'd all suspected da naga, but I knew nothin' of the Twilight Cult bein' beneath the waves. Somehow dey are corruptin' and pervertin' the elements, makin' demselves into dese horrors. We goin' ta have to be fightin' both of dese threats to stand a chance of bringin' peace ta Vashj'ir. We don't have da men ta do that yet. Come, $c, we got much ta do.
english.completed: Speak to Farseer Gadra.
english.objective1: Share in Farseer Gadra's Spirit Vision

text.title: 天然材料
text.objectives: 为莫沙彻营地的巫医尤克里收集2根断裂的原木、6颗包壳矿石、20片有弹性的肌腱和40块金属碎片。
text.description: 我需要一些特定的材料来完成我的工作……你可以把这件事情与我要给你的其它几个任务一起完成了。$B$B我需要菲拉斯树人身上的一段断裂的原木，西边的那些山岭巨人和精灵龙身上的包壳矿石，还有从辛特兰的枭兽或者菲拉斯的角鹰兽身上找到的有弹性的肌腱。最后，我还需要大量的金属碎片，这些碎片可以从我刚才提到过的这些生物身上找到。
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

english.title: Natural Materials
english.objectives: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
english.description: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.$B$BI'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

text.title: 测试容器
text.objectives: 杀死10头铁鬃熊或长牙奔跑者，使用野兽灵魂精华容器缩小并俘获倒下的野兽。
text.description: 尤克里师傅教过我如何制作强力的灵魂武器。我会帮你逐步制作，而你则能给我锻炼手艺的机会。$B$B这个容器能将被击败的生物缩小并困在其中。我们首先需要野兽的灵魂精华，铁鬃熊或长牙奔跑者就行。杀掉它们，在它们的灵魂逃逸之前，用灵魂精华容器将其缩小并俘获。
text.progress: Did you get the beast muisek?
text.completion: As my master told me... Upon a violent death, the muisek of a creature may escape and seek revenge. Shrinking the creatures, as you did, $n, prevents the muisek from escaping. Now we may use it as we please!
text.completed: Return to Gombana at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

english.title: Testing the Vessel
english.objectives: Kill 10 Ironfur Bears or Longtooth Runners, and use the Beast Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen beasts.
english.description: Master Uzer'i's taught me in the ways of making spirit weapons of great power. I'll help you set on the path to make some, and you'll give me the chance to practice my craft.$B$BThis vessel can shrink and trap a defeated creature inside of it. We'll need the muisek of beasts first; ironfur bears and longtooth wolves. Kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.
english.progress: Did you get the beast muisek?
english.completion: As my master told me... Upon a violent death, the muisek of a creature may escape and seek revenge. Shrinking the creatures, as you did, $n, prevents the muisek from escaping. Now we may use it as we please!
english.completed: Return to Gombana at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

text.title: 角鹰兽灵魂精华
text.objectives: 杀掉10只任意种类的乱羽角鹰兽，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。
text.description: The next step is hippogryphs.$B$BAs Master Uzer'i always said, hippogryphs have been loyal companions to the night elves for many years, an' their spirits are loyal and steadfast.$B$BI don't think they'll miss a few, and I don't care if they do. We need the muisek of 10 frayfeather hippogyphs in the wilderness to the south.
text.progress: 你捕获那些角鹰兽的灵魂了吗?
text.completion: Master always said "after killing an animal, if we allowed the muisek to escape, it may take the form of an even greater creature." This is dangerous stuff. Thanks for helping me with my studies.
text.completed: Return to Gombana at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

english.title: Hippogryph Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.
english.description: The next step is hippogryphs.$B$BAs Master Uzer'i always said, hippogryphs have been loyal companions to the night elves for many years, an' their spirits are loyal and steadfast.$B$BI don't think they'll miss a few, and I don't care if they do. We need the muisek of 10 frayfeather hippogyphs in the wilderness to the south.
english.progress: Were you able to capture the hippogryphs?
english.completion: Master always said "after killing an animal, if we allowed the muisek to escape, it may take the form of an even greater creature." This is dangerous stuff. Thanks for helping me with my studies.
english.completed: Return to Gombana at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

text.title: 树人灵魂精华
text.objectives: 杀掉3个森林漫游者，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。
text.description: The wandering forest walkers that can be found meandering through the forest are our next target, $N. Night elves have enlisted treants as allies to fight against the horde. Their movement may be slow, but their role as protectors is undeniable.$B$BSoon we will be able to use this power for our own benefit.$B$BFind three wandering forest walkers; kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them.
text.progress: 你捕获那些森林漫游者的灵魂了吗?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. This is my first time working with treant muisek...
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

english.title: Treant Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.
english.description: The wandering forest walkers that can be found meandering through the forest are our next target, $N. Night elves have enlisted treants as allies to fight against the horde. Their movement may be slow, but their role as protectors is undeniable.$B$BSoon we will be able to use this power for our own benefit.$B$BFind three wandering forest walkers; kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them.
english.progress: Were you able to capture the wandering forest walkers?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. This is my first time working with treant muisek...
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

text.title: 对鹰身人的复仇
text.objectives: 击败6只北泉鹰身人和6只北泉唤风者。
text.description: 年轻时，我曾是个经验丰富的猎手，没有什么野兽会让我感到害怕，直到……$B$B有一次在树林里，我在一场恶战之后正在打磨自己的武器，这时我遭到了伏击。鹰身人包围了我，好不容易我才脱了身。$B$B直到现在，我还能听见它们的嚎叫在耳边回荡……$B$B现在我已经不再年轻了，不过仇恨还在我的心中燃烧——这么多年了，我一定要报仇。$B$B北泉鹰身人就在西边，$N，去为我复仇。
text.completion: 谢谢，$N。你让一个年老的牛头人得到了心灵的慰籍。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

english.title: Vengeance on the Northspring
english.objectives: Kill 6 Northspring Harpies and 6 Northspring Windcallers.
english.description: In my day, I was a seasoned hunter. There wasn't any creature around that I feared. Until...$B$BI was out in the forest, sharpening my blade after a tough battle, when I was ambushed. Harpies surrounded me, and I barely managed to drag myself to safety.$B$BEven now, I can still hear their cries echoing...$B$BI was never the same after that. But the hate boils inside of me -- I must get even, after all these years.$B$BThe Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. $N, get my revenge.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You have put an old tauren's mind at peace.
english.completed: Return to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

text.title: 黑暗之心
text.objectives: 击败艾丹娜·邪爪，获得艾丹娜的黑色坠饰。
text.description: 艾丹娜·邪爪是居住在西面废墟里的北泉鹰身人的皇后。她是个彻头彻尾的恶魔，我听说她的心是水晶做的。除了对别人的仇恨之外，她没有一丝其它的情感。你必须干掉艾丹娜，把她的黑心交给我。$B$B我听说鹰身人有一种号角——在废墟北部的邪爪石那里吹响号角就可以召来她。$B$B当她发现召唤她的是死亡的命运而不是她的同族时，她会有多么惊讶啊！
text.progress: 不能让艾丹娜继续在这片土地上继续为非做歹了。
text.completion: Now I know that Edana is truly dead. This heart, I will keep it in memory of what you did here for me, $n. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Ataya in Feralas.
text.giverWindow: Search for the Hatetalon stones, then blast the horn. She will come.

english.title: Dark Heart
english.objectives: Slay Edana Hatetalon and obtain Edana's Dark Heart.
english.description: Edana Hatetalon is the queen of the Northspring harpies that reside in the ruins to the west. She is pure evil; I have heard that her heart is one of crystal. She is void of any emotion aside from the hate she feels towards all others. You must face Edana and bring me back her dark heart.$B$BI have heard of a horn that harpies carry -- blowing it by the Hatetalon stones, in the northern part of the ruins, will summon the queen.$B$BImagine her surprise when it is not her kin calling her, but her death.
english.progress: The hate that Edana spreads across the land must be stopped.
english.completion: Now I know that Edana is truly dead. This heart, I will keep it in memory of what you did here for me, $n. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Ataya in Feralas.
english.giverWindow: Search for the Hatetalon stones, then blast the horn. She will come.

text.title: 戈杜尼宝珠
text.objectives: 从一名戈杜尼术士手里获得戈杜尼宝珠。
text.description: 你在那里大开杀戒的时候……$B$B我收到了一些报告，我从报告中得知那些食人魔带来的威胁不仅仅是普通的乱砍乱伐而已。有人看见他们中的术士随身带着宝珠，很可能是一种象征权力的物品。$B$B那东西很容易就会被人当作是什么粗制的饰品什么的，不过我得搞清楚那玩意到底是什么，以防万一。给我带一颗宝珠回来。
text.progress: Do you have the orb?
text.completion: Well done. Let me have a look at this.
text.completed: Return to Orhan Ogreblade at Stonemaul Hold.

english.title: The Gordunni Orb
english.objectives: Collect a Gordunni Orb from a Gordunni Warlock.
english.description: While you're down there cracking skulls...$B$BI've gotten reports that make me think these ogres may be more than the usual lumbering threat. The Warlocks among them have been seen carrying orbs, possibly items of empowerment.$B$BIt would be easy to dismiss them as crude trinkets, but I need to make sure we're not surprised. Bring me back one of these orbs.
english.progress: Do you have the orb?
english.completion: Well done. Let me have a look at this.
english.completed: Return to Orhan Ogreblade at Stonemaul Hold.

text.title: Talk to Swar'jan
text.objectives: Deliver the Gordunni Orb to Swar'jan in Stonemaul Hold.
text.description: We're lucky and unlucky here, grunt. Lucky that I had you bother to bring this back, and unlucky that my suspicions turned out to hold water. This thing's full of corrupted stench.$B$BIt's far too new to be something fished out of the ruins, either. Someone is supplying these ogres, and we need to know who before this becomes a situation.$B$BGet that filthy thing upstairs to Swar'jan, the warlock on top of the guard tower. He's good for a few ideas; I'd listen to his suggestions, if I were you.
text.progress: 有事吗?
text.completion: What've you got for me here? You said the Gordunni had this? Disgusting...

english.objectives: Deliver the Gordunni Orb to Swar'jan in Stonemaul Hold.

english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: What've you got for me here? You said the Gordunni had this? Disgusting...

text.title: The Master's Plan
text.objectives: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the eastern part of the Jaggedswine Farm.
text.description: You're fitting in well here, $N, but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Golbaz is preparing a ritual before the altar at the eastern end of the farm. Wait there for him, and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.
text.completion: Now that you understand the master's plan, you must prepare yourself to play your part.
text.completed: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm.

text.title: 绑架食人魔
text.objectives: 用调整过的灵魂石俘虏一名戈多克食人魔。
text.description: There's no way the Gordunni made these. They're being supplied. Someone is giving them gifts of power, and we need to find out who.$B$BThe upper-class Gordok that guard Dire Maul will know more about this. Orhan is no doubt having you thin their numbers, but I'll need one alive.$B$BTake the orb back. It's similar to a Soulstone, so I've made some...adjustments. Hold it up in front of a weakened Gordok ogre, and once you've captured him, bring it back here.
text.completion: Ahh, I can feel the whelp in there. Let's get him out and ask him some questions...
text.completed: Return to Swar'jan at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

english.title: Ogre Abduction
english.objectives: Use the Modified Soulstone to capture a Gordok ogre.
english.description: There's no way the Gordunni made these. They're being supplied. Someone is giving them gifts of power, and we need to find out who.$B$BThe upper-class Gordok that guard Dire Maul will know more about this. Orhan is no doubt having you thin their numbers, but I'll need one alive.$B$BTake the orb back. It's similar to a Soulstone, so I've made some...adjustments. Hold it up in front of a weakened Gordok ogre, and once you've captured him, bring it back here.
english.completion: Ahh, I can feel the whelp in there. Let's get him out and ask him some questions...
english.completed: Return to Swar'jan at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.

text.title: 精灵龙灵魂精华
text.objectives: 杀掉8只精龙或小精龙，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。
text.description: $N，下一步我必须让你捕获一种看上去可能很脆弱，但却有着我们真正需要的强大精神力量的生物。我所说的就是精灵龙，它们是暗夜精灵的伙伴。我们必须抓一只精灵龙来进行研究，这样部落也可以从这种精神力量中获益。$B$B我们需要它们的灵魂精华，$N。杀掉八只小精龙或精龙，并俘获它们的灵魂。从这里向西就可以找到它们。
text.progress: 你捕获那些精灵龙的灵魂了吗?
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。现在精灵龙的灵魂力量可以为我们所用了。$B$B我希望你能再为我完成另一个任务。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

english.title: Faerie Dragon Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.
english.description: $N, next I must have you capture a creature that in appearance, may look quite fragile, yet its powerful spirit is what we are truly after. The faerie dragons that I speak of have served the night elves as their allies. We must capture one so that the horde may benefit from this strength of spirit as well.$B$BHere is the muisek, $N. Kill 8 sprite darters or sprite dragons, and capture their muisek. They may be found to the west of here.
english.progress: Were you able to capture the muisek of the faerie dragons?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Now the spiritual powers of the faerie dragon will be available to us. I hope you willing to perform another task for me.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

text.title: 山岭巨人灵魂精华
text.objectives: Kill 7 Mountain Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
text.description: The mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the Burning Legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.$B$BI am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.
text.progress: 你捕获那些山岭巨人的灵魂了吗?
text.completion: $N，想像一下我们现在拥有了什麽吧。有了你帮我收集到的材料，我就能将这些生物的灵魂精华永远囚禁起来。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

english.title: Mountain Giant Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 7 Mountain Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
english.description: The mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the Burning Legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.$B$BI am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.
english.progress: Were you able to capture the mountain giants?
english.completion: Just imagine the possibilities of what we now possess, $n. Along with the materials that you have collected, I will be able to forever trap the muisek of these creatures into whatever I wish.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

text.title: The Doomsday Plan
text.objectives: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
text.description: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside the city of Orgrimmar. The devices will unleash their fire elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $N, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Blood Guard Torek was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>
text.progress: You've returned at last. I was beginning to think that you'd taken up with the cultists for good.
text.completion: <You hand Blood Guard Torek the devices that the overseer gave you, explaining the cult's plans. Torek's eyes go wide.>$B$BCho'Gall is in charge of the cult? There can be no question then, this is the work of the Twilight's Hammer! You won't be the only one they've sent into the city to deploy these devices.
text.completed: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

text.title: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
text.objectives: Break Elemental Devices to release their elementals. You must defeat 5 Raging Fire Elementals.
text.description: You can't have been the only person sent into Orgrimmar to deploy those devices containing fire elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free and burn down the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? You need to break them open before the fire elementals inside have had time to reach full strength. They should be easy to defeat if you open the devices early. The cultists have probably put them all over the city.
text.completion: Excellent work, $N. Twilight's Hammer will think twice before trying to turn our own people against us again. I'm sure I'm not the only one troubled by just how many citizens were taken in by their message. Times aren't exactly easy, but if you have no honor or loyalty, you have nothing.
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

text.title: 扭曲的姐妹
text.objectives: 杀死7名堕落的树妖。
text.description: 我听说了你同堕落巨龙战斗的事迹，$N，对于你的勇气，我深表谢意……但我收到了一份令人不安的消息。$B$B尽管是暗夜精灵的盟友，但森林里的树妖对我们一直很友好。可她们突然变得残忍扭曲起来，攻击任何胆敢靠近东部荒野的生物。$B$B我担心这里难民们的安全，$N。拜托你，阻止这些扭曲的树妖。
text.completion: I thank you, $n, but the tale of your hunt troubles me. There should not be so many. The sickness is still spreading...
text.completed: Return to Chief Spirithorn at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

english.title: Twisted Sisters
english.objectives: Kill 7 Corrupted Dryads.
english.description: I have heard of your battle against the corrupted dragons, $n, and I thank you for your courage... but I have disturbing news.$B$BThe dryads of the forest, though allies of the Night Elves, have always passed us by in peace. But they have become cruel and twisted, attacking any who wander the eastern wilds.$B$BI fear for the safety of the refugees here, $n. Please, put a stop to these twisted dryads.
english.completion: I thank you, $n, but the tale of your hunt troubles me. There should not be so many. The sickness is still spreading...
english.completed: Return to Chief Spirithorn at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

text.title: 失踪的学徒
text.objectives: 在黑雾废墟里寻找失踪的学徒。
text.description: 不知能否打扰你一下，$C……$B$B我的一个学生独自去南边的黑雾废墟探索了。我警告过他，那里太危险，但他过于兴奋，听不进去。我跟他讲过一个被封印在那些废墟中的护符的故事。现在看来，他可能是去找那东西了，都是因为我……$B$B埃斯图兰禁止我们去追他。如果你打算去那边的话，能不能帮忙找一找？

english.title: The Lost Apprentice
english.objectives: Look for the Lost Apprentice in the Darkmist Ruins.
english.description: If you have a moment, $c...$B$BOne of the students I was teaching has gone to explore the darkmist ruins to the south by himself. I warned him that it was too dangerous, but he was too excited to listen.  I had spoken with him earlier about an amulet that is concealed within those ruins.  Now, I fear that he may have run off in search of it, because of me...$B$BEstulan has forbidden us to pursue him. If you go there, could you please look for him?

text.title: Alert Our Leaders
text.objectives: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
text.description: You have successfully defended Orgrimmar from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $N, and without shedding the blood of our own people. Our enemy will not rest for long. I cannot imagine that Cho'Gall will accept defeat so easily.$B$BGarrosh Hellscream is a well-known hero of the Horde and he will know how to deal with this matter. Go to the Valley of Wisdom and speak to him in Grommash Hold. Tell young Hellscream that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.
text.completion: <The warchief listens as you tell of your investigation into the Twilight's Hammer plot to destroy Orgrimmar.>$B$BYou are a dutiful member of the Horde, $N. You have done well in bringing this news to me. I will personally see to it that our enemies get what they deserve!

text.title: 秋风扫落叶
text.objectives: 击败8名暮光风暴召唤者和5名咆哮的裂隙位面生物。
text.description: 营地里那票干得真不错，$N。你不在的时候，我在圣殿前祈祷，于幻景中，我看到戈德林在密切地关注你。$B$B然而我们处于被动的时间太长了，现在是该对暮光之锤进行直接打击了。$B$B飞到闪电崖去阻挠他们的行动，杀掉风暴召唤者和他们准备释放出来的怪物。
text.completion: You should've seen the battle from here! Bodies were falling off of the cliff! Spectacular!
text.completed: 返回海加尔山的戈德林圣殿，向伊安·杜兰复命。

english.title: Sweeping the Shelf
english.objectives: Slay 8 Twilight Stormcallers and 5 Howling Riftdwellers.
english.description: Wonderful work in the hovel, $N. I prayed at the shrine while you were away, and in my visions, Goldrinn was watching you closely.$B$BBut we've been on the defensive too long: it's time to foil the Twilight's Hammer directly.$B$BFly up to the Lightning Ledge and disrupt their operation. Kill the stormcallers and the monstrosities they're preparing to unleash!
english.completion: You should've seen the battle from here! Bodies were falling off of the cliff! Spectacular!
english.completed: Return to Ian Duran at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 瓶中闪电
text.objectives: 从暮光闪电通道里收集一个充能的冷凝瓶。
text.description: When I prayed at the shrine, Goldrinn granted me another vision. I saw you standing astride the Lightning Ledge, with lightning in your hands. Goldrinn seems to feel that this is of the utmost importance, but I don't understand what the Ancient has planned...$B$B$N, go to the Lightning Ledge. Twilight's Hammer has been running experiments with something called a "Lightning Channel." Investigate these channels, then use this totem to summon the Spirit of Goldrinn and see what he has in mind...
text.progress: We meet again, $c. You carve a path of fear and confusion in your wake.
text.completion: So, it is true! You indeed carry lightning in your hands. You are the chosen one, $n. You will be my champion, and carry my vengeance to realms where I cannot tread...
text.completed: Use Goldrinn's Totem to summon and speak to the Spirit of Goldrinn.

english.objectives: Collect a Charged Condenser Jar from a Twilight Lightning Channel.
