english.objectives: Slay 15 Southsea pirates at the Southsea Holdfast.
english.description: It's time for a little payback, I think. Can you blame me? After they locked me down in that outhouse and left me to drown?!$B$BI'll make it worth your while if you head up to the Southsea Holdfast on the eastern bluffs and exact my revenge.
english.completion: That'll teach those scurvy dogs! You have my thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to Rugfizzle on Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 维兹尔去哪儿了？
text.objectives: 在千针石林的南海据点找到维兹尔·铜栓。
text.description: 嘿，$N，你见过我的另一个兄弟维兹尔吗？$B$B我刚得知海盗抓住了他！他说他打算把工程产品卖些给他们还是咋的。$B$B你能不能去东边南海据点帮忙找找看？我打赌是那个整天和他混在一起不干好事的地精赛恩格惹上的麻烦！
text.completion: Hey! Get me out of here!

english.title: Where's Wizzle?
english.objectives: Find Wizzle Brassbolts at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Hey, $N, you haven't seen my other brother, Wizzle, have you?$B$BI just know that the pirates captured him! He said that he was going to try to sell them some engineering stuff, or something.$B$BWould you please look for him up at the Southsea Holdfast to the east? I'll bet that no-good goblin he's always traveling with, Synge, got him into trouble!
english.completion: Hey! Get me out of here!

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：宿敌战！
text.objectives: Defeat Kelsey Steelspark.
text.description: It seems we have a special request! I have here a note from one Megs Dreadshredder, requesting to enter the cage and settle a dispute.$B$BShe's asked for you to be her partner, $n. A fan of your previous victories? Or perhaps you're acquainted outside the ring?$B$BI wouldn't back down now if I were you. This is the grand finale...
text.completion: Fantastic. I might challenge you to a duel myself someday.
text.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Thunderdrome: Grudge Match!
english.objectives: Defeat Kelsey Steelspark.
english.description: It seems we have a special request! I have here a note from one Megs Dreadshredder, requesting to enter the cage and settle a dispute.$B$BShe's asked for you to be her partner, $n. A fan of your previous victories? Or perhaps you're acquainted outside the ring?$B$BI wouldn't back down now if I were you. This is the grand finale...
english.completion: Fantastic. I might challenge you to a duel myself someday.
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 深度吸引
text.objectives: 消灭10名红腮拾荒者。
text.description: 我成功帮助幸存者们来到这个洞窟，但麻烦的事情也接踵而来。好像我们还不够头疼似的，一些发光的鱼人会从附近的裂隙里冒出来袭击本来已经苦不堪言的幸存者。$B$B那里的人都是战士，他们绝不轻言放弃，但从那该死的贝壳出来以后他们的身体状况就更加难以为继了。$B$B还是你还能憋两口气，出去帮我们干掉些鱼人。地狱咆哮关注着你呢。
text.completion: You know what it is to carry yourself with honor, $c. You do Hellscream proud.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim in Legion's Rest.

english.title: Deep Attraction
english.objectives: Kill 10 Redgill Scavengers.
english.description: I've been able to help some of the survivors make it to the cave, but it's starting to get hairy out there. If we didn't have enough problems, some glowing murlocs started creeping up from the nearby crevice to attack the stranded survivors.$B$BThe men up there are warriors--they won't go down without a fight--but they're much worse for the wear after that damned shell.$B$BIf you have any breath left in your lungs, get up there and take out some of those murlocs. Hellscream's eyes are upon you.
english.completion: You know what it is to carry yourself with honor, $c. You do Hellscream proud.
english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim in Legion's Rest.

text.title: 救命螺
text.objectives: 收集8枚呼吸螺，把它们交给被困住的奈瑟匹拉幸存者。
text.description: 还有很多人没来。他们肯定在海崖的气孔那儿赖着不走。$B$B我们在来的路上发现了一些呼吸螺。它们能产生的空气不是很多，不过足以让我们前往洞窟了。$B$B我得留在这儿数人头，等人到齐了帮他们恢复体力。你帮我个忙，去收集那些呼吸螺，交给我还滞留在海崖那儿的人，顺便给他们的屁股上来一脚，让他们好快点过来。
text.completion: Thank you, $c. You've proven very useful.
text.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn in Legion's Rest.

english.title: Shelled Salvation
english.objectives: Collect 8 Spiralung shells and give them to stranded Nespirah Survivors.
english.description: A lot of the men haven't made it to the cave yet. It's a safe bet that they're stranded at the vents on the ridge above us.$B$BWe found some spiralung shells on the way here. They don't produce much air, but it was enough for us to make the cave.$B$BI need to stay here to count heads and get them back on their feet as they arrive. Do me a favor - go collect those spiralung shells, get them to any of my men that are still up on the ridge, and give them a swift kick in the arse so that they get moving.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. You've proven very useful.
english.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn in Legion's Rest.

text.title: 狡猾的螃蟹
text.objectives: 收集12个菲亚斯科的散落零件。
text.description: 原来是该死的螃蟹！$B$B我以为进行水下练习能让我变得超级能打！我的背包确实越来越轻了。不过！其实是螃蟹在我包上夹了一个洞，里面的零件掉了一路。$B$B你能不能帮帅气的地精一个忙？回去帮我把所有掉出来的零件都找回来。我敢说那些阴险的小螃蟹肯定带走了不少。
text.progress: Never underestimate the appeal of something shiny.
text.completion: Glad you know a quick buck when you see one. Pleasure doing business with you, $g buddy:gorgeous;.
text.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin above Legion's Rest.

english.title: Crafty Crabs
english.objectives: Collect 12 of Fiasco's Stray Parts.
english.description: It was that darn crab!$B$BHere I thought that all the exercise from walking here was making me super buff! My pack just kept getting lighter and lighter. But no! That crab snipped a hole in my bag and all my parts were falling out the whole way here.$B$BPlease, help a good lookin' goblin out, will ya? Go back and help me pick up all of my stray parts. I'm sure those conniving vicious little crabs ran off with some of them too.
english.progress: Never underestimate the appeal of something shiny.
english.completion: Glad you know a quick buck when you see one. Pleasure doing business with you, $g buddy:gorgeous;.
english.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin above Legion's Rest.

text.title: 可以食用
text.objectives: 收集8块钳嘴石斑鱼的肉。
text.description: 他们打算把我们都饿死吗？！不给囚犯吃的也太不人道了。$B$B我们得喂饱这些士兵。来这儿的路上我发现那些巨型石斑鱼很有潜力。几条下肚我们就很长一段时间不会惦记肉味了。$B$B要是你能给我弄些来，我保证做好、公平分发。
text.progress: With all the rumbling bellies, it sounds like there's a monster in this cave. It's putting my nerves on edge.
text.completion: Now to hold up my end of the bargain. I'll get this cooked and passed out immediately.$B$BYou and I will have to have a talk later. I'm going to need help that these soldiers just can't offer.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra in Legion's Rest.

english.title: Something Edible
english.objectives: Collect 8 Snapjaw Grouper Meat.
english.description: Were they trying to starve us all to death?! Not giving prisoners food is just despicable.$B$BWe need to get these soldiers fed. The best prospect I spotted on the way here were those giant grouper. Several of those and we shouldn't want for meat for a while.$B$BIf you can bring me back some, I'll see to it that it gets cooked and passed out fairly.
english.progress: With all the rumbling bellies, it sounds like there's a monster in this cave. It's putting my nerves on edge.
english.completion: Now to hold up my end of the bargain. I'll get this cooked and passed out immediately.$B$BYou and I will have to have a talk later. I'm going to need help that these soldiers just can't offer.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra in Legion's Rest.

text.title: 赛恩格去哪儿了？
text.objectives: 在千针石林的南海据点找到赛恩格。
text.description: 嘿，$N，你见过我们的枪械工赛恩格吗？$B$B我刚得知海盗抓住了他！他说他打算把步枪卖些给他们还是咋的。$B$B你能不能去东边南海据点帮忙找找看？我打赌是那个整天和他混在一起不干好事的侏儒维兹尔·铜栓惹上的麻烦！
text.completion: Hey! Get me out of here!

english.title: Where's Synge?
english.objectives: Find Synge at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Hey, $N, you haven't seen our gunsmith, Synge, have you?$B$BI just know that the pirates captured him! He said that he was going to try to sell them some rifles, or something.$B$BWould you please look for him up at the Southsea Holdfast to the east? I'll bet that no-good gnome he's always traveling with, Wizzle Brassbolts, got him into trouble!
english.completion: Hey! Get me out of here!

text.title: 指挥官加洛德·影歌
text.objectives: 跟暗语小径的元素师奥泰尔谈一谈。
text.description: Only once has there been a leader capable of commanding demigods and mortals alike.$B$BHis name was Jarod Shadowsong and his ability to lead in battle was such that Cenarius and the other Ancients placed themselves under his command.$B$BHe disappeared for years and his whereabouts were unknown.  Until now.$B$BHe is being held captive inside a Twilight camp in Darkwhisper Gorge.$B$BYour job is to infiltrate their ranks and free Jarod.  Speak to the one known as Ortell at Darkwhisper Pass to the southeast.
text.completion: Hey there.  I'm glad to see they sent someone of your caliber for this operation. This here's going to call for some subtlety.  We can't risk Commander Shadowsong getting killed.

english.title: Commander Jarod Shadowsong
english.objectives: Speak to Elementalist Ortell at Darkwhisper Pass.
english.description: Only once has there been a leader capable of commanding demigods and mortals alike.$B$BHis name was Jarod Shadowsong and his ability to lead in battle was such that Cenarius and the other Ancients placed themselves under his command.$B$BHe disappeared for years and his whereabouts were unknown.  Until now.$B$BHe is being held captive inside a Twilight camp in Darkwhisper Gorge.$B$BYour job is to infiltrate their ranks and free Jarod.  Speak to the one known as Ortell at Darkwhisper Pass to the southeast.
english.completion: Hey there.  I'm glad to see they sent someone of your caliber for this operation. This here's going to call for some subtlety.  We can't risk Commander Shadowsong getting killed.

text.title: 屈尊乞求
text.objectives: 找到萨米尔和马克。
text.description: 你让我脱离了危险，俗话说好人做到底，还有一件小事想麻烦你。$B$B船长萨米尔和马克还流落在外。我确定他们已经抵达了海床地带，但是之后的情形就不得而知了。$B$B没有他们，我是不可能在这种地方生存的。$B$B我是在西边的柯尔普萨之森里跟他们走散的，就是你找到我的地方。$B$B快！他们可能没走多远……
text.completion: Where would we be without you, $r! I don't want to even imagine!
text.completed: Return to Adarrah in Smuggler's Scar.

english.title: Ain't Too Proud to Beg
english.objectives: Find Samir and Mack.
english.description: Now that you've brought me to safety, I'm afraid I must impose upon your kindness just a bit further.$b$bThe captain of our ship, Samir, is still out there. Mack too. I'm sure they made it to the sea floor but beyond that I didn't see what became of them.$b$bI simply couldn't get by in a place like this without their help.$b$bI lost sight of them in a clump of kelp west of where you found me.$b$bPlease hurry! They couldn't have gotten far...
english.completion: Where would we be without you, $r! I don't want to even imagine!
english.completed: Return to Adarrah in Smuggler's Scar.

text.title: 灰槌，传送门之主
text.objectives: 杀死灰槌，找到天启之书。
text.description: 暮光之锤使用许多像这些的通道，将补给物资从元素位面运往艾泽拉斯。要封闭这些通道，我们就必须搞清楚它们的构造是怎样的。$B$B帮我找到天启之书，元素生物就是用它打开位面之间的通路。$B$B传送门之主灰槌应该就有一本，你必须把他干掉。多加小心！他可不是好对付的……
text.progress: The tome! Have you found it?
text.completion: This is the tome we've heard about? I see... I guess it's good that I can read some of the elemental script. I'll work on translating this. Meanwhile, there's one final problem to take care of.
text.completed: Bring the Tome of Openings to Jordan Olafson within the Anvil of Flame.
text.giverWindow: Be careful: Cindermaul will almost certainly call forth reinforcements from the other elemental planes.

english.title: Cindermaul, the Portal Master
english.objectives: Slay Cindermaul and locate the Tome of Openings.
english.description: Twilight's Hammer is using these corridors, and others like them, to move supplies from the elemental planes up into Azeroth. In order to seal these passages off, we're going to need to know how they're constructed.$B$BFind for me the Tome of Openings, used by the elementals to open gates between the planes.$B$BCindermaul the Portal Master should have one. You'll have to kill him. Careful! He's probably got some tricks up his sleeve...
english.progress: The tome! Have you found it?
english.completion: This is the tome we've heard about? I see... I guess it's good that I can read some of the elemental script. I'll work on translating this. Meanwhile, there's one final problem to take care of.
english.completed: Bring the Tome of Openings to Jordan Olafson within the Anvil of Flame.
english.giverWindow: Be careful: Cindermaul will almost certainly call forth reinforcements from the other elemental planes.

text.title: 铸炉之主派伦迪乌斯
text.objectives: 杀死铸炉之主派伦迪乌斯。将他引诱到传送符文旁边，然后使用符文来削弱他。
text.description: 一股可怕的邪恶力量盘踞在这座山洞的中心，$N。铸炉之主派伦迪乌斯亲自打造了许多武器，供暮光之锤用来征服上面的世界。$B$B在我们离开这个烈焰的世界之前……必须除掉派伦迪乌斯。$B$B他可不会坐以待毙。但是，如果我对天启之书的研究结果没错的话，我们可以短暂地开启一些通往水的世界——深渊之喉的通道。将派伦迪乌斯引到传送符文旁，然后启动符文，就可以削弱他！
text.completion: It is done! We'll seal this fiery hole up behind us and let the minions of the Twilight's Hammer discover the corpses we left behind. We couldn't have done it without you, $n!
text.completed: Return to Jordan Olafson within the Anvil of Flame.
text.giverWindow: Use the runes that circle Pyrendius to destroy him. He's too strong to fight alone!

english.title: Forgemaster Pyrendius
english.objectives: Slay Forgemaster Pyrendius. Lure him onto the Portal Runes and use them to weaken him.
english.description: A terrible evil squats in the heart of this cavern, $N. Forgemaster Pyrendius has personally crafted many of the cursed weapons that Twilight's Hammer is using in their conquest of the realms above.$B$BBefore we leave these lands of flame... Pyrendius must die.$B$BHe will not go down easy. But, if I'm reading the tome correctly, we can briefly open up small gateways to the Abyssal Maw, the realm of water. Lure Pyrendius onto a portal rune and activate it to weaken him!
english.completion: It is done! We'll seal this fiery hole up behind us and let the minions of the Twilight's Hammer discover the corpses we left behind. We couldn't have done it without you, $n!
english.completed: Return to Jordan Olafson within the Anvil of Flame.
english.giverWindow: Use the runes that circle Pyrendius to destroy him. He's too strong to fight alone!

text.title: 尖子生
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山哀求熔炉的导师密尔瓦谈一谈。
text.description: 这就是了，“$N·丹玛斯！”你是班里的头一名！$B$B你有机会让这个星球上最狂热、最嗜血、最不要命的人们刮目相看。$B$B去向你的导师报到，了解一下详情，但要记住：你的目的是利用天选者之座的食人魔跟其他非特权种族之间的矛盾。$B$B要是一切顺利的话，我们就能在即将到来的暴动中把加洛德劫出来。
text.completion: There you are, Earthenfurydamus.  I've been meaning to talk to you about something. I heard about the unfortunate incident that befell our poor friend, Okrog.

english.title: Head of the Class
english.objectives: Speak to instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
english.description: That settles it, "$Ndamus!"  You are head of your class!$B$BYou will get a chance to address a crowd of the most fanatical, bloodthirsty and certifiably insane people on this planet.$B$BGo report to your instructor for the details, but remember: your goal is to exploit the animosity between the ogres at the Seat of the Chosen and the other, less privileged races.$B$BIf all goes well, we will smuggle Jarod out of here during the ensuing riot.
english.completion: There you are, Earthenfurydamus.  I've been meaning to talk to you about something. I heard about the unfortunate incident that befell our poor friend, Okrog.

text.title: 没有火花，生不了火
text.objectives: 在巴德的挖掘场找到一桶火药。
text.description: 马克依然不省人事，不赶紧生火的话，恐怕他会没命的。这些树枝都湿透了，我们需要特殊的易燃物。$B$B附近有一座被废弃的营地，营地里放着一桶炸药。我没法自己取回它。$B$B你愿意帮我跑一趟吗？为了马克？
text.progress: Did you get the explosives from the camp, $c?
text.completion: Outstanding! Let's see if this does the trick.... Stand back, $n!
text.completed: Return to Samir in Smuggler's Scar.

english.title: Can't Start a Fire Without a Spark
english.objectives: Get the Keg of Gunpowder from Budd's Dig.
english.description: Mack's still out of it, and I fear we may lose him if I can't get this fire started. With the wood being soaked, we'll need something special to get it going.$b$bThere's an abandoned camp nearby with a barrel of explosives in it. There's no way I can recover it on my own.$b$bWould you mind hauling it back for us? For Mack?
english.progress: Did you get the explosives from the camp, $c?
english.completion: Outstanding! Let's see if this does the trick.... Stand back, $n!
english.completed: Return to Samir in Smuggler's Scar.

text.title: Hammering It Out
text.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Stormwind, Ironforge, Exodar or Darnassus and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
text.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.
text.progress: What's this then?  Another device?
text.completion: Not another one! $n, these devices have been springing up all around Azeroth. We know that they can instigate elemental disturbances in the area, including causing tears in the elemental planes. The devices stink of Twilight's Hammer.  The engravings covering the surface and the captured elemental essence implicate Cho'gall and his minions are behind this. If you find more of these, bring them to me or one of my associates. We need to learn more about what's behind this attack.

text.title: 侏儒通讯器
text.objectives: 收集8份低劣的地精科技。
text.description: 地精让我觉得恶心。他们低劣的科技哪儿都比不上侏儒，然而……$B$B<萨克萨克教授叹了口气。>$B$B它却是拼图的最后一块！少了低劣的地精科技，侏儒通讯器就没法制造！$B$B到东边的“研发部”去，把他们低劣的地精垃圾给拿来！大多数应该都能在地精技师身上找到。$B$B<萨克萨克嘲讽地大笑起来。>$B$B地精技师？那是什么？$B$B<萨克萨克教授耸耸肩。>$B$B说反话吗？
text.progress: Ze junk? Do you have zit?
text.completion: Ah, ze junk haz arrived! Zit is ze last piece of ze puzzle! Now to zet it up! Standby, $n!
text.completed: Return to Professor Xakxak Gyromate at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.

english.title: Ze Gnomecorder
english.objectives: Recover 8 pieces of Filthy Goblin Technology.
english.description: Zese goblinz dizgust me. Zer filzy goblin technology iz inferior to anyzing gnomish, yet...$B$B<Professor Xakxak sighs.>$B$BIt iz ze last piece of ze puzzle! Wizout ze filzy goblin technology ze gnomecorder cannot be built!$B$BVenture eazt into ze "Skunkworks" and take from zem zer filzy goblin junk! You vill most likely find zem on goblin technicians.$B$B<Professor Xakxak laughs mockingly.>$B$BGoblin technician? Vut iz zat anyvay?$B$B<Professor Xakxak shrugs.>$B$BZome kind of oxymoron?
english.progress: Ze junk? Do you have zit?
english.completion: Ah, ze junk haz arrived! Zit is ze last piece of ze puzzle! Now to zet it up! Standby, $n!
english.completed: Return to Professor Xakxak Gyromate at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.

text.title: 刀劈火燎
text.objectives: 骑上一头翡翠幼龙，消灭40个暮光之锤单位和5头暮光幼龙。
text.description: 胜利是可能的，$N。$B$B这扇传送门不仅能将塞纳留斯从梦境中带回来。想想看吧，$N，一旦通往翡翠梦境的界门被打开，我们的部队就能用它自由出入月光林地、诺达希尔，甚至龙眠神殿，所有这些战略要冲。$B$B伊瑟拉需要的就是时间。要阻止暮光之锤在暗语峡谷的部队集结起来从东部攻打我们，就全得看你了。$B$B骑一条翡翠幼龙，去把他们杀个落花流水，$N。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  We might win this one yet.
text.completed: Return to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at the Gates of Sothann.

english.title: Slash and Burn
english.objectives: Ride an Emerald Drake and slay 40 Twilight's Hammer units and 5 Twilight Drakes.
english.description: Victory is possible, $N.$B$BThis portal is not just a means of bringing back Cenarius through the dream.  Think about it, $N.  Once a gateway through the Emerald Dream is open, our forces can use them to move freely from Moonglade, Nordrassil, and even Wyrmrest, to this strategic location.$B$BAll Ysera needs is time. It'll be up to you to keep the Twilight's Hammer forces in Darkwhisper Gorge from pulling together and attacking us from the east.$B$BTake one of the emerald drakes and hit them hard, $N.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  We might win this one yet.
english.completed: Return to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at the Gates of Sothann.

text.title: 水下宝藏
text.objectives: 收集8个沉没的宝箱。
text.description: 笼子的钥匙在海盗将军托尼·双牙手里，身边还有食人魔环侍左右，你杀不光的！$B$B<维兹尔哭闹了一阵，突然抬起头来，有了主意。>$B$B我有了！海盗们最想要的是什么？不，不是老酒。更棒的东西……财宝！$B$B他们有一整船财宝因为鲸鲨袭击沉在了闪光巨湖底。$B$B快去给我捞起来！
text.progress: Oh gosh, do you already have all of that sunken treasure?
text.completion: Oh yeah! Look at all that booty. Wait a minute... bring it closer!
text.completed: Return to Wizzle Brassbolts at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Sunken Treasure
english.objectives: Collect 8 Sunken Treasure Chests.
english.description: The key to the cage is held by Tony Two-Tusk, the pirate admiral, and he's guarded by ogres that you'll never be able to kill!$B$B<Wizzle cries some more and then looks up, an idea forming in his brain.>$B$BI've got it! What do all pirates want more than anything else? No, not grog. Something even better... treasure!$B$BThey had a ship full of treasure that was sunk by a giant whale-shark. The treasure is scattered all over down in the Mirage Abyss to the northwest.$B$BGo get it!
english.progress: Oh gosh, do you already have all of that sunken treasure?
english.completion: Oh yeah! Look at all that booty. Wait a minute... bring it closer!
english.completed: Return to Wizzle Brassbolts at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 从火焰之地凯旋而归
text.objectives: 返回海加尔山的戈德林圣殿，向伊安·杜兰复命。
text.description: 我会指挥戈德林的追随者们封印这道传送门。$B$B海加尔山的驻军听到这一胜利的消息应该会很高兴的。请转告伊安·杜兰我们的发现，还有我们是如何大获全胜的！$B$B跨过这道传送门，返回海加尔山吧。
text.completion: They're moving supplies to Hyjal straight from the elemental planes? That explains so much. You've made Goldrinn proud by sealing that flamegate, $n, but there may be more portals to seal. You should check with the other shrines!
text.completed: 返回海加尔山的戈德林圣殿，向伊安·杜兰复命。

english.title: Return from the Firelands
english.objectives: Return to Ian Duran at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
english.description: I'll usher out the rest of Goldrinn's followers and seal this portal behind us.$B$BThe rest of our forces at Mount Hyjal will want to hear of this victory. Return to Ian Duran and let him know what we've discovered and how we were triumphant!$B$BSimply step through the portal to return to Mount Hyjal.
english.completion: They're moving supplies to Hyjal straight from the elemental planes? That explains so much. You've made Goldrinn proud by sealing that flamegate, $n, but there may be more portals to seal. You should check with the other shrines!
english.completed: Return to Ian Duran at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 从火焰之地凯旋而归
text.objectives: Return to Takrik Ragehowl at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
text.description: I'll usher out the rest of the followers of Lo'Gosh and seal this portal behind us.$B$BThe rest of our forces at Mount Hyjal will want to hear of this victory. Return to Takrik Ragehowl and let him know what we've discovered and how we were triumphant!$B$BSimply step through the portal to return to Mount Hyjal.
text.completion: They're moving supplies to Hyjal straight from the elemental planes? Devious. You've made Lo'Gosh proud by sealing that flamegate, $n, but there may be more portals to seal. You should check with the other shrines!
text.completed: Return to Takrik Ragehowl at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: 为你自己好
text.objectives: 跟石爪山脉强击哨站的卡伦·强击谈一谈。
text.description: 这些暗夜精灵给我们发来了一个绝望的求救信号，请求我们的帮助，差不多是这样的：$B$B<诺莫巴士捏尖了嗓子模仿女人的声音说道。>$B$B“请来帮帮我们！又大又坏的部落有地精！呜，我们对付不了地精！他们扯我们的头发，把我们弄哭！”$B$B好吧，不管怎么说，我们来了。$B$B我做的第一件事就是升级他们的防御武装，把我最新款的狙击枪配给他们。问题是，他们不用枪。为你自己好，给他们搭把手，行吗？他们就在南边。
text.completion: We use guns just fine, friend. CANNONS, on the other hand, I take issue with...

english.title: Do Yourself a Favor
english.objectives: Speak to Kalen Trueshot at Trueshot Point in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: So these night elves send out a desperate call for help to us, goes something like this:$B$B<Gnombus changes the pitch of his voice to sound like a woman.>$B$B"Please come help us! The big, mean Horde has goblins! Oh, we can't handle goblins! They pull our hair and make us cry!"$B$BRight, anyway, so here we are.$B$BThe first thing I did was upgrade their aerial defenses with some of my new sniper guns. Problem is, they don't use guns. Do yourself a favor and lend 'em a hand, eh? Find 'em south of here.
english.completion: We use guns just fine, friend. CANNONS, on the other hand, I take issue with...

text.title: 下来的唯一办法就是进裹尸袋
text.objectives: 杀死8名战歌飞将。
text.description: 天空中飞满了全副武装的兽人，他们骑在更为全副武装的双足飞龙背上。我们尽全力想把他们击落，可收效甚微。我们的弓箭打在这些邪恶的生物身上，统统被弹开了。就算碰巧打下来一个，兽人还是会用地精降落伞安全落地的。$B$B我要你用诺莫巴士的狙击炮把战歌双足飞龙打下来，然后把跳伞的兽人也干掉。$B$B想要下来，就只能装在裹尸袋里。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. The gnome technology, while somewhat obnoxious, is highly effective. We should now have a clear path to Windshear Hold.
text.completed: Report to Kalen Trueshot at Trueshot Point in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: The Only Way Down is in a Body Bag
english.objectives: Kill 8 Warsong Wing Commanders.
english.description: The skies are swarming with heavily armored orcs on the backs of even more heavily armored wind riders. Our best efforts to bring them down have thus far proven fruitless. Our arrows usually just bounce off of those foul creatures. If we do happen to take one down the orcs deploy their goblin parachutes and safely land on the ground below.$B$BI need you to use Gnombus's sniper cannons and blow up the Warsong wind riders and then blow up the parachuting orcs.$B$BThe only way down is in a body bag.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. The gnome technology, while somewhat obnoxious, is highly effective. We should now have a clear path to Windshear Hold.
english.completed: Report to Kalen Trueshot at Trueshot Point in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 回到星尘塔
text.objectives: 去找灰谷星尘塔的女猎手嘉琳。
text.description: 若知道通往风剪要塞的道路安全了，女猎手嘉琳一定会高兴的。请回到星尘塔将捷报传给她。既然道路畅通了，那么她多半肯定会有更多的工作要你去做。$B$B谢谢你，祝你好运，朋友。
text.completion: With the airways clear our hippogryphs will be able to move into Stonetalon freely. Well done, $n! Now on to more pressing matters. What you witnessed at Trueshot Point was a small sampling of the decimation left in the wake of Hellscream's legacy. As Warchief of the Horde, Hellscream has declared Kalimdor as the Horde's sovereign territory. All that would oppose the Horde are destroyed. We are Kalimdor's last line of defense. Should we fall, Kalimdor will also fall. The Horde must be stopped!

english.title: Return to Stardust
english.objectives: Return to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.
english.description: Huntress Jalin will be pleased to know that the way to Windshear Hold is now clear. Please return to Stardust Spire and inform her of your success. She will most assuredly have more work for you now that our path is clear.$B$BThank you and good luck, friend.
english.completion: With the airways clear our hippogryphs will be able to move into Stonetalon freely. Well done, $n! Now on to more pressing matters. What you witnessed at Trueshot Point was a small sampling of the decimation left in the wake of Hellscream's legacy. As Warchief of the Horde, Hellscream has declared Kalimdor as the Horde's sovereign territory. All that would oppose the Horde are destroyed. We are Kalimdor's last line of defense. Should we fall, Kalimdor will also fall. The Horde must be stopped!

text.title: 地狱咆哮的遗产
text.objectives: 杀死10名克罗姆加焚化者。
text.description: 进入石爪山脉，穿过石爪小径，朝烧毁的树木那边走。找到那些焚烧森林的克罗姆加焚化者，把他们都杀掉！要当心，焚化者都是些厉害的兽人。用常规手段攻击他们通常都意味着死亡。把他们背上的油罐打爆，他们就会被火焰吞噬！$B$B成功之后去找狂风矿洞的哨兵海琳娜。她知道你接下去该怎么做。
text.completion: With the Krom'gar incinerators dealt with, the forest may be allowed to regrow. Only time can heal the wounds left by the Horde.
text.completed: Report to Sentinel Heliana at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Hellscream's Legacy
english.objectives: Slay 10 Krom'gar Incinerators.
english.description: Enter Stonetalon Mountains through Talondeep Pass and head towards the smoldering trees. Seek out the Krom'gar incinerators that are destroying the forest and slay as many as you can! Be warned, the incinerators are powerful orcs. Attacking them through conventional means will likely result in your death. Destroy the oil canisters on their backs and they will be devoured by flame!$B$BReport to Sentinel Heliana at Windshear Mine should you succeed. She will have your new orders.
english.completion: With the Krom'gar incinerators dealt with, the forest may be allowed to regrow. Only time can heal the wounds left by the Horde.
english.completed: Report to Sentinel Heliana at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 进入传送门！
text.objectives: 跨过海加尔山闪电崖顶端的火焰之门，跟乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。
text.description: 暮光之锤在闪电崖顶端创造了一道巨大的火焰之门。我不知道它通往哪里，我也进不去；但是我敢肯定，传送门那头肯定不是我们所在的位面。我们派出去的侦察兵全都没能回来。$B$B我要你跨入火焰之门，成为我的利齿。与乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈，如果他还活着的话。他会给你一件器物，可以让你在那个位面使用我的力量。$B$B拿出勇气来，$N。查明火焰之门通往哪里，并摧毁其中的一切。
text.completion: Ah, you are the champion Lo'Gosh promised! Your eyes don't deceive you: you have entered the Firelands, an elemental plane of molten stone and fire. We've got our work cut out for us here. Put aside your differences with the Alliance, there's plenty of danger to go around. And take this: the Fang of Lo'Gosh will allow you to channel the ancient's power here within the Firelands. Use it well!
text.completed: 跨过海加尔山闪电崖顶端的火焰之门，跟乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。

english.title: Into the Maw!
english.objectives: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.
english.description: Atop the Lightning Ledge, the Twilight's Hammer has erected an enormous flamegate. I do not know where it leads; I know it is not of this realm, and I cannot enter. None of my other followers have returned.$B$BI need you to enter this realm and be my fangs within. Step through the flamegate. If he is still alive, meet with Jordan Olafson inside. He will give you a token that will allow you to use my powers in that realm.$B$BBe bold, $N. Find out where that flamegate leads, and destroy whatever lies within.
english.completion: Ah, you are the champion Lo'Gosh promised! Your eyes don't deceive you: you have entered the Firelands, an elemental plane of molten stone and fire. We've got our work cut out for us here. Put aside your differences with the Alliance, there's plenty of danger to go around. And take this: the Fang of Lo'Gosh will allow you to channel the ancient's power here within the Firelands. Use it well!
english.completed: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.

text.title: 收复失地
text.objectives: 在瓦丝琪尔废墟里击败任意10名防御城市的克瓦迪尔人。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回到影像中。
text.description: 有的是克瓦迪尔人可杀。他们显然还没从我们的攻击中回过神来。这座城市被荒废了太久，我怀疑他们根本没料到纳迦会来抢地盘。$B$B目前还没有他们首领的消息，我肯定帮他们来次人口淘汰多半会让带头的浮出水面。$B$B那咱们就继续？
text.completion: Hah! It seems you were right. That broken trident is serving you just fine. I suppose I don't get to see you claw anything to death today after all.
text.completed: Return to Fathom-Stalker Azjentus in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Reoccupation
english.objectives: Kill 10 Kvaldir defenders in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: There's no shortage of Kvaldir to slaughter. They're obviously still reeling from our assault.  The city has been desolate so long, I doubt they expected any naga to contest them here.$B$BThere have been no reports yet of their leader. I'm sure that culling them further will force the coward to rear his head soon enough.$B$BShall we continue?
english.completion: Hah! It seems you were right. That broken trident is serving you just fine. I suppose I don't get to see you claw anything to death today after all.
english.completed: Return to Fathom-Stalker Azjentus in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

text.title: 尊敬的女士
text.objectives: 跟奎尔多米尔花园北端的纳兹夏尔女士谈一谈。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回到影像中。
text.description: 尊敬的女士有话要带给你。她在花园北端等你。$B$B要是你觉得有必要，尽管可以将忠诚战友艾金图斯的英雄事迹提上一提。我是不会介意你用我的名头的。$B$B那我就不耽搁你了。女士等着你呢。
text.completion: Ah, my battlemaiden, you've come to me. The warrior caste whispers of nothing but your victories on the battlefield, and we've only just begun our assault to take the city.$B$BYou have served me proud thus far. May the Queen favor you that you might continue to do more of the same.
text.completed: Speak to Lady Naz'jar at the north end of the Vashj'ir Temple Gardens.

english.title: The Revered Lady
english.objectives: Speak to Lady Naz'jar at the north end of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: The Revered Lady has sent word for you. She awaits you at the far end of the temple gardens.$B$BIf you feel the need to mention the heroic exploits of your faithful battle brother, Azjentus, please don't hold back. I won't take your admiration of me as a weakness.$B$BI'll hold you up no longer. The Lady awaits.
english.completion: Ah, my battlemaiden, you've come to me. The warrior caste whispers of nothing but your victories on the battlefield, and we've only just begun our assault to take the city.$B$BYou have served me proud thus far. May the Queen favor you that you might continue to do more of the same.
english.completed: Speak to Lady Naz'jar at the north end of the Vashj'ir Temple Gardens.

text.title: 实地试验：侏儒通讯器
text.objectives: 进入石爪山脉，沿着石抓小径南部来到地精钻机处。
text.description: 侏儒通讯器完成了！现在我们得测试一下！$B$B到东南方的石爪山脉，进入石爪小径，直到你发现一台低劣的地精钻机为止。等你到了目的地之后，我就会启动侏儒通讯器！
text.completion: Come in, $n. Can you hear me? Zis iz Professor Xakxak! *POP* *CRACKLE* PERFECT! Viz ze Gnomecorder I vill be able to direct you about Stonetalon vile staying out of harmz vay! Now, onto our next order of buziness!

english.title: Field Test: Gnomecorder
english.objectives: Enter Stonetalon Mountains and travel south along the Talondeep Pass until you arrive at a goblin drill machine.
english.description: Ze Gnomecorder iz complete! Now ve must test zit!$B$BVenture into Stonetalon Mountains to ze southeast and valk down ze Talondeep Pass until you reach a filzy goblin drill machine. I vill activate ze gnomecorder ven you reach your destination!
english.completion: Come in, $n. Can you hear me? Zis iz Professor Xakxak! *POP* *CRACKLE* PERFECT! Viz ze Gnomecorder I vill be able to direct you about Stonetalon vile staying out of harmz vay! Now, onto our next order of buziness!

text.title: 烧吧，宝贝，烧吧！
text.objectives: 从克罗姆加焚化者手里获得战歌火焰喷射器，用战歌火焰喷射器摧毁8堆战歌物资。
text.description: 这些烧毁森林的兽人焚化者手里有强大的武器！你必须击败他们，把他们的火焰喷射器拿来。到手以后，在森林里寻找战歌物资，用火焰喷射器烧掉！$B$B都烧光，我会奖赏你的！没错，侏儒通讯器可以传输物品！$B$B等等！你听见没有！我想附近有个兽人！小心！
text.completion: Vonderful! As promised, VOILA, your reward! Now, I have a bit of news that you might find interesting.
text.giverWindow: Do you hear zat?
text.turninWindow: Varsong veapons zis vay and zat!

english.title: Burn, Baby, Burn!
english.objectives: Obtain a Warsong Flame Thrower from a Krom'gar Incinerator and use the Warsong Flame Thrower to destroy 8 Warsong Stockpiles.
english.description: Deze orc incinerators zat burn ze forest carry viz zem powerful veaponry! You must kill zem and take zhere flame thrower. Vonce you have ze flame thrower, search ze forest for varsong stockpilez and use ze flame thrower to burn zem down!$B$BBurn zem all and I vill reward you! Yes, ze Gnomecorder can transport items!$B$BVait! Do you hear zat! I zink zhere iz an orc nearby! Vatchout!
english.completion: Vonderful! As promised, VOILA, your reward! Now, I have a bit of news that you might find interesting.
english.giverWindow: Do you hear zat?
english.turninWindow: Varsong veapons zis vay and zat!

text.title: 进入传送门！
text.objectives: 跨过海加尔山闪电崖顶端的火焰之门，跟乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。
text.description: $N，你来了！只有戈德林选中的英雄才有可能完成他交代的这项任务。暮光之锤在闪电崖顶端创造了一道火焰之门。我们不知道它通往哪里，连戈德林也进不去。狼神希望你成为他的利齿。$B$B跨过火焰之门，与J乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。他会给你一件器物，可以让你在那个位面使用戈德林的力量。查明火焰之门通往哪里！
text.completion: Ah, you are the champion Goldrinn promised! Your eyes don't deceive you: you have entered the Firelands, an elemental plane of molten stone and fire. We've got our work cut out for us here. Put aside your differences with the Horde, there's plenty of danger to go around. And take this: the Fang of Goldrinn will allow you to channel the ancient's power here within the Firelands. Use it well!
text.completed: 跨过海加尔山闪电崖顶端的火焰之门，跟乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。

english.title: Into the Maw!
english.objectives: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.
english.description: $N, there you are! Goldrinn has a mission that only his champion can accomplish. Atop the Lightning Ledge, Twilight's Hammer has erected a flamegate. We don't know where it leads, but Goldrinn can't enter. The ancient needs you to be his fangs.$B$BStep into the flamegate and talk to Jordan Olafson when you get inside. He'll give you a token to allow you to use Goldrinn's power in that realm. Find out where the flamegate leads!

text.title: 过去的影像：自深渊崛起
text.objectives: 在奎尔多米尔神殿某处使用女武士的断剑来目睹她最后的经历。
text.description: 你之前告诉我关于纳迦的事情一直萦绕在我的脑海里。他们召唤的盟友到底是谁？他们真的认为自己可以击败猎潮者吗？$B$B逃出洞穴让人松了一口气，但我们在这里还有未竟的事情。我希望你能最后一次从女武士那里寻得答案。$B$B我想他们只可能把神器带到一个地方去——废墟顶部的神殿。显然那里会有重兵把守。小心行事。
text.completion: Minions of the Old God? Two very potent foes have joined forces then. Their hope to defeat the Tidehunter may not be so foolish after all. $n, we can't let that happen. If Azshara defeats the Tidehunter and takes his power for herself, I'm not sure any number of us could ever hope to oppose her on the seas. The first step is clear at least - we need to hunt down the fiend that destroyed our ships. The navy was confident enough to bring in a new fleet, perhaps they have a plan.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Volaren at the Tranquil Wash.
text.objective2: Witness the Concluding Story of the Battlemaiden

english.title: Visions of the Past: Rise from the Deep
english.objectives: Witness the concluding story of the Battlemaiden by using her broken blade somewhere in the Temple of Quel'Dormir.
english.description: What you told me of the naga before has been plaguing my mind. Who are these allies they're summoning? Do they really think they can defeat the Tidehunter?$B$BEscaping this cave brings a degree of relief, but our purpose here remains. I'm hoping you will be willing to seek answers from the Battlemaiden one last time.$B$BThere's only one place that I can think of where they would have taken the artifact - the temple atop the ruins. It's sure to be well guarded. Proceed carefully.
english.completion: Minions of the Old God? Two very potent foes have joined forces then. Their hope to defeat the Tidehunter may not be so foolish after all. $n, we can't let that happen. If Azshara defeats the Tidehunter and takes his power for herself, I'm not sure any number of us could ever hope to oppose her on the seas. The first step is clear at least - we need to hunt down the fiend that destroyed our ships. The navy was confident enough to bring in a new fleet, perhaps they have a plan.
