english.objective2: Witness the Concluding Story of the Battlemaiden

text.title: 扳倒双牙
text.objectives: 夺取生锈的牢笼钥匙。
text.description: 财宝都是假的，不过那些洞穴践踏者才看不出来呢。愚蠢的食人魔！$B$B计划是这样的……你走进舰队司令的洞去，把“财宝”到处乱洒，贿赂食人魔。然后再去单挑托尼·双牙。$B$B钥匙就很容易到手了！
text.progress: What's going on? You gonna get me out of here?
text.completion: Yeah, yeah, yeah... I'm sure that your little adventure into the cave was very interesting. How about we talk about it over drinks back on the Speedbarge once you get me out of this cage?
text.completed: Return to Wizzle Brassbolts at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: Get the rusted cage key from the pirate admiral, Tony Two-Tusk.

english.title: Two-Tusk Takedown
english.objectives: Obtain the Rusted Cage Key.
english.description: This treasure's all fake, but it's not like those den whompers are going to know the difference. Stupid ogres!$B$BHere's the plan... you head into the Admiral's Den and spread all of this "treasure" around to any ogres that get in your way. Then all you have to do is confront Tony Two-Tusk.$B$BYou'll have the key to the cage in no-time!
english.progress: What's going on? You gonna get me out of here?
english.completion: Yeah, yeah, yeah... I'm sure that your little adventure into the cave was very interesting. How about we talk about it over drinks back on the Speedbarge once you get me out of this cage?
english.completed: Return to Wizzle Brassbolts at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Get the rusted cage key from the pirate admiral, Tony Two-Tusk.

text.title: 扳倒双牙
text.objectives: 夺取生锈的牢笼钥匙。
text.description: 财宝都是假的，不过那些洞穴践踏者才看不出来呢。愚蠢的食人魔！$B$B计划是这样的……你走进舰队司令的洞去，把“财宝”到处乱洒，贿赂食人魔。然后再去单挑托尼·双牙。$B$B钥匙就很容易到手了！
text.progress: What's going on? You gonna get me out of here?
text.completion: Yeah, yeah, yeah... I'm sure that your little adventure into the cave was very interesting. How about we talk about it over drinks back on the Speedbarge once you get me out of this cage?
text.completed: Return to Synge at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: Get the rusted cage key from the pirate admiral, Tony Two-Tusk.

english.title: Two-Tusk Takedown
english.objectives: Obtain the Rusted Cage Key.
english.description: This treasure's all fake, but it's not like those den whompers are going to know the difference. Stupid ogres!$B$BHere's the plan... you head into the Admiral's Den and spread all of this "treasure" around to any ogres that get in your way. Then all you have to do is confront Tony Two-Tusk.$B$BYou'll have the key to the cage in no-time!
english.progress: What's going on? You gonna get me out of here?
english.completion: Yeah, yeah, yeah... I'm sure that your little adventure into the cave was very interesting. How about we talk about it over drinks back on the Speedbarge once you get me out of this cage?
english.completed: Return to Synge at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Get the rusted cage key from the pirate admiral, Tony Two-Tusk.

text.title: 尊敬女士的帮手
text.objectives: 在战场上打败8名纳兹夏尔荣誉守卫的对手，给他们下达新的命令。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回影像。
text.description: 女武士！$B$B去战场上找到我的荣誉守卫，解决掉他们的对手。我需要他们立刻回来保卫女祭司们！$B$B我来守住入口，动作快！
text.completion: Well done, Battlemaiden.$B$BI will attend to the eastern bridge. I need you to attend to the temple itself. The ritual must not be interrupted.
text.completed: Return to Lady Naz'jar in front of the Temple of Quel'Dormir.

english.title: Her Lady's Hand
english.objectives: Defeat the opponents of 8 Naz'jar Honor Guard on the field of battle and deliver their new orders.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: Battlemaiden!$B$BFind my Honor Guard upon the field of battle and relieve them of their foes. I need them to return to guard the priestesses immediately!$B$BI will hold the entrance. Be swift!
english.completion: Well done, Battlemaiden.$B$BI will attend to the eastern bridge. I need you to attend to the temple itself. The ritual must not be interrupted.
english.completed: Return to Lady Naz'jar in front of the Temple of Quel'Dormir.

text.title: 海加尔山之火
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山艾森娜林地的莱恩娜·夜空谈一谈。
text.description: 你看见了没有，$N？山脊西南边……缕缕黑烟直冲天际。$B$B海加尔山在燃烧。$B$B假如火势已经蔓延到了山的这头，那么艾森娜林地和我们的部队显然就危险了。你能去调查一下吗？$B$B跟艾森娜林地的莱恩娜·夜空谈一谈。我听最新消息说她在那儿抵挡敌人的攻势。
text.completion: Can this wait, $c? The battle is not going well. Oh, you're here to help. I hope you don't mind a little heat...
text.completed: 跟海加尔山艾森娜林地的莱恩娜·夜空谈一谈。

english.title: The Fires of Mount Hyjal
english.objectives: Speak with Laina Nightsky near the Grove of Aessina in Hyjal.
english.description: Do you see it, $N? From the ridge southwest of here... plumes of black smoke curling into the sky.$B$BMount Hyjal is burning.$B$BIf the fires have raced this far up the mountain, surely they threaten the Grove of Aessina and all of our forces there. Can you investigate?$B$BSpeak with Laina Nightsky near the Grove of Aessina. Last I heard, she was fighting off the assault.
english.completion: Can this wait, $c? The battle is not going well. Oh, you're here to help. I hope you don't mind a little heat...
english.completed: Speak with Laina Nightsky near the Grove of Aessina in Hyjal.

text.title: 毫无防备
text.objectives: 杀死10名艾萨尔巡逻兵。
text.description: I can't imagine that our escape from the shell went unnoticed, but either the naga at these ruins were not informed or don't consider us a threat. I do not intend to take such opportunities for granted - we must strike now.$B$BI need you to slip into the lower level of the ruins and take out as many of their patrols as you can. We cannot risk any of those patrols finding out about our occupation of this cave - make sure none escape.

english.title: Caught Off-Guard
english.objectives: Kill 10 Azsh'ir Patrollers.
english.description: I can't imagine that our escape from the shell went unnoticed, but either the naga at these ruins were not informed or don't consider us a threat. I do not intend to take such opportunities for granted - we must strike now.$B$BI need you to slip into the lower level of the ruins and take out as many of their patrols as you can. We cannot risk any of those patrols finding out about our occupation of this cave - make sure none escape.

text.title: 蹑手蹑脚
text.objectives: Destroy 10 Azsh'ir Sentry Wards.
text.description: I've taken the liberty of performing some preliminary scouting. The naga may not be aware of out position, but they are not entirely unprepared for intruders.$B$BBeyond their patrols, they have set up magical sentry devices that will warn them of unwelcome guests. Fortunately, they seem to have sacrificed quality for quantity, and there is definitely a window in which the devices can be destroyed before their alarms are answered.$B$BI trust that you can see to this before our other soldiers arrive.

english.title: Swift Approach
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Azsh'ir Sentry Wards.
english.description: I've taken the liberty of performing some preliminary scouting. The naga may not be aware of out position, but they are not entirely unprepared for intruders.$B$BBeyond their patrols, they have set up magical sentry devices that will warn them of unwelcome guests. Fortunately, they seem to have sacrificed quality for quantity, and there is definitely a window in which the devices can be destroyed before their alarms are answered.$B$BI trust that you can see to this before our other soldiers arrive.

text.title: 时光的记录
text.objectives: Investigate the 6 in-tact statues in the Vashj'ir Gardens.
text.description: Look--$n is it?--I need your help. I know most everyone in this cave thinks that we're not in a position to be worrying about anything but our own hides right now, but we have an amazing opportunity here.$B$BThis was one of the royal cities of the elves in the days when Azshara was queen. In this city lie the keys to lore long lost and artifacts of unimaginable historical value. All I want from you, while you're out on your little jaunt, is to keep an eye out for exactly those kinds of things.

english.title: An Occupation of Time
english.objectives: Investigate the 6 in-tact statues in the Vashj'ir Gardens.
english.description: Look--$n is it?--I need your help. I know most everyone in this cave thinks that we're not in a position to be worrying about anything but our own hides right now, but we have an amazing opportunity here.$B$BThis was one of the royal cities of the elves in the days when Azshara was queen. In this city lie the keys to lore long lost and artifacts of unimaginable historical value. All I want from you, while you're out on your little jaunt, is to keep an eye out for exactly those kinds of things.

text.title: 奇袭点
text.objectives: Scout out the Garden Plaza, the Main Road, and the Temple District.
text.description: This cave is our only refuge. There's no place to which we can retreat. There's no help on the way. Whatever happens, this cave must remain safe or we are all sure to die down here.$B$BI have no intention of standing idle. The best way to keep the naga from finding us is to keep them off-balance, but we can't risk them following us back here between strikes. We need a forward post to launch or attacks from.$B$BI'd like you scout the ruins for a suitable base of operation. Something defensible.

english.title: A Better Vantage
english.objectives: Scout out the Garden Plaza, the Main Road, and the Temple District.
english.description: This cave is our only refuge. There's no place to which we can retreat. There's no help on the way. Whatever happens, this cave must remain safe or we are all sure to die down here.$B$BI have no intention of standing idle. The best way to keep the naga from finding us is to keep them off-balance, but we can't risk them following us back here between strikes. We need a forward post to launch or attacks from.$B$BI'd like you scout the ruins for a suitable base of operation. Something defensible.

text.title: 在战斗现场
text.objectives: Bring the broken shard back to THE CAVE.
text.description: 你周围曾经发生过一场激烈的战斗。纳迦骷髅不稀奇，但这些武器和他们对手留下的痕迹却出人意料。$B$B在骸骨中间，你发现一块奇怪得惹眼的金属从其中一个颅骨中扎出来。很难说它曾经是什么武器上的，不过它是如此地惹人注意，你无法不把它作为证据带走。$B$B洞里肯定会有人对这一发现感兴趣的。

english.title: Upon the Scene of Battle
english.objectives: Bring the broken shard back to THE CAVE.
english.description: All around you lie the remnants of a fierce battle. The naga skeletons are no surprise, but the weapons and remains of their apparent opponents are somewhat more unexpected.$B$BAmidst the bones, you spot a strangely prominent piece of metal jutting out from one of the skulls. It's difficult to tell what sort of weapon it might have once been part of, but it stands out sufficiently to prompt you to retrieve it as evidence.$B$BSurely someone back at the cave would be interested in this revelation.

text.title: Starve a Fever, Feed a Cold
text.objectives: Collect 4 Turtle Meats from Speckled Sea Turtles.
text.description: Mack is fading in and out of consciousness.$b$bIf he's going to make it, he's going to need all the help we can muster.$b$bI know a good recipe for turtle soup that's sure to warm him up.$b$bBring me some turtle meat and I'll handle the rest.
text.completed: Speak with Samir in Smuggler's Scar.

english.title: Starve a Fever, Feed a Cold
english.objectives: Collect 4 Turtle Meats from Speckled Sea Turtles.
english.description: Mack is fading in and out of consciousness.$b$bIf he's going to make it, he's going to need all the help we can muster.$b$bI know a good recipe for turtle soup that's sure to warm him up.$b$bBring me some turtle meat and I'll handle the rest.
english.completed: Speak with Samir in Smuggler's Scar.

text.title: 响应深水领主的号召
text.objectives: 消灭纳舒拉平台上的16名克瓦迪尔人。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回到影像中。
text.description: 深水领主金加塔尔来消息说克瓦迪尔首领露面了。我希望你能到上层平台的尽头去找他，他就在废墟的中层部分：纳舒拉平台那里。$B$B杀掉胆敢挡路的克瓦迪尔人。我们要让这次败北回荡在他们的脑中，让他们不敢再来滋扰我们。$B$B你的忠诚不会被无视，我的女武士。有我的祝福，去吧。
text.completion: It is good of you to join me, Battlemaiden. The echoes of your combat graced your approach. It was a beautiful sound to behold.
text.completed: Report to Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar on the southern portion of Nar'shola Terrace.
text.objective1: Kvaldir invaders on the terrace slain

english.title: To the Fathom-Lord's Call
english.objectives: Kill 16 Kvaldir on Nar'shola Terrace, the middle level of the ruins.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar has sent word that the Kvaldir leader has shown himself. I would like you to make your way to him at the far end of the terrace above us, on the middle level of the ruins: Nar'shola Terrace.$B$BKill any Kvaldir that stand in your path on that terrace. We want the echoes of this defeat to ring in their minds so that they will dare not return to threaten our purpose here.$B$BYour devotion does not go unnoticed, my battlemaiden. Go knowing that you have my blessing.
english.completion: It is good of you to join me, Battlemaiden. The echoes of your combat graced your approach. It was a beautiful sound to behold.
english.completed: Report to Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar on the southern portion of Nar'shola Terrace.
english.objective1: Kvaldir invaders on the terrace slain

text.title: 绝望的请求
text.objectives: Take the Soggy Note to Erunak at Shallow's End.
text.description: 瓶中的笔记被海水浸湿了，但上面的字迹尚可辨认。$B$B作者说自己从海底的纳迦监狱里逃了出来。$B$B字里行间透露出难以抑制的恐慌，你不禁猜测他说不定是被绑架的船员之一。$B$B你也不知道该上哪儿找逃亡者，不妨将这本笔记给埃鲁纳克瞧瞧。
text.completion: If he still lives, I may be able to locate this poor soul.

english.title: A Desperate Plea
english.objectives: Take the Soggy Note to Erunak at Shallow's End.
english.description: The note in this bottle is soaked through, but still legible.$b$bIn it, the author claims to have escaped from some sort of undersea naga prison.$b$bHe is clearly in fear for his life, and you can't help but wonder if it might be one of your recently abducted shipmates.$b$bAt a loss as to how to locate the escapee, you determine to share the find with Erunak.
english.completion: If he still lives, I may be able to locate this poor soul.

text.title: 炸弹投放：狂风矿洞！
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉狂风矿洞的“齿轮语者”布格。
text.description: 至于你在银风避难所发现的那枚巨型地精炸弹，其位置我们已经知道了。$B$B你还记得布格吗？你从兽人拷问车里救出来的那个侏儒？是这样，他和明克斯查到炸弹就在狂风矿洞。马上到那儿去，$N！他们正在等你。
text.completion: Good to see you again, $n. Thanks for the rescue in Ashenvale. Damn shame about all the gnomes we lost. You ready to get down to business?

english.title: Bombs Away: Windshear Mine!
english.objectives: Report to Boog the "Gear Whisperer" at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Ve have discovered ze vhereabouts of ze gigantic goblin bomb zat you discovered at Silvervind Refuge.$B$BYou remember Boog? Ze gnome you rescued from ze orcish vagon of agony? Vell, he and Minx have tracked ze bomb down to Windshear Mine. Go zhere immediately, $N! Zey'll be expecting you.
english.completion: Good to see you again, $n. Thanks for the rescue in Ashenvale. Damn shame about all the gnomes we lost. You ready to get down to business?

text.title: The Flow of Muisek
text.objectives: Deliver the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
text.description: I've done all I can for you. Muisek stronger than the hippogryph just isn't within my power to work with yet, so I won't make you deal with the disaster that could bring.$B$BBut while you've been busy, I've fully readied the hippogryph muisek. Take it to my master, Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache. He can create powerful weapons with it, and hopefully he'll be impressed by what I've done.
text.progress: I sense something familiar in your presence...
text.completion: Well done indeed... I'd expect nothing less from my own daughter. She'll make a fine witch doctor someday.

english.title: The Flow of Muisek
english.objectives: Deliver the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
english.description: I've done all I can for you. Muisek stronger than the hippogryph just isn't within my power to work with yet, so I won't make you deal with the disaster that could bring.$B$BBut while you've been busy, I've fully readied the hippogryph muisek. Take it to my master, Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache. He can create powerful weapons with it, and hopefully he'll be impressed by what I've done.
english.progress: I sense something familiar in your presence...
english.completion: Well done indeed... I'd expect nothing less from my own daughter. She'll make a fine witch doctor someday.

text.title: 别瞧他们的眼睛
text.objectives: 收集10份天青铁矿石样本。
text.description: 低头，$N。别引起不必要的注意。$B$B看来兽人在把矿洞里的某种矿石朝气球上装。去那里把矿石从兽人手上拿来。不管你弄到什么，都带给我，我把它们送给教授去检查。$B$B你去之前，有几句忠告：你可以轻松避开克罗姆加，因为一、他们又蠢又脏；二、他们带着矿石啥都看不见。当然了，要想拿到矿石，你还是要把他们杀掉才行。
text.progress: Get me those ore samples!
text.completion: Not too much trouble, I hope. With these samples we should be able to figure out what they plan to do with the ore and the big bomb.

english.title: Don't Look Them in the Eyes
english.objectives: Collect 10 Azure Iron Ore samples.
english.description: Keep your head down, $N. No need to draw unwanted attention.$B$BLooks like the orcs are piling that balloon up with some type of ore from the mine. Get in there and take the ore from the orcs. Bring me back whatever you manage to grab and I'll ship it off to the professor for examination.$B$BBefore you go, a word of advice: you can avoid the Krom'gar pretty easily in there as (1) they're dumb as dirt and (2) they can't see anything if they're carrying ore. Of course, you need to kill them to get their ore.
english.progress: Get me those ore samples!
english.completion: Not too much trouble, I hope. With these samples we should be able to figure out what they plan to do with the ore and the big bomb.

text.title: 黑雾废墟
text.objectives: 在黑雾废墟寻找圣者帕尔伦纳描述的护符。
text.description: 我被各种幻象困扰不堪，$C。都是在预示着一个具有强大力量的形象落入了邪恶之手。我看见了一枚护符，被上古精灵们保存着……无人问津，与此同时，护符周围的一切化为了废墟，直到恶魔利用欺诈和恶毒的手段将它收入囊中。$B$B每天晚上，这些景象就会浮现在我的梦中。但是我年事已高，营地的勇士们又忙于保卫我们而抽不开身。我只能请求你依照我的幻象提示，前往南边的黑雾废墟里，找到那块护符。

english.title: The Darkmist Ruins
english.objectives: Search the Darkmist Ruins for the amulet Sage Palerunner described.
english.description: I have been beset by visions, $c. Visions of an icon of great power falling into sinister hands. I see an amulet, held by the ancient elves...sitting forgotten while its surroundings turn to ruins, until it is captured by demons through treachery and malice.$B$BEvery night, these sights flow through my dreams. The spirits are warning us. I am too old, and the camp's braves too occupied with guarding us. I must beseech you to follow my visions to the south, to the Darkmist Ruins, and seek out the amulet.

text.title: 暮光龙卵
text.objectives: Take the Pure Twilight Egg to Aronus at the Gates of Sothann in Hyjal.
text.description: 这枚龙卵同你以前所见过的大不相同。它那半透明的外壳似乎将周围的光线都扭曲了。$B$B旁边有张字条，记叙着一条多产的龙母是如何来到升腾者高地的。$B$B也许你该把这个带给阿隆努斯看。
text.completion: You were right to come to me with this, $n.  This represents a great threat to us if we do not act swiftly and boldly.

english.title: The Twilight Egg
english.objectives: Take the Pure Twilight Egg to Aronus at the Gates of Sothann in Hyjal.
english.description: The egg is unlike any that you've seen before.  Its translucent shell appears to bend the light around it.$B$BAccompanying it, you find a note describing the arrival of a fertile broodmother at the Ascendant's Rise.$B$BPerhaps you should show this to Aronus.
english.completion: You were right to come to me with this, $n.  This represents a great threat to us if we do not act swiftly and boldly.

text.title: Return to Sage Palerunner
text.objectives: Bring the Darkmist Amulet to Sage Palerunner.
text.description: The soft glow from the pedestal brightens, and you can see a simple chain left behind. This must be the amulet Sage Palerunner sent you here for...
text.progress: You've returned. What have you found?
text.completion: I am a fool...I was misled. This is nothing more than a rusted trinket, and my visions have no doubt been fulfilled. Forgive me, $n. But should you meet this demoness again, I pray you will triumph over her as you did Verinias.

english.title: Return to Sage Palerunner
english.objectives: Bring the Darkmist Amulet to Sage Palerunner.
english.description: The soft glow from the pedestal brightens, and you can see a simple chain left behind. This must be the amulet Sage Palerunner sent you here for...
english.progress: You've returned. What have you found?
english.completion: I am a fool...I was misled. This is nothing more than a rusted trinket, and my visions have no doubt been fulfilled. Forgive me, $n. But should you meet this demoness again, I pray you will triumph over her as you did Verinias.

text.title: 狂风矿洞大扫除
text.objectives: 杀死6名风剪监工。
text.description: 部落侵占了狂风矿洞。我不确定这些兽人在里面寻找什么，或者他们的目的为何，但我知道肯定没有好事。到矿洞里去，干掉管理层。没有了地精监工，那些苦工就什么都不是。$B$B进去以后，眼睛放尖点，看看有没有关于部落采矿行动的情报。$B$B祝你好运！
text.completion: Nice job, I could hear their shrill screams from out here. You've turned the whole place on its head! Did you happen to find any other information about the mining operation?
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Heliana at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Windshear Mine Cleanup
english.objectives: Kill 6 Windshear Overseers.
english.description: The Horde has overrun Windshear Mine. I'm not sure what these orcs are hauling out of here or why they're here, but I know that it can't be good. Get in that mine and take out the management. Without goblin overseers, these peons will be even more worthless.$B$BWhile you're inside, keep your eyes peeled for any other information about the Horde operation in the mines.$B$BGood luck!
english.completion: Nice job, I could hear their shrill screams from out here. You've turned the whole place on its head! Did you happen to find any other information about the mining operation?
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Heliana at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 字迹模糊的兽人信件
text.objectives: 把字迹模糊的兽人信件交给石爪山脉狂风矿洞的“齿轮语者”布格。
text.description: 你发现了一张羊皮纸，上面郑重其事地盖着部落的蜡印。不幸的是，文件的其余部分字迹模糊，还是用兽人语写就的。$B$B把这封信交给布格。他也许知道该怎么做！
text.progress: What have you got there?
text.completion: Interesting. Hrm... Troubling... Can't understand a damn thing written here - if that is writing. Could just be toilet paper. Sure smells like it.

english.title: Illegible Orc Letter
english.objectives: Take the Illegible Orc Letter to Boog the "Gear Whisperer" at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: You've discovered a parchment with an impressive looking Horde seal imprinted upon its page. Unfortunately, the rest of the document is completely illegible as it is in orcish.$B$BTake the letter to Boog. He might know what to do with it!
english.progress: What have you got there?
english.completion: Interesting. Hrm... Troubling... Can't understand a damn thing written here - if that is writing. Could just be toilet paper. Sure smells like it.

text.title: 杜隆塔尔之外
text.objectives: 前往艾萨拉的奥格瑞玛后门，向阿格图·血拳报到。
text.description: 嗯……看样子，别的地方也需要你的帮助。阿格图·血拳正在招募新兵，协助部落在奥格瑞玛北边的艾萨拉地区的行动。$B$B我相信你在杜隆塔尔这边肯定还有事情要做，我也明白，贫瘠之地很快就会寻求你的帮助。如果我是你的话，我就暂时哪都不去，不过如果你渴望干出一番大事来……就去艾萨拉吧。
text.completion: Good, you're here.  Welcome to Azshara, the stage for the next act of the Horde's glorious future.  Now get to work.

english.title: Beyond Durotar
english.objectives: Report to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.
english.description: Hmmph... it looks like your services are being requested elsewhere.  Ag'tor Bloodfist is looking for recruits to assist the Horde's ventures in Azshara, north of Orgrimmar.$b$bI'm sure you still have work to do here in Durotar, and I understand that they'll shortly be asking for your help in the Barrens.  I wouldn't be going anywhere yet if I were you, but if you're itching for some manifest destiny... Azshara awaits.
english.completion: Good, you're here.  Welcome to Azshara, the stage for the next act of the Horde's glorious future.  Now get to work.

text.title: 明克斯能破译
text.objectives: 把字迹模糊的兽人信件交给石爪山脉狂风矿洞的明克斯
text.description: 好消息是明克斯精通兽人语，而且她就在附近。回到矿洞里去找到她。她也许在更深一点的地方，无所事事地站着。$B$B别忘了把那信也带上！
text.progress: What have you got there?
text.completion: Uh oh... Disgusting! The good news is that this isn't toilet paper. The bad news is that the ink on this paper is a mixture of kodo poop and blood. That's not the worst of it, though...

english.title: Minx'll Fix It
english.objectives: Take the Illegible Orc Letter to Minx inside the Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: The good news is that Minx is fluent in orcish and she's nearby. Head back into the mine and find her. She's probably deeper inside, standing around being useless.$B$BDon't forget the parchment!
english.progress: What have you got there?
english.completion: Uh oh... Disgusting! The good news is that this isn't toilet paper. The bad news is that the ink on this paper is a mixture of kodo poop and blood. That's not the worst of it, though...

text.title: 高级指挥官的命令
text.objectives: 把翻译好的兽人信件交给石爪山脉狂风矿洞的“齿轮语者”布格。
text.description: 这封信实际上是部落高级指挥官的命令。克罗姆加大王下令要将这座矿洞“挖地三尺”，为的是获得一种叫做天青铁矿石的碎片，估计是从矿石上剥离下来。$B$B更糟糕的是，他们打算把碎片和外面巨型炸弹里的炸药混合，炸掉风剪要塞。$B$B我们没有时间了，$N！把这份信件翻译稿带给布格！他知道下面该怎么做。
text.progress: Well? What's it say?
text.completion: This is bad. Really, really bad. You have to warn Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold. What in the... It's MOVING! The goblin balloon is taking off! We're too late!

english.title: Orders from High Command
english.objectives: Take the Translated Orc Letter to Boog the "Gear Whisperer" at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: The letter is actually an order from Horde high command. Someone named Overlord Krom'gar has issued a "strip job" on this mine in order to obtain something called azure iron flake. Presumably this flake is obtained from breaking down the ore.$B$BIt gets worse. They plan to mix the azure flake with the explosives sitting inside the huge bomb outside and blow up Windshear Hold.$B$BWe don't have a moment to lose, $N! Take this translated copy of the letter and return to Boog! He'll know what to do next.
english.progress: Well? What's it say?
english.completion: This is bad. Really, really bad. You have to warn Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold. What in the... It's MOVING! The goblin balloon is taking off! We're too late!

text.title: 噢，可怕的疯癫！
text.objectives: 在戈博格海崖收集50枚被窃的炮弹，海地精贮藏者也携带着这种炮弹。将收集到的炮弹制成一桶火药。
text.description: 嗯，我一直在想……$B$B如果有个疯子发癫，他自己会知道吗？$B$B举个例子，我发誓我已经用炮弹制成了一桶火药，可是现在怎么都找不到了。$B$B我还清楚地记得我从西边的海地精手里抢来了炮弹。$B$B或许别人说得对……可能真的被我给弄丢了。
text.progress: You want nuthin' to do with me, $r. I'm a touch... screwy.
text.completion: My gunpowder! You found it! I'm not crazy after all!
text.completed: Speak to Budd at Budd's Dig in the Kelp'thar Forest in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Oh, the Insanity!
english.objectives: Collect 50 Pilfered Cannonballs from Gurboggle's Ledge and from Gilblin Hoarders. Use the Cannonballs to create a Barrel of Gunpowder.
english.description: So, I've been thinkin'...$b$bIf someone's out-of-their-mind-guano-crazy, do they know it?$b$bCase in point, I coulda swore that I'd collected a barrel of gunpowder from the cannonballs around here, but it's nowhere ta be found.$b$bI distinctly remember lifting the cannonballs from them Gilblins just west of here.$b$bMaybe they're right... maybe I really have lost it.
english.progress: You want nuthin' to do with me, $r. I'm a touch... screwy.
english.completion: My gunpowder! You found it! I'm not crazy after all!
english.completed: Speak to Budd at Budd's Dig in the Kelp'thar Forest in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 操纵气球！
text.objectives: 爬到克罗姆加热气球里去，阻止它摧毁风剪要塞。
text.description: 我们一刻都不能浪费了，$N。你得操纵那个热气球，让它停下来！$B$B怎么做？我根本不知道！没时间争论细节了！爬上那根绳梯！进去以后就大闹一场！$B$B如果你碰巧成功地把气球停了下来，并且还活着的话，就去西边的风剪要塞找指挥官法罗米尔。$B$B祝你好运，我们全靠你了。抱歉，我得失陪一下，因为我要逃命去啦！
text.completion: Amazing story, lad. I'd have never believed you had I not seen it with my own eyes. You did enough damage to that balloon to make those fiends pull back! Alas, the threat is far from over. We have only delayed the attack. There is much work to do if we are to stop the Horde from destroying Stonetalon!
text.completed: Report to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Commandeer That Balloon!
english.objectives: Ride the Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon and attempt to stop it from destroying Windshear Hold.
english.description: We don't have a moment to lose, $N. You're going to have to commandeer that hot air balloon and stop it!$B$BHow? I have no idea! We don't have time to argue details! Grab onto that rope ladder and climb up! Just start banging on stuff once you're inside!$B$BIf you somehow manage to stop the balloon and survive, report to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in the west.$B$BGood luck, we're all counting on you. Now if you'll excuse me I'm going to RUN FOR MY LIFE!
english.completion: Amazing story, lad. I'd have never believed you had I not seen it with my own eyes. You did enough damage to that balloon to make those fiends pull back! Alas, the threat is far from over. We have only delayed the attack. There is much work to do if we are to stop the Horde from destroying Stonetalon!
english.completed: Report to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 古神们与我们同在
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山诺达希尔的伊瑟拉。
text.description: 涅墨西斯……被消灭了。$B$B我感觉再度恢复了活力。$B强大。$B清醒。$B$B告诉伊瑟拉，她随时可以借助我的力量。$B$B暮光之锤必将灭亡。
text.completion: By relieving Tortolla of his final burdens you have acquired for us a formidable ally... and the final piece of the puzzle. Steel yourself, $n. The most difficult part of our journey is to begin. We will bring the fight to their stronghold.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山诺达希尔的伊瑟拉。

english.title: The Ancients are With Us
english.objectives: Return to Ysera at Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Nemesis... destroyed.$B$BI feel rejuvenated.$BPowerful.$BAwakened.$B$BTell Ysera my strength is hers.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer will fall.
english.completion: By relieving Tortolla of his final burdens you have acquired for us a formidable ally... and the final piece of the puzzle. Steel yourself, $n. The most difficult part of our journey is to begin. We will bring the fight to their stronghold.
english.completed: Return to Ysera at Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 黑暗之心
text.objectives: 击败艾丹娜·邪爪，获得艾丹娜的黑色坠饰。
text.description: 艾丹娜·邪爪是北泉鹰身人的女王，她就栖息在西边的废墟中。就是她心怀恶意地指挥着鹰身人，以守卫着他们巢穴为名霸占着我们民众的家园废墟。$B$B鹰身人可以使用随身携带的号角召唤她，在废墟北边邪爪之石附近吹响它，就能召唤艾丹娜。$B$B对那些卑鄙的生物不要心慈手软。杀掉她，把她的黑色坠饰带给我。
text.progress: We must not tolerate the infestation of our ancestor's ruins by the harpies.
text.completion: These lands will finally be free of the foulness of the harpies. I cannot thank you enough.
text.completed: Return to Erina Willowborn at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas.
text.giverWindow: Search for the Hatetalon stones, then blast the horn. She will come.

english.title: Dark Heart
english.objectives: Slay Edana Hatetalon and obtain Edana's Dark Heart.
english.description: Edana Hatetalon is the queen of the Northspring harpies that reside in the ruins to the west. It is her malicious will that leads the harpies to defend their nests among the ruins of our people.$B$BThe harpies can call to her with a horn they carry - blowing it by the Hatetalon stones, in the northern part of the ruins, will summon Edana.$B$BShow no mercy for these foul creatures. Slay her, and bring her dark heart to me.
english.progress: We must not tolerate the infestation of our ancestor's ruins by the harpies.
english.completion: These lands will finally be free of the foulness of the harpies. I cannot thank you enough.
english.completed: Return to Erina Willowborn at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas.
english.giverWindow: Search for the Hatetalon stones, then blast the horn. She will come.

text.title: 虫翅问题
text.objectives: 消灭任意种类的10名虫翅鹰身人（尖啸者或者迅爪刺客。）
text.description: 啸天者欧穆隆对虫翅鹰身人也太心软了，居然允许他们在山头上也有一席之地。就因为大家都是天上的生物。我说$C，天上的生物可并不见得就得平等。$B$B当海加尔攻势开始的时候，虫翅就发了狂。他们现在就在上面，试图要攻下自己一度尊崇的神圣祭坛。$B$B我倒不操心这个，现在咱们总算有理由把他们赶出海加尔山了，不是吗？
text.completion: Feels great to be off the leash, doesn't it?
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal.

english.title: The Wormwing Problem
english.objectives: Slay any combination of 10 Wormwing Harpies (either Screechers or Swifttalons).
english.description: Skylord Omnuron has been too gentle with the Wormwing harpies. He allows them to share a perch on this mountain just because they're creatures of the air. Well $c, not all creatures of the air are created equal.$B$BWhen the attacks on Hyjal began, the Wormwing went into a frenzy. They're up there right now, assaulting a sacred shrine they once claimed to revere.$B$BI'm not troubled. Now we have a reason to drive them from Hyjal, don't we?
english.completion: Feels great to be off the leash, doesn't it?
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal.

text.title: 夺回巨蛋
text.objectives: 收集8枚海加尔巨蛋。
text.description: 虫翅的进攻是有规律可循的。有些堂而皇之地从正面攻击圣殿，而其他的就俯冲到附近的鸟巢里攫走海加尔飞行生物的蛋。$B$B这些动物归我们保护，因此在弄明白虫翅为什么要这么干之前，我们得尽量从它们的利爪下把鸟蛋抢救下来。
text.progress: <Thisalee is cleaning her nails with a dagger. She looks up at you expectantly.>
text.completion: Good, that's a start. The birds who laid these eggs will never accept them again, so we'll have to raise these birds as orphans in the shrine here. Were Aviana here, she never would've let this travesty happen. But, on to business...
text.completed: Bring the eggs to Thisalee Crow at the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal.

english.title: Scrambling for Eggs
english.objectives: Gather 8 Hyjal Eggs.
english.description: There's a pattern to these Wormwing attacks. While groups make a showy assault on the shrine itself, others swoop into the nearby nests and make off with eggs from all the flying creatures of Hyjal.$B$BThese animals are under our protection. Before we find out why the Wormwing are doing this, it's up to us to rescue as many eggs as we can from their talons.
english.progress: <Thisalee is cleaning her nails with a dagger. She looks up at you expectantly.>
english.completion: Good, that's a start. The birds who laid these eggs will never accept them again, so we'll have to raise these birds as orphans in the shrine here. Were Aviana here, she never would've let this travesty happen. But, on to business...
english.completed: Bring the eggs to Thisalee Crow at the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal.

text.title: 大白鲨逼近
text.objectives: 巴德要你对放置在骸骨珊瑚礁的生锈的猎鱼枪使用诱杀虫饵。
text.description: 既然你对我这么好，我就跟你分享一个大秘密吧。$B$B我找到了一件大得无以伦比的宝贝，离我们所站的地方不到50步！$B$B只有一件事情挡在你我和发财之间——它叫利颚。$B$B不要急，我有一个计划。$B$B利颚很喜欢吃虫子，所以我在虫饵里添加了炸药，用它做了一个陷阱，你明白了吗？$B$B只要让它浮在暗礁中，等那条鲨鱼死掉之后，我们就发财了！
text.completion: Amazing! You watch the great white beast swim off into the depths and wonder to yourself if anything could ever take him down...
text.completed: Speak with Budd at Budd's Dig in the Kelp'thar Forest.
text.giverWindow: These waters are far from safe!

english.title: Dah, Nunt... Dah, Nunt...
english.objectives: Budd wants you to use the Booby-Trapped Bait at the Rusty Harpoon Gun in the Skeletal Reef.
english.description: So, seein' as ya been so kind to me, I'm inclined to let you in on a special secret.$b$bI've found the biggest shiney of all, no more than 50 steps from where we're standin'!$b$bOnly one thing stands between you, me, and great fortune - and his name is Gnaws.$b$bDon't fret now - I've got a plan.$b$bGnaws loves his grubs, so I've loaded one up with that gunpowder so as to make like a trap of sorts, ya see?$b$bJust set it floatin' up in the reef. Once the shark is dead, we're rich!
english.completion: Amazing! You watch the great white beast swim off into the depths and wonder to yourself if anything could ever take him down...
english.completed: Speak with Budd at Budd's Dig in the Kelp'thar Forest.
english.giverWindow: These waters are far from safe!

text.title: 耐久的设施
text.objectives: 重启6处纳舒拉防御屏障。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回到影像中。
text.description: 女士，高阶祭司有一个任务要我传达。城中的许多防御设施都在沉入海底时保留了下来，若不是有无数的克瓦迪尔人阻拦，要将它们重新启动起来易如反掌。$B$B我们听说您将在上面的纳舒拉平台英勇善战，若能途经之时顺手启动那些装置，将是为大功一件。您的高贵血统亦将倍加显赫。
text.completion: The Nar'shola Wards are performing perfectly. I will inform the Mistress of the Tides of your aid immediately.$B$BThank you for your assistance, my lady.
text.completed: Speak to the Sira'kess Tide Priestess on the southern portion of Nar'shola Terrace.

english.title: Built to Last
english.objectives: Reactivate 6 Nar'shola Wards on the middle level of the ruins: Narshola Terrace.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: My lady, I have a request from the High Priestess that I am to pass along to you. Many of the city's defenses remain from long before it sunk beneath the waves, and some of them are but a trivial task to reactivate, were it not for the countless Kvaldir that stand in our way.$B$BWe are told you are to be fighting on Nar'shola Terrace above us. You would do my lady a great service if you would but touch some of the devices as you pass. Your noble blood should prove more than sufficient to reactivate them.
english.completion: The Nar'shola Wards are performing perfectly. I will inform the Mistress of the Tides of your aid immediately.$B$BThank you for your assistance, my lady.
english.completed: Speak to the Sira'kess Tide Priestess on the southern portion of Nar'shola Terrace.

text.title: 难以遗忘的往事
text.objectives: 杀死冷酷的瓦尔库。$B$B这项任务是纳兹夏尔女武士幻象的一部分。如有必要，可使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃返回幻象。
text.description: 克瓦迪尔首领有一张腐烂且丑陋的脸，他已经在我们西边的大厅尽头处现身了，游过去很快。如果能干掉瓦尔库，克瓦迪尔侵占我们的城市的行动就会终止。$B$B当心点，女武士。他不容易对付。瓦尔库麾下有很多克瓦迪尔战士。我会指派几名希拉柯丝海巫跟你并肩而战，但是克瓦迪尔战士会打断海巫的施法。$B$B不要手下留情，女武士。
text.progress: Your foe is but a short swim down this hall. Go, and bring death with you.
text.completion: <The Kvaldir General crumples to the ground, defeated.>$B$B<With this, the ruins of Vashj'ir have been claimed for Lady Naz'jar. Her ultimate goals remain uncertain, but it is clear that the naga came here with purpose.>$B$B<If only you could continue, you are sure that the answers to defeating the naga lie within this vision, but the Wavespeaker's magics are waning, and you are losing your connection with the Battlemaiden.>
text.completed: Return to Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar on the southern portion of Nar'shola Terrace.
text.giverWindow: Leader of the Kvaldir forces in Vashj'ir, Varkul is known for being prideful and fearless.

english.title: Not Soon Forgotten
english.objectives: Kill Varkul the Unrelenting.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: The Kvaldir leader has shown his rotting, ugly face but a short swim from here, down this hall to our west. We kill him now and the Kvaldir occupation of our once beloved city shall be ended.$B$BBeware Battlemaiden, for he is no weakling. He has many Kvaldir at his command. Some Sira'kess Sea Witches have been dispatched to weaken him during your attack, but they will be interrupted if you let any of his Kvaldir attack them.$B$BShow no mercy, Battlemaiden.
english.progress: Your foe is but a short swim down this hall. Go, and bring death with you.
english.completion: <The Kvaldir General crumples to the ground, defeated.>$B$B<With this, the ruins of Vashj'ir have been claimed for Lady Naz'jar. Her ultimate goals remain uncertain, but it is clear that the naga came here with purpose.>$B$B<If only you could continue, you are sure that the answers to defeating the naga lie within this vision, but the Wavespeaker's magics are waning, and you are losing your connection with the Battlemaiden.>
english.completed: Return to Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar on the southern portion of Nar'shola Terrace.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the Kvaldir forces in Vashj'ir, Varkul is known for being prideful and fearless.

text.title: 鬼上身
text.objectives: 同千针石林南海据点的阿加蒙·招魂者交谈。
text.description: 你以为你把我杀了我就会轻易放过你吗？没门！我白手起家建起商业帝国，可不是让你来扳倒的。$B$B你得帮我重新复活。去据点北方找我的前妻阿加蒙。你就循着气味儿找吧，她走哪儿都带着那口臭气熏天的药锅子。
text.completion: What ya be wantin'? Oh no you don't. I can see ya got Tony's spirit with ya, and I want nothin' to do with it!

english.title: Haunted
english.objectives: Speak with Ajamon Ghostcaller at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.description: You think I'm going to just let you go after you killed me like that, mon? No way! I didn't create a piratical mercantile empire out of nothing just to see you bring me down.$B$BYou're going to help me get back to life. Find my ex-wife, Ajamon, on the north side of the Holdfast. Just follow your nose. She'll be wherever the stinky brewing cauldron is.
english.completion: What ya be wantin'? Oh no you don't. I can see ya got Tony's spirit with ya, and I want nothin' to do with it!

text.title: 帮点小忙……
text.objectives: 找齐邪恶人偶、老海盗法哈多和“旱鸭子”莉莉的徽记。
text.description: Fine, I be helpin' ya. He not gettin' outa payin' me alimony that easy! 'Sides, there be the baby he had with me sistah ta take care of!$B$BFirst thing we needin' is the innards of his closest friends. That'd be his cap'ns.$B$BGo down there an pay the three of them a visit.
text.progress: A fresh heart, lungs, an' liver be what we needin'. The ones from his cap'ns will have ta do though they all be likely picked.
text.completion: They's gonna have ta do. It not be like he had many friends. Ain't that right, Two-Tusk?
text.completed: Return to Ajamon Ghostcaller at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.

english.title: With a Little Help...
english.objectives: Collect Evil Dolly's Heart, Seadog Fajardo's Lungs, and Lilly Landlubber's Liver.
english.description: Fine, I be helpin' ya. He not gettin' outa payin' me alimony that easy! 'Sides, there be the baby he had with me sistah ta take care of!$B$BFirst thing we needin' is the innards of his closest friends. That'd be his cap'ns.$B$BGo down there an pay the three of them a visit.
english.progress: A fresh heart, lungs, an' liver be what we needin'. The ones from his cap'ns will have ta do though they all be likely picked.
english.completion: They's gonna have ta do. It not be like he had many friends. Ain't that right, Two-Tusk?
english.completed: Return to Ajamon Ghostcaller at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 解救我们的姐妹
text.objectives: 获得5把部落牢笼钥匙，解救5名被俘的女猎手。
text.description: 昨天早上我派一队女猎手前往狂风峭壁执行任务，收集部落在石爪山的行动情报。前线来消息报告说包括队长女猎手伊莉奥娜在内，她们都被俘了。$B$B到东边的狂风峭壁去，杀掉占据峭壁的克罗姆加步兵，从他们的尸体上拿到钥匙，打开囚禁我们姐妹的部落牢笼。$B$B解救女猎手后，想办法找到女猎手伊莉奥娜。
text.completion: We don't have much time. To get me out of here you are going to have to take out Warlord Roktrog. He holds the key to this prison.
text.completed: Find Huntress Illiona at Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Free Our Sisters
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Horde Cage Keys to free 5 Captured Huntresses.
english.description: Yesterday morning I dispatched a squadron of huntresses on a mission into Windshear Crag to obtain information about Horde operations in Stonetalon. Field intelligence reports that they have all been captured, including their squad leader, Huntress Illiona.$B$BHead east into Windshear Crag and slay the Krom'gar infantry that occupy the crag and take from them their keys to unlock the Horde cages holding our sisters.$B$BDo your best to locate Illiona once you've freed the huntresses.
english.completion: We don't have much time. To get me out of here you are going to have to take out Warlord Roktrog. He holds the key to this prison.
english.completed: Find Huntress Illiona at Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 献给艾维娜的祭品
text.objectives: 在艾维娜的墓葬法阵里使用圣水。
text.description: 尽管百禽守护者的肉身无法与我们长在，但我有时依然能在落叶的低语中听到她的声音。$B$B$N，你刚开始着手保卫山峦，我们就提出了这么多要求。在你出发前，请稍事思考。$B$B带上这奉献之圣水到艾维娜的石制墓葬法阵去，它就在圣殿主门外。也许同艾维娜的记忆少许独处，能帮你理清你的头脑。
text.progress: <The spirit fades in and out of your vision, as though here and elsewhere at the same time.>
text.completion: To be born again, but in darkness... I have been stolen away.
text.completed: Speak to the Mysterious Winged Spirit outside of the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: An Offering for Aviana
english.objectives: Use the Sacred Nectar at Aviana's Burial Circle.
english.description: Although the guardian of all winged creatures is no longer with us in body, I sometimes hear her voice in the whisper of swaying leaves.$B$B$N, we ask much of you as you set out to preserve this mountain. Before going on, take a moment to reflect.$B$BTake this offering of nectar to Aviana's burial circle, a circle of stones just outside the main door of the shrine. Perhaps some time alone with Aviana's memory will help sharpen your focus.
english.progress: <The spirit fades in and out of your vision, as though here and elsewhere at the same time.>
english.completion: To be born again, but in darkness... I have been stolen away.
english.completed: Speak to the Mysterious Winged Spirit outside of the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 翅膀与祈祷
text.objectives: 在世界之脊上找到任意一处布雷瑟的巢穴并使用巨鸟召唤哨，然后击败布雷瑟，获取他的一根远古之羽。
text.description: 一个带翅膀的幻影？难道是……？$B$B$N，没时间浪费了。和你对话的可能就是艾维娜，她试图要回到我们中间。$B$B我需要艾维娜过去的一些东西来同她建立联系。在俯瞰圣殿的山脊上，你可以找到许多巢穴，它们属于布雷瑟，那是一头曾经是她配偶的猛禽。一万年来，他已经被悲伤折磨得失去了理智。$B$B到他其中的一个栖息地去，用这只哨子来召唤他。杀掉布雷瑟，把他的一根羽毛给我带来。
text.progress: Don't trouble yourself over Blaithe's condition. Grief robbed that creature of a soul epochs ago. He was but a shell of his former self, a beast of pure rage.
text.completion: That was nasty work, $n, but it had to be done. And if Aviana is truly to be resurrected, then perhaps your actions have enabled Blaithe to someday come back as well? Now let's see if we can contact our long lost guardian...
text.completed: Take the Ancient Feather back to Choluna within the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: Use the Enormous Bird Call to summon Blaithe.

english.title: A Prayer and a Wing
english.objectives: Use the Enormous Bird Call at one of Blaithe's Nests perched atop the Rim of the World. Kill Blaithe and gather one of his Ancient Feathers.
english.description: A winged visage? Could it be...?$B$B$N, there's no time to waste. You may have been speaking to Aviana herself, trying to return to us.$B$BI'll need something from Aviana's past to reach out to her. High atop the ridge overlooking this shrine, you'll find a series of huge nests belonging to Blaithe, an ancient bird of prey that was once her consort. For ten thousand years he's been mad with grief.$B$BGo to one of his roosts, and use this call to summon him. Kill Blaithe and bring me one of his feathers.
english.progress: Don't trouble yourself over Blaithe's condition. Grief robbed that creature of a soul epochs ago. He was but a shell of his former self, a beast of pure rage.
english.completion: That was nasty work, $n, but it had to be done. And if Aviana is truly to be resurrected, then perhaps your actions have enabled Blaithe to someday come back as well? Now let's see if we can contact our long lost guardian...
english.completed: Take the Ancient Feather back to Choluna within the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Use the Enormous Bird Call to summon Blaithe.

text.title: 莫名的请求
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的楚伦娜。
text.description: <你没办法弄明白灵魂急切的祷词，也许楚伦娜可以破译它所说的话。>$B$B<回到圣殿去找楚伦娜谈谈！>
text.completion: Slow down, $c! You look as though you've seen a ghost...
text.completed: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的楚伦娜。

english.title: A Plea From Beyond
english.objectives: Return to Choluna inside of the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <You can't make sense of the spirit's urgent plea, but maybe Choluna can decipher what's going on here.>$B$B<Speak with Choluna back inside the shrine!>
english.completion: Slow down, $c! You look as though you've seen a ghost...
english.completed: Return to Choluna inside of the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Getting Your Hands Dirty
text.objectives: Collect 5 Grimy Grub Guts from the Giant Sea Grubs near Harrison's Dig.
text.description: Make no mistake, $r, that is one clever shark. You don't survive down here as long as he has without a little extra smarts.$b$bWhat I'm saying is he won't be fooled so easily again. We're going to have to change our approach a bit.$b$bI won't bore you with the details just yet. For now, I need you to collect a bunch of the innards from these giant sea grubs.$b$bThink you can handle that?
text.completed: Speak with Harrison at Harrison's Dig.

english.title: Getting Your Hands Dirty
english.objectives: Collect 5 Grimy Grub Guts from the Giant Sea Grubs near Harrison's Dig.
english.description: Make no mistake, $r, that is one clever shark. You don't survive down here as long as he has without a little extra smarts.$b$bWhat I'm saying is he won't be fooled so easily again. We're going to have to change our approach a bit.$b$bI won't bore you with the details just yet. For now, I need you to collect a bunch of the innards from these giant sea grubs.$b$bThink you can handle that?
english.completed: Speak with Harrison at Harrison's Dig.

text.title: 宰杀雪怪
text.objectives: 在灰色洞穴杀掉10只雪怪。你可以杀死雪怪或者雪怪幼崽。
text.description: 镇子西南边灰色洞穴里的雪怪长久以来就是我们的眼中钉。它们没有强悍到足以威胁卡拉诺斯，但它们却时常偷袭旅行者，巡山人巡逻兵，还有补给车队。$B$B我要把观察员从灰色洞穴撤回来，因为巨魔前线急需人手。你能不能帮我的人削减一下雪怪的数量？没有了数量优势，它们也就没法攻击我们了。
text.completion: Now that you've dealt with the wendigos, we should be able to focus our efforts on the Frostmane trolls to the east.
text.completed: Return to Captain Tharran in Kharanos.

english.title: Culling the Wendigos
english.objectives: Kill 10 Wendigos in the Grizzled Den. You may kill Wendigos or Young Wendigos.
english.description: The wendigos in the Grizzled Den to the southwest of town have long been a thorn in our side. They're never quite strong enough to threaten Kharanos directly, yet they prey on travelers, mountaineer patrols, and supply convoys.$B$BI'm going to be withdrawing my observers from the Grizzled Den because I need them on the troll front. Would you help my men finish culling the wendigo population? Without strength of numbers, they won't be able to attack us.
english.completion: Now that you've dealt with the wendigos, we should be able to focus our efforts on the Frostmane trolls to the east.
english.completed: Return to Captain Tharran in Kharanos.

text.title: 被窃的补给品
text.objectives: 从灰色洞穴夺回6份被窃的补给品。
text.description: 霜鬃在东边惹麻烦，雪怪感觉到了我们的弱点，愈发大胆地展开袭击。最近的四辆补给车，只有一辆安全抵达。雪怪把剩下的都掳去了，堆在镇子西南边的灰色洞穴里。如果你愿意去那里把被窃的补给品夺回来，所有的镇民和保卫卡拉诺斯的巡山人都会感谢你的。
text.progress: Did you find any of the missing supplies?
text.completion: Well done, $n. The mountaineers will be glad to hear that half-rations are at an end. They'll need all their strength to continue fighting the Frostmanes.
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster Glynna in Kharanos.

english.title: Pilfered Supplies
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Pilfered Supplies from the Grizzled Den.
english.description: With the Frostmanes making trouble to our east, the wendigos have sensed our weakness and grown bolder in their raids. Only one of the four most recent supply wagons has made it here safely. The wendigos made off with the rest, stashing it in the Grizzled Den, a cave southwest of town. If you're willing to go down there and recover the stolen supplies, you would have the gratitude of all the townspeople and the mountaineers defending Kharanos.
english.progress: Did you find any of the missing supplies?
english.completion: Well done, $n. The mountaineers will be glad to hear that half-rations are at an end. They'll need all their strength to continue fighting the Frostmanes.
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster Glynna in Kharanos.

text.title: 大闹伐木场
text.objectives: 杀死督军罗克托克，获得女猎手伊莉奥娜的牢笼钥匙，解救女猎手伊莉奥娜。
text.description: 做好准备，$N！督军来了！杀掉他，拿到钥匙，把我放出来。$B$B要是我们能逃出去，就把这些告诉指挥官法罗米尔：$B$B由于我们一位英雄的努力，部落放弃了摧毁风剪要塞的计划。他们现在转而打算将炸弹运往战痕谷，投放到同部落交战的我方部队头上。$B$B必须阻止他们！
text.completion: A hero thwarted their plans to destroy Windshear Hold, eh? That hero was you, $n. You are the pride of the Alliance! It seems that you have bought us a little bit of time. I must plan for the battle that lies ahead of us. Seek out the other inhabitants of Windshear Hold and lend them your assistance. I will call for you when I am ready to initiate our defensive strategy.
text.completed: Report to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Rumble in the Lumber... Mill
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Roktrog and free Huntress Illiona by using Huntress Illiona's Cage Key.
english.description: Prepare yourself, $N! The Warlord comes! Kill him and take his key. Use the key to release me.$B$BShould we make it out of here, report the following to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold:$B$BThe Horde has aborted their plans to destroy Windshear Hold due to the efforts of one of our heroes. They now plan to move the bomb to Battlescar Valley and drop it on our armies battling the Horde at that location.$B$BThey must be stopped!
english.completion: A hero thwarted their plans to destroy Windshear Hold, eh? That hero was you, $n. You are the pride of the Alliance! It seems that you have bought us a little bit of time. I must plan for the battle that lies ahead of us. Seek out the other inhabitants of Windshear Hold and lend them your assistance. I will call for you when I am ready to initiate our defensive strategy.
english.completed: Report to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 猎鲨进行曲
text.objectives: 对放置在骸骨珊瑚礁的生锈的猎鱼枪使用巴德的链条。当利颚进入射程后，发射鱼叉。
text.description: 如果利颚有脚的话，它现在已经跳起来了。$B$B你很幸运，我可以像鲨鱼一样思考。$B$B利颚正在狂怒之中，这就是我们可以利用的优势。$B$B给，我在寻宝的时候找到了这根链子。把它绑在鱼枪上。$B$B当利颚看到你的时候，它会怒火中烧——然后我们就发起攻击！$B$B你去干掉它，我溜进去拿走宝贝。$B$B快点，$C，趁它的牙还没长回来，赶紧动手！
text.completion: This really ain't as bad as it looks...
text.completed: Speak with Budd at The Skeletal Reef in Kelp'thar Forest.
text.giverWindow: It's a little bit safer to go back in these waters, but not much...

english.title: DUN-dun-DUN-dun-DUN-dun
english.objectives: Use Budd's Chain on the Rusty Harpoon Gun in The Skeletal Reef. Fire the Harpoon when Gnaws is in position over the gun.
english.description: If ol' Gnaws had heels he'd be on 'em right now.$b$bFortunately for you, I think like a shark.$b$bGnaws is mad as all get out and we're gunna use that to our advantage.$b$bHere, I found this chain while out treasure-huntin'. Use it to tie off to that harpoon gun.$b$bWhen Gnaws sees ya he'll be consumed with rage - that's when we strike!$b$bYou try to finish him off and I'll sneak in there and grab the shiney.$b$bHurry, $c, before he grows them teeth back!
english.completion: This really ain't as bad as it looks...
english.completed: Speak with Budd at The Skeletal Reef in Kelp'thar Forest.
english.giverWindow: It's a little bit safer to go back in these waters, but not much...

text.title: Thinning the Horde
text.objectives: Slay any 20 soldiers of the Horde in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: The Horde's numbers swell as reinforcements from Ashenvale and Azshara arrive. There is no diplomacy to be had with the beasts. This is Hellscream's Horde and Hellscream's Horde wants our blood! We will not sit idly by and allow them to take our land and kill our people. We must act!$B$BWe must thin the Horde! Consider it your daily responsibility.$B$BVenture forth into Stonetalon Mountains and slay as many of the Horde as you are able. Let them know that the Alliance will not surrender!
text.completion: Good. Their blood is on Hellscream's hands. Send enough of them back to Orgrimmar in a body bag and the populace of the Horde might react. Who am I kidding? They're monsters!
text.completed: Return to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Thinning the Horde
english.objectives: Slay any 20 soldiers of the Horde in Stonetalon Mountains.

This is Hellscream's Horde and Hellscream's Horde wants our blood! We will not sit idly by and allow them to take our land and kill our people. We must act!$B$BWe must thin the Horde! Consider it your daily responsibility.$B$BVenture forth into Stonetalon Mountains and slay as many of the Horde as you are able. Let them know that the Alliance will not surrender!
english.completion: Good. Their blood is on Hellscream's hands. Send enough of them back to Orgrimmar in a body bag and the populace of the Horde might react. Who am I kidding? They're monsters!
english.completed: Return to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 整理遗骸
text.objectives: 收集10份动物遗骸。
text.description: 这些徽记很有用，哥们儿，不过咱们还得要点儿别的。一般来说，都是从家人开刀，不过那就是指我和我姐的孩子了，为托尼才不值当呢！$B$B所以，咱们得找东西替代。其实，就是很多动物的遗骸！$B$B闪光深渊下面有的是，都是叫大水给赶进来淹死的。下去给我带点上来。
text.progress: Ya gots to get me lotsa those carcasses, mon! We not be rid of his foolish spirit if ya don't!
text.completion: Oh, that's disgustin'! We almost there, mon. Just need ta do one more ting!
text.completed: Return to Ajamon Ghostcaller at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Carcass Collection
english.objectives: Collect 10 Creature Carcasses.
english.description: These organs be a good start, mon, but we still be needin' lotsa other tings. Normally, we'd be gettin' stuff from family now, but dats only me and my sistah's boy, and Tony ain't worth it!$B$BSo, we be substitutin' some stuff. Lotsa carcasses, in fact!$B$BDeep down in the Shimmering Deep, there's tons of dem from when the water came rushin' in. Killed all of dem creatures. Go down there and bring me up some.
english.progress: Ya gots to get me lotsa those carcasses, mon! We not be rid of his foolish spirit if ya don't!
english.completion: Oh, that's disgustin'! We almost there, mon. Just need ta do one more ting!
english.completed: Return to Ajamon Ghostcaller at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 问问爱丽斯
text.objectives: 找到BD-816战斗仪器、机械火焰、机械之冰和机械空气。
text.description: 水泡先生病了，$G先生:小姐;。你能帮帮他吗？你只要找到他的帽子和他的电池，他就会好起来的。我本想自己去，但我不能把水泡先生一个人丢下！$B$B他的帽子被水车那儿的风险投资公司坏蛋偷走了，他的电池藏在狂风峭壁周围。你得去好好找找！$B$B你能不能行行好，把水泡先生的东西拿回来，好让他给那些部落的坏人们一个教训？
text.progress: Mr. P is so sad. We need to make him happy!
text.completion: Mr. P you're gonna be ok! Hooray! Oh, Mr. P! I knew it!
text.completed: Return to Alice at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Just Ask Alice
english.objectives: Recover the BD-816 War Apparatus, Mechanized Fire, Mechanized Ice and Mechanized Air.
english.description: Mr. P is sick, $g mister:miss;. Won't you help him? All you have to do is find his hat and batteries and he'll be all better. I'd go get them myself, but I can't leave Mr. P alone!$B$BHis hat was stolen by the meanies in the Venture Co. over at the water wheel and his batteries are hidden around Windshear Crag. You'll just have to look real hard for those!$B$BWould you kindly bring Mr. P's stuff back so he can teach those baddies in the Horde a lesson?
english.progress: Mr. P is so sad. We need to make him happy!
english.completion: Mr. P you're gonna be ok! Hooray! Oh, Mr. P! I knew it!
english.completed: Return to Alice at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 无用的自尊
text.objectives: 杀死巨槌要塞的一个巨槌伏击者。
text.description: 这里曾是一座兽人城市……艾泽拉斯历史最悠久的兽人城市之一，在食人魔把我们赶出来之前一直都是。$B$B今天部落可不再会被食人魔呼来喝去。我和我的部队用武力夺回了城镇，曾经住在这里的食人魔如今成了我的奴仆。现在，我们的工作正式开始。$B$B你看来够强壮，但我要你要证明给我看。杀掉一个还在围攻我们的食人魔，然后回来复命。
text.completion: Well done, $r.  You've proven that you can take down an ogre... no small feat.  Now let's see if you can take down an Alliance iron mine...
text.completed: Return to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Futile Pride
english.objectives: Kill a Dreadmaul Ambusher in Dreadmaul Hold.
english.description: This is actually an old orc city... one of the oldest on Azeroth.  That is, it was until the ogres pushed us out.$b$bToday's Horde refuses to be pushed over by ogres.  My troops and I took the town back by force, and the ogres who once lived here now work as my servants.  Now, our real work begins.$b$bYou look strong enough, but I'd like to see some proof.  Kill one of the ogres that still besiege us, and return to me.
english.completion: Well done, $r.  You've proven that you can take down an ogre... no small feat.  Now let's see if you can take down an Alliance iron mine...
english.completed: Return to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 食人魔战斗
text.objectives: 杀死6名巨槌战士和5名巨槌术士。
text.description: 我看到了你的杰作，$R。你对捕杀食人魔怎么看？$B$B我们只是奴役了我们能抓到的那些，但最强壮的食人魔们还在巨槌岗哨繁衍生息，妄图卷土重来。我们的守卫可以对付零星的伏击，但是我们的防御还算不上是严密，一旦遭到有组织的进攻就很快会溃不成军。$B$B到南边的巨槌岗哨去教训教训他们，$N。在他们明白过来之前，把最强壮的杀掉。
text.completion: You've done well today, $n.  Not only have you purchased more time before the next ogre attack, but I think you scared some of the captives into working harder.
text.completed: Return to Master Aitokk at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Ogre Combat
english.objectives: Slay 6 Dreadmaul Maulers and 5 Dreadmaul Warlocks.
english.description: I saw your handiwork down there, $r.  How'd you like to hunt some more ogres?$b$bWe only enslaved the ones we could catch.  Most of the strongest ogres still brood in Dreadmaul Post, plotting our demise.  Our guards can handle the scattered ambushers, but we are not yet firmly entrenched, and will buckle quickly under a coordinated attack.$b$bGo south to Dreadmaul Post and send a message, $n.  Slay the strongest before they get any ideas.
english.completion: You've done well today, $n.  Not only have you purchased more time before the next ogre attack, but I think you scared some of the captives into working harder.
english.completed: Return to Master Aitokk at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 心脏打击
text.objectives: 去找诅咒之地守望堡矿井的罗菲利安·达恩。
text.description: 我们没有任何希望能从联盟手中夺下守望堡矿井……至少目前是这样。守望堡防御森严，补给线畅通无阻。那么，我们的目标，就是摧毁他们的经济。我们不能武力夺取矿井，那就用精确打击来大大降低矿井的效率。$B$B我已经在矿井外设下佯攻。到东边去，摸到矿井里，跟罗菲利安·达恩谈谈，接受你的任务。
text.completion: Finally... another operative shows up.  I hope you're loosened up... it's time to tango, partner.

english.title: Heartstrike
english.objectives: Report to Rofilian Dane at the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: We don't have any hope of taking the Nethergarde Mines from the Alliance... at least not yet.  Nethergarde is well-defended, and their supply routes are established and strong.  Our goal, then, is to damage their economy.  We can't take the mine by force, but with surgical strikes we can drastically reduce the mine's efficiency.$b$bI have men creating a distraction outside the mines.  Head east, sneak into the mines, and speak with Rofilian Dane for your assignment.
english.completion: Finally... another operative shows up.  I hope you're loosened up... it's time to tango, partner.

text.title: 都是我的
text.objectives: 在守望堡矿井的6处矿石堆上使用超浓溶剂。
text.description: 这洞穴里都是无人看管的矿石堆，就等着锤炼。很显然，我们的第一选择就是把矿石偷出来，但那需要矿车、保护、劳工……这三样东西我们都没有。因此取而代之的方案是，我们要用一点高腐蚀性的溶剂来给这个小小的采矿派对捣捣乱。$B$B把这瓶子拿上——要当心——把里面的东西倒在矿石堆上。假如我们拿不到矿石，他们也别想要。
text.completion: There's nothing quite like a big fat kick in the wallet, is there, you Alliance lunkheads?!
text.completed: Return to Rofilian Dane at the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: It's All Mine
english.objectives: Use the Concentrated Solvent on 6 Ore Heaps in the Nethergarde Mines.
english.description: All over this cavern you'll find unguarded piles of ore, just waiting to be tampered with.  Our first choice would be to steal the ore, obviously, but that requires mine carts, protection, and labor... three things we just don't have.  So instead, we're just going to ruin this little mining party with a little bit of highly corrosive solvent.$b$bTake this bottle - CAREFULLY - and pour it onto those heaps of ore.  'Cause if we can't have this ore, then neither can they.
english.completion: There's nothing quite like a big fat kick in the wallet, is there, you Alliance lunkheads?!
english.completed: Return to Rofilian Dane at the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 选择你的命运
text.objectives: 杀掉8名守望堡矿工3名守望堡技师和3名守望堡工头。
text.description: 训练一个矿工大约要花掉联盟五十金币，技师是两百金币，一个工头要三百。我们杀掉的每个联盟走狗不仅仅是军事上的胜利……同时也是经济上的。$B$B现在下去把他们的工人们都干掉！
text.completion: Excellent work, friend.  I like the way you do business.
text.completed: Return to Rofilian Dane at the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Pick Your Fate
english.objectives: Slay 8 Nethergarde Miners, 3 Nethergarde Engineers, and 3 Nethergarde Foremen.
english.description: It costs the Alliance approximately fifty gold to train a miner, two hundred to train an engineer, and three hundred to train a foreman.  Every Alliance goon that we kill isn't just a military victory... it's a financial one.$b$bNow get down there and destroy their workers!
english.completion: Excellent work, friend.  I like the way you do business.
english.completed: Return to Rofilian Dane at the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 进入山脉
text.objectives: 去找诅咒之地守望堡矿井更深处的塔卡利里。
text.description: 行动的下一阶段是在矿井的更深处。跟塔卡利里谈谈，获取下一个任务指示。沿着矿车轨道朝东南走，拐过去就是了。你可以在矿井上层大厅的入口处找到他。$B$B能同你共事真是令人愉快，$N。
text.completion: Good, you here already.  Stick around for a bit, little $r.  We gonna mess with the Alliance. I love my job, mon.

english.title: Into the Mountain
english.objectives: Report to Tak'arili deeper within the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: The next phase of operations takes place deeper within the mine.  Speak with Tak'arili for your next assignment.  Just follow the mine cart rails to the southeast, and follow the curve around.  You'll see him at the entrance to the mine's upper chamber.$b$bIt's been a pleasure doing business with you, $n.
english.completion: Good, you here already.  Stick around for a bit, little $r.  We gonna mess with the Alliance. I love my job, mon.

text.title: 那不是我们
text.objectives: 查清楚是什么让守望堡矿井里的矿工如此害怕，把它杀掉。
text.description: 先说重要的……看来我们有麻烦了。这些沿着右路去的矿工像无头苍蝇一样乱撞。我猜他们是挖得太深，发现了什么不干净的东西……一个恶魔，一个元素生物，或是某种触手怪。$B$B塔卡利里可不喜欢惊喜。去查清楚，把麻烦处理掉，然后我们才能回到正轨上来。
text.completion: So it was a demon?  Those miners never seen a demon before?  We're in the Blasted Lands, mon!  Demons are everywhere! Ah well... let's get on to da good stuff, shall we?
text.completed: Return to Tak'arili at the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: That's Not Us
english.objectives: Find and slay whatever is frightening the miners in the Nethergarde Mines.
english.description: First things first... it looks like we got ourselves a problem.  These miners down the pathway to the right have been runnin' around like a chickens without they heads on.  My best guess is that they dug too deep and found somethin' nasty... a demon, an elemental, or some kind o' tentacley beast.$b$bTak'arili don't like surprises.  Find out what the problem is and take care of it, then we get ourselves back on track.
english.completion: So it was a demon?  Those miners never seen a demon before?  We're in the Blasted Lands, mon!  Demons are everywhere! Ah well... let's get on to da good stuff, shall we?
english.completed: Return to Tak'arili at the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 有些人就是得杀
text.objectives: 杀死首席勘察员宏多。一路用不起眼的盒子伪装自己。
text.description: 沿着前面的通道往西，你就可以直接到达首席勘察员宏多的办公室。他可是这儿的大人物，塔卡利里听说他还是个不得了的矿工。这就是他必须得死的原因。$B$B不过有一个问题：通道里充斥着这些烦人的守望堡小丑。这也就是你要伪装自己的原因。钻到这只盒子里去，沿着通道一路潜行。但愿你这一路上不会引起太多的怀疑。
text.completion: Nice work, mon!  Without Hondo, these guys are helpless.  Dis mine'll be ours soon enough!
text.completed: Return to Tak'arili at the Nethergarde Mines in Blasted Lands.
text.giverWindow: A chunky boy, Hondo was always picked on as a child.

english.title: Some People Just Need Killing
english.objectives: Slay Chief Prospector Hondo.  Use the Inconspicuous Box to disguise yourself along the way.
english.description: The tunnel ahead, headin' west, will take you straight to Chief Prospector Hondo's office.  He's the big cheese around here, and Tak'arili's heard tell that he's a darn fine miner.  That's why he's gotta die.$b$bThere's just one problem: the pathway is completely FILLED with those pesky Nethergarde flunkies.  That's why you gotta disguise yourself.  Hop inside this box here, and sneak down the pathway.  Hopefully you won't draw too much suspicion on your way to da killin'.
english.completion: Nice work, mon!  Without Hondo, these guys are helpless.  Dis mine'll be ours soon enough!
english.completed: Return to Tak'arili at the Nethergarde Mines in Blasted Lands.
english.giverWindow: A chunky boy, Hondo was always picked on as a child.

text.title: 任务完成
text.objectives: 把守望堡矿井报告交给诅咒之地巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉 。
text.description: 我们完事了，伙计。剩下来的最后一件事情就是回去跟奥克莉拉 报告了。你现在有事吗？
text.progress: You've returned, $n?
text.completion: Impressive, $n.  I wouldn't have hidden in that box, but otherwise, you have performed bravely and admirably.  The battle we won today may not win us any immediate spoils, but the damage you've done to the Alliance will last for a long time.

english.title: Mission Complete
english.objectives: Deliver the Nethergarde Mine Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: We be done here, mon.  Only thing left to do is send a report to Okrilla.  You doin' anything right now?
english.progress: You've returned, $n?
english.completion: Impressive, $n.  I wouldn't have hidden in that box, but otherwise, you have performed bravely and admirably.  The battle we won today may not win us any immediate spoils, but the damage you've done to the Alliance will last for a long time.

text.title: 巨槌熔炉
text.objectives: 向诅咒之地巨槌熔炉深处的血法师莱诺雷报到。
text.description: 我是认真的，$R。你帮了我的忙，现在我要回报你。$B$B你说的那个恶魔猎手来过这里，不过只停留了一小会。他到南边去了，说是要追杀恶魔。一般说来，我见了暗夜精灵都是直接动手的，不过他好像不是联盟的渣滓，而且任何猎杀恶魔的人对我来说都是有价值的。$B$B你应该去找莱诺雷和德拉吉亚，我把这一对血法师派到那边去了。他们就在一座食人魔洞穴的最深处扎营。
text.completion: Okrilla sent you?  Okrilla the killa'? Loramus was his name?  I'm sorry to say that we have not seen your demon hunter... but we have ways of finding him.

english.title: The Dreadmaul Furnace
english.objectives: Report to Bloodmage Lynnore in the back of the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: I meant what I said, $r.  You helped me, now I'll pass on what I know.$b$bA demon hunter recently came through here, but only briefly.  He was headed south, speaking of demons.  Normally I'd have slain the night elf on sight, but he didn't seem to be Alliance scum, and anybody who kills demons is useful to me for the time being.$b$bYou should check in with Lynnore and Drazial, a pair of blood mages I sent down that way.  They've camped in the back of an ogre cave.
english.completion: Okrilla sent you?  Okrilla the killa'? Loramus was his name?  I'm sorry to say that we have not seen your demon hunter... but we have ways of finding him.

text.title: 血石同调
text.objectives: 与巨槌熔炉的血石传送器进行同调。
text.description: 我承认，我们没有选择……最合适的地点来进行研究，特别是在路过的冒险者想要随意进出的情况下。我们跟食人魔的协议非常脆弱，所以恐怕我不能说服他们不去攻击你。$B$B不过，我可以让你和我的血石传送器进行同调。只要把你的手放在我右边的那块石头上，就可以传送到洞穴外面了。如果你想回来的话，可以用洞外的石头再传送回来！
text.completion: Excellent.  Now that that's out of the way...
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Attune the Bloodstone
english.objectives: Attune yourself to the Bloodstone Teleporters in the Dreadmaul Furnace.
english.description: I admit, we haven't picked the most... convenient of spots to perform our studies, especially for passing adventurers who wish to enter and leave at will.  Our agreement with the ogres is tenuous, and I'm afraid we can't convince them not to attack you when you draw near.$b$bHowever, I can allow you to attune yourself to our bloodstone teleporters.  Simply place your hands on the stone to my right, and you will be teleported outside of the cave.  Then use the stone outside to teleport back!
english.completion: Excellent.  Now that that's out of the way...
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 第一步
text.objectives: 收集9瓶弯牙土狼的血液和9瓶红石蜥蜴的血。
text.description: 要启动你需要的那种仪式——还有随后可能用到的其它仪式——我们需要血液。诅咒之地有着我们的血魔法所必需的一切血液原料……只需把它们正确调合起来就行。$B$B<莱诺雷迅速地跟德拉吉亚交谈了一会。>$B$B我们需要等量的蜥蜴血和土狼血，而且要许多。到东边去，在诅咒之地的中心地带找找。另外别忘了……你可以使用那个传送器！
text.progress: Ogre blood only takes you so far.  Do you have it?
text.completion: More than enough, and still warm!  Now, let's get this ritual started, shall we?
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The First Step
english.objectives: Obtain 9 vials of Snickerfang Hyena Blood and 9 vials of Redstone Basilisk Blood.
english.description: To perform the ritual you've requested - and perhaps some more rituals in the near future - we're going to need blood.  The Blasted Lands are filled with every type of reagent we might need for our blood magic... it's just a matter of the correct combination.$b$b<Lynnore quickly confers with Drazial for a moment.>$b$bBasilisks and hyenas, even amounts.  And we're going to need plenty of it.  Head east, to the center of the Blasted Lands.  And don't forget... you can use that teleporter!
english.progress: Ogre blood only takes you so far.  Do you have it?
english.completion: More than enough, and still warm!  Now, let's get this ritual started, shall we?
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 鲜血仪祭
text.objectives: 与血法师莱诺雷交谈，开始鲜血仪祭。
text.description: 我们的目标是找到恶魔猎手洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯。等你准备好开始鲜血仪祭了，就告诉我一声，然后站远点。
text.completion: The blood ritual was a success; I can clearly see where Loramus is right now.  That is, I can see where the pieces of his body lie...
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Blood Ritual
english.objectives: Speak with Bloodmage Lynnore to begin the blood ritual.
english.description: Our goal is to find the demon hunter, Loramus Thalipedes.  Let me know when you are ready to begin the blood ritual, and then stand back.
english.completion: The blood ritual was a success; I can clearly see where Loramus is right now.  That is, I can see where the pieces of his body lie...
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 特别的尸体
text.objectives: 找到洛拉姆斯的头颅、洛拉姆斯的躯干和洛拉姆斯的腿。
text.description: 洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯已经死了。嗯，我退一步讲……这是我的猜测，不过我确实知道他的躯体已经被分成三块了。$B$B<莱诺雷沉思了一会。>$B$B如果你能把他的躯体凑起来，我们也许还有办法。尸体的三个部分都在附近……巨槌食人魔把它们藏在洞穴里。实际上，其中的一块就在我身后的岩架下面的箱子里……
text.progress: Trust me... whatever happened to Loramus, we can fix.  The limits of blood magic are still undefined.
text.completion: I see... yes, we can work with this. Loramus Thalipedes, demon hunter.  I look forward to meeting you.
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.
text.giverWindow: The demon hunter in life.

english.title: Not Just Any Body
english.objectives: Find Loramus' Head, Loramus' Torso, and Loramus' Legs.
english.description: Loramus Thalipedes is dead.  Well, let me step back... that's an assumption on my part, but I do know that his body lies in three pieces.$b$b<Lynnore ponders for a moment.>$b$bIf you bring me the pieces, we still have a recourse.  All three pieces are nearby... the Dreadmaul ogres hide them in their caves.  In fact, one of them is in that chest, down the ledge behind me...
english.progress: Trust me... whatever happened to Loramus, we can fix.  The limits of blood magic are still undefined.
english.completion: I see... yes, we can work with this. Loramus Thalipedes, demon hunter.  I look forward to meeting you.
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.
english.giverWindow: The demon hunter in life.

text.title: 风暴祭坛
text.objectives: 将洛拉姆斯的躯体带到风暴祭坛去，然后在仪式进行期间保护它。
text.description: 我们这座惬意的山洞上面的断崖顶部有一座祭坛。那是一座威力强大的恶魔祭坛，虽然是由教徒保护着，但它本身也是非常强大的。如果你能到祭坛上去，就可以用它来将洛拉姆斯带回我们身边。$B$B祭坛很可能会抵抗你的法术，因此你必须在仪式进行期间保护洛拉姆斯的躯体。结束之后，把这位恶魔猎手带到我这里来。
text.completion: You... you fool!  What have you done?
text.completed: Return to Loramus Thalipedes at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Altar of Storms
english.objectives: Bring Loramus' Body to the Altar of Storms, then protect it while the ritual completes.
english.description: Up on the bluffs above our comfy cave is a powerful altar.  A powerful DEMONIC altar, guarded by cultists, but powerful nonetheless.  If you can reach it, you can use it to bring Loramus back to us.$b$bThe altar will likely resist your efforts, so you'll have to protect Loramus' body while the ritual completes.  Bring the demon hunter back to me afterwards.
english.completion: You... you fool!  What have you done?
english.completed: Return to Loramus Thalipedes at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 时间紧迫
text.objectives: 将不谐符文交给诅咒之地黑暗之门的观察者瓦兹克。
text.description: 当时我在猎杀一个名叫拉瑟莱克的恶魔，他的食人魔副官戈洛尔袭击了我。我猝不及防，就被杀掉了……不过戈洛尔也死了。拉瑟莱克想要重返诅咒之地，并指挥他的恶魔征服艾泽拉斯。眼下，他正在准备召唤他的军团把我们全部消灭。有了这三个护符，我们就可以召唤他……但仍然没办法毁灭它。$B$B<恶魔猎手迅速在空中画了一个符文，然后把它交给了你。>$B$B把这个交给黑暗之门那里的瓦兹克，他就在东南边。他会告诉你该怎么做的。快一点！时间紧迫！
text.progress: Do I know you, good $r?
text.completion: What?  LORAMUS?! Oh blast, keep it down, would ya?  If my boss gets word that I worked for Loramus, do you know how quickly I'd be on my rear end?! Well, you weren't lying.  Let's get to work.

english.title: Time is Short
english.objectives: Deliver the Discordant Rune to Watcher Wazzik at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: I was hunting a demon named Razelikh, when his ogre lieutenant Grol assaulted me.  I was caught unaware, and I died... but so did Grol.$b$bRazelikh plans to return to the Blasted Lands and overwhelm the lands with his demons.  Even now, he is preparing to summon his legions to eliminate us.$b$b<The demon hunter quickly draws a rune in the air, then hands it to you.>$b$bDeliver this to Wazzik at the Dark Portal, to the southeast.  He will guide you.  Quickly!  We haven't much time!
english.progress: Do I know you, good $r?
english.completion: What?  LORAMUS?! Oh blast, keep it down, would ya?  If my boss gets word that I worked for Loramus, do you know how quickly I'd be on my rear end?! Well, you weren't lying.  Let's get to work.

text.title: 血法师也要吃饭啊
text.objectives: 从诅咒之地的灰鬃野猪身上收集5块灰鬃肉排。
text.description: 与人们的常见观念不同，血精灵血法师并不啜饮鲜血。我们和其他人一样，吃普通的食品——而这种东西在一座食人魔要塞里是很难搞到的。$B$B诅咒之地中部峡谷中的灰鬃野猪别的没什么好，就一个优点：吃起来很方便，因为它们的肉不需要额外的烹制环节。你能去猎杀一些野猪，帮我们补充一下越来越捉襟见肘的食物储备吗？
text.progress: I'm famished!  If you don't hurry, I might actually resort to drinking our reagents.
text.completion: These are perfect, $n.  Lynnore and I will eat well for the next several days.
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Drazial in the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: A Bloodmage's Gotta Eat Too
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Ashmane Steaks from Ashmane Boars in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Contrary to popular belief, blood elf bloodmages do NOT drink blood.  We eat normal food like everybody else - something which can be hard to come by in the recesses of an ogre stronghold.$b$bThe ashmane boars in the central valley of the Blasted Lands are, if nothing else, convenient for eating, as their meat does not require any cooking.  Would you hunt these boars and help us replenish our foodstores?
english.progress: I'm famished!  If you don't hurry, I might actually resort to drinking our reagents.
english.completion: These are perfect, $n.  Lynnore and I will eat well for the next several days.
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Drazial in the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 黑暗之门的焦黑花岗岩
text.objectives: 收集24块焦黑的花岗岩片。
text.description: 洛拉姆斯想让我们——呃，我是说让你——从黑暗之门周围的岩石上挖一些花岗岩片。我不知道他要石头干什么，但我有自己的猜测，而且还不是好的方向。$B$B拿着这把锄头，到黑暗之门的爆炸范围边缘去找一找露出地面的岩石吧。
text.progress: Keep it down, would ya?
