text.completion: I hope this is what he needs.  We probably don't have time for you to return and mine any more.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Wazzik at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands

english.title: The Charred Granite of the Dark Portal
english.objectives: Obtain 24 Charred Granite Chips.
english.description: Loramus wants us - er, YOU - to gather granite chips from these chunks of rock around the Dark Portal.  I don't know what he'd want rocks for, but I have my suspicions, and they're not pleasant ones.$b$bUse this pick and look for small outcroppings of rock along the edge of the portal's blast radius.
english.progress: Keep it down, would ya?
english.completion: I hope this is what he needs.  We probably don't have time for you to return and mine any more.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Wazzik at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands

text.title: 邪能魔化之血
text.objectives: 收集7瓶邪能魔化之血。
text.description: 萨里比迪斯需要恶魔的血。依我看，那玩意简直不能说是血——更像是脓液——不过这不重要。$B$B你很幸运，黑暗之门周围满地都是恶魔。地狱火啦，恶魔犬啦，恶魔卫士啦……它们身上都有你要的东西，量非常足。
text.progress: Ugh, what's that smell?  Is that you, or the blood?
text.completion: There's no doubt about it, you found demon blood. Loramus' requests aside, I'm sure Dar'toon is thankful for your efforts.  They've been struggling to deal with these demon distractions for some time now.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Wazzik at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Vile Blood of Demons
english.objectives: Obtain 7 bottles of Vile Demonic Blood.
english.description: Thalipedes wants demon blood.  Personally, the stuff doesn't even seem like blood to me - more like liquid rot - but that's neither here nor there.$b$bLuckily for you, the area around the Dark Portal is crawling with demons.  Infernals, felhounds, felguards... they've all got what you need, in copious, pustulent amounts.
english.progress: Ugh, what's that smell?  Is that you, or the blood?
english.completion: There's no doubt about it, you found demon blood. Loramus' requests aside, I'm sure Dar'toon is thankful for your efforts.  They've been struggling to deal with these demon distractions for some time now.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Wazzik at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 强化石头
text.objectives: 将瓦兹克的包裹交给诅咒之地巨槌熔炉的洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯。
text.description: <瓦兹克把材料仔细地放在一个包裹里。>$B$B这就是洛拉姆斯要的所有东西啦。当你见到他的时候，记得告诉他我出了许多力。我担心他不知道我做出了多少贡献。
text.progress: $C... you return...
text.completion: This is sufficient.  If you see Wazzik again, you may tell him that he performed satisfactorily.  I will get the bloodmages to work on fashioning the stone knife of sealing.  There is no need for questions now.  All will be revealed in time. While they work, I have another task for you to complete.  Actually, make that three tasks.

english.title: Enhancing the Stone
english.objectives: Bring Wazzik's Package to Loramus Thalipedes at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: <Wazzik finishes packing the materials up in a neatly-wrapped package.>$b$bThat's all that Loramus asked of us.  When you see him, make sure you let him know how much of a help I was.  I fear he will not see my hand in this.
english.progress: $C... you return...
english.completion: This is sufficient.  If you see Wazzik again, you may tell him that he performed satisfactorily.  I will get the bloodmages to work on fashioning the stone knife of sealing.  There is no need for questions now.  All will be revealed in time. While they work, I have another task for you to complete.  Actually, make that three tasks.

text.title: 保护后方
text.objectives: 杀死伽罗克·裂翼、莎罕达娜和格姆加兹。
text.description: 你能看到我跟联盟士兵站在一起的唯一理由，就是我们的职责超越了彼此之间的敌意……不过只有一点点而已。我们的职责是阻止未经许可穿越黑暗之门的行为，而在最近的大灾变之后，我们更有可能受到攻击了。这一带据说已经有黑龙活动的迹象了……$B$B我的部队把注意力全都放在了自己的职责上，所以我们需要别人帮忙，确保这一地区的恶魔在控制中。在传送门周围，你可以找到三个恶魔军官，去杀掉他们。
text.completion: Your work is appreciated, soldier. $r... if you're still interested, I have one more small task for you...
text.completed: Return to Warlord Dar'toon at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Protecting Our Rear
english.objectives: Kill Jarroc Torn-wing, Shahandana, and Gomegaz.
english.description: The only reason you see me standing aside Alliance soldiers is because our duty outweighs our enmity... however slightly.  We have been charged with protecting the Dark Portal from unauthorized travel, and with the recent cataclysm, we are particularly susceptible to an attack.  We've already heard reports of black dragons in the area...$b$bWith my men focused on their duty, we need someone to keep the area demons in check.  Around the portal you will find three demon lieutenants.  Slay them.
english.completion: Your work is appreciated, soldier. $r... if you're still interested, I have one more small task for you...
english.completed: Return to Warlord Dar'toon at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 留个心眼
text.objectives: 在不被发现的情况下，查阅黑暗之门的联盟计划书。
text.description: <督军达图恩悄悄地说。>$B$B我收到了来自……上峰的命令，你正是合适的人选。我隔段时间就会听到联盟的人提及那边木桶上的一叠文件。我要你去看看那些文件，搞明白他们到底在策划什么阴谋。我的职责和身份使我不便执行这样可疑的任务，但是像你这样的新人也许不会引起他们的注意……
text.completion: You're certain nobody saw you?  Good. Hmph... fairly harmless stuff.  Either the Alliance are foolish enough to NOT be planning something against us... or they're hiding their information better than I expected.  Either way, well done, soldier.
text.completed: Return to Warlord Dar'toon at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Watching Our Back
english.objectives: Examine the Alliance Plans at the Dark Portal without getting caught.
english.description: <Warlord Dar'toon speaks in hushed tones.>$b$bI have orders from... higher up... that you would be suitable for.  I've seen the Alliance periodically referring to a stack of papers on that barrel over there.  I'd like you to take a look at those papers and find out what it is that they're plotting.  My duty and station prevent me from such a questionable task, but a newcomer like you might be able to slip in unnoticed...
english.completion: You're certain nobody saw you?  Good. Hmph... fairly harmless stuff.  Either the Alliance are foolish enough to NOT be planning something against us... or they're hiding their information better than I expected.  Either way, well done, soldier.
english.completed: Return to Warlord Dar'toon at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 日纱考察营地
text.objectives: Report to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.
text.description: 哦，对了，几天前，我收到了某人的通知。神圣遗物学会，是吧？他们在找人去……做些事……$B$B<督军翻看着文件。>$B$B啊，在这里！没错，神圣遗物学会的洛翰·日纱正在招募有能力的冒险者，帮助他们设在南边的考古队。$B$B来，拿着这个。你为什么不去跟那个精灵谈谈？
text.completion: Welcome, traveler.  Thank you for responding to my summons.

english.title: The Sunveil Excursion
english.objectives: Report to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Oh, right, I received a notification from someone a few days ago.  The Reliquary, was it?  They're looking for someone to... do something...$b$b<The Warlord rifles through some papers.>$b$bAh, here it is!  Yes, Rohan Sunveil of The Reliquary is seeking able-bodied adventurers to assist with an archaeological expedition to the south.$b$bHere, take this with you.  Why don't you go speak with that elf?
english.completion: Welcome, traveler.  Thank you for responding to my summons.

text.title: 奥利斯塔的护符
text.objectives: 在诅咒之地的盘蛇谷获得奥利斯塔的护符。
text.description: 当我的导师帮助我移除双眼的时候，他给了我特殊的视界……比你和那些嗜血的精灵看得更远更多。我可以看到带有恶魔能量的物体，比如奥利斯塔的护符。$B$B奥利斯塔已经死了，但是他将自己的护符藏在了东边盘蛇谷的一只箱子里。把这些护符合在一起的话，我们就可以前往拉瑟莱克的高台。
text.progress: Allistarj left a piece of himself in that amulet.  Even now, I can sense his evil.
text.completion: He was an archmage, I can feel it.  I will hold the amulet for you while you collect the rest.
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Amulet of Allistarj
english.objectives: Obtain the Amulet of Allistarj from the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: When my master helped me to take my eyes out, he gave me the gift of sight... a sight much greater than yours, or even of these blood-craving elves.  My sight allows me to see objects of demonic power, such as the Amulet of Allistarj.$b$bAllistarj himself is dead, but he locked his amulet up in a trove inside the Serpent's Coil, to the east.  Along with the other amulets, this relic will give us access to Razelikh's perch.
english.progress: Allistarj left a piece of himself in that amulet.  Even now, I can sense his evil.
english.completion: He was an archmage, I can feel it.  I will hold the amulet for you while you collect the rest.
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 瑟温妮的护符
text.objectives: 从诅咒之地破碎海滩附近的盐腮手中夺取瑟温妮的护符。
text.description: 瑟温妮的护符在一只鱼人的手里。他在遥远的东边，一处可以俯瞰破碎海滩的岩架上。这东西是怎么跑到鱼人手里去的，我也不知道，不过我敢肯定的是，你可以在那里找到它。$B$B比起拉瑟莱克的其他仆从，我感觉到自己与瑟温妮之间的联系更紧密一些……也许是因为她建造了风暴祭坛，而你在那里复活了我。把她的护符和另外两枚护符都交给莱诺雷。
text.progress: Sevine's amulet... along with the others, we can reach the Rise of the Defiler.
text.completion: A warlock... and a powerful one at that.  I will hold onto this until the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Amulet of Sevine
english.objectives: Obtain the Amulet of Sevine from Salt-Flop near the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Sevine's amulet is in the hands of a murloc, far to the east, on a shelf that overlooks the Shattershore.  How it ended up in that murloc's possession, I cannot say, but I can state with certainty that you will find it there.$b$bI feel a stronger connection with Sevine than with the rest of Razelikh's servants... possibly because she built the Altar of Storms, upon which you resurrected me.  Bring her Amulet to Lynnore, along with the rest.
english.progress: Sevine's amulet... along with the others, we can reach the Rise of the Defiler.
english.completion: A warlock... and a powerful one at that.  I will hold onto this until the time is right.
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 戈洛尔的护符
text.objectives: 在诅咒之地的破碎海滩获得戈洛尔的护符。
text.description: 戈洛尔……那个把我分尸的食人魔。$B$B<洛拉姆斯笑了。>$B$B我们同归于尽之后，戈洛尔的尸体好像已经转了几次手，不过他已经不在那些食人魔那里了。他的尸体和他的护符，都在东边的破碎海滩上的一艘破船里。他的护符是最后一枚……把这三枚护符合起来之后，我们就可以找到拉瑟莱克，并阻止他的疯狂计划。
text.progress: The third amulet, from Razelikh's third lieutenant.
text.completion: He was a powerful warrior, this one.  I will keep the amulet until Loramus is ready to proceed.
text.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Amulet of Grol
english.objectives: Obtain Grol's Amulet from the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Grol... the ogre who tore me apart.$b$b<Loramus laughs.>$b$bIt would seem that Grol's body has changed hands several times since we died together, but it no longer rests with the ogres.  His body, along with his amulet of power, is in a wrecked ship off the Shattershore, to the east.  His amulet is the last... once combined, the three will give us access to Razelikh, and therein lies our chance to stop his madness.
english.progress: The third amulet, from Razelikh's third lieutenant.
english.completion: He was a powerful warrior, this one.  I will keep the amulet until Loramus is ready to proceed.
english.completed: Return to Bloodmage Lynnore at the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 洛拉姆斯在等待
text.objectives: 与血法师莱诺雷交谈，参与他的仪式。
text.description: 这些护符上的魔法并不是很复杂。借助它们的力量，你就可以接触到它们的创造者——拉瑟莱克。$B$B我已经准备好为你和洛拉姆斯进行这个仪式了。等你们都准备好之后，就告诉我一声。
text.completion: It would seem that we are prepared to face our demon, $n.  We have the amulet's blessing, we have the stone knife, and I alone know the demon's true name: Rakh'likh.  Together, this may be enough to defeat the Defiler.
text.completed: Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Loramus Thalipedes Awaits
english.objectives: Speak with Bloodmage Lynnore and participate in her ritual.
english.description: The enchantment on these amulets was not complex.  Together, their power will grant you access to Razelikh, the amulets' creator.$b$bI am prepared to perform the ritual on you and Loramus.  Speak with me when you are both ready.
english.completion: It would seem that we are prepared to face our demon, $n.  We have the amulet's blessing, we have the stone knife, and I alone know the demon's true name: Rakh'likh.  Together, this may be enough to defeat the Defiler.
english.completed: Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in the Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 恶魔拉瑟莱克
text.objectives: 与污染者高地北面的乌舍尔交谈。抵达高地顶端之后，摧毁拉瑟莱克的躯体，然后用封印石匕禁锢他的灵魂。
text.description: 英雄，仔细听好了。$B$B首先，我们必须去找乌舍尔，他就在污染者高地的北边山脚下等着我们，那处高地在我们的东北方。乌舍尔会把我们送到高地顶端去。到那里之后，你要帮助我击败拉瑟莱克，恐怕我一个人是无法战胜他的。$B$B最关键的是，我要你拿着封印石匕，等到我告诉你用它的时候，你再用它。匕首会把拉瑟莱克的灵魂禁锢在一个新的、永恒的牢笼中。$B$B如果我们成功了，就去告诉瓦兹克。
text.completion: I see.  So this was Loramus' plan all along. I suspected correctly, but I suppose I refused to believe it.  And now, his final instruction for me makes much more sense: He asked me to let you choose from one of these.
text.completed: Report Loramus' fate to Watcher Wazzik at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
text.giverWindow: Your knowledge of his true name shall prove to be his undoing.

english.title: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
english.objectives: Speak with the Deathly Usher north of the Rise of the Defiler.  Once atop the Rise, destroy Razelikh's body, then use the Stone Knife of Sealing to imprison his soul.
english.description: Hero, listen well.$b$bFirst, we must travel to the Deathly Usher, who waits at the northern foot of the Rise of the Defiler, to our northeast.  The usher will take us to the top of the rise.  Once there, I need you to help me defeat Razelikh, for I fear that I am not strong enough to defeat him alone.$b$bMost importantly, I need you to hold the stone knife, and do not use it until I tell you to.  The knife will trap Razelikh's soul within its new, eternal prison.$b$bIf we succeed, speak with Wazzik.
english.completion: I see.  So this was Loramus' plan all along. I suspected correctly, but I suppose I refused to believe it.  And now, his final instruction for me makes much more sense: He asked me to let you choose from one of these.
english.completed: Report Loramus' fate to Watcher Wazzik at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
english.giverWindow: Your knowledge of his true name shall prove to be his undoing.

text.title: 家…没了…纳迦…
text.objectives: 盐腮要你去跟石坑鱼人的酋长耐普托谈谈。
text.description: <鱼人努力地想用你的语言说话。>$B$B岩池村……攻击。纳迦来，占了村庄，村民。$B$B盐腮逃走了，其他没有。去南边，找酋长耐普托谈。也许他还活着。
text.completion: Salt-Flop did not shame himself by running away.  Look behind me, and see for yourself. The Rockpool had no hope against the naga's attack.
text.completed: Report to Neptool at the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Home... Gone... Naga...
english.objectives: Salt-Flop has asked you to speak with Chief Neptool of the Rockpool murlocs.
english.description: <The murloc struggles to speak your language.>$b$bRockpool... attacked.  Naga turn, take village, villagers.$b$bSalt-Flop escape, but others do not.  Go south, talk to Chief Neptool.  Maybe he survive.
english.completion: Salt-Flop did not shame himself by running away.  Look behind me, and see for yourself. The Rockpool had no hope against the naga's attack.
english.completed: Report to Neptool at the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 暴行
text.objectives: 杀死10个血浪蛮兵和10个血浪女巫。
text.description: <虽然鱼人酋长的嘴唇没有动，但你还是可以感觉到他在跟你说话。>$B$B自从我们记事以来，血浪纳迦和石坑鱼人一直都和平相处。我们之间是有差异，但从来都没有交恶。那么，为什么他们要突然攻打我们？$B$B<耐普托回头看了看他曾经的村庄。>$B$B你看到他们在干什么了吗？他们奴役我们，强迫我们互相杀戮。我要阻止他们，$R……你就是我的武器。
text.completion: You have done well, brave $c.  I am pleased... but I am not yet satisfied.
text.completed: Return to Neptool at the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Atrocities
english.objectives: Slay 10 Bloodwash Barbarians and 10 Bloodwash Enchantresses.
english.description: <Though his lips do not move, you can feel the murloc chief speaking to you.>$b$bThe Bloodwash naga and the Rockpool murloc have lived among one another for as long as we could remember.  We have always had our differences, but never provoked one another.  Why, then, would they turn on us?$b$b<Neptool looks over his shoulder at his former villagers.>$b$bYou see what they do now?  They enslave us, sacrifice us, force us to fight one another.  I will stop them, $r... and you will be my weapon.
english.completion: You have done well, brave $c.  I am pleased... but I am not yet satisfied.
english.completed: Return to Neptool at the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 疯狂法师
text.objectives: 抽取疯狂法师提尔希的魔精。
text.description: 还有一件事我们不得不做。你必须让托尼在场的情况下，击败一名拥有强大魔精的人。$B$B不，不是我！$B$B老法师提尔希发了疯癫，试图阻挡大灾变的洪水来袭。现在他在据点南部阴魂不散。$B$B带上这根灵魂之杖，伙计，在他的躯体上使用，然后把托尼带回来，咱们就能开始复活他了。$B$B你可以用我的灵魂传送门过去和回来。
text.completion: Now we gonna bring Tony Two-Tusk back ta life. You both ready, mon?
text.completed: Return to Ajamon Ghostcaller at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: Extract his soul.

english.title: The Mad Magus
english.objectives: Extract the soul of Mad Magus Tirth.
english.description: There's only one ting left dat we can do. Ya gotta slay someone with the big mojo in Tony's presence.$B$BNo, not me!$B$BOl' Magus Tirth went crazy when he tried ta stop the waters rushin' in at the Cataclysm. Now he be hauntin' the area just south of the Holdfast.$B$BTake dis soul stick an' use it on his corpse, mon. Then bring Tony back an' we be gettin' him back in his body.$B$BYa can use me spirit portal ta get down there an' back.
english.completion: Now we gonna bring Tony Two-Tusk back ta life. You both ready, mon?
english.completed: Return to Ajamon Ghostcaller at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Extract his soul.

text.title: 虚假的偶像
text.objectives: 摧毁赤色海岸的8尊艾萨尔神像。
text.description: 猎潮者耐普图隆是我们的神。他也是血浪纳迦的神，但看来他们背叛了他。他们现在选择只崇拜艾萨拉，他们的纳迦女王。你可以在他们的聚居点周围找到由海石刻成的艾萨拉雕像。$B$B<鱼人看到你的武器，两眼放光。>$B$B那件武器不错。把他们的艾萨尔神像毁掉。得有人提醒他们，我们的父亲耐普图隆才是唯一一个真正的海洋统治者。
text.progress: Neptulon guide you, landwalker.
text.completion: You make an old murloc proud, $r. Thank you, and may the waves ever lap at your feet.
text.completed: Return to Neptool at the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: False Idols
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Azsh'ir Idols on the Red Reaches.
english.description: Neptulon the Tidehunter is our god.  He was the god of the Bloodwash, too, but they have turned their back on him, it seems.  They now choose to worship only Azshara, their naga queen.  You will see likenesses of Azshara littered around their settlements, carved out of seastone.$b$b<The murloc spirit eyes your weapon.>$b$bThat weapon will do.  Send it through their Azsh'ir idols.  They need to be reminded that our father Neptulon is the only one who truly rules the seas.
english.progress: Neptulon guide you, landwalker.
english.completion: You make an old murloc proud, $r. Thank you, and may the waves ever lap at your feet.
english.completed: Return to Neptool at the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 耐普托的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死8名血浪追随者、8名血浪狂热者、4名血浪赌徒，以及4名血浪崇拜者。
text.description: 无论死多少个纳迦，岩池部族都无法复生，但复仇多少能让我的人可以瞑目。$B$B许多更为强大的血浪纳迦在西北的洞穴里建起了要塞。以岩池的名义，杀掉他们。剩下的血浪纳迦在我们的海滩上竖起了角斗池和艾萨尔祭坛，让我的族人在里面互相残杀，崇拜他们的伪神。以猎潮者的名义，杀掉他们。
text.completion: The last Rockpool may be taken hostage today and killed tomorrow, landwalker... but they will pass into the underworld knowing that a brave $r avenged their death.  Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Neptool on the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Neptool's Revenge
english.objectives: Slay 8 Bloodwash Acolytes, 8 Bloodwash Zealots, 4 Bloodwash Gamblers, and 4 Bloodwash Idolaters.
english.description: No number of naga deaths will bring back the Rockpool tribe, but any amount of revenge will help the spirits of my people rest more easily.$b$bMany of the more powerful Bloodwash have set up a fortress in the caverns to the northwest.  Slay them, in the name of the Rockpool.  The remaining Bloodwash have erected gladiatorial pools and Azsh'ir altars on our beach, where they pit my people against one another and worship their false god.  Slay them, in the name of the Tidehunter.
english.completion: The last Rockpool may be taken hostage today and killed tomorrow, landwalker... but they will pass into the underworld knowing that a brave $r avenged their death.  Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Neptool on the Red Reaches in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 岩池的未来
text.objectives: 把被遗弃的血浪石箱拖到赤色海岸外的禁忌之海里。
text.description: 留在这只箱子里的岩池鱼人蝌蚪看上去又累又怕，几乎要干涸而死。他们需要被放回水里去，而且要快。$B$B也许你可以把箱子拖过海滩，放到远离赤色海岸的禁忌之海里去，那样他们才会有机会逃走，岩池鱼人才可以活下去……
text.objective1: Rockpool Tadpoles returned to the Forbidding Sea

english.title: The Future of the Rockpool
english.objectives: Drag the Abandoned Bloodwash Crate to the Forbidden Sea off the coast of the Red Reaches.
english.description: The Rockpool tadpoles left upon this crate appear tired, scared, and nearly dried out.  They need to be taken to the water, and quickly.$b$bPerhaps if you can drag this crate across the beach and into the Forbidden Sea, far off the coast of the Red Reaches, then they will have a chance of escaping, and the Rockpool murlocs may live on...
english.objective1: Rockpool Tadpoles returned to the Forbidding Sea

text.title: 我们逝去的朋友们
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩杀死13个溺死的吉尔尼斯人，释放他们的灵魂。
text.description: 基于你所告诉我的情报来判断，幸存者大概不多……只有一些不得安宁的灵魂。我们所能做的就只是让他们安息。$B$B<恩诺哈尔从盛满黑啤酒的杯子里喝了一大口。>$B$B回到破碎海滩去，战胜那些滞留的狼人鬼魂。这样就能把他们的灵魂从这个世界解放，去投胎转世。
text.completion: Aye, you've done well, lad.  You do the Alliance proud.
text.completed: Return to Enohar Thunderbrew at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Our Fallen Friends
english.objectives: Kill 13 Drowned Gilneans on the Shattershore to release their spirits.
english.description: Based on what you're telling me, it sounds like there aren't many survivors... just restless spirits.  The least we can do is give them their rest.$b$b<Enohar takes a long draw off of a mug of black ale.>$b$bHead back to the Shattershore and vanquish the worgen ghosts that still remain.  Doing so should release their spirit from this world and allow them to pass into the next.
english.completion: Aye, you've done well, lad.  You do the Alliance proud.
english.completed: Return to Enohar Thunderbrew at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 消减黑尾
text.objectives: 用恩诺哈尔的爆破箭矢在破碎海岸消灭20个黑尾拾骨者。
text.description: 船骸让我担心的另一件事就是闻风而来的秃鹫。这些鸟是干什么的就不用多说了，它们一定已经把骨头都啃干净了，但还是……还是不能让它们继续亵渎我们朋友们的尸体。$B$B我在学会酿酒之前就开始打猎了。给，拿上这把弓，更重要的，是这些箭矢。它们加了一点调和物，可以给那些啃骨头的一个惊喜。
text.completion: It's a tragedy, what happened on the Shattershore.  They weren't even soldiers... just people looking for a new home. I think we've done all we can, $n.
text.completed: Return to Enohar Thunderbrew at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Curtail the Darktail
english.objectives: Use Enohar's Explosive Arrows to slay 20 Darktail Bonepickers in the Shattershore.
english.description: The other thing that concerns me about those shipwrecks is all the vultures that they've attracted.  Knowing how those birds operate, they've already picked the bones clean, but still... we can't allow them to further desecrate the bodies of our friends.$b$bBefore I brewed, I hunted.  Here, take this bow, and more importantly, these arrows.  They've been laced with a little concoction that should give those bonepickers a surprise.
english.completion: It's a tragedy, what happened on the Shattershore.  They weren't even soldiers... just people looking for a new home. I think we've done all we can, $n.
english.completed: Return to Enohar Thunderbrew at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 小事一桩
text.objectives: 杀死诅咒之地守望堡外的一名欧卡里隆斥候。
text.description: 守望堡固若金汤，多年来对抗着污染这片土地的恶魔进攻。我们的守望永不结束，我们的警惕永不松懈，我们的勇气一往如前。$B$B黑暗之门打开以来，我们就坚守在这片土地上，但如今这些部落害虫居然敢无礼地妨碍我们！？我们保护自己的同时，也保护了他们！$B$B<朗格尔斯打量着你。>$B$B让我看看你是不是一块战斗的料。去杀掉一个部落派到我们防线上来动手动脚的欧卡里隆斥候。
text.completion: Hmm... not bad.  You're quicker than many of my men.  Stick around, $n... I may have use of you yet.
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Minor Distractions
english.objectives: Kill an Okril'lon Scout outside of Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Nethergarde has stood steadfast for years against the demon onslaught that plagues this land.  Our watch is never-ending, our vigilance unfaltering, and our courage bottomless.$b$bWe have held these lands since the portal opened, but now these Horde insects have the insolence to stand in our way!?  We have protected THEM as well as we have protected ourselves!$b$b<Lungertz looks you over.>$b$bLet's see if you've got a hand for combat.  Slay one of the Horde's Okril'lon scouts that nibble at our perimeter.
english.completion: Hmm... not bad.  You're quicker than many of my men.  Stick around, $n... I may have use of you yet.
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 消灭欧卡里隆
text.objectives: 杀掉守望堡补给营的9名欧卡里隆步兵。
text.description: 部落，我们要对付的部落真的让人很是头疼，而且他们比我们先前估计要更难对付的多。你必须阻止他们。$B$B在守望堡的西边，欧卡里隆的主力正在对我们的防御施压。他们目前占领着守望堡矿井，并且打算直取补给营，最终则是打算攻下守望堡。削减他们的数量，阻止他们的推进，$N。
text.completion: You're an excellent asset to the Alliance and the Kirin Tor, $n.  Well done. With time, our forces will retake the mine and press these Horde dogs out of the Blasted Lands.
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Eliminate the Okril'lon
english.objectives: Slay 9 Okril'lon Infantry at the Nethergarde Supply Camp.
english.description: The Horde are a nuisance that we will deal with, but they are proving more difficult than previously expected.  You are to put a stop to this.$b$bTo the west of Nethergarde, the Okril'lon main forces press on our defenses.  They currently hold the Nethergarde Mines, and they mean to move into the supply camps and, eventually, the Keep.  Thin their numbers and delay their advance, $N.
english.completion: You're an excellent asset to the Alliance and the Kirin Tor, $n.  Well done. With time, our forces will retake the mine and press these Horde dogs out of the Blasted Lands.
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 守望堡的统治
text.objectives: 杀掉守望堡补给营的梅特勒克上尉。
text.description: 朗格尔斯是个强势的领袖，但他太骄傲。他低估了部落对我们施加的压力。没有矿井……守望堡就一文不值。$B$B我们现在就要把部落军队从补给营赶出去，这就意味着要杀掉他们的指挥官梅特勒克上尉。他不是一个强势的领袖，喜欢躲在阵线后方发号施令。但即便如此，我们也要他死。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  Thanks to your efforts, I am confident that with time, we will take back the Nethergarde Mine.
text.completed: Return to Leyan Steelson at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Nethergarde Reigns
english.objectives: Slay Captain Metlek at the Nethergarde Supply Camp.
english.description: Lungertz is a strong leader, but he is proud.  He understates the pressure that the Horde is really putting on us.  Without our mine... Nethergarde is penniless.$b$bWe need to move the Horde forces from the supply camp NOW, and doing so means killing their commander, Captain Metlek.  He's not a strong leader, and prefers to bark orders from the back lines, but even so, his death might buy us the victory we need.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  Thanks to your efforts, I am confident that with time, we will take back the Nethergarde Mine.
english.completed: Return to Leyan Steelson at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 解除他们的武装
text.objectives: 对守望堡补给营的8个欧卡里隆的武器箱使用巴顿威洛的手榴弹。$B$B一定要在与目标有一定距离的地方使用手榴弹，否则你也要挨炸。
text.description: 你好……$N，是你吗？我对你有一个有关炸药的提议。感兴趣吗？$B$B我不小心听到了你和军需官的对话。你看……我一直在研究一种爆破装置。它对其他生物不是很有效，但对于军械来说却是毁灭性的。如果你到战场上去拜访那些兽人的话，顺便找到敌人的补给，再试试这东西。谁知道呢……也许他们也喜欢爆炸。
text.completion: Ahh, the sound of things going boom makes my heart pitter-pat.  You've made this gnome's day, $n.
text.completed: Return to Buttonwillow McKittrick at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Remove Their Arms
english.objectives: Use Buttonwillow's Hand Grenade on 8 Okril'lon Weapons Crates in the Nethergarde Supply Camp.$b$bMake sure to use the grenades from afar, or you will be blasted.
english.description: Say there... $N, is it?  I've got a proposition for you which involves explosions.  Interested?$b$bI couldn't help but overhear your conversation with the quartermaster.  You see... I've been working on an explosive device.  It's not very effective against other creatures, but devastating against artillery.  If you're heading back into the field to visit those orcs, find some enemy supplies and give this thing a try.  Who knows... maybe they like explosions too.
english.completion: Ahh, the sound of things going boom makes my heart pitter-pat.  You've made this gnome's day, $n.
english.completed: Return to Buttonwillow McKittrick at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 看守者马哈尔巴
text.objectives: 去找守望堡法师塔里的看守者马哈尔巴。
text.description: 是时候让你去拜访看守者了。他最近有一点情绪化，我不知道原因是什么。$B$B到法师塔顶上去找他吧。我这里没什么事要交给你做了，不过我相信他会有事的。
text.completion: My associates were correct to send you to me.  I have a problem which may threaten the sanctity of Nethergarde, and I need someone more capable than most.

english.title: Watcher Mahar Ba
english.objectives: Report to Watcher Mahar Ba in the mage tower at Nethergarde Keep.
english.description: It's time for you to visit the Watcher.  He's been in a bit of a mood lately, and I'm not quite sure why.$b$bHead up to the top of the mage tower and check in with him.  I don't have any work for you here, but I'm certain that he will.
english.completion: My associates were correct to send you to me.  I have a problem which may threaten the sanctity of Nethergarde, and I need someone more capable than most.

text.title: 近距离观察
text.objectives: 侦查诅咒之地破碎海岸的失事船只。
text.description: 我们已经看到无数的船只驶过海岸，前往东南方，大多数都没什么问题。不过，几天前，一场强大的风暴让几艘船在海岸上搁浅了。$B$B要不是我热爱守望堡烈酒，我就赌一品脱守望堡烈酒，它们肯定是部落的船只。不过，如果你能去查看一下那些船，再回来报告给我，我可以付你钱。
text.completion: You saw worgen?  That's bad. Worgen ghosts?  That's even worse. Those weren't Horde ships... they were Gilnean.  And they must have been headed down to Surwich, at the bottom of the Tainted Forest.  That makes a lot more sense. We've got to try to help them, $n!  The worgen are our allies!
text.end: Scout the ships on the Shattershore
text.completed: Return to Enohar Thunderbrew in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: A Closer Look
english.objectives: Scout out the crashed ships on the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: We've seen countless ships sail past the shore to the southeast, but most pass by inconspicuously.  Several days ago, however, a powerful storm carried several of the ships to shore and left them wrecked.$b$bI'd bet a pint of Nethergarde Bitter that they were Horde ships if I didn't love Nethergarde Bitter so much.  I can pay you gold, though, if you'll go check out those ships and report back.
english.completion: You saw worgen?  That's bad. Worgen ghosts?  That's even worse. Those weren't Horde ships... they were Gilnean.  And they must have been headed down to Surwich, at the bottom of the Tainted Forest.  That makes a lot more sense. We've got to try to help them, $n!  The worgen are our allies!
english.end: Scout the ships on the Shattershore
english.completed: Return to Enohar Thunderbrew in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 门口的邪教徒
text.objectives: 从诅咒之地的魔誓魔剑士和魔誓神秘学者身上获得6颗完好的魔誓法术核心。
text.description: 你多半已经遇见过那些居住在守望堡西南边的魔誓教徒了吧。他们没有对堡垒构成直接威胁，但我怀疑他们是不是在谋划什么你想象不到的可怕事情。$B$B在低级成员所携带的法术核心上也许能够找到答案。假如你能把它们从邪教徒的手里抢过来的话，就给我带一些完好无损的回来。
text.progress: The cultists will not part easily with their foci.  Slay them quickly before they suspect our intent.
text.completion: Ably done, $n.  Now we see if my suspicions are correct.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Mahar Ba at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Cultists at our Doorstep
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Intact Shadowsworn Spell Foci from Shadowsworn Spellblades and Shadowsworn Occultists in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: You may have already run into some of the Shadowsworn cultists that dwell in the caves just to the southwest of Nethergarde.  They do not impress an immediate danger upon our fortress, but I fear that they are planning something more dreadful than you can imagine.$b$bThe low-ranking members carry spell foci that might hold an answer.  Bring some back to me intact, if you can wrench them from the cultists' hands.
english.progress: The cultists will not part easily with their foci.  Slay them quickly before they suspect our intent.
english.completion: Ably done, $n.  Now we see if my suspicions are correct.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Mahar Ba at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 恶魔和德鲁伊
text.objectives: 在腐烂森林里杀死5个厄运守卫毁灭者、5个恐惧领主污染者、5个堕落的黑木树人和3个邪孢沼泽领主。
text.description: 神圣遗物学会的宗旨是收集和保存魔法圣物。我们这支远征队的目标是回收一些恶魔圣物，它们就藏在那片曾被称为腐烂之痕的土地上。$B$B一个狼人德鲁伊在腐烂之痕定居了下来，并种植了一片森林。不过他好像失败了，那片地区仍然有大量恶魔肆虐。$B$B不管怎样，他的森林和那些恶魔都挡了我们的道。去干掉那些被腐蚀的怪物，然后回来找我，我们来想办法对付那个德鲁伊。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. I should be a bit more up-front with you.  The demons were a nuisance, but they are not the real problem.  That worgen druid is our problem.
text.completed: Return to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Demons and the Druid
english.objectives: Kill 5 Doomguard Destroyers, 5 Dreadlord Defilers, 5 Corrupted Darkwood Treants, and 3 Felspore Bog Lords in the Tainted Forest.
english.description: The Reliquary is focused on the acquisition and preservation of magical artifacts.  Our particular excursion is focused on the demonic artifacts that are hidden in what used to be the Tainted Scar.$b$bA worgen druid has taken residence in the scar and is coaxing a forest to grow.  He seems to be failing, however, as the area is still infested with demons.$b$bAnyhow, his forest stands in the way of our excursion, as do these demons.  Slay the tainted ones, then return to me so we might deal with the druid.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. I should be a bit more up-front with you.  The demons were a nuisance, but they are not the real problem.  That worgen druid is our problem.
english.completed: Return to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 最佳方案
text.objectives: 向诅咒之地日纱考察营地的埃莉雅·暮翔报到。
text.description: 你在下面把那些恶魔杀得落花流水的时候，我们的斥候终于有机会仔细观察了一下那个德鲁伊。情报表明，他的名字叫玛尔·虫棘……一个力量强大的吉尔尼斯云游德鲁伊。他就住在森林中间的那棵扭曲的巨树玛尔卓斯中，有某种奇怪的力量保护他免受伤害。至于那种力量究竟是恶魔的还是自然的，我们还不知道。$B$B去跟埃莉雅谈谈吧，他也许有更多情报与你分享。
text.completion: Rohan's sending YOU to slay his druid?  Very well. You should know: Marl Wormthorn is as much demon as he is druid.  Even a druid of his power doesn't have a chance against the demonic energies that run so deeply through this land.  That does not, however, make him any less of an obstacle.

english.title: How Best to Proceed
english.objectives: Report to Elijah Dawnflight at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Your demon-slaying down there bought our scouts enough time to get a good look at that druid.  My intelligence tells me that his name is Marl Wormthorn... a rogue Gilnean druid of substantial power.  He resides in Maldraz, the large, twisted tree at the center of the forest, and is protected from harm by some strange force.  Whether that force is of demonic or natural sources, we have yet to determine.$b$bSpeak with Elijah.  He may have some more information for you.
english.completion: Rohan's sending YOU to slay his druid?  Very well. You should know: Marl Wormthorn is as much demon as he is druid.  Even a druid of his power doesn't have a chance against the demonic energies that run so deeply through this land.  That does not, however, make him any less of an obstacle.

text.title: 魔能容器
text.objectives: 在腐烂森林里杀死腐烂的黑熊、腐烂的夜行蜘蛛和腐烂的尖啸蝙蝠，并将它们的肢体组合成魔能容器。
text.description: 我们要想办法吸引虫棘的注意力，某种打断他的沉睡的办法，某种一定会奏效的办法。$B$B能在腐烂森林生存的少数几种野生动物无疑受到了这里能量的影响。你的任务就是收集它们的肢体，想办法把它们组合成一具容器。如果虫棘的沉睡是德鲁伊式的，甚至是恶魔式的，一个足够大的、由腐蚀的动物躯体组成的容器就足以打破它。
text.progress: Dawnflight's plan is a good one.  Do you have the vessel, $n?
text.completion: Brilliantly done, $n.  We have what we need to break the worgen's trance.
text.completed: Return to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Demoniac Vessel
english.objectives: Kill the Tainted Black Bears, Tainted Nightstalkers, and Tainted Screechers in the Tainted Forest, and try to assemble their parts into a Demoniac Vessel.
english.description: We need a way to get Wormthorn's attention.  Something to break him out of his trance.  Something that's guaranteed to work.$b$bThe few types of wildlife that managed to make a foothold in the Tainted Forest are, without a doubt, affected by the land's latent energies.  Your task is to collect their body parts and find a way to combine them into a vessel.  If Wormthorn's trance is druidic, or even if it is demonic, a large enough vessel of tainted animal flesh should be able to break it.
english.progress: Dawnflight's plan is a good one.  Do you have the vessel, $n?
english.completion: Brilliantly done, $n.  We have what we need to break the worgen's trance.
english.completed: Return to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 玛尔·虫棘之死
text.objectives: 在诅咒之地的玛尔卓斯杀死玛尔·虫棘。你可以使用魔能容器打断他的沉睡。
text.description: 虫棘的那片非自然的森林威胁着我们的工作。他的树木用根须毁坏我们的锄头，他的苔藓长满了我们的挖掘场，他的野兽袭击我的下属。为了挖掘，把这片森林变成恶魔横行的废土也无所谓。$B$B拿着魔能容器，对玛尔·虫棘使用它，打断他的沉睡。解决掉他之后再回来找我。
text.completion: Hopefully, with this druid out of the picture, we can get back to our digging.  The world is full of powerful artifacts, $n.  You just need to be willing to do what it takes to get to them. Feel free to take one of these.  The Reliquary is always happy to share some of its trove with fellow members of the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.
text.giverWindow: When the demons took his mind, all hope was lost.

english.title: The Downfall of Marl Wormthorn
english.objectives: Kill Marl Wormthorn at Maldraz in the Blasted Lands.  You can use the Demoniac Vessel to pull him out of his trance.
english.description: Wormthorn's unnatural forest threatens our excursion's progress.  His trees' roots break our picks, his moss grows over our excavation sites, and his animals attack my men.  When it comes to digging, I'll take a demon-infested wasteland over a forest any day.$b$bTake the demoniac vessel and use it on Marl Wormthorn to pull him from his trance.  Return to me when he is no more.
english.completion: Hopefully, with this druid out of the picture, we can get back to our digging.  The world is full of powerful artifacts, $n.  You just need to be willing to do what it takes to get to them. Feel free to take one of these.  The Reliquary is always happy to share some of its trove with fellow members of the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Rohan Sunveil at the Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands.
english.giverWindow: When the demons took his mind, all hope was lost.

text.title: 抗击洪水
text.objectives: 摧毁10名洪水元素。
text.description: 我来这儿就是因为穆拉丁他老人家知道，勘测队里得有人让这些懒散的家伙皮绷紧点儿。他们都被这儿的活物吓得啥都干不了！要是想让他们动起来，就非得清理清理不可。$B$B首先，元素就是个麻烦。大水让我们吃足了苦头，还不依不饶。$B$B我打赌你以前从没试过抽醒一片湖吧，我要让你干的就是这个。去好好抽打抽打那些元素。
text.completion: Well I'll be. There's someone around here that isn't a disgrace to Magni, bless his poor gravelly heart.$B$BJust for that, you get first crack at the ale, $glad:lass;. But don't let it get to your bloody head! We've got more gorram work to do, and I won't tolerate you lettin' up early!
text.completed: Return to Forba Slabchisel at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

english.title: Fight the Flood
english.objectives: Kill 10 Flood Elementals.
english.description: I'm here because Muradin himself knew that this survey needed someone to keep these buffoons on their toes. They're all too scared of the wildlife to do a thing! If I'm to get them off their duffs, I'm going to need some cleanup done.$B$BWe've got an elemental problem, first off. The flood did such a number here that the water itself's gone hysterical.$B$BI bet you've never slapped the sense into an entire lake before, but I'm askin' it of you now. Whallop those elementals but good for me.
english.completion: Well I'll be. There's someone around here that isn't a disgrace to Magni, bless his poor gravelly heart.$B$BJust for that, you get first crack at the ale, $glad:lass;. But don't let it get to your bloody head! We've got more gorram work to do, and I won't tolerate you lettin' up early!
english.completed: Return to Forba Slabchisel at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

text.title: 沉淀，我亲爱的。
text.objectives: 收集8份洪水沉淀物样本。
text.description: 巨石水坝决口可不是小事，$G小子:姑娘;。我们来这儿就是调查损害有多大的。大水在这里横行，要是对大地造成了过度的侵扰，之后我们的麻烦可就大了。$B$B研究涝区的沉积物可以获得许多有用的信息。我需要尽可能多的土壤样本，要是你能去给我收集一些来，那就再好不过了。
text.progress: Let's see the sediment, then.
text.completion: Ah, well. The good news is, these will do perfectly. The bad news is I can tell they're the wrong color for topsoil here, even drunk as I am.$B$BThat means things aren't looking good for the area, $n. But we've got more tests to run before we hang up the towel.
text.completed: Return to Surveyor Thurdan at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

english.title: Sedimentary, My Dear
english.objectives: Collect 8 Flood Sediment Samples.
english.description: The destruction of the Stonewrought Dam was no small thing, $glad:lass;. We're here to find out just how bad the damage is. A mighty load of water's rampaged through here, and if it's disturbed the earth too far, we could be in for worse later on.$B$BWe can tell a lot from studying the sediment of the flooded area. I need as many soil samples as I can get, so if you could head out there and collect some more, I'd much appreciate it.
english.progress: Let's see the sediment, then.
english.completion: Ah, well. The good news is, these will do perfectly. The bad news is I can tell they're the wrong color for topsoil here, even drunk as I am.$B$BThat means things aren't looking good for the area, $n. But we've got more tests to run before we hang up the towel.
english.completed: Return to Surveyor Thurdan at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

text.title: 碰运气
text.objectives: 从被迫迁徙的蛇颈龙身上割下8块蛇颈龙肉块。
text.description: The local wildlife's all messed up from the flood, it seems. This fen used to be full of crocolisks, but I haven't spotted a single one.$B$BWhat I have spotted are threshadons. Never used to be any here, so the flood must've swept them all right out of Loch Modan.$B$BLucky for us, because they're tastier than crocolisks, and I'm running low on provisions. Bring me back some Threshadon meat for the camp, and I'll gladly pay you for it.
text.progress: Are they meaty ones? Let's have a look.
text.completion: Lovely. These'll fry up nice, and the camp'll be spared a week of mushroom biscuits.
text.completed: Return to Dunlor Marblebeard at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

english.title: Thresh Out of Luck
english.objectives: Collect 8 Threshadon Chunks from Displaced Threshadons.
english.description: The local wildlife's all messed up from the flood, it seems. This fen used to be full of crocolisks, but I haven't spotted a single one.$B$BWhat I have spotted are threshadons. Never used to be any here, so the flood must've swept them all right out of Loch Modan.$B$BLucky for us, because they're tastier than crocolisks, and I'm running low on provisions. Bring me back some Threshadon meat for the camp, and I'll gladly pay you for it.
english.progress: Are they meaty ones? Let's have a look.
english.completion: Lovely. These'll fry up nice, and the camp'll be spared a week of mushroom biscuits.
english.completed: Return to Dunlor Marblebeard at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

text.title: 霜鬃的挑衅
text.objectives: Kill 5 Frostmane Seers and 7 Frostmane Snowstriders on Shimmer Ridge
text.description: 大灾变让丹莫罗的力量平衡变得很不明朗，$N。诺莫瑞根附近的洞穴里，一波穴居人毫无预兆地出现，打退了霜鬃巨魔。这些巨魔从此就在东边扎下了根。$B$B往常西北边的闪光岭总有巨魔出现，然而随着迁移，巨魔现在把我们包围了。我们不能让巨魔占据地利。我的人在东边守住阵线，你去攻打闪光岭。
text.completion: We should be able to focus our efforts on the rest of the trolls to the east, but there's still the matter of the wendigos in the Grizzled Den.
text.completed: Return to Captain Tharran at Kharanos.

english.title: Frostmane Aggression
english.objectives: Kill 5 Frostmane Seers and 7 Frostmane Snowstriders on Shimmer Ridge
english.description: The cataclysm has thrown the balance of power in Dun Morogh into question, $N. Without warning, a wave of troggs emerged from the caves near Gnomeregan and overran the Frostmane trolls. The trolls have been migrating east ever since.$B$BThere has always been a Frostmane presence up on Shimmer Ridge, to the northwest, but with the migration, the trolls now surround us. We can't allow the trolls to use this position to their advantage. While my men hold the line in the east, strike against Shimmer Ridge.
english.completion: We should be able to focus our efforts on the rest of the trolls to the east, but there's still the matter of the wendigos in the Grizzled Den.
english.completed: Return to Captain Tharran at Kharanos.

text.title: 越橘
text.objectives: 采集15捧越橘。
text.description: 我们口粮还够，但药品有点稀缺。营地的一半都倒下了，药物还在走程序。$B$B好在我亲爱的老娘教过我一个偏方，只要几种当地的材料就成。$B$B可以的话，帮我找些越橘来。它们通常长在潮湿阴凉的地方，所以去岸边和植物旁多找找。
text.progress: How much've you got?
text.completion: These'll do nicely. I'll have the lads back on their feet as soon as I make these somewhat edible.
text.completed: Return to Dunlor Marblebeard at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

english.title: Fenbush Berries
english.objectives: Collect 15 Handfuls of Fenberries.
english.description: We're good on provisions, but we're in need of some medicine. Half the camp's fiercely hung over, and a remedy's in order.$B$BLuckily, I know a good folk remedy taught to me by my dear old mum. We just need some local ingredients.$B$BGather me some fenbush berries, if you would. They keep to where there's water and shade, so look along the shore and near other plants.
english.progress: How much've you got?
english.completion: These'll do nicely. I'll have the lads back on their feet as soon as I make these somewhat edible.
english.completed: Return to Dunlor Marblebeard at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

text.title: 水准活儿
text.objectives: 从一只滑腻淤泥怪的身上拿到水准仪。
text.description: 好吧，我要你把我的水准仪找来。$B$B看什么看？没错！我说的就是水准仪！它是一件很重要的勘测仪器！$B$B该死的名字又不是我起的，行了吧？去找！我就是把它搁在了石头上，结果给一只要命的软泥怪上来一口给吞了。那地方全是软泥怪，不过东西肯定还在其中一只的肚子里。
text.progress: Did you find the dumpy?
text.completion: Oh good, it's undamaged! Thanks a lot.$B$BYou ah, you might want to wipe yourself off a bit there.
text.completed: Return to Surveyor Thurdan at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

english.title: A Dumpy Job
english.objectives: Obtain a Dumpy Level from a Silty Ooze.
english.description: Alright, I need you to help me find my dumpy level.$B$BWhat's that look for? That's right! I said my dumpy level! It's a piece of significant surveying equipment!$B$BI didn't name the bloody thing, alright? Go look it up! All I did was leave it on a rock long enough for one of those horrible oozes to swallow it up. The place is crawling with 'em, but one of them should still have it inside.
english.progress: Did you find the dumpy?
english.completion: Oh good, it's undamaged! Thanks a lot.$B$BYou ah, you might want to wipe yourself off a bit there.
english.completed: Return to Surveyor Thurdan at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

text.title: 杜隆格·怒视
text.objectives: 杀死杜隆格·怒视，割下他的胡子。
text.description: 黑铁氏族没安好心。要是这让你吃惊，那你就比帐篷里那些脑子坏了的公子哥儿还要蠢。穆拉丁在铁炉堡给这些黑蛋子说得好听，在这儿什么都不算数。$B$B营地昨晚遭到了一次袭击，一次就够了。他们的首领是个叫怒视的大块头，就藏在河水南岸的洞穴里。$B$B把怒视的胡子带来，好证明他对铁炉堡不再构成威胁。
text.progress: Let's see it, then.
text.completion: Good riddance to bad rubbish! I'll burn the foul thing later so it doesn't stink up the camp.
text.completed: Return to Forba Slabchisel at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.
text.giverWindow: Get his beard.  That's right, his beard.

english.title: Drungeld Glowerglare
english.objectives: Kill Drungeld Glowerglare and take his beard.
english.description: The Dark Iron clan is up to no good out here. And if that surprises you, you're thicker than the addled blotters over in that tent. Muradin may pay lip service to those sooty cretins back in Ironforge, but out here all bets are off.$B$BWe had a raid against the camp last night, and one raid is too many. Their leader's a stout fellow by the name of Glowerglare, and he's hiding in the cave on the south bank of the river.$B$BBring me Glowerglare's beard as proof he's no longer a threat to us and Ironforge.
english.progress: Let's see it, then.
english.completion: Good riddance to bad rubbish! I'll burn the foul thing later so it doesn't stink up the camp.
english.completed: Return to Forba Slabchisel at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.
english.giverWindow: Get his beard.  That's right, his beard.

text.title: 水泡先生的狂野之旅
text.objectives: 击败20名地精技师和5名地精收割者。
text.description: 现在水泡先生需要天使来帮他导航。你愿意做那个天使吗，$G先生:小姐;？有你帮忙，我们就能到峭壁里去消灭大群大群的部落！你怎么说？来嘛，$G先生:小姐;！真的求求你了好不好了啦？$B$B如果我们消灭足够多的部落，法罗米尔会给我们大家买冰激凌！
text.completion: This is awkward... Good job out there with the robot. You caught me a little off guard. I didn't realize the little girl was so... Special... Well, whatever gets the job done, right? Am I right? Probably. Have some ice cream.
text.completed: 跟石爪山脉风剪要塞的指挥官法罗米尔谈一谈。

english.title: Mr. P's Wild Ride
english.objectives: Kill 20 Goblin Technicians and 5 Goblin Harvesters.
english.description: Now Mr. P just needs an angel to help him navigate. Will you be that angel, $g mister:miss;? With you helping we can go out into the crag and kill bunches and bunches of Horde! Waddya say? Come on, $g mister:miss;! PRETTY PLEASE WITH SUGAR ON TOP?$B$BIf we kill enough Horde, Mr. Fallowmere will buy us all ice cream!
english.completion: This is awkward... Good job out there with the robot. You caught me a little off guard. I didn't realize the little girl was so... Special... Well, whatever gets the job done, right? Am I right? Probably. Have some ice cream.
english.completed: Speak to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 叛徒格雷苏
text.objectives: 杀死格雷苏。
text.description: <伴随着巨大的蜂鸣声，侏儒通讯器响了起来。>$B$B回话，$N！你在吗？我在地图上注意到你目前就在峭壁湖水车附近，是否正确？$B$B似乎风险投资公司在水车那儿有所驻扎。到那里留意一下。如果你碰巧遇见一个叫做格雷苏的叛变侏儒，请代表我和替诺莫瑞根好好地教训他一顿。我会出大价钱的！
text.completion: Vonderful! That's von more name I can scratch off of my list! I vill be in touch. Xakxak, out!
text.giverWindow: You vill be taking care of ze gnome, yes?
text.turninWindow: You kill vith a passion!  Zuperb!

english.title: Gerenzo the Traitor
english.objectives: Kill Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle.
english.description: <The Gnomecorder comes to life with a loud buzz.>$B$BCome in, $N! Are you zhere? I have noted on ze map that you are near ze Cragpool Lake vater vheel, is that correct?$B$BIt vould appear that ze Venture Co. has holed up at ze vheel. Have a look around vhile you are up zhere. If you happen to zee a traitorous gnome by ze name of Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, put your boot firmly up his keester for me and for Gnomeregan! I vill pay handsomely!
english.completion: Vonderful! That's von more name I can scratch off of my list! I vill be in touch. Xakxak, out!
english.giverWindow: You vill be taking care of ze gnome, yes?
english.turninWindow: You kill vith a passion!  Zuperb!

text.title: 当心峭颚！
text.objectives: 杀死峭颚，拿到峭颚的巨齿。
text.description: 那些不想被一条真的很大的鱼吞掉的人下令，峭壁湖禁止入内！不知什么人把一条巨大的食矮人鱼放在了湖里。$B$B强烈建议你别插手，不过，要是你是那种喜欢逞英雄的，又有几个朋友在身边，那么帮我们大家一个忙，杀掉那该死的玩意！也许我到时候可以钓个鱼什么的，嗯？$B$B你要是真的办成了，就到风剪要塞来找我要奖赏。$B$B——老铁羊
text.progress: You kill the beast?
text.completion: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle. You actually got the beast, eh? Well, a deal's a deal! Here's your reward!
text.completed: Return Cragjaw's Huge Tooth to Ol' Irongoat at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mounts.

english.title: BEWARE OF CRAGJAW!
english.objectives: Kill Cragjaw and take Cragjaw's Huge Tooth.
english.description: By order of people not wanting to get themselves devoured whole by a really huge fish, Cragpool Lake is OFF-LIMITS! Someone decided to up and put a huge, dwarf-eating fish in the lake.$B$BIt is strongly recommended that you stay out, however, if you are the heroic type and have a few friends around, do us all a favor and kill the damned thing! Maybe I can get some fishing done then, eh?$B$BIf you manage to actually do it, meet me back at Windshear Hold for a reward.$B$B-Ol' Irongoat
english.progress: You kill the beast?
english.completion: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle. You actually got the beast, eh? Well, a deal's a deal! Here's your reward!
english.completed: Return Cragjaw's Huge Tooth to Ol' Irongoat at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mounts.

text.title: 一鸟在手
text.objectives: 熄灭一处鹰身人烽火吸引玛瑞恩·虫翅前来。同她交战直到希萨莉制服她，然后讯问这个鹰身人主母。
text.description: It's time to get to the bottom of this. We need to interrogate the matron of these beasts, Marion Wormwing. We'll capture her alive. Here's the plan:$B$BThe Harpies communicate across the ridge using a series of signal fires. If we extinguish one, Marion is sure to come investigate.$B$BYou fight her as a distraction while I sneak up behind and grab her. I'll leave the questioning to you. Let's get her, $N!
text.completion: So the Harpies are tools of some sort of dragon - "Sethria." But what are the dragons doing to those eggs? And what's this 'special' egg that Sethria wanted so badly? This is beyond me, $n. I've given a report to Skylord Omnuron - he'll know what to do next.
text.completed: Meet Thisalee Crow back at Aviana's Shrine in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: Just lure her out and start fighting. I'll sneak up behind her and take care of the rest.

english.title: A Bird in Hand
english.objectives: Extinguish a Harpy Signal Fire to get the attention of Marion Wormwing. Fight her until Thisalee subdues her, then question the harpy matron.
english.description: It's time to get to the bottom of this. We need to interrogate the matron of these beasts, Marion Wormwing. We'll capture her alive. Here's the plan:$B$BThe Harpies communicate across the ridge using a series of signal fires. If we extinguish one, Marion is sure to come investigate.$B$BYou fight her as a distraction while I sneak up behind and grab her. I'll leave the questioning to you. Let's get her, $N!
english.completion: So the Harpies are tools of some sort of dragon - "Sethria." But what are the dragons doing to those eggs? And what's this 'special' egg that Sethria wanted so badly? This is beyond me, $n. I've given a report to Skylord Omnuron - he'll know what to do next.
english.completed: Meet Thisalee Crow back at Aviana's Shrine in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Just lure her out and start fighting. I'll sneak up behind her and take care of the rest.

text.title: 解除诅咒
text.objectives: 巴德要你从戈博格海崖的戈博格大王那里获得锡镴古锤。
text.description: 我们成功了！$B$B利颚已死，我也拿到了宝贝！$B$B这是好消息。$B$B该死的宝贝受了诅咒——会把所有接触过它的人变成骷髅。$B$B这是坏消息。$B$B这些受诅咒的海盗说海地精国王有办法移除诅咒。$B$B这是好消息。$B$B我一步也不能走出暗礁去，否则就会被永远诅咒。$B$B这是坏消息。
text.progress: So, $r... You gunna remove this curse, or what?
text.completion: This is it? How is this gunna remove - wait a minute...
text.completed: Speak with Budd in The Skeletal Reef in Kelp'thar Forest.
text.giverWindow: Come and get it!

english.title: A Bone to Pick
english.objectives: Budd wants you to collect the Pewter Pounder from King Gurboggle at Gurboggle's Ledge.
english.description: We did it!$b$bGnaws is down, and I have our shiney!$b$bThat's good news.$b$bDarn shiney is cursed treasure - makes everyone who touches it a skeleton.$b$bThat's bad news.$b$bThese cursed pirates say the Gilblin King has the secret to remove the hex.$b$bThat's good news.$b$bI can't step foot outside the reef or I'll be cursed forever.$b$bThat's bad news.
english.progress: So, $r... You gunna remove this curse, or what?
english.completion: This is it? How is this gunna remove - wait a minute...
english.completed: Speak with Budd in The Skeletal Reef in Kelp'thar Forest.
english.giverWindow: Come and get it!

text.title: 滚出去，捕猎者
text.objectives: 杀死7只洞穴捕猎者和7只吸血捕猎者。
text.description: 瑟根石是很个重要的地方，我们需要在这里对基岩构成进行研究。$B$B当然，事情没那么简单，因为瑟根石到处都是巨大的洞穴捕猎者。跟矮人差不多大，胃口好两倍。正如我所说的那样，这些漂亮小伙儿是研究学问的，不是舞刀弄枪的。所以要想让他们干些什么，你得先帮我把那些恶心的虫子清出去。$B$B尽可能地把那些玩意儿给干掉，我不会亏待你的。
text.completion: Good job. I wouldn't be surprised if the horrid things had eggs in there somewhere, but it'll do for now.
text.completed: Return to Forba Slabchisel at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

english.title: Get Out Of Here, Stalkers
english.objectives: Kill 7 Cave Stalkers and 7 Leech Stalkers.
english.description: Thelgen Rock's an important site here. We need to use it to study the bedrock formations an' such.$B$BOf course, it can't be that easy, so Thelgen Rock's also full of giant cave stalkers. Big as a dwarf and twice as hungry. Like I said, these fancy-lads are researchers, not warriors, so if I want them to get anything done you're gonna have to help me clear the filthy bugs out.$B$BKill as many of the blighters as you can and I'll make it worth your while, $n.
english.completion: Good job. I wouldn't be surprised if the horrid things had eggs in there somewhere, but it'll do for now.
english.completed: Return to Forba Slabchisel at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

text.title: 深入瑟根石
text.objectives: 从瑟根石回收瑟根地震记录。
text.description: 好像不那么晕乎了，所以我打算把仪器架起来进行最终测量。不过还有一件事要你帮忙。$B$B瑟根石深处设置了一架记录地下运动的测震仪。要是大灾变后下面还有什么动静，这东西会告诉我们。$B$B测震仪就在洞穴的最深处，找到它把数据记录带给我。
text.progress: Let's see what we've got, aye?
text.completion: Wonderful, $glad:lass;. This should be all we need. Let's have a look.
text.completed: Return to Surveyor Thurdan at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

english.title: Down In Thelgen Rock
english.objectives: Retrieve the Thelgen Seismic Record from Thelgen Rock.
english.description: I'm feeling slightly less wobbly now, so I'm going to start setting up the level for my final measurements here. There's one last thing I need from you.$B$BThere's a seismograph set up deep within Thelgen Rock to record any movements in the earth. If things have been continuing to shift since the cataclysm, this'll tell us.$B$BThe seismograph's at the very bottom of the cave; find it and bring the record it's created back to me.
english.progress: Let's see what we've got, aye?
english.completion: Wonderful, $glad:lass;. This should be all we need. Let's have a look.
english.completed: Return to Surveyor Thurdan at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.
